  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS si_number text,

  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS store_branch text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS expiry_date date,

  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_document_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS google_drive_folder_url text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS google_drive_folder_id text;

--- START FILE: add_photos_and_gps_schema.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- 1. ADD REASON, PHOTOS & GPS COLUMNS TO rma_reports
-- ==============================================================================
ALTER TABLE public.rma_reports 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS reason text DEFAULT 'Damaged in Transit / Crushed',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS explanation text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS photos jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gps_latitude numeric(10,7),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gps_longitude numeric(10,7),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gps_accuracy numeric(8,2),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS gps_timestamp timestamptz;

-- ==============================================================================
-- 2. CREATE SUPABASE STORAGE BUCKET FOR PROOF PHOTOS ('rma-photos')
-- ==============================================================================
INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public) 
VALUES ('rma-photos', 'rma-photos', true)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET public = true;

-- Allow public uploads to 'rma-photos'
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public uploads to rma-photos" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "Allow public uploads to rma-photos" ON storage.objects
  FOR INSERT TO anon, authenticated, service_role
  WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'rma-photos');

-- Allow public reads from 'rma-photos'
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public reads from rma-photos" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "Allow public reads from rma-photos" ON storage.objects
  FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated, service_role
  USING (bucket_id = 'rma-photos');

--- END FILE: add_photos_and_gps_schema.sql ---

--- START FILE: consolidated_enterprise_qa_migration.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- WHOLESALE RMA PORTAL V2 - CONSOLIDATED ENTERPRISE QA MIGRATION
-- Run this complete, idempotent script in Supabase:
-- Dashboard > SQL Editor > New query > Paste & Run
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. PATCH rma_reports TABLE WITH ENTERPRISE LOGISTICS & TRIAGE COLUMNS
ALTER TABLE public.rma_reports 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS condition_grade text DEFAULT 'B - Damaged Packaging Only',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS disposition text DEFAULT 'Pending Triage',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS warehouse_location text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS inspected_by text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS inspected_at timestamptz,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS audit_trail jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ae_name text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ae_email text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS company text;

-- Fast Lookup Indexes for rma_reports
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_barcode ON public.rma_reports(barcode);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_status ON public.rma_reports(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_disposition ON public.rma_reports(disposition);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_condition_grade ON public.rma_reports(condition_grade);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_warehouse_location ON public.rma_reports(warehouse_location);

-- Permissions & Delete Policy for rma_reports
ALTER TABLE public.rma_reports ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.rma_reports TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon read all rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon read all rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports
  FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon insert rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon insert rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports
  FOR INSERT TO anon, authenticated, service_role WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon update rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon update rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports
  FOR UPDATE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon delete rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon delete rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports
  FOR DELETE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);


-- 2. PATCH products TABLE WITH AE & COMPANY COLUMNS
ALTER TABLE public.products 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ae_name text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ae_email text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS company text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS image_url text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_verified boolean DEFAULT true;

-- Permissions & Delete Policy for products
ALTER TABLE public.products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.products TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon read all products" ON public.products;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon read all products" ON public.products
  FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon insert products" ON public.products;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon insert products" ON public.products
  FOR INSERT TO anon, authenticated, service_role WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon update products" ON public.products;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon update products" ON public.products
  FOR UPDATE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon delete products" ON public.products;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon delete products" ON public.products
  FOR DELETE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);


-- 3. ENSURE credit_memos TABLE EXISTS
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.credit_memos (
  id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  credit_memo_number text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  rma_number text NOT NULL,
  report_id bigint,
  barcode text NOT NULL,
  product_name text NOT NULL,
  sku text,
  supplier_name text,
  company text DEFAULT 'Wholesale Distribution',
  customer_ae_name text,
  customer_ae_email text,
  quantity numeric DEFAULT 1,
  unit_name text DEFAULT 'pc',
  unit_price numeric(12, 2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  amount numeric(12, 2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  pull_out_ref text NOT NULL,
  pull_out_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  credit_amount numeric(12, 2) NOT NULL,
  credit_issued_by text NOT NULL,
  credit_issued_by_email text,
  credit_issued_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  notes text,
  status text DEFAULT 'issued',
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_cm_number ON public.credit_memos(credit_memo_number);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_rma_number ON public.credit_memos(rma_number);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_barcode ON public.credit_memos(barcode);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_pull_out_ref ON public.credit_memos(pull_out_ref);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_issued_at ON public.credit_memos(credit_issued_at DESC);

ALTER TABLE public.credit_memos ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.credit_memos TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon full access credit_memos" ON public.credit_memos;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon full access credit_memos" ON public.credit_memos
  FOR ALL TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);


-- 4. ENSURE api_keys TABLE EXISTS & SEED DEFAULT CLIENT KEYS
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.api_keys (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name text NOT NULL,
  key_hash text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  masked_key text NOT NULL,
  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,
  rate_limit integer DEFAULT 60,
  expires_at timestamptz,
  last_used_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_api_keys_key_hash ON public.api_keys(key_hash);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_api_keys_name ON public.api_keys(name);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_api_keys_is_active ON public.api_keys(is_active);

ALTER TABLE public.api_keys ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.api_keys TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow full access for API key operations" ON public.api_keys;
CREATE POLICY "Allow full access for API key operations" ON public.api_keys
  FOR ALL TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

--- START FILE: create_api_keys_table.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- WHOLESALE RMA PORTAL V2 - API KEYS SCHEMA MIGRATION (SUPABASE POSTGRESQL)
-- Project: rma-system-v2
-- Purpose: Secure SHA-256 Hashed API Key Management for 4 Client Systems:
--   1. Primary System (Mine)
--   2. Jarmen
--   3. Jelo
--   4. Arlito
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. CREATE TABLE public.api_keys
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.api_keys (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name text NOT NULL,                                -- "Primary System (Mine)", "Jarmen", "Jelo", "Arlito"
  key_hash text UNIQUE NOT NULL,                     -- SHA-256 hash of secret key (never plain text)
  masked_key text NOT NULL,                          -- e.g. "sk_live_...4a2b" (safe for UI display)
  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,                    -- Active status
  rate_limit integer DEFAULT 60,                     -- Max requests per minute
  expires_at timestamptz,                            -- Optional expiration timestamp
  last_used_at timestamptz,                          -- Updated automatically on valid API calls
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- 2. CREATE FAST LOOKUP INDEXES
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_api_keys_key_hash ON public.api_keys(key_hash);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_api_keys_name ON public.api_keys(name);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_api_keys_is_active ON public.api_keys(is_active);

-- 3. ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY & PERMISSIONS
ALTER TABLE public.api_keys ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.api_keys TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- Policies for public.api_keys
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow full access for API key operations" ON public.api_keys;
CREATE POLICY "Allow full access for API key operations" ON public.api_keys
  FOR ALL TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

-- 4. INITIAL SEED KEYS FOR 4 CLIENT SYSTEMS
-- Note: Raw keys to distribute:
--   Primary System (Mine) : sk_live_rma_31cbd381bef1941ee7a34471ba3582194d1e538c6b41ebe8
--   Jarmen                : sk_live_rma_b68541b70325e2d858fbf11a4adbb6fcc79709c075cee6c6
--   Jelo                  : sk_live_rma_574476c1afcf114ccbae34a19a6e4d8c26fce0765a768698
--   Arlito                : sk_live_rma_7602959976377c494c5081f98b8556492f725dc0f9be3738

INSERT INTO public.api_keys (name, key_hash, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit)
VALUES
  ('Primary System (Mine)', '193fd3625aa8d92cada37559077d505835788bc7857782bc7638e40f9f80b25d', 'sk_live_...ebe8', true, 120),
  ('Jarmen',                '482b643d99ee07125a4744481f5ffd1978212c75b3359e96fb025e8fb0bafbf5', 'sk_live_...e6c6', true, 60),
  ('Jelo',                  '56d39f1668d4bb4b5faf4a67759e75c16706f7f1ccfb35bd119ba1f3f8d73924', 'sk_live_...8698', true, 60),
  ('Arlito',                '23073ef83400383b29f122c29ec9bce8ff7fc93f963ece4ac092ff4f4827e3ef', 'sk_live_...3738', true, 60)
ON CONFLICT (key_hash) DO NOTHING;

-- 5. VERIFICATION QUERY
SELECT id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, last_used_at, created_at FROM public.api_keys;

--- END FILE: create_api_keys_table.sql ---

--- START FILE: create_credit_memos_table.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- CREATE TABLE: public.credit_memos
-- Dedicated Table for Finance Credit Memos in Supabase
-- Run this script in your Supabase SQL Editor:
-- Dashboard > SQL Editor > New query > Paste & Run
-- ==============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.credit_memos (
  id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  credit_memo_number text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  rma_number text NOT NULL,
  report_id bigint,
  barcode text NOT NULL,
  product_name text NOT NULL,
  sku text,
  supplier_name text,
  company text DEFAULT 'Wholesale Distribution',
  customer_ae_name text,
  customer_ae_email text,
  quantity numeric DEFAULT 1,
  unit_name text DEFAULT 'pc',
  unit_price numeric(12, 2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  amount numeric(12, 2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  pull_out_ref text NOT NULL,
  pull_out_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  credit_amount numeric(12, 2) NOT NULL,
  credit_issued_by text NOT NULL,
  credit_issued_by_email text,
  credit_issued_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  notes text,
  status text DEFAULT 'issued',
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Fast Lookups and Indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_cm_number ON public.credit_memos(credit_memo_number);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_rma_number ON public.credit_memos(rma_number);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_barcode ON public.credit_memos(barcode);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_pull_out_ref ON public.credit_memos(pull_out_ref);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_issued_at ON public.credit_memos(credit_issued_at DESC);

-- Enable Row Level Security (RLS) & Grant Full Permissions to Web App
ALTER TABLE public.credit_memos ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.credit_memos TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon read all credit_memos" ON public.credit_memos;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon read all credit_memos" ON public.credit_memos
  FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon insert credit_memos" ON public.credit_memos;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon insert credit_memos" ON public.credit_memos
  FOR INSERT TO anon, authenticated, service_role WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon update credit_memos" ON public.credit_memos;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon update credit_memos" ON public.credit_memos
  FOR UPDATE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon delete credit_memos" ON public.credit_memos;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon delete credit_memos" ON public.credit_memos
  FOR DELETE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

--- END FILE: create_credit_memos_table.sql ---

--- START FILE: create_device_intake_sessions.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- UNBYPASSABLE ANTI-FRAUD COOLDOWN LOCKOUT SYSTEM
-- Tables: public.device_intake_sessions & updates to public.portal_access_keys
-- Description: Enforces hardware-level device & IP cooldown tracking to prevent
--              incognito, multi-browser, or cache-clearing bypasses.
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. Add cooldown_duration_hours to public.portal_access_keys if missing
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
    WHERE table_schema = 'public' 
      AND table_name = 'portal_access_keys' 
      AND column_name = 'cooldown_duration_hours'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.portal_access_keys 
    ADD COLUMN cooldown_duration_hours numeric(10, 4) DEFAULT 6;
  ELSE
    ALTER TABLE public.portal_access_keys 
    ALTER COLUMN cooldown_duration_hours TYPE numeric(10, 4);
  END IF;

  -- Ensure session_duration_hours also supports fractional hours (minutes)
  ALTER TABLE public.portal_access_keys 
  ALTER COLUMN session_duration_hours TYPE numeric(10, 4);
END $$;

-- Update Customer Delivery Boxes default profile with 6-hour cooldown
UPDATE public.portal_access_keys
SET cooldown_duration_hours = 6
WHERE access_slug = 'returns' AND (cooldown_duration_hours IS NULL OR cooldown_duration_hours = 0);

-- 2. Create public.device_intake_sessions tracking table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.device_intake_sessions (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  profile_id uuid REFERENCES public.portal_access_keys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  access_slug text NOT NULL,
  device_fingerprint text NOT NULL,
  ip_address text NOT NULL,
  session_started_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  session_expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  cooldown_until timestamptz NOT NULL,
  status text CHECK (status IN ('active', 'in_cooldown', 'expired')) DEFAULT 'active',
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- 3. High-performance composite indexes for instant gatekeeper lookups
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_device_sessions_lookup 
  ON public.device_intake_sessions (access_slug, device_fingerprint, ip_address);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_device_sessions_cooldown 
  ON public.device_intake_sessions (access_slug, cooldown_until);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_device_sessions_profile 
  ON public.device_intake_sessions (profile_id);

-- 4. Enable Row Level Security (RLS) & grant permissions
ALTER TABLE public.device_intake_sessions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.device_intake_sessions TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon full access device_intake_sessions" ON public.device_intake_sessions;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon full access device_intake_sessions" ON public.device_intake_sessions
  FOR ALL TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);


--- END FILE: create_device_intake_sessions.sql ---

--- START FILE: create_pin_requests_table.sql ---
-- ======================================================================
-- SUPABASE SQL MIGRATION: PIN REQUESTS AUDIT TABLE
-- Table: public.pin_requests
-- Track, review, and audit 6-digit PIN access requests for QR profiles
-- ======================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.pin_requests (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  access_key_id uuid REFERENCES public.portal_access_keys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  access_slug text NOT NULL,
  requester_email text NOT NULL,
  requester_name text NOT NULL,
  organization_name text,
  notes text,
  status text DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')),
  approved_by text,
  reviewed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Optimized Indexes for Real-Time Queue & Admin Filtering
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pin_requests_status ON public.pin_requests(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pin_requests_access_slug ON public.pin_requests(access_slug);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pin_requests_created_at ON public.pin_requests(created_at DESC);

-- Enable Row Level Security (RLS)
ALTER TABLE public.pin_requests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Allow public anonymous reporters to submit PIN requests
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public insert to pin_requests" ON public.pin_requests;
CREATE POLICY "Allow public insert to pin_requests" 
ON public.pin_requests FOR INSERT 
TO public 
WITH CHECK (true);

-- Allow reading PIN requests (for admin management queue and status lookups)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow select on pin_requests" ON public.pin_requests;
CREATE POLICY "Allow select on pin_requests" 
ON public.pin_requests FOR SELECT 
TO public 
USING (true);

-- Allow updating PIN requests (for admin approvals, rejections, and review timestamps)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow update on pin_requests" ON public.pin_requests;
CREATE POLICY "Allow update on pin_requests" 
ON public.pin_requests FOR UPDATE 
TO public 
USING (true);

-- Allow deleting old or invalid PIN requests
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow delete on pin_requests" ON public.pin_requests;
CREATE POLICY "Allow delete on pin_requests" 
ON public.pin_requests FOR DELETE 
TO public 
USING (true);

-- Optional: Comments for PostgREST schema introspection
COMMENT ON TABLE public.pin_requests IS 'Log of 6-digit PIN requests submitted by external stores and warehouse personnel';


--- END FILE: create_pin_requests_table.sql ---

--- START FILE: create_portal_access_keys_table.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- UNIFIED "ROLE-BASED QR CODE & 6-DIGIT PIN GATEKEEPER ENGINE"
-- Table: public.portal_access_keys
-- Description: Stores customizable QR Access Profiles for Warehouse & Customer Intake.
-- ==============================================================================

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.portal_access_keys (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name text NOT NULL,                                       -- e.g. "Main Warehouse Floor", "Customer Delivery Boxes"
  type text NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('internal_warehouse', 'external_customer')),
  access_slug text UNIQUE NOT NULL,                         -- e.g. "dock", "returns"
  pin_code varchar(6) NOT NULL,                             -- 6-digit numeric PIN, e.g. "123456"
  session_duration_hours integer DEFAULT 0,                 -- 0 = No Expiry (internal); >0 e.g. 2, 4, 24 for customer devices
  is_active boolean DEFAULT true,
  created_by text DEFAULT 'System Admin',
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Optimize slug lookups during gatekeeping
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_portal_access_keys_slug ON public.portal_access_keys(access_slug);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_portal_access_keys_active ON public.portal_access_keys(is_active);

-- Enable Row Level Security (RLS) and grant permissions
ALTER TABLE public.portal_access_keys ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.portal_access_keys TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon full access portal_access_keys" ON public.portal_access_keys;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon full access portal_access_keys" ON public.portal_access_keys
  FOR ALL TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

-- Seed two default profiles if empty:
-- 1. Main Warehouse Floor: internal_warehouse, slug 'dock', PIN '123456', Duration 0 (No Expiry)
-- 2. Customer Delivery Boxes: external_customer, slug 'returns', PIN '654321', Duration 2 (2 Hours per device)
INSERT INTO public.portal_access_keys (name, type, access_slug, pin_code, session_duration_hours, is_active, created_by)
VALUES 
  ('Main Warehouse Floor', 'internal_warehouse', 'dock', '123456', 0, true, 'System Default'),
  ('Customer Delivery Boxes', 'external_customer', 'returns', '654321', 2, true, 'System Default')
ON CONFLICT (access_slug) DO NOTHING;


--- END FILE: create_portal_access_keys_table.sql ---

--- START FILE: create_rma_manifest_and_items_schema.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- MIGRATION: Multi-Item Batch Returns (Manifest Mode) and RMA Line Items Schema
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. Add Manifest & Parent/Child linking columns to public.rma_reports
ALTER TABLE public.rma_reports
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_rma_id bigint REFERENCES public.rma_reports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_parent boolean DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_items integer DEFAULT 1,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS total_quantity integer DEFAULT 1;

-- 2. Create normalized public.rma_items table for line-item queries and reporting
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.rma_items (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  rma_report_id bigint REFERENCES public.rma_reports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  rma_number text NOT NULL,
  barcode text NOT NULL,
  sku text,
  name text NOT NULL,
  quantity integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  unit_name text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pc',
  price numeric(12, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  price_with_vat numeric(12, 2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
  supplier_name text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Savemore',
  reason text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging',
  explanation text,
  expiry_date date,
  batch_lot_number text,
  photos jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- 3. Indexes for fast lookup
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_parent_rma_id ON public.rma_reports(parent_rma_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_is_parent ON public.rma_reports(is_parent);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_items_rma_report_id ON public.rma_items(rma_report_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_items_rma_number ON public.rma_items(rma_number);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_items_barcode ON public.rma_items(barcode);

-- 4. Enable RLS and Grant Permissions
ALTER TABLE public.rma_items ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.rma_items TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon read all rma_items" ON public.rma_items;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon read all rma_items" ON public.rma_items FOR SELECT USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon insert rma_items" ON public.rma_items;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon insert rma_items" ON public.rma_items FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon update rma_items" ON public.rma_items;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon update rma_items" ON public.rma_items FOR UPDATE USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon delete rma_items" ON public.rma_items;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon delete rma_items" ON public.rma_items FOR DELETE USING (true);

-- 5. Realtime replication setup for rma_items
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_publication WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime'
  ) THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pg_publication_tables
      WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime' AND tablename = 'rma_items'
    ) THEN
      ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.rma_items;
    END IF;
  END IF;
END $$;


--- END FILE: create_rma_manifest_and_items_schema.sql ---

-- ==============================================================================
-- CREATE TABLE: public.supplier_claims (Return to Vendor Debit Claims)

);

GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.supplier_claims TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon full access supplier_claims" ON public.supplier_claims;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon full access supplier_claims" ON public.supplier_claims
  FOR ALL TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

--- START FILE: enable_public_anon_access.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- ENABLE PUBLIC / ANONYMOUS ACCESS FOR WHOLESALE RMA PORTAL (DOCK SCANNERS & CUSTOMERS)
--
-- Instructions:
-- 1. Open your Supabase Dashboard: https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/lschluviltzsknptwgrz
-- 2. Click "SQL Editor" in the left sidebar
-- 3. Click "New query", paste this entire script, and click "Run" (or Ctrl + Enter)
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. Ensure core tables have Row Level Security enabled
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS public.products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE IF EXISTS public.rma_reports ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- 2. Grant table permissions to anon, authenticated, and service_role
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.products TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.rma_reports TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- 3. Public Read-Only Policy for products (Allows anonymous dock workers & phones to look up barcodes)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public read-only access to products" ON public.products;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon read all products" ON public.products;
CREATE POLICY "Allow public read-only access to products" ON public.products
  FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

-- 4. Public Insert & Read Policy for rma_reports (Allows anonymous dock workers & phones to file returns)
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public insert to rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon insert rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
CREATE POLICY "Allow public insert to rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports
  FOR INSERT TO anon, authenticated, service_role WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public read-only access to rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon read all rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
CREATE POLICY "Allow public read-only access to rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports
  FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

-- 5. Public Upload Policy for Proof Photos (Storage bucket: rma-photos)
INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public) 
VALUES ('rma-photos', 'rma-photos', true)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET public = true;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public uploads to rma-photos" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "Allow public uploads to rma-photos" ON storage.objects
  FOR INSERT TO anon, authenticated, service_role
  WITH CHECK (bucket_id = 'rma-photos');

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public reads from rma-photos" ON storage.objects;
CREATE POLICY "Allow public reads from rma-photos" ON storage.objects
  FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated, service_role
  USING (bucket_id = 'rma-photos');

-- 6. Verification confirmation
SELECT 
  'Public Anon Access Configured Successfully' AS status,
  NOW() AS executed_at;

--- END FILE: enable_public_anon_access.sql ---

--- START FILE: fix_invites_and_schema.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- IDEMPOTENT MIGRATION: Dedicated public.rma_invites Table & Schema Synchronization
-- File: fix_invites_and_schema.sql
-- Run in Supabase SQL Editor: https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/lschluviltzsknptwgrz/sql
-- Description:
--   1. Creates public.rma_invites table to eliminate 404 schema cache errors.
--   2. Enables Row Level Security (RLS) with full anon and authenticated access policies.
--   3. Synchronizes stream types (customer_inbound vs. supplier_outbound) and entity names.
--   4. Backfills existing active customer invites from rma_settings.
--   5. Adds rma_invites to supabase_realtime publication for live UI updates.
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. CREATE DEDICATED RMA INVITES TABLE
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.rma_invites (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  token text UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  stream_type text NOT NULL CHECK (stream_type IN ('customer_inbound', 'supplier_outbound')) DEFAULT 'customer_inbound',
  authorized_email text NOT NULL,
  entity_name text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pingcon Wholesale Client', -- Store Branch or Master Supplier
  store_branch text,                                         -- Backwards-compatibility alias
  duration_value integer DEFAULT 24,
  duration_unit text DEFAULT 'hours',
  duration_display text DEFAULT '24 hours',
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  created_by text DEFAULT 'Admin',
  status text DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'revoked', 'expired')),
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

-- Ensure backwards-compatibility columns exist if table was partially created
ALTER TABLE public.rma_invites ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS store_branch text;
ALTER TABLE public.rma_invites ALTER COLUMN entity_name SET DEFAULT 'Pingcon Wholesale Client';

-- 2. CREATE INDEXES FOR FAST QUERYING
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_invites_token ON public.rma_invites(token);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_invites_email ON public.rma_invites(authorized_email);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_invites_stream ON public.rma_invites(stream_type);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_invites_status ON public.rma_invites(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_invites_expires ON public.rma_invites(expires_at);

-- 3. ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY & FULL ACCESS POLICIES
ALTER TABLE public.rma_invites ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.rma_invites TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow full access to rma_invites" ON public.rma_invites;
CREATE POLICY "Allow full access to rma_invites" 
  ON public.rma_invites 
  FOR ALL 
  TO anon, authenticated, service_role 
  USING (true) 
  WITH CHECK (true);

-- 4. AUTOMATIC SYNCHRONIZATION TRIGGER (entity_name <-> store_branch)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_rma_invites_entity_fields()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.entity_name IS NULL OR NEW.entity_name = '' THEN
    NEW.entity_name := COALESCE(NULLIF(NEW.store_branch, ''), 'Pingcon Wholesale Client');
  END IF;
  IF NEW.store_branch IS NULL OR NEW.store_branch = '' THEN
    NEW.store_branch := NEW.entity_name;
  END IF;
  NEW.updated_at := now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_sync_rma_invites_entity_fields ON public.rma_invites;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_rma_invites_entity_fields
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.rma_invites
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_rma_invites_entity_fields();

-- 5. BACKFILL EXISTING INVITES FROM rma_settings (IF PRESENT)
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.rma_settings WHERE key = 'customer_rma_invites_store') THEN
    INSERT INTO public.rma_invites (
      token,
      stream_type,
      authorized_email,
      entity_name,
      store_branch,
      duration_value,
      duration_unit,
      duration_display,
      expires_at,
      created_by,
      status,
      created_at,
      updated_at
    )
    SELECT
      elem->>'token' AS token,
      COALESCE(elem->>'stream_type', 'customer_inbound') AS stream_type,
      COALESCE(elem->>'authorized_email', 'unknown@pingconmarketing.com') AS authorized_email,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(elem->>'entity_name', ''), NULLIF(elem->>'store_branch', ''), 'Pingcon Wholesale Client') AS entity_name,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(elem->>'store_branch', ''), NULLIF(elem->>'entity_name', ''), 'Pingcon Wholesale Client') AS store_branch,
      COALESCE((elem->>'duration_value')::integer, 24) AS duration_value,
      COALESCE(elem->>'duration_unit', 'hours') AS duration_unit,
      COALESCE(elem->>'duration_display', '24 hours') AS duration_display,
      (elem->>'expires_at')::timestamptz AS expires_at,
      COALESCE(elem->>'created_by', 'Admin') AS created_by,
      COALESCE(elem->>'status', 'active') AS status,
      COALESCE((elem->>'created_at')::timestamptz, now()) AS created_at,
      now() AS updated_at
    FROM public.rma_settings,
         jsonb_array_elements(value) AS elem
    WHERE key = 'customer_rma_invites_store'
      AND elem->>'token' IS NOT NULL
    ON CONFLICT (token) DO UPDATE SET
      status = EXCLUDED.status,
      expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
      updated_at = now();
  END IF;
END $$;

-- 6. ENABLE REALTIME PUBLICATION FOR LIVE SYNCHRONIZATION ACROSS ADMIN SESSIONS
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_publication_tables 
    WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime' AND tablename = 'rma_invites'
  ) THEN
    ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.rma_invites;
  END IF;
END $$;


--- END FILE: fix_invites_and_schema.sql ---

# SYSTEM CONTEXT: WHOLESALE RMA PORTAL V2
> **Instructions for Google AI Studio / Gemini**:
> You are acting as the Principal Lead Architect and Domain Expert for the **Wholesale Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) Portal v2**.
> Use the entire system specification below as your ground-truth context to understand the application architecture, business logic, database schemas, APIs, and workflows.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Purpose

The **Wholesale RMA Portal v2** is an enterprise-grade, mobile-first logistics, intake, and finance platform designed to streamline returns of damaged, expired, or defective wholesale goods. It bridges warehouse receiving docks, sales account executives (AEs), logistics teams, finance departments, and external partner systems.

### Core Objectives:
1. **Intake & Receiving**: Allow warehouse staff and customers to scan barcodes/QR codes, capture proof photos with their phone cameras, log quantities, and record damage reasons on the spot.
2. **SKU Matching & Catalog Enrichment**: Automatically match unknown scans with product catalog data, auto-suggest SKUs from external systems, and enable quick assignment by admins.
3. **Finance & Credit Memos**: Generate official, numbered Credit Memo vouchers (`CM-YYYYMMDD-XXXX`) linked to pull-out authorization references for vendor deductions.
4. **Automated Notification Dispatch**: Route rich HTML email notifications via Google SMTP to Account Executives and logistics leads based on supplier and company rules.
5. **Multi-System REST API**: Provide an authenticated, rate-limited, SHA-256 hashed REST API for 4 external client systems (**Primary System**, **Jarmen**, **Jelo**, **Arlito**).
6. **Code-First Interactive Docs**: Auto-generate OpenAPI 3.1 specifications from Zod schemas served interactively via Scalar at `/docs`.

---

## 2. Business Domain & Organizations

The system operates across several affiliated wholesale distribution and manufacturing entities:
- **Keysys Tech Corp & A2Z2Go**: Central management, systems engineering, and technology infrastructure.
- **Pingcon Marketing**: Consumer goods, snack foods, beverages, and wholesale distribution.
- **Bonita Tissue**: Tissue paper, paper towel, and hygiene product wholesale lines.
- **Savemore / Liwayway / Partner Suppliers**: Supermarket distribution networks and external manufacturers.
- **Partner Systems**: 
  - **Primary System (Mine / Danilo)**: Central operations.
  - **Jarmen**: Partner logistics and wholesale client system.
  - **Jelo**: Partner warehouse and dispatch system.
  - **Arlito**: Partner inventory and retail system.

---

## 4. Key Modules & Functional Workflows

### A. Public Reporter & Multi-Item Intake Manifest (`/` or Default View)
- **Multi-Item Batch Manifest Mode**:
  - Allows adding multiple returned line items to a single return manifest under ONE overarching RMA Ticket (`RMA-YYYY-XXXX-XXXX`).
  - For each line item: collects Barcode / SKU, Quantity, Packaging Unit (`pc`, `carton`, `box`, `case`), Defect Reason dropdown, and item-specific proof photos.
  - Interactive queued items table / card preview with immediate "Remove Line Item" capability and live total item/quantity counters.
  - Global Manifest Header & Paperwork: Captures Store / Branch Location, Sales Invoice (SI#), Delivery Receipt (DR#), Purchase Order (PO#), AI-powered paperwork OCR photo capture, and reporter contact details.
- **Instant Barcode/QR Scanner**: Uses device camera via `html5-qrcode` to scan EAN/UPC barcodes and auto-queries product catalog.
- **Auto-Fill & Quantity Counter**:
  - Scanning increments item quantity automatically.
  - Volume controls: `[-]` and `[+]` buttons plus direct numerical input.
- **Proof Photo Upload**: Compressed directly in-browser to WebP; synced to Google Workspace Shared Drive or Supabase Storage.
- **Dock GPS Capture**: Optionally captures geolocation coordinates (`latitude`, `longitude`, `accuracy`) if within dock threshold (<= 150m).
- **Thermal 4x6" RMA Box Label**: Renders multi-item summary label featuring high-density 1D Code128 barcode, 2D QR Code, total item count, total quantity, and branch details. Optimized for thermal label printers (Zebra, Dymo) and mobile screen printing.

### B. Admin & Warehouse Intake Review (`/admin`)
- **Gate Authentication**: OTP verification and email-based Super Admin authentication.
- **Mobile Quick Actions Modal (`QuickRMAActionModal.jsx`)**:
  - Optimized for warehouse supervisors on phones and tablets.
  - Allows immediate SKU assignment, catalog creation, photo inspection, and Credit Memo issuance.
- **SKU & Product Name Auto-Population**:
  - Bi-directional auto-fill: Selecting a product name auto-populates its SKU; typing a SKU auto-populates its name, price, VAT, and supplier.
  - Pulls live suggestions from the external Laravel Cloud Purchase Orders API (`purchase-order-db-production-ff1oho.laravel.cloud/api/v1`).
- **Bulk Report Management**: Batch status updates, report filtering, and bulk deletion with safety confirmation modals.

### C. Finance & Credit Memo Engine
- **Issuance**: Generates official Credit Memo vouchers linked to an RMA report and a physical pull-out reference number (`pull_out_ref`).
- **Credit Memo ID**: Auto-generates `CM-YYYYMMDD-XXXX`.
- **Calculations**: Unit price (net or with VAT) multiplied by quantity equals credited amount.
- **Printable Vouchers**: Renders printable and downloadable PDF vouchers formatted for wholesale accounting records.

### D. Multi-System REST API v1
- **Protected Endpoints**: Full CRUD for RMA reports, catalog products, and credit memos.
- **Key Authentication**: Validates `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
- **SHA-256 Hashed**: Secret keys (`sk_live_rma_...`) are hashed using SHA-256 before storage; raw keys are never saved in the database.
- **Client Identity Injection**: Each request automatically identifies the client system (`Primary System (Mine)`, `Jarmen`, `Jelo`, `Arlito`) for auditing.
- **Key Management UI**: Super Admin can view masked keys (`sk_live_...4a2b`), monitor last used timestamps, rotate keys, and revoke keys.

### E. Code-First Interactive Docs & Automated Project Context (`/docs` & `/api/context`)
- **Dynamic OpenAPI 3.1 Specification**: All route schemas defined in `api/_lib/schemas/*.schema.js` using Zod. `api/_lib/openapiRegistry.js` compiles schemas dynamically into OpenAPI 3.1 JSON at `/api/openapi.json` at runtime on every request with zero drift.
- **Interactive Playground**: Served at `/docs` using Scalar with multi-language code snippets (cURL, JavaScript, Python) and an **Authorize** modal for live testing.
- **Automated Living Project Context (`PROJECT_CONTEXT.txt`)**:
  - Automatically compiled during `npm run build` by `scripts/build_context.js`, embedding directory tree, package dependencies, and 109+ project source files.
  - Deployed directly to `/PROJECT_CONTEXT.txt` (static edge CDN asset) and `/api/context` (via `api/docs.js?format=context`) with standard CORS, cache headers, and timestamp metadata. Never goes out of date.

## 8. Guidelines for AI Studio Assistant Behavior

When answering prompts about this project in Google AI Studio:
1. **Maintain Context Awareness**: All features are already live in production; avoid suggesting boilerplate that ignores existing tables (`rma_reports`, `credit_memos`, `api_keys`).
2. **Preserve Code-First Documentation**: Do not recommend modifying static JSON files for OpenAPI. All documentation is generated using Zod in `api/_lib/schemas/*.schema.js`.
3. **Respect Security Standards**: Never expose plain secret keys in databases. Always use SHA-256 hashes for API key authentication and match client attribution in the audit logs.
4. **Vercel Serverless Best Practices**: Keep serverless functions fast, avoid stateful background daemons, and ensure CORS headers use dynamic origin reflection.

---

## 9. Free-Tier Architecture & Living Documentation Contract

### Free-Tier Operating Constraints:
1. **Vercel Serverless Function Limit (Hobby Cap: 12 Functions)**:
   - The project is strictly architected with **exactly 12 serverless endpoints** in `api/`:
     `api/docs.js`, `api/send-email.js`, `api/upload-photo.js`, `api/v1/health.js`,
     `api/v1/api-keys/index.js`, `api/v1/api-keys/[id].js`, `api/v1/credit-memos/index.js`, `api/v1/credit-memos/[id].js`,
     `api/v1/products/index.js`, `api/v1/products/[id].js`, `api/v1/rma/index.js`, `api/v1/rma/[id].js`.
   - Never add a 13th function file directly in `api/`. Auxiliary routes must use rewrites or existing handlers.
2. **Vercel Serverless Execution Timeout (10-Second Hobby Cap)**:
   - Proof photos are **NEVER** proxied uncompressed through serverless functions.
   - All captures are aggressively compressed directly in the browser via Canvas API to WebP (1280px max dimension, quality 0.7), reducing 4MB–10MB phone uploads to ~80KB–180KB (>95% reduction).
   - `/api/upload-photo` features an active 7.5s abort timeout guard.
3. **Supabase 1 GB Storage Cap & Google Workspace Drive Hybrid Storage**:
   - Primary: Proof photos upload directly to company Google Workspace Shared Drive (`keysysincorporated.com` / `pingconmarketing.com`) using zero-dependency OAuth2 JWT service account integration.
   - Clean Organized Hierarchy:
     * `RMA-Reports-Item/{RMA_NUMBER}/{PHOTO_FILES}`: Proof of damaged/expired merchandise photos.
     * `RMA-Reports-SI/DR/PO/{RMA_NUMBER}/{PAPERWORK_FILES}`: Scanned receipts, delivery slips, and purchase orders.
     * `Products/{SKU} {DESCRIPTION}/{CATALOG_IMAGES}`: Official verified catalog reference images.
   - Cascading Deletion: When an RMA record, customer return, or product is deleted in Admin Hub, all corresponding files in Google Drive and Supabase Storage are systematically purged to reclaim cloud storage space.
   - Fallback: If Google Drive credentials are not configured, seamlessly falls back to Supabase Storage `rma-photos` bucket; tertiary fallback to offline Base64 Data URLs.
4. **Supabase 500 MB Database Quota & Connection Pooler**:
   - All high-frequency query columns (`rma_number`, `barcode`, `supplier_name`, `status`, `created_at`) are indexed via `optimize_free_tier_indexes.sql` to eliminate sequential scans.
   - Serverless functions use `api/_lib/supabase.js` with client caching on `globalThis._supabaseServerlessClient` for warm container connection reuse over HTTPS/REST. Direct DB connections must use Supavisor Transaction Pooler port `6543`.

### Architectural Development Rule: "LIVING DOCUMENTATION CONTRACT"
- **Single Source of Truth**: `docs/MANUAL_QA_TESTING_CHECKLIST.md` is our binding Quality Assurance contract.
- **Mandatory Simultaneous Update**: WHENEVER any developer or AI assistant modifies, adds, or removes any UI button, modal, form input, or API endpoint in this project, they MUST simultaneously update `docs/MANUAL_QA_TESTING_CHECKLIST.md` with the corresponding test cases, location details, actions, expected behaviors, and checkable verification boxes `[ ]`.

--- START FILE: optimize_free_tier_indexes.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- WHOLESALE RMA PORTAL V2 - FREE-TIER DATABASE INDEXING & OPTIMIZATION SCRIPT
-- Target: Supabase Free-Tier (PostgreSQL 15+)
-- Purpose: Eliminate sequential table scans, minimize CPU/RAM utilization,
--          and prevent compute/connection spikes under free-tier caps.
-- Execution: Copy & run in Supabase Dashboard > SQL Editor > New query > Run
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. INDEXES ON public.rma_reports (Most frequently queried & sorted table)
-- Accelerates fast barcode lookup, RMA search, status filtering, and date ordering.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_rma_number 
  ON public.rma_reports(rma_number);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_barcode 
  ON public.rma_reports(barcode);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_supplier_name 
  ON public.rma_reports(supplier_name);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_status 
  ON public.rma_reports(status);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_created_at 
  ON public.rma_reports(created_at DESC);

-- Composite index for the main Admin Return Reports tab: filters by status and sorts by created_at
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_status_created 
  ON public.rma_reports(status, created_at DESC);

-- Logistics & Triage lookup indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_disposition 
  ON public.rma_reports(disposition);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_condition_grade 
  ON public.rma_reports(condition_grade);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_warehouse_location 
  ON public.rma_reports(warehouse_location);


-- 2. INDEXES ON public.products (Master Catalog & Dock Auto-Suggest)
-- Prevents full table scan on every barcode intake or product search.
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_barcode 
  ON public.products(barcode);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_code 
  ON public.products(code);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_supplier_name 
  ON public.products(supplier_name);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_is_verified 
  ON public.products(is_verified);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_products_updated_at 
  ON public.products(updated_at DESC);


-- 3. INDEXES ON public.credit_memos (Finance Claims & BIR Vouchers)
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'credit_memos') THEN
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_rma_number 
      ON public.credit_memos(rma_number);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_cm_number 
      ON public.credit_memos(credit_memo_number);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_status 
      ON public.credit_memos(status);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credit_memos_created_at 
      ON public.credit_memos(created_at DESC);
  END IF;
END $$;


-- 4. INDEXES ON public.api_keys (REST API Partner SHA-256 Auth Vault)
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'api_keys') THEN
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_api_keys_key_hash 
      ON public.api_keys(key_hash);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_api_keys_is_active 
      ON public.api_keys(is_active);
  END IF;
END $$;


-- 5. INDEXES ON public.rma_settings (System Config & Recipients)
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename = 'rma_settings') THEN
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_settings_key 
      ON public.rma_settings(key);
  END IF;
END $$;


-- ==============================================================================
-- 6. VERIFICATION: DISPLAY CREATED FREE-TIER OPTIMIZATION INDEXES
-- ==============================================================================
SELECT 
    tablename, 
    indexname, 
    indexdef 
FROM pg_indexes 
WHERE schemaname = 'public' 
  AND tablename IN ('rma_reports', 'products', 'credit_memos', 'api_keys', 'rma_settings')
ORDER BY tablename, indexname;

--- END FILE: optimize_free_tier_indexes.sql ---

--- START FILE: README.md ---
# Wholesale Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) Portal v2

Enterprise wholesale return merchandise authorization and warehouse intake platform for **Pingcon Marketing**, **Bonita Tissue**, **Keysys Tech Corp**, and **A2Z2Go**.

---

## 🚀 Key Modules & Architecture

### 1. In-Browser Scanner & Intake (Submit RMA)
- **Camera Barcode & QR Scanner**: Real-time camera viewfinder powered by `html5-qrcode`.
- **GTIN / Box Barcode Auto-Population**: Matches retail packaging barcodes with product catalog (`BON-FT-200`, `PC-JRT-500`, etc.).
- **Uncatalogued Manual Input**: Seamless fallback to type description manually if barcode is unlisted.
- **Re-scan Increment**: Re-scanning the same box automatically increments quantity `+1`.
- **Direct Volume Controls**: Big `[ - ]` and `[ + ]` buttons plus editable numeric box (type large quantities e.g. `20` immediately).
- **One-Click AI Defect Detection**: Generates structured technical defect diagnosis statements based on failure categories.
- **GPS Dock Location Grabber**: Captures verified receiving dock coordinates via `navigator.geolocation`.
- **Defect Photo Uploader**: Direct mobile camera or photo upload to Supabase bucket `rma-defect-photos`.

### 2. Automated Smart AE Routing & Outbound Dispatch
- **Group 1 (KEYSYS & A2Z2GO)**:
  - **Sender**: `finance2@a2z2go.net`
  - **To**: `azgodev@gmail.com`
  - **CC**: `mgan@a2z2go.net`, `AZGan@a2z2go.net`, `marketing@a2z2go.net`, `jaezelle.benito@pingconmarketing.com` + Assigned AE + Supervisor
- **Group 2 (PINGCON & BONITA TISSUE)**:
  - **Sender**: `finance@pingconmarketing.com`
  - **To**: `azgodev@gmail.com`
  - **CC**: `mgan@pingconmarketing.com`, `AZGan@pingconmarketing.com`, `marketing@pingconmarketing.com`, `jaezelle.benito@pingconmarketing.com` + Assigned AE + Supervisor
- **Simulation / Test Mode**: Safety toggle that automatically appends `.test` to all destination emails during testing.

### 3. Tickets Vault (Audit Archive)
- Complete history of all submitted return tickets with Ticket ID format: `RMA-2026-####-[4 alphanumeric chars]`.
- Multi-attribute search and status filtering (*Pending Inspection, Approved, In Transit, Buffer Replacement, Credit Memo Issued, Rejected*).
- Printable return QR code labels formatted for thermal sticker printers.
- Export to CSV for audit and reporting.

### 4. Finance Credit Memo Workstation
- Pull-out verification checkbox for logistics confirmation.
- Direct entry of official Credit Memo number (e.g. `CM-2026-0145`) and Credit Amount (₱).
- General Ledger integration (GL-4010) and finance officer authorization stamps.

### 5. Purchasing & Inventory Buffer Control
- Consolidated defective lot grouping by manufacturer/supplier (Bonita Mills, Pingcon Paper, Keysys Tech, A2Z Innovations).
- 7-Day Vendor Buffer Replacement SLA countdown timer with overdue indicators.
- One-click vendor replacement PO generation (`PO-RET-2026-###`).
- Immediate inventory buffer stock dispatch to customer accounts.

### 6. Print SKU Barcodes
- Printable A4 sheet grid for Pingcon, Bonita, and Keysys SKU barcodes for warehouse repackers labeling unlabelled cartons.

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack
- **Framework**: React 18 + Vite 6
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS + PostCSS
- **Icons**: Lucide React (`lucide-react`)
- **Scanner**: `html5-qrcode`
- **QR Code Engine**: `qrcode.react`
- **Backend / Database**: Supabase (`@supabase/supabase-js`) with automatic offline mock redundancy

---

## 🏃 Running Locally

```powershell
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Start development server
npm run dev
```

Open `http://localhost:5173` in your browser.

---

## 🛡️ Free-Tier Architecture & Safety Controls

1. **Vercel Hobby 12-Function Hard Cap**: Strictly limited to 12 serverless functions in `api/`.
2. **Aggressive Client WebP Compression**: Photos are downscaled to $\le$ 1280px at 0.7 quality in-browser via Canvas API (~80–180KB), eliminating Vercel 10s execution timeouts.
3. **Google Workspace Drive Hybrid Photo Storage**: RMA proof photos upload directly to dedicated company Google Drive (`Wholesale RMA Photos/YYYY-MM/`) via service account OAuth2 JWT, conserving Supabase 1 GB storage.
4. **Graceful Multi-Tier Redundancy**: Seamless automatic fallback to Supabase Storage `rma-photos` bucket and offline Base64 data URLs.
5. **Database Indexing**: All query columns indexed via `optimize_free_tier_indexes.sql` to protect Supabase 500 MB quota and prevent connection spikes.

--- START FILE: separate_customer_and_supplier_rma_types.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- WHOLESALE RMA PORTAL V2: SEPARATE CUSTOMER INBOUND & SUPPLIER OUTBOUND RETURNS
-- ==============================================================================
-- Cleanly separates:
-- 1. Customer Returns (Inbound Logistics): Branch/store returns pending inspection and Credit Memos
-- 2. Supplier Returns (Outbound Logistics / RTV): Warehouse defective stock pending vendor debit claims
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. Add rma_type column to public.rma_reports with strict CHECK constraint and default
ALTER TABLE public.rma_reports
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rma_type text 
  CHECK (rma_type IN ('customer_inbound', 'supplier_outbound')) 
  DEFAULT 'customer_inbound';

-- 2. Backfill existing records to ensure backward compatibility
-- Historical records with 'Return to Vendor (RTV)' disposition or from internal warehouse dock are supplier outbound;
-- all others default safely to 'customer_inbound'.
UPDATE public.rma_reports
SET rma_type = CASE 
  WHEN disposition ILIKE '%Return to Vendor%' OR disposition ILIKE '%RTV%' THEN 'supplier_outbound'
  ELSE 'customer_inbound'
END
WHERE rma_type IS NULL;

-- 3. Performance Indexes for Instant Tab Isolation in Admin Dashboard
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_rma_type 
  ON public.rma_reports (rma_type);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_type_status 
  ON public.rma_reports (rma_type, status);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rma_reports_type_created 
  ON public.rma_reports (rma_type, created_at DESC);

-- 4. Verify Schema Mutation
COMMENT ON COLUMN public.rma_reports.rma_type IS 
  'Logistics classification: customer_inbound (customer/store return) or supplier_outbound (warehouse vendor return/RTV claim)';


--- END FILE: separate_customer_and_supplier_rma_types.sql ---

--- START FILE: supabase_schema.sql ---
-- ==============================================================================
-- WHOLESALE RMA PORTAL V2 - DATABASE SCHEMA & STORAGE SETUP (SUPABASE)
-- Project: rma-system-v2
-- URL: https://lschluviltzsknptwgrz.supabase.co
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. CLEAN UP OLD UNUSED TABLES (Safe to re-run)
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.rma_tickets CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.rma_items CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.products CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.rma_reports CASCADE;

-- 2. CREATE PRODUCTS CATALOG TABLE
CREATE TABLE public.products (
  id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  barcode text UNIQUE NOT NULL,       -- Scanned Barcode (e.g., 2310943156)
  code text,                          -- SKU / Item Code (e.g., P2678P)
  name text NOT NULL,                 -- Product Name
  price numeric(12,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  price_with_vat numeric(12,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  supplier_name text DEFAULT 'Savemore',
  brand_name text,
  unit_name text DEFAULT 'pc',
  has_serial_numbers boolean DEFAULT false,
  image_url text,                     -- Optional Reference Photo uploaded by Admin
  is_verified boolean DEFAULT true,   -- false = auto-logged from unknown scan, true = verified by admin
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_products_barcode ON public.products(barcode);
CREATE INDEX idx_products_code ON public.products(code);
CREATE INDEX idx_products_is_verified ON public.products(is_verified);

-- 3. CREATE RMA REPORTS TABLE (With Proof Photos, Reason, GPS & Reporter Contact)
CREATE TABLE public.rma_reports (
  id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  rma_number text NOT NULL,
  barcode text NOT NULL,
  code text,
  name text NOT NULL,
  quantity integer DEFAULT 1,
  supplier_name text,
  price numeric(12,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  price_with_vat numeric(12,2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  unit_name text DEFAULT 'pc',
  status text DEFAULT 'pending',      -- 'pending', 'pending_admin_details', 'resolved'
  location text,                      -- Warehouse rack / slot (optional)
  reason text DEFAULT 'Damaged Box / Crushed Packaging',
  explanation text,
  photos jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,   -- Array of proof image URLs
  gps_latitude numeric(10,7),         -- Auto GPS Latitude (only if hardware accurate <= 150m)
  gps_longitude numeric(10,7),        -- Auto GPS Longitude
  gps_accuracy numeric(8,2),          -- Accuracy in meters
  gps_timestamp timestamptz,
  reporter_name text,                 -- Name of person reporting
  reporter_contact text,              -- Phone number or Email
  reported_by text DEFAULT 'Customer / Reporter',
  notes text,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_rma_reports_barcode ON public.rma_reports(barcode);
CREATE INDEX idx_rma_reports_status ON public.rma_reports(status);

-- ==============================================================================
-- 4. ROW LEVEL SECURITY (RLS) POLICIES FOR PUBLIC ACCESS
-- ==============================================================================

ALTER TABLE public.products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.rma_reports ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.products TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.rma_reports TO anon, authenticated, service_role;
GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

-- Policies for public.products
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon read all products" ON public.products;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon read all products" ON public.products
  FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon insert products" ON public.products;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon insert products" ON public.products
  FOR INSERT TO anon, authenticated, service_role WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon update products" ON public.products;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon update products" ON public.products
  FOR UPDATE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon delete products" ON public.products;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon delete products" ON public.products
  FOR DELETE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

-- Policies for public.rma_reports
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon read all rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon read all rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports
  FOR SELECT TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon insert rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon insert rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports
  FOR INSERT TO anon, authenticated, service_role WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon update rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon update rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports
  FOR UPDATE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon delete rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon delete rma_reports" ON public.rma_reports
  FOR DELETE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

-- ==============================================================================
-- 5. SUPABASE STORAGE BUCKET FOR PHOTOS ('rma-photos')
-- ==============================================================================
INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public) 
VALUES ('rma-photos', 'rma-photos', true)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET public = true;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public uploads to rma-photos" ON storage.objects;

  FOR INSERT TO anon, authenticated, service_role

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon update admin_users" ON public.admin_users;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon update admin_users" ON public.admin_users
  FOR UPDATE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

-- 2. CREATE OTP VERIFICATION TOKENS TABLE
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.otp_tokens (
  id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email text NOT NULL,
  otp_code text NOT NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  is_used boolean DEFAULT false,
  created_at timestamptz DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.otp_tokens ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
GRANT ALL ON TABLE public.otp_tokens TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon manage otp_tokens" ON public.otp_tokens;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon manage otp_tokens" ON public.otp_tokens
  FOR ALL TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

-- ==============================================================================
-- UPDATE SCHEMA V5: Products Delete Policy & Supabase Realtime Publication
-- Run this in Supabase SQL Editor: https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/lschluviltzsknptwgrz/sql
-- ==============================================================================

-- 1. ALLOW DELETE ON PRODUCTS TABLE
DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow anon delete products" ON public.products;
CREATE POLICY "Allow anon delete products" ON public.products
  FOR DELETE TO anon, authenticated, service_role USING (true);

-- 2. ENABLE REALTIME PUBLICATION FOR REALTIME BROADCASTING
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_publication_tables 
    WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime' AND tablename = 'products'
  ) THEN
    ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.products;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_publication_tables 
    WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime' AND tablename = 'rma_reports'
  ) THEN
    ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.rma_reports;
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_publication_tables 
    WHERE pubname = 'supabase_realtime' AND tablename = 'admin_users'
  ) THEN
    ALTER PUBLICATION supabase_realtime ADD TABLE public.admin_users;
  END IF;
END $$;

--- END FILE: update_schema_v5.sql ---

-- ==============================================================================
-- WHOLESALE RMA PORTAL V2 - DATABASE MIGRATION SCRIPT V6

ALTER TABLE public.products

GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE public.products TO anon, authenticated, service_role;

--- START FILE: vite.config.js ---
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import basicSsl from '@vitejs/plugin-basic-ssl'

// https://vitejs.dev/config/
export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    react(),
    basicSsl(),
    {
      name: 'docs-server',
      configureServer(server) {
        server.middlewares.use(async (req, res, next) => {
          if (req.url === '/docs' || req.url === '/docs/') {
            res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8');
            return res.end(`<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <title>Wholesale RMA Portal | Interactive REST API Documentation</title>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  </head>
  <body style="margin: 0; background-color: #0b0f19;">
    <script
      id="api-reference"
      data-url="/api/openapi.json"
      data-configuration='{"theme":"purple","layout":"modern","showSidebar":true,"searchHotKey":"k"}'
      src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@scalar/api-reference"></script>
  </body>
</html>`);
          }
          if (req.url === '/api/openapi.json' || req.url?.startsWith('/api/openapi.json')) {
            const handler = (await import('./api/docs.js')).default;
            return handler(req, res);
          }
          if (req.url?.startsWith('/api/v1/auth/verify-pin') || req.url?.startsWith('/api/v1/auth/clear-cooldown')) {
            let body = '';
            req.on('data', chunk => { body += chunk; });
            req.on('end', async () => {
              try { req.body = JSON.parse(body); } catch (e) { req.body = body; }
              const { handleVerifyPin, handleClearCooldown } = await import('./api/_lib/verifyPinHandler.js');
              if (req.url?.includes('verify-pin')) {
                return handleVerifyPin(req, res);
              } else {
                return handleClearCooldown(req, res);
              }
            });
            return;
          }
          next();
        });
      }
    }
  ],
  server: {
    port: 5173,
    host: true
  }
})

--- END FILE: vite.config.js ---

# Wholesale RMA Portal v2 — Comprehensive Manual QA Testing Checklist

**QA Director:** Lead QA Director & Principal Software Architect  
**Test Suite:** End-to-End Functional, Regression, UI/UX, and Database Integrity Suite  
**Application Target:** `https://rma-portal-v2.vercel.app`  
**Execution Type:** Manual QA with checkable verification boxes `[ ]`  

---

> [!IMPORTANT]
> ### 📜 LIVING DOCUMENTATION CONTRACT & QA PROTOCOL
> 1. **Single Source of Truth**: This checklist (`docs/MANUAL_QA_TESTING_CHECKLIST.md`) is our binding contract for Quality Assurance.
> 2. **Mandatory Simultaneous Update**: WHENEVER any developer, DevOps engineer, or AI assistant modifies, adds, or removes any UI button, modal, form input, or API endpoint in this project, they **MUST simultaneously update this document** with the corresponding test cases and checkboxes `[ ]`.
> 3. **Free-Tier Protection**: All tests verify strict adherence to Vercel Hobby limits (12 serverless functions, 10s execution cap) and Supabase Free Tier quotas (1 GB storage, 500 MB database, connection pooling).

---

## Document Structure & Legend
Each test scenario defines:
* **Location**: Specific screen, modal, or tab.
* **Button / Input Label**: Exact text as rendered in the interface.
* **Action**: User interaction (Click, Type, Scan, Touch, Keypress).
* **Expected Behavior (UI + Database)**: Exact frontend response and Supabase table mutation.
* **Edge-Case / Failure Test**: Negative test case verifying validation, error handling, and recovery.

---

## Section 1: Customer RMA Invites & Cryptographic Google Identity Lock Gatekeeper

### 1.0 Google Identity Lock & Station Authentication
- [ ] **TC-GATE-01 (Direct Public URL Access Blocking)**
  * **Location**: Public Root (`/`)
  * **Action**: Open `https://rma-portal-pingconmarketing.vercel.app/` in a clean incognito window without an active session token or invite parameter.
  * **Expected Behavior**: The intake form is strictly blocked by the Branded Gatekeeper overlay displaying: *"Authorization Required — Please contact your assigned Pingcon representative or Account Executive to receive your store's personalized return authorization link."* An **"Admin & Staff Login"** button is accessible at the bottom.
  * **Edge Case**: Verify direct URL navigation cannot bypass the lock overlay until a valid invite token is validated.

- [ ] **TC-GATE-02 (Valid Invite Link Token Resolution & Zero Manual Email Typing)**
  * **Location**: Customer Invite URL (`/intake?token=inv_...`)
  * **Action**: Visit a valid personalized invite URL generated by Admin Staff.
  * **Expected Behavior**: Token is automatically parsed. The Gatekeeper screen renders:
    1. Header: *"Verified Return Authorization — Pingcon RMA Portal"*
    2. Recipient Card: *"Private Return Link Issued Exclusively To:"* with authorized email (e.g. `daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com`), store/branch name, and live expiration countdown.
    3. Notice: *"Google Identity Lock — To prevent fraud and unauthorized returns, access is cryptographically locked to the authorized Google account above."*
    4. Prominent Button: `[ 🔵 Continue with Google ]` with official Google 'G' icon.
    5. **CRITICAL SECURITY REQUIREMENT**: There is NO manual email text input field. Users cannot type in an email address to bypass OAuth.
  * **Edge Case**: If token is expired or revoked, displays a 401/403 Amber alert explaining the link has expired and directing customer to request a fresh authorization from Pingcon Operations.

- [ ] **TC-OAUTH-01 (Cross-Account Rejection & Local Sign-Out)**
  * **Location**: Gatekeeper Modal (`/intake?token=inv_...` issued to `daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com`)
  * **Action**: User forwards the private link to another party, or signs into Google using an unauthorized account (e.g. `bargarareymond@gmail.com`).
  * **Expected Behavior**:
    1. System queries `supabase.auth.getUser()` and detects `bargarareymond@gmail.com !== daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com`.
    2. **DO NOT UNLOCK THE PORTAL**.
    3. System immediately signs out locally: `await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: 'local' })` to eradicate unauthorized JWT tokens.
    4. Displays the 403 Forbidden Screen:
       * Badge: `403 FORBIDDEN — IDENTITY MISMATCH`
       * Title: *"Access Denied — Identity Mismatch"*
       * Signed in as: `bargarareymond@gmail.com`
       * Authorized account: `daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com`
       * Notice: *"Forwarding private return links is prohibited under Pingcon Wholesale Governance."*
       * Action: `[ Switch Google Account ]` and `[ Admin Staff Login ]`.

- [ ] **TC-OAUTH-02 (Switch Google Account with Forced Account Picker)**
  * **Location**: 403 Forbidden Screen
  * **Action**: Click `[ Switch Google Account ]`.
  * **Expected Behavior**:
    1. Re-triggers Google OAuth with `prompt: 'select_account'` and `access_type: 'offline'`.
    2. Google displays the full account chooser modal, preventing silent auto-login into the previous unauthorized account.
    3. User can choose or sign into the authorized account (`daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com`).

- [ ] **TC-OAUTH-03 (Matching Email Unlock & ReadOnly Reporter Lock)**
  * **Location**: Gatekeeper Modal (`/intake?token=inv_...` issued to `daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com`)
  * **Action**: Click `[ 🔵 Continue with Google ]` and authenticate with matching account (`daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com`).
  * **Expected Behavior**:
    1. Supabase OAuth callback redirects to portal.
    2. Identity verification matches `user.email === invite.authorized_email`.
    3. Portal immediately unlocks with toast: *"Portal Unlocked: daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com"*.
    4. Gate session saved to `localStorage.rma_portal_gate_session`.
    5. Section 4 (Reporter Information) `reporterContact` is populated with `daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com` and made permanently `readOnly` with verified badge: *"✓ Verified Google Identity (daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com)"*.
    6. Store/Branch is auto-populated if included in the invite.
    7. Clicking `[ Lock Device ]` clears the gate session, calls `supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: 'local' })`, and re-locks the station.

- [ ] **TC-OAUTH-04 (Pre-Flight Provider Probe & Secure Email OTP Fallback)**
  * **Location**: Gatekeeper Modal (`/intake?token=inv_...`)
  * **Action**: Click `[ 🔵 Continue with Google ]` when Google OAuth provider is not yet enabled in the Supabase Dashboard.
  * **Expected Behavior**:
    1. Pre-flight API check (`/api/auth-provider-check?provider=google`) detects provider is not active.
    2. Browser is **PREVENTED** from navigating to `https://<ref>.supabase.co/auth/v1/authorize` (preventing raw JSON 400 screen).
    3. Displays in-modal alert: *"Google Authentication Configuration Required"* with step-by-step Supabase dashboard setup instructions.
    4. Secure passwordless option: `[ ✉️ Email One-Time Access Link to <authorized_email> ]` strictly dispatches a magic login link to the authorized email address.
    5. Zero client-side bypass buttons exist. Unauthorized accounts (`finance2@a2z2go.com`) cannot unlock an invite issued to `daniloalvaro031717@gmail.com`.

- [ ] **TC-INV-DELETE (Expired-Only Invite Deletion Guard)**
  * **Location**: Admin Dashboard -> **"🎫 RMA Invites"** Modal -> Authorized Invites Table
  * **Action**:
    1. Inspect an **Active** invite (`status: active`, remaining duration > 0).
    2. Inspect an **Expired** or **Revoked** invite (`status: expired` or `status: revoked`).
  * **Expected Behavior**:
    1. Active invites display ONLY Copy Link, Send Email, and Revoke Access buttons. The Delete trash can icon is **HIDDEN**.
    2. Expired or Revoked invites display the red Delete trash can icon `[ 🗑️ Delete Expired Invite ]`.
    3. Clicking delete prompts: *"Permanently delete expired invite record for <email>?"* and removes the record from `rma_invites` and `rma_settings`. Active invites cannot be deleted.

- [ ] **TC-GATE-05A (Customer Return vs Supplier RTV Invite Creation)**
  * **Location**: Admin Dashboard -> **"🎫 Customer & Supplier RMA Invites"** Modal
  * **Action**:
    1. Select stream toggle: `[ 📥 Customer Return Invite ]` vs `[ 📤 Supplier RTV Invite ]`.
    2. For Customer Return: Enter Customer Google Email and Store / Supermarket Branch Location (`Savemore Taguig`).
    3. For Supplier RTV: Enter Supplier / Vendor Representative Email and Master Supplier / Vendor Name (`Liwayway Marketing`).
    4. Set Expiration: Choose preset chips (`15m`, `2h`, `12h`, `24h`, `2d`, `7d`) or input custom number + unit (`minutes`, `hours`, `days`).
    5. Click **"Generate Customer Return Invite"** or **"Generate Supplier RTV Invite"**.
  * **Expected Behavior**: Generates cryptographic token `inv_...`. Saves record to Supabase `rma_invites` table (`stream_type: customer_inbound | supplier_outbound`) with `rma_settings` fallback. Displays 1-click **"Copy Private Link"** and **"📧 Send Invite Email"** buttons with stream-tailored email templates.

### 1.1 Unbypassable Cooldown Lockout & Anti-Fraud Security
- [ ] **Active Session 2-Hour Expiration Trigger**
  * **Location**: Customer Intake Gateway (`/intake/returns`)
  * **Action**: Scan customer box QR code, enter PIN `654321`. Verify active session countdown starts at 2 hours. Fast-forward clock or expire session.
  * **Expected Behavior**: Upon expiration, the intake portal immediately locks and transitions the physical device into the configured 6-hour Cooldown Period.

- [ ] **Server-Side Cooldown Lockout Verification**
  * **Location**: `/api/v1/auth/verify-pin`
  * **Action**: With device or IP currently in an active cooldown, attempt to send a POST request to `/api/v1/auth/verify-pin` with valid PIN `654321`.
  * **Expected Behavior**: Server rejects authentication with HTTP `429 Too Many Requests` and JSON payload `{ error: "COOLDOWN_ACTIVE", cooldownRemainingMinutes: ..., unlocksAt: ... }`. The UI displays the Cooldown Lockout Screen with live ticking timer (`HH:MM:SS`).

- [ ] **Incognito / Different Browser Bypass Prevention Test**
  * **Location**: Secondary Browser / Incognito Tab (e.g. Chrome -> Safari, Brave, or Private Window)
  * **Action**: On the same physical device in active cooldown, open an incognito tab or switch browsers. Navigate to `/intake/returns` and enter PIN `654321`.
  * **Expected Behavior**: The deterministic hardware fingerprint engine (`src/utils/deviceFingerprint.js`) identifies the identical physical GPU, audio context, and display metrics. The server blocks authentication with HTTP 429 and displays the Cooldown Lockout Screen. Browser switching or cache wiping CANNOT bypass the lockout.

- [ ] **Admin Emergency Cooldown Reset Test**
  * **Location**: Admin Dashboard -> **"QR Keys & PINs Manager"** -> Profile Action: **"Clear Cooldowns"**
  * **Action**: As Super Admin or Admin, click **"Clear Cooldowns"** on the `Customer Delivery Boxes` profile. Confirm the prompt.
  * **Expected Behavior**: Server calls `/api/v1/auth/clear-cooldown` and purges matching records from `public.device_intake_sessions`. Previously locked devices are instantly unlocked and can scan and authenticate with the PIN immediately.

### 1.2 Barcode Intake & Camera Scanner

### 1.3 Proof Photo Capture, WebP Compression & Google Drive Storage
- [ ] **TC-PUB-07 (In-Browser Aggressive WebP Compression)**
  * **Location**: Section 2: `PROOF PHOTOS (REQUIRED)`
  * **Action**: Upload a high-resolution 48MP / 10MB mobile phone camera JPG.
  * **Expected Behavior**: Canvas compressor resizes the image to $\le$ 1280px max dimension and encodes it as `image/webp` at `0.7` quality. The payload is reduced by $>95\%$ to approximately 80KB–180KB, preventing Vercel 10s serverless timeout errors.
  * **Edge Case**: Upload an image on a browser with canvas WebP disabled; verify automatic fallback to JPEG 0.7 without crashing.

- [ ] **TC-PUB-07B (Google Workspace Drive Primary Photo Upload)**
  * **Location**: Section 2: `PROOF PHOTOS (REQUIRED)` -> Submission workflow
  * **Action**: Submit report with Google Service Account credentials configured.
