import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Key, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  Copy, 
  Check, 
  RefreshCw, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Trash2, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Plus, 
  Clock, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Lock,
  Layers
} from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';

const TARGET_SYSTEMS = [
  { id: 'primary', name: 'Primary System (Mine)', role: 'Internal Central System', badge: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/40 dark:text-blue-300' },
  { id: 'jarmen', name: 'Jarmen', role: 'Partner Wholesale System', badge: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-300' },
  { id: 'jelo', name: 'Jelo', role: 'Partner Operations System', badge: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/40 dark:text-purple-300' },
  { id: 'arlito', name: 'Arlito', role: 'Partner Inventory System', badge: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/40 dark:text-amber-300' }
];

export default function ApiKeysManagementSection() {
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(null);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState(null);

  // New Key Generation / Reveal State
  const [showGenerateModal, setShowGenerateModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSystem, setSelectedSystem] = useState(TARGET_SYSTEMS[0].name);
  const [rateLimit, setRateLimit] = useState(60);
  
  // One-time revealed key
  const [revealedKey, setRevealedKey] = useState(null);
  const [hasCopied, setHasCopied] = useState(false);

  // Load existing API keys
  const loadKeys = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      // Fetch via Supabase table public.api_keys
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('api_keys')
        .select('id, name, masked_key, is_active, rate_limit, expires_at, last_used_at, created_at')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (error) {
        // Table might not exist yet if user hasn't run the SQL migration
        if (error.code === '42P01') {
          setFeedback({
            type: 'warning',
            message: 'Database table "api_keys" not found. Please run the SQL migration script in your Supabase SQL Editor.'
          });
          setKeys([]);
          return;
        }
        throw error;
      }

      setKeys(data || []);
      setFeedback(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error fetching API keys:', err);
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err.message || 'Failed to load API keys' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadKeys();
  }, []);

  // Generate a key via the API endpoint
  const handleGenerateKey = async () => {
    setActionLoading('generate');
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/v1/api-keys', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: selectedSystem,
          rateLimit: parseInt(rateLimit, 10) || 60
        })
      });

      const text = await res.text();
      let json = null;
      try {
        json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
      } catch (e) {}

      if (!res.ok || !json?.success) {
        throw new Error(json?.message || `Failed to generate key (Status ${res.status}): ${text.slice(0, 100)}`);
      }

      // Store revealed key to show user once
      setRevealedKey({
        rawKey: json.apiKey,
        name: selectedSystem,
        maskedKey: json.keyRecord?.masked_key
      });
      setShowGenerateModal(false);
      setHasCopied(false);
      await loadKeys();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error generating key:', err);
      alert('Failed to generate key: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  // Rotate a key
  const handleRotateKey = async (keyItem) => {
    const confirmRotate = window.confirm(
      `Are you sure you want to rotate the API key for "${keyItem.name}"?\n\nThe current key (${keyItem.masked_key}) will be immediately revoked and a new secret key will be generated.`
    );
    if (!confirmRotate) return;

    setActionLoading(`rotate-${keyItem.id}`);
    try {
      // Use query parameter which routes cleanly to both index.js and [id].js
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/api-keys?id=${encodeURIComponent(keyItem.id)}`, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: keyItem.id })
      });
      
      const text = await res.text();
      let json = null;
      try {
        json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
      } catch (e) {}

      if (!res.ok || !json?.success) {
        throw new Error(json?.message || `Failed to rotate key (Status ${res.status}): ${text.slice(0, 100)}`);
      }

      setRevealedKey({
        rawKey: json.apiKey,
        name: keyItem.name,
        maskedKey: json.keyRecord?.masked_key,
        isRotated: true
      });
      setHasCopied(false);
      await loadKeys();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Rotate key error:', err);
      alert('Failed to rotate key: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  // Revoke / Delete a key
  const handleRevokeKey = async (keyItem) => {
    const confirmRevoke = window.confirm(
      `Are you sure you want to permanently revoke and delete the API key for "${keyItem.name}"? Any system currently using this key will immediately receive 401 Unauthorized.`
    );
    if (!confirmRevoke) return;

    setActionLoading(`revoke-${keyItem.id}`);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/api-keys?id=${encodeURIComponent(keyItem.id)}`, {
        method: 'DELETE',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id: keyItem.id })
      });

      const text = await res.text();
      let json = null;
      try {
        json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
      } catch (e) {}

      if (!res.ok || (json && !json.success)) {
        // Direct Supabase fallback in case of serverless routing error
        const { error: dbErr } = await supabase
          .from('api_keys')
          .delete()
          .eq('id', keyItem.id);

        if (dbErr) {
          throw new Error(json?.message || dbErr.message || `Status ${res.status}`);
        }
      }

      await loadKeys();
      setFeedback({ type: 'success', message: `API Key for ${keyItem.name} revoked successfully.` });
      setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 4000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Revoke key error:', err);
      alert('Failed to revoke key: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleCopySecret = () => {
    if (!revealedKey?.rawKey) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(revealedKey.rawKey);
    setHasCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setHasCopied(false), 3000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xs space-y-5">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
              <Key className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                Multi-System REST API Keys & Integration
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  SHA-256 Hashed
                </span>
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Manage secure API keys for <strong>Primary System</strong>, <strong>Jarmen</strong>, <strong>Jelo</strong>, and <strong>Arlito</strong>.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <a
            href="/docs"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Interactive Docs (/docs)</span>
          </a>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setShowGenerateModal(true)}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm shadow-purple-600/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Generate New Key</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {feedback && (
        <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 ${
          feedback.type === 'warning' ? 'bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/40 dark:border-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300' :
          feedback.type === 'error' ? 'bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-900 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:border-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300' :
          'bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300'
        }`}>
          <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
          <span>{feedback.message}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4 Client Systems Overview Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        {TARGET_SYSTEMS.map((sys) => {
          const matchingKeys = keys.filter(k => k.name.toLowerCase().includes(sys.id) || k.name.toLowerCase().includes(sys.name.toLowerCase().split(' ')[0]));
          const activeKey = matchingKeys.find(k => k.is_active);

          return (
            <div
              key={sys.id}
              className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 space-y-2"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md ${sys.badge}`}>
                  {sys.name}
                </span>
                {activeKey ? (
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> Active
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400">
                    No Active Key
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
                {sys.role}
              </div>

              {activeKey ? (
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <div className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                    {activeKey.masked_key}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                    <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                    Last used: {activeKey.last_used_at ? new Date(activeKey.last_used_at).toLocaleDateString() : 'Never'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedSystem(sys.name);
                    setShowGenerateModal(true);
                  }}
                  className="w-full mt-2 py-1.5 px-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 hover:bg-purple-50 dark:hover:bg-purple-950/40 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-dashed border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  + Issue Key for {sys.name.split(' ')[0]}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Active Keys Table */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h4 className="text-xs font-extrabold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 uppercase tracking-wider">
            All Registered API Keys ({keys.length})
          </h4>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={loadKeys}
            disabled={loading}
            className="text-xs text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3 h-3 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        {keys.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center border border-dashed border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-400">
            No API keys issued yet. Click <strong>Generate New Key</strong> above to issue a key for Primary System, Jarmen, Jelo, or Arlito.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
              <thead className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <tr>
                  <th className="p-3">Client System</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Masked Key</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Rate Limit</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Last Used</th>
                  <th className="p-3">Status</th>
                  <th className="p-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
                {keys.map((k) => (
                  <tr key={k.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/30">
                    <td className="p-3 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      {k.name}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 font-mono text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                      {k.masked_key}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                      {k.rate_limit || 60} req/min
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      {k.last_used_at ? new Date(k.last_used_at).toLocaleString() : 'Never'}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3">
                      {k.is_active ? (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300">
                          Active
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300">
                          Revoked
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3 text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleRotateKey(k)}
                          disabled={actionLoading === `rotate-${k.id}`}
                          title="Rotate API Key (Invalidate current and create new)"
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-50 dark:hover:bg-purple-950/40 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${actionLoading === `rotate-${k.id}` ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                        </button>

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleRevokeKey(k)}
                          disabled={actionLoading === `revoke-${k.id}`}
                          title="Revoke and Delete API Key"
                          className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/40 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* MODAL 1: Generate Key Modal */}
      {showGenerateModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <Key className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-600" />
                Issue New API Key
              </h3>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowGenerateModal(false)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Target Client System
                </label>
                <select
                  value={selectedSystem}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedSystem(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-600"
                >
                  {TARGET_SYSTEMS.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={s.name}>
                      {s.name} ({s.role})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Rate Limit (Requests per minute)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="10"
                  max="300"
                  value={rateLimit}
                  onChange={(e) => setRateLimit(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-600"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/30 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900 rounded-xl text-[11px] text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-300">
                <p className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Security Notice
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1">
                  The secret API key will be hashed using SHA-256 before being stored in the database. You will only be shown the raw key <strong>once</strong>.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowGenerateModal(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleGenerateKey}
                disabled={actionLoading === 'generate'}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-sm shadow-purple-600/20 transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {actionLoading === 'generate' ? 'Generating...' : 'Generate Key'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODAL 2: One-Time Key Reveal Modal */}
      {revealedKey && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-2xl p-5 max-w-lg w-full shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {revealedKey.isRotated ? 'API Key Rotated Successfully' : 'API Key Generated Successfully'}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Client: <strong>{revealedKey.name}</strong>
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3.5 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 rounded-xl space-y-1">
              <div className="text-xs font-extrabold text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                Copy this secret key now. It cannot be shown again!
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400">
                For security reasons, only the SHA-256 hash is kept in the database. If you lose this key, you will need to rotate or generate a replacement.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Raw Secret Key
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="flex-1 p-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl font-mono text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-emerald-400 select-all break-all">
                  {revealedKey.rawKey}
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleCopySecret}
                  className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    hasCopied
                      ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                      : 'bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900 dark:hover:bg-slate-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  {hasCopied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  <span>{hasCopied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy'}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                Masked representation: <code className="font-mono">{revealedKey.maskedKey}</code>
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRevealedKey(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                I have saved this key safely
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/BufferExchangeSlipModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Printer, Truck, ArrowLeftRight, CheckCircle2, Building2, Package, ShieldCheck, UserCheck, Calendar, FileText, RefreshCw, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { printIsolatedElement } from '../utils/printIsolatedElement';
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';

export default function BufferExchangeSlipModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  report,
  reports = [],
  onDispatched,
  hasCreditMemo = false
}) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Resolve target reports array
  const reportsToRender = (reports && reports.length > 0)
    ? reports
    : (report ? [report] : []);

  if (reportsToRender.length === 0) return null;

  // Driver, vehicle, and dispatch state
  const [driverName, setDriverName] = useState(report?.ai_document_metadata?.buffer_driver || '');
  const [plateNumber, setPlateNumber] = useState(report?.ai_document_metadata?.buffer_plate || '');
  const [dispatcherName, setDispatcherName] = useState('Logistics Lead');
  const [sourceBin, setSourceBin] = useState(report?.warehouse_location || 'BUFFER-STOCK-RACK-01');
  const [isDispatching, setIsDispatching] = useState(false);
  const [dispatchSuccess, setDispatchSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [autoPrintOnDispatch, setAutoPrintOnDispatch] = useState(true);

  const isAlreadyDispatched = reportsToRender.some(
    r => r.status === 'buffer_replacement_dispatched' || (r.disposition && r.disposition.includes('Buffer'))
  );

  const handleConfirmDispatch = async () => {
    if (isDispatching) return;
    setIsDispatching(true);
    try {
      const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
      const driver = driverName.trim() || 'Authorized Driver';
      const plate = plateNumber.trim().toUpperCase() || 'TRUCK-ASSIGNED';
      const dispatcher = dispatcherName.trim() || 'Logistics Lead';
      const bin = sourceBin.trim().toUpperCase() || 'BUFFER-STOCK-RACK-01';

      const updatedReports = [];
      for (const rep of reportsToRender) {
        const existingAudit = Array.isArray(rep.audit_trail) ? [...rep.audit_trail] : [];
        const payload = {
          status: 'buffer_replacement_dispatched',
          disposition: '6- Buffer Stock Exchange',
          warehouse_location: bin,
          inspected_by: dispatcher,
          inspected_at: timestamp,
          notes: `${rep.notes ? rep.notes + ' | ' : ''}1-to-1 Buffer Stock Replacement Dispatched (${rep.quantity} ${rep.unit_name || 'pc'}). Driver: ${driver} (${plate}). Released by: ${dispatcher}.`,
          audit_trail: [
            ...existingAudit,
            {
              timestamp,
              stage: 'BUFFER_DISPATCHED',
              actor: dispatcher,
              disposition: 'Buffer Stock Exchange',
              note: `1-to-1 Buffer stock replacement dispatched: ${rep.quantity} ${rep.unit_name || 'pc'} released to driver ${driver} (${plate}). Gate pass authorized.`
            }
          ]
        };

        const { data: updated, error } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .update(payload)
          .eq('id', rep.id)
          .select('*')
          .single();

        if (error) throw error;
        updatedReports.push(updated || { ...rep, ...payload });
      }

      setDispatchSuccess(true);
      if (autoPrintOnDispatch) {
        handlePrint();
      }
      if (onDispatched) {
        onDispatched(updatedReports[0], updatedReports);
      }
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-data-changed', {
        detail: { type: 'buffer-dispatched', rma: updatedReports[0]?.rma_number }
      }));

      setTimeout(() => {
        setDispatchSuccess(false);
        onClose();
      }, 2500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Buffer dispatch error:', err);
      alert(`Buffer Dispatch failed: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsDispatching(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    const docTitle = reportsToRender.length === 1 && reportsToRender[0]?.rma_number
      ? `Buffer-Exchange-Slip-${reportsToRender[0].rma_number}`
      : `Batch-Buffer-Exchange-Slips-${reportsToRender.length}`;

    printIsolatedElement({
      elementId: 'buffer-exchange-slip-print-root',
      documentTitle: docTitle,
      pageSize: 'portrait',
      pageMargin: '0.35in',
      customStyles: `
        #buffer-exchange-slip-print-root {
          width: 100% !important;
          max-width: 195mm !important;
          margin: 0 auto !important;
          padding: 0 !important;
          box-shadow: none !important;
          border: none !important;
          background: #ffffff !important;
          color: #0f172a !important;
          max-height: none !important;
          height: auto !important;
          overflow: visible !important;
        }
        #buffer-exchange-slip-print-root > div {
          max-height: none !important;
          height: auto !important;
          overflow: visible !important;
        }
        .slip-sheet {
          page-break-after: always !important;
          break-after: page !important;
          page-break-inside: avoid !important;
          break-inside: avoid !important;
          padding: 16px 20px !important;
          background: #ffffff !important;
          border: none !important;
          box-shadow: none !important;
        }
        .slip-sheet:last-child {
          page-break-after: auto !important;
          break-after: auto !important;
        }
        .print-hidden, .print\\:hidden, .bottom-sheet-handle,
        #buffer-exchange-slip-print-root .print\\:hidden,
        #buffer-exchange-slip-print-root .bottom-sheet-handle {
          display: none !important;
        }
        input {
          border: none !important;
          outline: none !important;
          background: transparent !important;
        }
      `
    });
  };

  const isBulk = reportsToRender.length > 1;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-6 md:p-8 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in overflow-y-auto">
      
      {/* Print Specific Stylesheet Injection */}
      <style>{`
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: portrait;
            margin: 10mm 14mm;
          }
          html, body {
            background: #ffffff !important;
            color: #0f172a !important;
            font-size: 11pt !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
          }
          #app-main-view-container,
          .print-hidden, .print\\:hidden {
            display: none !important;
          }
          #buffer-exchange-slip-print-root {
            position: static !important;
            display: block !important;
            width: 100% !important;
            max-width: 100% !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            background: #ffffff !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            border: none !important;
            border-radius: 0 !important;
            overflow: visible !important;
          }
          .slip-sheet {
            page-break-after: always;
            break-after: page;
            page-break-inside: avoid;
            break-inside: avoid;
            margin: 0 0 10mm 0;
            padding: 16px 20px !important;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            background: #ffffff !important;
          }
          .slip-sheet:last-child {
            page-break-after: auto;
            break-after: auto;
          }
        }
      `}</style>

      <div
        id="buffer-exchange-slip-print-root"
        className="bg-white rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 max-w-2xl w-full flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] sm:max-h-[95vh] overflow-hidden text-slate-900 my-0 sm:my-auto pb-safe"
      >
        {/* Mobile Drag Indicator */}
        <div className="bottom-sheet-handle sm:hidden print:hidden" />

        {/* Top Control Bar (Hidden when printing) */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 print:hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="p-2 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 rounded-xl">
              <Truck className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="font-extrabold text-xs text-slate-800 block">
                {isBulk ? `Batch Buffer Exchange Slips (${reportsToRender.length})` : 'Buffer Stock Replacement Dispatch Slip'}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                Official Gate Pass & Store Handover Delivery Voucher
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleConfirmDispatch}
              disabled={isDispatching}
              className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 active:bg-emerald-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              title="Update system to Buffer Dispatched, record driver & vehicle, and authorize gate pass"
            >
              {isDispatching ? (
                <>
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Recording Dispatch...</span>
                </>
              ) : isAlreadyDispatched ? (
                <>
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Update &amp; Re-dispatch</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>🚀 Confirm &amp; Dispatch Buffer</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
              title="Print Physical Gate Pass Slip"
            >
              <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Print Slip / PDF</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Double-Compensation Safety Warning (Credit Memo already issued) */}
        {hasCreditMemo && (
          <div className="mx-4 sm:mx-6 mt-4 p-3.5 bg-amber-50 border-2 border-amber-300 rounded-2xl text-amber-900 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2.5 shadow-2xs print:hidden animate-in fade-in">
            <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
            <span>⚠️ Note: A Finance Credit Memo was already issued for this return. Only dispatch buffer stock if physical replacement is also authorized.</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Success Alert Banner */}
        {dispatchSuccess && (
          <div className="px-6 py-3 bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-2 print:hidden animate-in fade-in">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>Buffer Stock Replacement Confirmed &amp; Dispatched! System lifecycle updated to "Buffer Dispatched".</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Notice if already dispatched */}
        {isAlreadyDispatched && !dispatchSuccess && (
          <div className="px-6 py-2 bg-indigo-50 border-b border-indigo-200 text-indigo-900 text-xs font-medium flex items-center gap-2 print:hidden">
            <Truck className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
            <span>This RMA ticket was already recorded as <strong>Buffer Replacement Dispatched</strong>. You can reprint or re-authorize dispatch below.</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Driver, Truck, Bin & Dispatcher Quick Inputs */}
        <div className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-indigo-50/70 border-b border-indigo-100 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-xs print:hidden">
          <div>
            <label className="text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-900 block mb-0.5">Assigned Driver</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={driverName}
              onChange={(e) => setDriverName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Juan Delivery / Repacker"
              className="w-full px-2.5 py-1 bg-white border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-900 block mb-0.5">Vehicle / Plate #</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={plateNumber}
              onChange={(e) => setPlateNumber(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. NBD-1042 / Truck 03"
              className="w-full px-2.5 py-1 bg-white border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-900 block mb-0.5">Source Buffer Bin</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={sourceBin}
              onChange={(e) => setSourceBin(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. BUFFER-STOCK-RACK-01"
              className="w-full px-2.5 py-1 bg-white border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-600 font-mono"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-900 block mb-0.5">Warehouse Dispatcher</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={dispatcherName}
              onChange={(e) => setDispatcherName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Warehouse Supervisor"
              className="w-full px-2.5 py-1 bg-white border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-600"
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Document Container */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto divide-y-4 divide-slate-200 print:divide-y-0 print:overflow-visible">
          {reportsToRender.map((rep, idx) => {
            const slipNumber = rep?.rma_number
              ? `BES-${rep.rma_number.replace(/^RMA-/, '')}`
              : `BES-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(idx + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`;

            return (
              <div
                key={rep.id || rep.rma_number || idx}
                className="slip-sheet p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-4 sm:space-y-5 print:p-2 print:space-y-3.5"
              >
                {/* Header */}
                <div className="border-b-2 border-slate-900 pb-3 sm:pb-4">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                    <div className="pl-1">
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-black tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-500">
                        PINGCON MARKETING • WHOLESALE REVERSE LOGISTICS
                      </div>
                      <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black tracking-tight text-slate-900 mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span>BUFFER STOCK REPLACEMENT SLIP</span>
                      </h1>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium mt-0.5">
                        Official Warehouse Gate Pass & Store 1-to-1 Replacement Voucher
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                      <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-900 rounded-lg text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider inline-block">
                        GATE PASS / DISPATCH
                      </span>
                      <div className="font-mono font-black text-sm text-slate-900 mt-1">
                        {slipNumber}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                        Date: {new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Reference Overview Grid */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 text-xs bg-slate-50 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Receiving Customer / Store</span>
                    <div className="font-black text-slate-900 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-0.5">
                      {rep.store_branch || rep.supplier_name || rep.company || 'Customer Store'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Linked Return Ticket</span>
                    <div className="font-mono font-black text-indigo-700 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-0.5">
                      {rep.rma_number}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Original SI / DR #</span>
                    <div className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-800 text-xs mt-0.5">
                      {rep.si_number || rep.dr_number || rep.invoice_dr_number || 'N/A (Intake Verified)'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Assigned AE / Coordinator</span>
                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-xs mt-0.5">
                      {rep.ae_name ? (rep.ae_email ? `${rep.ae_name} (${rep.ae_email})` : rep.ae_name) : 'Unassigned'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Replacement Goods Table */}
                <div className="border border-slate-300 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xs">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-300 text-slate-700 uppercase font-black text-[10px] tracking-wider">
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Item Description / Name</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Barcode / SKU</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">Unit</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">Replacement Qty</th>
                        <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Exchange Category</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200 bg-white">
                      {(() => {
                        const lineItems = (Array.isArray(rep.items) && rep.items.length > 0)
                          ? rep.items
                          : (typeof rep.items === 'string' && rep.items.trim()
                              ? (() => { try { const p = JSON.parse(rep.items); return Array.isArray(p) ? p : []; } catch(e){ return []; } })()
                              : []);

                        if (lineItems.length > 1) {
                          const totalQty = lineItems.reduce((acc, it) => acc + (Number(it.quantity) || 1), 0);
                          return (
                            <>
                              {lineItems.map((it, itIdx) => (
                                <tr key={it.id || itIdx}>
                                  <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                                    <div className="font-black text-slate-900 text-xs sm:text-sm">
                                      {it.name || it.productName || `Item #${itIdx + 1}`}
                                    </div>
                                    <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                                      Original Defect: <strong className="text-amber-700">{it.reason || rep.reason || 'Damaged packaging'}</strong>
                                    </div>
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-mono font-bold text-slate-700">
                                    <div>{it.barcode}</div>
                                    {(it.code || it.sku) && <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">SKU: {it.code || it.sku}</div>}
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase">
                                    {it.unit_name || it.unit || rep.unit_name || 'pc'}
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                                    <span className="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 rounded-lg font-black text-sm">
                                      {it.quantity || 1} {it.unit_name || it.unit || rep.unit_name || 'pc'}
                                    </span>
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                                      <ArrowLeftRight className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-600" />
                                      <span>1-to-1 Buffer Swap</span>
                                    </span>
                                    <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Zero Balance Deduction</div>
                                  </td>
                                </tr>
                              ))}
                              {/* Total Multi-Item Summary Row */}
                              <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-t-2 border-slate-300 font-black">
                                <td colSpan={2} className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right uppercase text-[10px] text-slate-600">
                                  Total Multi-Item Buffer Replacement ({lineItems.length} Products):
                                </td>
                                <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center text-slate-500 text-[10px] uppercase">
                                  Total Qty
                                </td>
                                <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                                  <span className="inline-block px-3 py-1 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-900 rounded-lg font-black text-sm font-mono">
                                    {totalQty} {rep.unit_name || 'pcs'}
                                  </span>
                                </td>
                                <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
                                  ✓ Full Manifest Dispatched
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            </>
                          );
                        }

                        // Standard Single Item Fallback
                        return (
                          <tr>
                            <td className="py-3 px-3">
                              <div className="font-black text-slate-900 text-xs sm:text-sm">{rep.name}</div>
                              <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                                Original Defect: <strong className="text-amber-700">{rep.reason || 'Damaged packaging'}</strong>
                              </div>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono font-bold text-slate-700">
                              <div>{rep.barcode}</div>
                              {rep.code && <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">SKU: {rep.code}</div>}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase">
                              {rep.unit_name || 'pc'}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                              <span className="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 rounded-lg font-black text-sm">
                                {rep.quantity} {rep.unit_name || 'pc'}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3 px-3">
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                                <ArrowLeftRight className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-600" />
                                <span>1-to-1 Buffer Swap</span>
                              </span>
                              <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Zero Balance Deduction</div>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })()}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                {/* Warehouse Location & Gate Pass Info Banner */}
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Package className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600 shrink-0" />
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-700">Source Buffer Bin: </span>
                      <strong className="font-mono text-indigo-900">{sourceBin || rep.warehouse_location || 'BUFFER-STOCK-RACK-01'}</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500">
                    Condition: <strong className="text-emerald-700">Brand New / Sealed Wholesale Stock</strong>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Transport & Vehicle Details Box */}
                <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-50/50 border border-indigo-200 rounded-xl grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-xs">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-indigo-800 block">Delivery Truck / Plate #</span>
                    <div className="font-mono font-black text-slate-900 uppercase">
                      {plateNumber || 'TRUCK-ASSIGNED'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-indigo-800 block">Authorized Delivery Driver</span>
                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-900">
                      {driverName || 'Authorized Driver'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-1">
                    <span className="text-[9.5px] uppercase font-bold text-indigo-800 block">Warehouse Gate Pass Release</span>
                    <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>RELEASE AUTHORIZED</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Triple Signature Blocks */}
                <div className="border-t-2 border-slate-900 pt-4 mt-6">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 text-center">
                    {/* Warehouse Release */}
                    <div className="border-t border-slate-400 pt-1.5">
                      <div className="font-black text-xs text-slate-900">{dispatcherName || 'Warehouse Supervisor'}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Warehouse Dispatcher</div>
                      <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400">Stock Inspected & Released</div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Driver Handover */}
                    <div className="border-t border-slate-400 pt-1.5">
                      <div className="font-black text-xs text-slate-900">{driverName || 'Delivery Driver'}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Logistics Transport (Driver)</div>
                      <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400">Received for Store Handover</div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Customer Store Receiving */}
                    <div className="border-t border-slate-400 pt-1.5">
                      <div className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-400">(Customer Signature & Date)</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-700 mt-0.5">Store Receiving In-Charge</div>
                      <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-500">Replacement Received in Good Condition</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Official Legal & Audit Footnote */}
                <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 text-center pt-2">
                  This Buffer Stock Replacement Dispatch Slip serves as an official warehouse gate pass and delivery handover confirmation under RMA Ticket {rep.rma_number}. No monetary credit or deduction is granted for this physical item replacement.
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
