  Plus,
  Minus,
  FileText, 
  Building2,
  Percent
} from 'lucide-react';
import { creditMemoService } from '../services/creditMemoService';
import { authService } from '../services/authService';
import { hasAssignedSku } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

export default function CreditMemoModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  report,
  creditMemo,
  onSaved,
  onViewVoucher,
  currentUser,
  reportsList = [],
  savedProductsList = [],
  creditMemosCount = 0,
  onAssignSku
}) {
  const isEditing = Boolean(creditMemo && creditMemo.credit_memo_number);

  const prevIsOpenRef = useRef(false);
  const currentEditingRef = useRef(null);
  const prevTargetReportIdRef = useRef(null);

  const [selectedReportId, setSelectedReportId] = useState('');
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);
  const [unitName, setUnitName] = useState('pc');
  const [unitPrice, setUnitPrice] = useState('0.00');
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('0.00');
  const [pullOutRef, setPullOutRef] = useState('');
  const [pullOutDate, setPullOutDate] = useState(() => new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [creditAmount, setCreditAmount] = useState('0.00');
  const [financeHead, setFinanceHead] = useState(creditMemo?.credit_issued_by || 'Analiza B. Benoza');
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState(null);

  // Clean customer inbound return reports list (filtering out manifest sub-items to avoid duplicates)
  const availableReports = useMemo(() => {
    if (!Array.isArray(reportsList)) return [];
    return reportsList.filter(r => {
      if (r.rma_type && r.rma_type !== 'customer_inbound') return false;
      if (r.parent_rma_id && reportsList.some(p => p.id === r.parent_rma_id && p.rma_number === r.rma_number)) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    });
  }, [reportsList]);

  // Active report resolution: prioritize user-selected report from dropdown, then passed report, then first available report
  const activeReport = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedReportId) {
      if (report && (
        String(report.id) === String(selectedReportId) ||
        String(report.rma_number) === String(selectedReportId) ||
        String(report.barcode) === String(selectedReportId) ||
        `${report.rma_number}_${report.barcode}` === String(selectedReportId)
      )) {
        return report;
      }
      const match = availableReports.find(r => String(r.id) === String(selectedReportId) || r.rma_number === selectedReportId);
      if (match) return match;
    }
    if (report) return report;
    if (!isEditing && availableReports.length > 0) {
      return availableReports[0];
    }
    return null;
  }, [report, selectedReportId, availableReports, isEditing]);

  // Validation: Guard against issuing credit memo for ₱0.00 or unassigned SKU
  const isMissingSku = useMemo(() => {
    if (isEditing) return false;
    const target = activeReport || report;
    if (!target) return false;
    return !hasAssignedSku(target, savedProductsList);
  }, [isEditing, activeReport, report, savedProductsList]);

  // Synchronize all form data when an RMA return ticket is selected
  const applyReportToForm = (rep) => {
    if (!rep) return;
    // Always default to the exact quantity entered on the return ticket
    const qty = Math.max(1, Number(rep.quantity) || 1);
    const price = Number((Number(rep.price_with_vat ?? rep.price ?? 0)).toFixed(2));
    const gross = Number((qty * price).toFixed(2));

    const targetKey = rep.id || (rep.barcode ? `${rep.rma_number}_${rep.barcode}` : rep.rma_number) || '';
    setSelectedReportId(targetKey);
    setQuantity(qty);
    setUnitName(rep.unit_name || rep.unit || 'pc');
    setUnitPrice(price.toFixed(2));
    setAmount(gross.toFixed(2));
    setCreditAmount(gross.toFixed(2));

    // Standardized POR: POR-2026-0001-1A4D
    const por = creditMemoService.generatePullOutReference(creditMemosCount);
    setPullOutRef(por);
    setPullOutDate(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
    setNotes('');
  };

  // Immediate handler when user picks an item from the dropdown: ALL data updates immediately
  const handleReportDropdownChange = (newVal) => {
    setSelectedReportId(newVal);
    if (report && (
      String(report.id) === String(newVal) ||
      String(report.rma_number) === String(newVal) ||
      `${report.rma_number}_${report.barcode}` === String(newVal)
    )) {
      applyReportToForm(report);
      return;
    }
    const found = availableReports.find(r => String(r.id) === String(newVal) || r.rma_number === newVal);
    if (found) {
      applyReportToForm(found);
    }
  };

  // Sync state ONLY when modal opens or target report/memo explicitly switches
  useEffect(() => {
    const isOpening = isOpen && !prevIsOpenRef.current;
    const memoChanged = isEditing && creditMemo?.credit_memo_number !== currentEditingRef.current;
    const currentTargetId = report ? (report.id ? String(report.id) : (report.barcode ? `${report.rma_number}_${report.barcode}` : report.rma_number)) : null;
    const reportChanged = !isEditing && isOpen && currentTargetId && currentTargetId !== prevTargetReportIdRef.current;

    if (isOpening || memoChanged || reportChanged) {
      prevIsOpenRef.current = isOpen;
      currentEditingRef.current = creditMemo?.credit_memo_number || null;
      prevTargetReportIdRef.current = currentTargetId;
      setErrorMessage(null);
      setIsLoading(false);

      if (isEditing && creditMemo) {
        setSelectedReportId(creditMemo.report_id || creditMemo.rma_number || '');
        setQuantity(creditMemo.quantity || 1);
        setUnitName(creditMemo.unit_name || 'pc');
        setUnitPrice(Number(creditMemo.unit_price || 0).toFixed(2));
        setAmount(Number(creditMemo.amount || 0).toFixed(2));
        setPullOutRef(creditMemo.pull_out_ref || creditMemoService.generatePullOutReference(creditMemosCount));
        setPullOutDate(creditMemo.pull_out_date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
        setCreditAmount(Number(creditMemo.credit_amount || creditMemo.amount || 0).toFixed(2));
        setFinanceHead(creditMemo.credit_issued_by || 'Analiza B. Benoza');
        setNotes(creditMemo.notes || '');
      } else {
        setFinanceHead('Analiza B. Benoza');
        const initialReport = report || (availableReports.length > 0 ? availableReports[0] : null);
        if (initialReport) {
          applyReportToForm(initialReport);
        }
      }
    } else if (!isOpen) {
      prevIsOpenRef.current = false;
      currentEditingRef.current = null;
      prevTargetReportIdRef.current = null;
      setSelectedReportId('');
    }
  }, [isOpen, creditMemo, isEditing, report, availableReports, creditMemosCount]);

  const updateCalculations = (newQty, newPrice) => {
    const q = Number(newQty) || 0;
    const p = parseFloat(newPrice) || 0;
    const gross = Number((q * p).toFixed(2));
    setAmount(gross.toFixed(2));
    setCreditAmount(gross.toFixed(2));
  };

  // Quantity handlers (smooth typing, backspace deletes cleanly without jumping, stepper buttons)
  const handleQuantityChange = (val) => {
    if (val === '') {
      setQuantity('');
      updateCalculations(0, unitPrice);
      return;
    }
    // Allow typing multi-digit numbers freely; strip any non-digit chars
    const clean = val.replace(/[^\d]/g, '');
    if (clean === '') {
      setQuantity('');
      updateCalculations(0, unitPrice);
      return;
    }
    const parsed = parseInt(clean, 10);
    if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed >= 0) {
      setQuantity(parsed);
      updateCalculations(parsed, unitPrice);
    }
  };

  const handleQuantityBlur = () => {
    const parsed = parseInt(quantity, 10);
    const target = activeReport || report;
    const defaultQty = Math.max(1, Number(target?.quantity) || 1);
    const finalQty = (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed > 0) ? parsed : defaultQty;
    setQuantity(finalQty);
    updateCalculations(finalQty, unitPrice);
  };

  const stepQuantity = (delta) => {
    const current = parseInt(quantity, 10) || 1;
    const next = Math.max(1, current + delta);
    setQuantity(next);
    updateCalculations(next, unitPrice);
  };

  // Price handlers with strict 2-decimal limit
  const handleUnitPriceChange = (val) => {
    if (val === '' || /^\d*\.?\d{0,2}$/.test(val)) {
      setUnitPrice(val);
      const num = parseFloat(val) || 0;
      updateCalculations(quantity, num);
    }
  };

  const handleUnitPriceBlur = () => {
    const p = Number((parseFloat(unitPrice) || 0).toFixed(2));
    setUnitPrice(p.toFixed(2));
    updateCalculations(quantity, p);
  };

  const handleAmountChange = (val) => {
    if (val === '' || /^\d*\.?\d{0,2}$/.test(val)) {
      setAmount(val);
      setCreditAmount(val);
    }
  };

  const handleAmountBlur = () => {
    const a = Number((parseFloat(amount) || 0).toFixed(2));
    setAmount(a.toFixed(2));
    setCreditAmount(a.toFixed(2));
  };

  const handleCreditAmountChange = (val) => {
    if (val === '' || /^\d*\.?\d{0,2}$/.test(val)) {
      setCreditAmount(val);
    }
  };

  const handleCreditAmountBlur = () => {
    const ca = Number((parseFloat(creditAmount) || 0).toFixed(2));
    setCreditAmount(ca.toFixed(2));
  };

  const applyCreditPercentage = (pct) => {
    const gross = parseFloat(amount) || 0;
    const val = Number((gross * pct).toFixed(2));
    setCreditAmount(val.toFixed(2));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e, thenPrint = false) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (isMissingSku) {
      setErrorMessage("Cannot issue Finance Credit Memo for ₱0.00 or unassigned SKU. Please click 'Assign SKU' first to register the official item code and verified price in the catalog.");
      return;
    }
    const finalQty = parseInt(quantity, 10) || 1;
    if (finalQty <= 0) {
      setErrorMessage('Quantity must be at least 1 unit.');
      return;
    }
    const finalCredit = parseFloat(creditAmount);
    if (isNaN(finalCredit) || finalCredit < 0) {
      setErrorMessage('Please enter a valid Credit Amount (up to 2 decimals).');
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const target = activeReport || creditMemo || report || {};
      const payload = {
        credit_memo_number: creditMemo?.credit_memo_number,
        rma_number: target?.rma_number,
        report_id: target?.id || target?.report_id,
        barcode: target?.barcode,
        product_name: target?.name || target?.product_name,
        sku: target?.code || target?.sku,
        supplier_name: target?.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
        company: 'Wholesale Distribution',
        customer_ae_name: target?.ae_name || target?.customer_ae_name || 'N/A',
        customer_ae_email: target?.ae_email || target?.customer_ae_email || '',
        quantity: finalQty,
        unit_name: unitName || target?.unit_name || 'pc',
        unit_price: Number(Number(unitPrice || 0).toFixed(2)),
        amount: Number(Number(amount || 0).toFixed(2)),
        pull_out_ref: pullOutRef.trim() || 'Warehouse Pull-Out',
        pull_out_date: pullOutDate,
        credit_amount: Number(finalCredit.toFixed(2)),
        credit_issued_by: (financeHead || '').trim() || 'Analiza B. Benoza',
        credit_issued_by_email: 'analiza@savemore.com',
        notes: notes.trim()
      };

      let resultMemo = null;
      if (isEditing) {
        const res = await creditMemoService.updateCreditMemo(creditMemo.credit_memo_number, payload);
        resultMemo = res.memo;
      } else {
        const res = await creditMemoService.createCreditMemo(payload);
        resultMemo = res.memo;
      }

      if (onSaved) onSaved(resultMemo);

      if (thenPrint && onViewVoucher) {
        onViewVoucher(resultMemo);
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Credit Memo save error:', err);
      setErrorMessage(err.message || 'Failed to save Credit Memo.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const targetReport = activeReport || creditMemo || report || {};
  const currentAeName = targetReport.ae_name || targetReport.customer_ae_name || 'Unassigned';


  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-xl w-full flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] sm:max-h-[92vh] overflow-hidden my-0 sm:my-auto">
        {/* Mobile Drag Indicator */}
        <div className="bottom-sheet-handle sm:hidden" />
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-2xl shadow-inner">
              <Receipt className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                  {isEditing ? 'Edit Finance Credit Memo' : 'Issue Finance Credit Memo'}
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  {isEditing ? creditMemo.credit_memo_number : 'New Voucher'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Generate official credit deduction linked to return ticket {targetReport.rma_number || ''}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Form Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
          
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
              <span>{errorMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Ticket Picker (Always available when creating so user can switch tickets and sync all data) */}
          {!isEditing && (availableReports.length > 0 || report) && (
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Select Linked RMA Return Ticket *
              </label>
              <select
                value={selectedReportId || (activeReport?.id ? String(activeReport.id) : (activeReport?.barcode ? `${activeReport.rma_number}_${activeReport.barcode}` : activeReport?.rma_number)) || ''}
                onChange={(e) => handleReportDropdownChange(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
              >
                {report && (report.is_manifest_child || !availableReports.some(r => String(r.id) === String(report.id) || (r.rma_number === report.rma_number && r.barcode === report.barcode))) && (
                  <option value={report.id || `${report.rma_number}_${report.barcode}`}>
                    {report.rma_number} — {report.name || report.product_name || report.barcode} (Line Item: {report.quantity || 1} {report.unit_name || 'pc'} • {report.supplier_name || 'Savemore'})
                  </option>
                )}
                {availableReports.map(r => (
                  <option key={r.id || r.rma_number} value={r.id || r.rma_number}>
                    {r.rma_number} — {r.name || r.barcode} (Qty: {r.quantity || 1} • {r.supplier_name || 'Warehouse'})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Linked RMA Report Summary Strip */}
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400">
                Ticket: {targetReport.rma_number || 'N/A'}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Supplier: {targetReport.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <div className="font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs sm:text-sm">
                  {targetReport.name || targetReport.product_name || 'Item'}
                </div>
                <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  Barcode: {targetReport.barcode || 'N/A'} {targetReport.code || targetReport.sku ? `• SKU: ${targetReport.code || targetReport.sku}` : ''}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Assigned Customer AE</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                  {currentAeName}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Financial Validation & Safety Guard Banner if item is unassigned or ₱0.00 */}
          {isMissingSku && (
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-2xl flex items-start justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-black text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200">
                    Financial Validation & Safety Guard
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
                    Cannot issue Finance Credit Memo for ₱0.00 or unassigned SKU. Please click &apos;Assign SKU&apos; first to set the official item code and verified price in the catalog.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              {onAssignSku && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    onClose();
                    onAssignSku(targetReport);
                  }}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Assign SKU Now</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          <form id="credit-memo-form" onSubmit={(e) => handleSubmit(e, false)} className="space-y-3.5 text-xs">
            
            {/* ROW 1: Quantity, Unit, Unit Price, Amount */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Quantity *
                </label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => stepQuantity(-1)}
                    className="w-8 h-9 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm shrink-0 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    title="Decrease Quantity"
                  >
                    <Minus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>

                  <div className="relative flex-1">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      inputMode="numeric"
                      pattern="[0-9]*"
                      required
                      value={quantity}
                      onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                      onChange={(e) => handleQuantityChange(e.target.value)}
                      onBlur={handleQuantityBlur}
                      placeholder="1"
                      className="w-full px-2.5 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-black font-mono text-center text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => stepQuantity(1)}
                    className="w-8 h-9 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm shrink-0 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    title="Increase Quantity"
                  >
                    <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Unit *
                </label>
                <select
                  value={unitName}
                  onChange={(e) => setUnitName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-2.5 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800 cursor-pointer h-9"
                >
                  <option value="pc">pc (piece)</option>
                  <option value="case">case</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Unit Price (₱ w/ VAT)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  value={unitPrice}
                  onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                  onChange={(e) => handleUnitPriceChange(e.target.value)}
                  onBlur={handleUnitPriceBlur}
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800 h-9"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Gross Amount (₱)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  value={amount}
                  onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                  onChange={(e) => handleAmountChange(e.target.value)}
                  onBlur={handleAmountBlur}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 h-9"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ROW 2: Pull Out Reference & Pull Out Date */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                    Pull Out Reference / Receipt # *
                  </label>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setPullOutRef(creditMemoService.generatePullOutReference(creditMemosCount))}
                    className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:text-emerald-700 dark:hover:text-emerald-300 flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                    title="Generate a new POR reference code"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>Regenerate POR</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={pullOutRef}
                  onChange={(e) => setPullOutRef(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. POR-2026-0001-1A4D"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Pull Out Date *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  required
                  value={pullOutDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setPullOutDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ROW 3: FINAL APPROVED CREDIT AMOUNT (Highlighted Card) */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50/80 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border-2 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800/80 rounded-2xl space-y-2.5">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300 tracking-wider">
                    Credit Amount (₱) *
                  </label>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    Approved financial deduction credited to customer account
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Quick adjustment buttons */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => applyCreditPercentage(1.0)}
                    className="px-2 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black transition-colors"
                    title="Grant 100% full credit"
                  >
                    100% Full
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => applyCreditPercentage(0.9)}
                    className="px-2 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-emerald-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black transition-colors"
                    title="Apply 10% handling fee deduction"
                  >
                    90% (-10%)
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="relative">
                <span className="absolute left-3.5 top-2.5 text-base font-black text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                  ₱
                </span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  required
                  value={creditAmount}
                  onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                  onChange={(e) => handleCreditAmountChange(e.target.value)}
                  onBlur={handleCreditAmountBlur}
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  className="w-full pl-8 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-2 border-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-600 rounded-xl text-base font-black font-mono text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ROW 4: Authorized Finance Head & Issuer Role */}
            <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl space-y-1.5 text-xs">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Authorized Finance Head / Approved By *
              </label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="p-2 bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/60 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 rounded-xl shrink-0">
                  <User className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  value={financeHead}
                  onChange={(e) => setFinanceHead(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Analiza B. Benoza"
                  className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-600 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-purple-500"
                />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-black px-2 py-1 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/80 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 rounded-lg shrink-0 uppercase">
                  Finance Head
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Authorized financial signatory appearing on the credit memo voucher and official audit records.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Accounting Notes / Remarks */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Accounting Remarks / Audit Notes (Optional)
              </label>
              <textarea
                rows={2}
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Approved pull-out deduction against Invoice #INV-2026-9042..."
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
              />
            </div>

          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Pinned Footer with Actions */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 pb-safe bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 shrink-0 flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="touch-target px-4 py-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white text-xs font-bold"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => handleSubmit(e, true)}
              disabled={isLoading || isMissingSku}
              className="touch-target px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs active:scale-95"
              title={isMissingSku ? "Cannot save voucher: Assign SKU first" : "Save Credit Memo and open printable official voucher"}
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
              <span className="truncate">Save & View Voucher</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="submit"
              form="credit-memo-form"
              disabled={isLoading || isMissingSku}
              className="touch-target px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
              title={isMissingSku ? "Cannot issue Credit Memo: Assign SKU first" : "Issue Credit Memo"}
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              )}
              <span className="truncate">{isEditing ? 'Update Credit Memo' : 'Issue Credit Memo'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/CreditMemoModal.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/CreditMemosTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Receipt, 
  Search, 
  Plus, 
  Printer, 
  Edit3, 
  Trash2, 
  DollarSign, 
  Package, 
  ArrowUpDown, 
  ArrowUp, 
  ArrowDown, 
  Download, 
  RotateCcw,
  Building2,
  Calendar,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertCircle,
  Database,
  CheckSquare,
  Square
} from 'lucide-react';
import TablePagination from './TablePagination';
import { formatFilenameDateTime } from '../utils/exportCsv';

export default function CreditMemosTab({
  creditMemosList = [],
  onOpenCreateModal,
  onEditCreditMemo,
  onViewVoucher,
  onPrintBulk,
  onRequestDeleteCreditMemo,
  onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo,
  recentReportsList = [],
  currentUser
}) {
  const canManageCreditMemos = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [supplierFilter, setSupplierFilter] = useState('All');
  const [dateFrom, setDateFrom] = useState('');
  const [dateTo, setDateTo] = useState('');
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState('credit_issued_at');
  const [sortDirection, setSortDirection] = useState('desc');
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(10);
  const [selectedMemoNumbers, setSelectedMemoNumbers] = useState(new Set());

  // Extract unique suppliers from credit memos
  const suppliers = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set();
    creditMemosList.forEach(m => {
      const sup = (m.supplier_name || 'Savemore').trim();
      if (sup) set.add(sup);
    });
    return ['All', ...Array.from(set).sort()];
  }, [creditMemosList]);

  // Automatically prune orphan credit memo selection numbers whenever creditMemosList updates
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedMemoNumbers(prev => {
      if (prev.size === 0) return prev;
      const valid = new Set(creditMemosList.map(m => m.credit_memo_number).filter(Boolean));
      const next = new Set([...prev].filter(num => valid.has(num)));
      return next.size === prev.size ? prev : next;
    });
  }, [creditMemosList]);

  // Financial summary metrics
  const metrics = useMemo(() => {
    let totalCredited = 0;
    let totalGross = 0;
    let totalUnits = 0;

    creditMemosList.forEach(m => {
      totalCredited += Number(m.credit_amount || m.amount || 0);
      totalGross += Number(m.amount || 0);
      totalUnits += Number(m.quantity || 1);
    });

    return {
      count: creditMemosList.length,
      totalCredited,
      totalGross,
      totalUnits
    };
  }, [creditMemosList]);

  // Filter & sort (with date range support)
  const processedMemos = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    let list = creditMemosList.filter(item => {
      if (supplierFilter !== 'All') {
        const itemSup = (item.supplier_name || 'Savemore').toLowerCase();
        if (itemSup !== supplierFilter.toLowerCase()) return false;
      }

      if (q) {
        const matches = (
          (item.credit_memo_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.rma_number || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.barcode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.product_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.pull_out_ref || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.credit_issued_by || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (item.supplier_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
        if (!matches) return false;
      }

      if (dateFrom) {
        const itemDate = new Date(item.credit_issued_at || item.created_at || 0).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        if (itemDate < dateFrom) return false;
      }

      if (dateTo) {
        const itemDate = new Date(item.credit_issued_at || item.created_at || 0).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        if (itemDate > dateTo) return false;
      }

      return true;
    });

    list.sort((a, b) => {
      let valA, valB;
      switch (sortField) {
        case 'credit_memo_number':
          valA = String(a.credit_memo_number || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.credit_memo_number || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'rma_number':
          valA = String(a.rma_number || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.rma_number || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'supplier_name':
          valA = String(a.supplier_name || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.supplier_name || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'credit_amount':
          valA = Number(a.credit_amount || 0);
          valB = Number(b.credit_amount || 0);
          break;
        case 'quantity':
          valA = Number(a.quantity || 0);
          valB = Number(b.quantity || 0);
          break;
        case 'gross_amount':
          valA = Number(a.amount || 0);
          valB = Number(b.amount || 0);
          break;
        case 'pull_out_ref':
          valA = String(a.pull_out_ref || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.pull_out_ref || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'credit_issued_by':
          valA = String(a.credit_issued_by || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.credit_issued_by || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'product_name':
          valA = String(a.product_name || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.product_name || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'credit_issued_at':
        default:
          valA = new Date(a.credit_issued_at || 0).getTime();
          valB = new Date(b.credit_issued_at || 0).getTime();
          break;
      }

      if (valA < valB) return sortDirection === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      if (valA > valB) return sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    });

    return list;
  }, [creditMemosList, searchQuery, supplierFilter, dateFrom, dateTo, sortField, sortDirection]);

  // Paginated slice
  const paginatedMemos = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return processedMemos.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [processedMemos, currentPage, pageSize]);

  // Selection handlers
  const isAllPageSelected = paginatedMemos.length > 0 && paginatedMemos.every(m => selectedMemoNumbers.has(m.credit_memo_number));
  const isSomeSelected = selectedMemoNumbers.size > 0;

  const toggleSelect = (cmNum) => {
    setSelectedMemoNumbers(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(cmNum)) {
        next.delete(cmNum);
      } else {
        next.add(cmNum);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (isAllPageSelected) {
      setSelectedMemoNumbers(prev => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        paginatedMemos.forEach(m => next.delete(m.credit_memo_number));
        return next;
      });
    } else {
      setSelectedMemoNumbers(prev => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        paginatedMemos.forEach(m => next.add(m.credit_memo_number));
        return next;
      });
    }
  };

  const clearSelection = () => {
    setSelectedMemoNumbers(new Set());
  };

  const handleBulkPrint = () => {
    const selected = creditMemosList.filter(m => selectedMemoNumbers.has(m.credit_memo_number));
    if (selected.length === 0) return;
    if (onPrintBulk) {
      onPrintBulk(selected);
    } else if (onViewVoucher) {
      onViewVoucher(selected);
    }
  };

  const handleBulkDelete = () => {
    const selected = creditMemosList.filter(m => selectedMemoNumbers.has(m.credit_memo_number));
    if (selected.length === 0) return;
    if (onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo) {
      onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo(selected);
    }
  };

  const handleSort = (field) => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
    if (sortField === field) {
      setSortDirection(prev => prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
      setSortField(field);
      setSortDirection('desc');
    }
  };

  // Fixed CSV Export with Blob and UTF-8 BOM so Excel opens all data cleanly
  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    if (!processedMemos.length) return;
    const headers = [
      'SN',
      'Credit Memo #',
      'RMA #',
      'Issue Date',
      'Supplier / Vendor',
      'Barcode',
      'Product Description',
      'Quantity',
      'Unit',
      'Net Unit Price (PHP)',
      '12% VAT Amount (PHP)',
      'Total Credited Amount (PHP)',
      'Gross Amount (PHP)',
      'Pull Out Ref',
      'Pull Out Date',
      'Issued By',
      'Customer AE'
    ];

    const rows = processedMemos.map((m, idx) => {
      const totalAmt = Number(m.credit_amount) || Number(m.amount) || 0;
      const netPrice = totalAmt / 1.12;
      const vatAmt = totalAmt - netPrice;
      const dateStr = m.credit_issued_at ? new Date(m.credit_issued_at).toISOString().slice(0, 10) : '';

      return [
        `"${idx + 1}"`,
        `"${m.credit_memo_number || ''}"`,
        `"${m.rma_number || ''}"`,
        `"${dateStr}"`,
        `"${(m.supplier_name || 'Savemore').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
        `"${m.barcode || ''}"`,
        `"${(m.product_name || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
        m.quantity || 1,
        `"${m.unit_name || 'pc'}"`,
        (Number(m.unit_price) || (netPrice / (m.quantity || 1))).toFixed(2),
        vatAmt.toFixed(2),
        totalAmt.toFixed(2),
        (Number(m.amount) || 0).toFixed(2),
        `"${(m.pull_out_ref || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
        `"${m.pull_out_date || ''}"`,
        `"${(m.credit_issued_by || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
        `"${(m.customer_ae_name || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`
      ];
    });

    const csvContent = [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.join(','))].join('\r\n');
    const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.setAttribute('download', `Finance_Credit_Memos ${formatFilenameDateTime()}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 animate-in fade-in">
      
      {/* Financial Summary KPI Strip: Fluid responsive grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5 sm:gap-3.5">
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 mb-1.5">
            <Receipt className="w-5 h-5" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
              Approved
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">
            {metrics.count}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5">Credit Memos</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Total vouchers issued</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 mb-1.5">
            <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
              Credited
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono">
            ₱{metrics.totalCredited.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5">Total Credit Amount</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Financial deductions granted</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 mb-1.5">
            <Package className="w-5 h-5" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
              Logistics
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">
            {metrics.totalUnits}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5">Units Pulled Out</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Total defective/pull-out pcs</div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 mb-1.5">
            <Building2 className="w-5 h-5" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300">
              Ledger
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">
            ₱{metrics.totalGross.toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5">Gross Invoiced Value</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Initial gross claim</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Table Card */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4 w-full min-w-0 box-border">
        
        {/* Title and Top Actions */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full min-w-0">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Finance Credit Memorandum Section
              </h2>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-black bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 font-mono shrink-0">
                {creditMemosList.length} Total
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
              Manage approved customer deductions, pull-out receipts, credit amounts, and printable accounting vouchers.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto flex-wrap shrink-0">
            {creditMemosList.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExportCsv}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 sm:px-3.5 sm:py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-xs shrink-0"
                title="Export all credit memos to Excel CSV"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Export CSV</span>
              </button>
            )}

            {canManageCreditMemos && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onOpenCreateModal}
                className="px-3.5 sm:px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm shadow-emerald-600/20 transition-all cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Issue Credit Memo</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search & Date Range Toolbar */}
        <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-3.5 space-y-2.5 w-full min-w-0 box-border">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center gap-2.5 w-full min-w-0">
            {/* Search Input */}
            <div className="relative w-full md:flex-1 min-w-0">
              <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3 shrink-0" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => {
                  setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                placeholder="Search by CM #, RMA #, barcode, item name, pull-out ref, or issuer..."
                className="w-full min-w-0 pl-10 pr-9 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 transition-all box-border"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSearchQuery('');
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                  }}
                  className="absolute right-3 top-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Filter Controls Row */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:flex md:items-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto min-w-0">
              {/* Supplier Filter Dropdown */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full md:w-auto min-w-0">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 shrink-0">
                  Supplier:
                </label>
                <select
                  value={supplierFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setSupplierFilter(e.target.value);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                  }}
                  className="w-full md:w-auto px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 cursor-pointer shadow-2xs truncate box-border"
                  title="Filter by Supplier"
                >
                  {suppliers.map(sup => (
                    <option key={sup} value={sup}>
                      {sup === 'All' ? 'All Suppliers' : sup}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>

              {/* Custom Date Range Filter */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 w-full sm:w-auto min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs min-w-0 box-border">
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase shrink-0">From</span>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={dateFrom}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setDateFrom(e.target.value);
                      setCurrentPage(1);
                    }}
                    className="bg-transparent text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono text-[11px] focus:outline-none cursor-pointer w-full min-w-0"
                    title="Filter credit memos from date"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs min-w-0 box-border">
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase shrink-0">To</span>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={dateTo}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setDateTo(e.target.value);
                      setCurrentPage(1);
                    }}
                    className="bg-transparent text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono text-[11px] focus:outline-none cursor-pointer w-full min-w-0"
                    title="Filter credit memos to date"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Reset Filters */}
              {(searchQuery || supplierFilter !== 'All' || dateFrom || dateTo) && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={resetFilters}
                  className="w-full sm:w-auto px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-colors shrink-0 cursor-pointer box-border"
                  title="Reset all filters"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                  <span>Reset</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 px-1 font-medium">
            <span>
              Showing <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{processedMemos.length}</strong> of {creditMemosList.length} credit memos
              {(searchQuery || dateFrom || dateTo) && (
                <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold ml-1.5">• Date / search filters active</span>
              )}
            </span>
            <span className="text-slate-400">
              Click column headers to sort (<strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 capitalize">{sortField}</strong> {sortDirection === 'asc' ? '▲' : '▼'})
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Floating Bulk Action Bar (When items are selected) */}
        {isSomeSelected && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 border-2 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 rounded-2xl flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-top-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse" />
              <span className="text-xs font-black text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-200">
                {selectedMemoNumbers.size} Credit Memo{selectedMemoNumbers.size > 1 ? 's' : ''} Selected
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleBulkPrint}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
                title="Print all selected credit memos sequentially"
              >
                <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Print Selected ({selectedMemoNumbers.size})</span>
              </button>

              {canManageCreditMemos && onRequestBulkDeleteCreditMemo && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleBulkDelete}
                  className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  title="Void and delete all selected credit memos"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Delete Selected ({selectedMemoNumbers.size})</span>
                </button>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={clearSelection}
                className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white text-xs font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Clear Selection
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Table Records */}
        {creditMemosList.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-12 space-y-3 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 p-6">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-inner">
              <Receipt className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
              No Credit Memos Issued Yet
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
              When items are returned and pulled out from stores or warehouse inventory, Finance can issue official Credit Memos with approved credit amounts and printable vouchers.
            </p>
            {canManageCreditMemos && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onOpenCreateModal}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Issue First Credit Memo</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : processedMemos.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-10 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
            No credit memos match "{searchQuery}"
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-xs">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-slate-800/90 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    
                    {/* Header Select All Checkbox */}
                    <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center w-10">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={isAllPageSelected}
                        onChange={toggleSelectAll}
                        title="Select All on this page"
                        className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-emerald-600 focus:ring-emerald-500 cursor-pointer"
                      />
                    </th>

                    <th className="py-3 px-3 w-14 font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                      SN
                    </th>

                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('credit_memo_number')}
                      className="py-3 px-3 font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>CM #</span>
                        {sortField === 'credit_memo_number' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('rma_number')}
                      className="py-3 px-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>RMA & Supplier</span>
                        {sortField === 'rma_number' || sortField === 'supplier_name' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('product_name')}
                      className="py-3 px-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>Product & Barcode</span>
                        {sortField === 'product_name' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('quantity')}
                      className="py-3 px-3 font-bold text-center cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                        <span>Quantity</span>
                        {sortField === 'quantity' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('gross_amount')}
                      className="py-3 px-3 text-right font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                        <span>Gross Amount</span>
                        {sortField === 'gross_amount' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('pull_out_ref')}
                      className="py-3 px-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>Pull Out Reference</span>
                        {sortField === 'pull_out_ref' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('credit_amount')}
                      className="py-3 px-3.5 font-black text-right cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                        <span>Credit Amount (₱)</span>
                        {sortField === 'credit_amount' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th 
                      onClick={() => handleSort('credit_issued_by')}
                      className="py-3 px-3.5 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-emerald-600 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>Credit Issued By</span>
                        {sortField === 'credit_issued_by' ? (
                          sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        ) : <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300" />}
                      </div>
                    </th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-bold">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800 font-medium">
                  {paginatedMemos.map((memo, idx) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedMemoNumbers.has(memo.credit_memo_number);
                    return (
                      <tr 
                        key={memo.credit_memo_number}
                        className={`transition-colors ${isSelected ? 'bg-emerald-50/50 dark:bg-emerald-950/30' : 'hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50'}`}
                      >
                        {/* Checkbox */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center w-10">
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={isSelected}
                            onChange={() => toggleSelect(memo.credit_memo_number)}
                            className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-slate-300 text-emerald-600 focus:ring-emerald-500 cursor-pointer"
                          />
                        </td>

                        {/* SN */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 font-mono">
                          <span className="font-black text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs">
                            #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* CM # */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onViewVoucher(memo)}
                            className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                            title="Click to view official printable voucher"
                          >
                            <Receipt className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                            <span>{memo.credit_memo_number}</span>
                          </button>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-sans">
                              {memo.credit_issued_at ? new Date(memo.credit_issued_at).toLocaleDateString() : ''}
                            </span>
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full" title="Stored in Supabase database">
                              <Database className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                              <span>DB</span>
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* RMA # */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3.5 font-mono font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 text-xs">
                          {memo.rma_number || 'N/A'}
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-sans">
                            Supplier: {memo.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Product Name & Barcode */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3.5 max-w-[200px]">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate" title={memo.product_name}>
                            {memo.product_name}
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
                            {memo.barcode} {memo.sku ? `• SKU: ${memo.sku}` : ''}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Quantity */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center font-bold font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                          {memo.quantity} {memo.unit_name || 'pc'}
                        </td>

                        {/* Gross Amount (Strict 2 Decimals) */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                          ₱{Number(memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>

                        {/* Pull Out Reference */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3.5 max-w-[180px]">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate" title={memo.pull_out_ref}>
                            {memo.pull_out_ref || 'Warehouse Pull-Out'}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">
                            Date: {memo.pull_out_date || 'N/A'}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Credit Amount (₱) (Strict 2 Decimals) */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3.5 text-right font-black font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 text-sm">
                          ₱{Number(memo.credit_amount || memo.amount || 0).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}
                        </td>

                        {/* Credit Issued By */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3.5">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs truncate max-w-[140px]" title={memo.credit_issued_by}>
                            {memo.credit_issued_by || 'Finance'}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono truncate max-w-[140px]">
                            {memo.credit_issued_by_email || ''}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Actions */}
                        <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => onViewVoucher(memo)}
                              className="p-1.5 text-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                              title="Print Official Credit Voucher"
                            >
                              <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </button>

                            {canManageCreditMemos && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onEditCreditMemo(memo)}
                                className="p-1.5 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Edit Credit Memo"
                              >
                                <Edit3 className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </button>
                            )}

                            {canManageCreditMemos && onRequestDeleteCreditMemo && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onRequestDeleteCreditMemo(memo)}
                                className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Void / Delete Credit Memo"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* Pagination */}
            <TablePagination
              currentPage={currentPage}
              pageSize={pageSize}
              totalItems={processedMemos.length}
              onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
              onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
                setPageSize(newSize);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
            />
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/CreditMemoVoucherModal.jsx ---
import React from 'react';
import { X, Printer, Receipt, CheckCircle2, Building2, UserCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import { printIsolatedElement } from '../utils/printIsolatedElement';

export default function CreditMemoVoucherModal({ isOpen, onClose, creditMemo, creditMemos = [] }) {
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Resolve memos array: either passed array or single creditMemo
  const memosToRender = (creditMemos && creditMemos.length > 0)
    ? creditMemos
    : (creditMemo ? [creditMemo] : []);

  if (memosToRender.length === 0) return null;

  const handlePrint = () => {
    const docTitle = (memosToRender.length === 1 && memosToRender[0]?.credit_memo_number)
      ? `Credit-Memo-${memosToRender[0].credit_memo_number}`
      : `Batch-Credit-Memos-${memosToRender.length}-Vouchers`;

    printIsolatedElement({
      elementId: 'credit-memo-voucher-print-root',
      documentTitle: docTitle,
      pageSize: 'portrait',
      pageMargin: '0.35in',
      customStyles: `
        #credit-memo-voucher-print-root {
          width: 100% !important;
          max-width: 195mm !important;
          margin: 0 auto !important;
          padding: 0 !important;
          box-shadow: none !important;
          border: none !important;
          background: #ffffff !important;
          color: #0f172a !important;
          max-height: none !important;
          height: auto !important;
          overflow: visible !important;
        }
        #credit-memo-voucher-print-root > div {
          max-height: none !important;
          height: auto !important;
          overflow: visible !important;
        }
        .voucher-sheet {
          page-break-after: always !important;
          break-after: page !important;
          page-break-inside: avoid !important;
          break-inside: avoid !important;
          padding: 12px 16px !important;
          background: #ffffff !important;
          border: none !important;
          box-shadow: none !important;
        }

  };

  const isBulk = memosToRender.length > 1;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-6 md:p-8 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in overflow-y-auto">

            position: static !important;

            max-width: 100% !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
