import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  CheckCircle, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Edit3, 
  Save, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Barcode, 
  Upload, 
  Camera,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  Search,
  ArrowUpDown,
  ArrowUp,
  ArrowDown,
  UserCheck,
  Building2,
  ChevronDown,
  Trash2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';
import { authService } from '../services/authService';
import { notificationService } from '../services/notificationService';
import ImageLightboxModal from './ImageLightboxModal';
import TablePagination from './TablePagination';
import SupplierInput from './SupplierInput';
import ProductAutoSuggest from './ProductAutoSuggest';
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';

export default function PendingBarcodesModal({ isOpen, onClose, pendingList = [], onUpdated, currentUser }) {
  const [selectedBarcode, setSelectedBarcode] = useState(null);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState('id');
  const [sortDirection, setSortDirection] = useState('desc');
  const [lightboxPhoto, setLightboxPhoto] = useState(null);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(10);

  const canVerify = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';

  // AE & Company state
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
  const [loadingEmployees, setLoadingEmployees] = useState(false);
  const [selectedAe, setSelectedAe] = useState(null);
  const [aeSearch, setAeSearch] = useState('');
  const [isAeDropdownOpen, setIsAeDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const [company, setCompany] = useState('Pingcon / Bonita');

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    code: '',
    name: '',
    supplierName: '',
    price: '',
    priceWithVat: '',
    brandName: '',
    unitName: 'pc',
    imageUrl: ''
  });
  const [isUploadingImage, setIsUploadingImage] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg] = useState(null);
  const [skuError, setSkuError] = useState(null);
  const [nameError, setNameError] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setLoadingEmployees(true);
      authService.getEmployees()
        .then(list => setEmployees(list || []))
        .catch(err => console.warn('Failed to fetch employees in PendingBarcodesModal:', err))
        .finally(() => setLoadingEmployees(false));
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const handleSelect = (item) => {
    setSelectedBarcode(item);
    const itemBarcode = String(item.barcode || '').trim();
    const rawCode = String(item.code || item.sku || '').trim();
    const isCodeValid = rawCode && rawCode !== itemBarcode && !rawCode.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting') && !rawCode.toLowerCase().includes('unidentified');

    setFormData({
      code: isCodeValid ? rawCode : '',
      name: item.name && !item.name.includes('Unidentified') ? item.name : '',
      supplierName: item.supplier_name && item.supplier_name !== 'Pending Assignment' ? item.supplier_name : '',
      price: item.price ? String(item.price) : '',
      priceWithVat: item.price_with_vat ? String(item.price_with_vat) : '',
      brandName: item.brand_name || '',
      unitName: item.unit_name || 'pc',
      imageUrl: '' // Strictly start with empty state for unassigned pending barcodes
    });

    if (item.ae_name || item.ae_email) {
      setSelectedAe({
        name: item.ae_name || '',
        email: item.ae_email || '',
        department: item.ae_department || 'Account Executive'
      });
    } else {
      setSelectedAe(null);
    }

    const sup = String(item.supplier_name || '').toLowerCase();
    const nameStr = String(item.name || '').toLowerCase();
    if (sup.includes('a2z') || sup.includes('keysys') || nameStr.includes('a2z') || nameStr.includes('keysys')) {
      setCompany('A2Z2GO / Keysys');
    } else {
      setCompany('Pingcon / Bonita');
    }

    setAeSearch('');
    setIsAeDropdownOpen(false);
    setStatusMsg(null);
    setSkuError(null);
    setNameError(null);
  };

  const handleAutoPopulate = (item) => {
    if (!item) return;
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      name: item.name || prev.name,
      code: item.code || item.sku || prev.code,
      supplierName: item.supplierName || item.supplier_name || '',
      price: (item.price !== undefined && item.price !== null && Number(item.price) > 0) ? String(Number(item.price).toFixed(2)) : '',
      priceWithVat: (item.priceWithVat !== undefined && item.priceWithVat !== null && Number(item.priceWithVat) > 0)
        ? String(Number(item.priceWithVat).toFixed(2))
        : (item.price && Number(item.price) > 0 ? String((Number(item.price) * 1.12).toFixed(2)) : ''),
      unitName: item.unitName || item.unit_name || 'pc',
      brandName: item.brandName || item.brand || '',
      imageUrl: item.imageUrl || ''
    }));
    setNameError(null);
    setSkuError(null);
  };

  const handleImageFile = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setIsUploadingImage(true);
    try {
      const url = await catalogService.uploadPhoto(file, null, 'product', {
        sku: formData.code?.trim() || formData.barcode?.trim(),
        name: formData.name?.trim()
      });
      if (url) {
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, imageUrl: url }));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Image upload error:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsUploadingImage(false);
    }
  };

  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState(null);

  const handleDeletePending = async (item) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to dismiss and delete pending barcode ${item.barcode}?`)) {
      return;
    }
    setDeletingId(item.id || item.barcode);
    try {
      await catalogService.deletePendingBarcode(item.barcode, item.id);
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to delete pending barcode:', e);
    } finally {
      setDeletingId(null);
    }
  };

  // Filter employees for AE Search
  const filteredEmployees = useMemo(() => {
    const q = aeSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!q) return employees.slice(0, 15);
    return employees.filter(emp => 
      (emp.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (emp.email || emp.company_email || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (emp.department || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [employees, aeSearch]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedBarcode) return;
    if (!formData.name.trim()) {
      setStatusMsg({ type: 'error', text: 'Please enter a product name.' });
      return;
    }

    // Customer AE required
    if (!selectedAe || !selectedAe.email) {
      setStatusMsg({ type: 'error', text: 'Customer Account Executive (AE) is required. Please search and select an AE.' });
      return;
    }

    // Deduplication removed: 1 SKU from company can have more than one barcode assignation
    setIsSaving(true);
    setStatusMsg(null);

    try {
      await catalogService.updateBarcodeDetails({
        barcode: selectedBarcode.barcode,
        code: formData.code,
        name: formData.name,
        supplierName: formData.supplierName,
        price: formData.price,
        priceWithVat: formData.priceWithVat || (Number(formData.price) * 1.12).toFixed(2),
        brandName: formData.brandName,
        unitName: formData.unitName,
        imageUrl: formData.imageUrl,
        aeName: selectedAe.name,
        aeEmail: selectedAe.email,
        company: company
      });



      setStatusMsg({ 
        type: 'success', 
        text: `Barcode ${selectedBarcode.barcode} is now verified! Future scans will automatically display "${formData.name}" and its reference photo.` 
      });

      setTimeout(() => {
        setSelectedBarcode(null);
        if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      }, 1500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Update error:', err);
      setStatusMsg({ type: 'error', text: 'Failed to update: ' + err.message });
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  // Filter & sort pending barcodes
  const processedPendingList = useMemo(() => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    let list = pendingList.filter(item => {
      // Exclude batch manifests: batches contain multiple items and do not have an individual SKU
      const name = String(item.name || '').toLowerCase();
      const b = String(item.barcode || '');
      if (item.is_parent || name.startsWith('batch return manifest') || name.startsWith('batch rma') || b.startsWith('RMA-')) {
        return false;
      }
      if (!q) return true;
      return (
        (item.barcode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        String(item.id || '').includes(q) ||
        (item.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (item.supplier_name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });

    list.sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortField === 'id') {
        const idA = Number(a.id) || 0;
        const idB = Number(b.id) || 0;
        return sortDirection === 'asc' ? idA - idB : idB - idA;
      }
      return 0;
    });

    return list;
  }, [pendingList, searchQuery, sortField, sortDirection]);

  // Paginated slice
  const paginatedList = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return processedPendingList.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [processedPendingList, currentPage, pageSize]);

  // Early return strictly placed AFTER hooks to prevent React error #310
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-xl w-full p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4 max-h-[92dvh] sm:max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain pb-safe my-0 sm:my-auto">
        {/* Mobile Drag Indicator */}
        <div className="bottom-sheet-handle sm:hidden" />
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 rounded-2xl shadow-inner">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Pending Unknown Barcodes
                </h2>
                <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-black bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300">
                  {processedPendingList.length} Pending
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Filter, sort, paginate & update product details with Customer AE assignment.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Status notice */}
        {statusMsg && (
          <div className={`p-3 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 ${
            statusMsg.type === 'success' 
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800' 
              : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'
          }`}>
            <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{statusMsg.text}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* List of unverified barcodes OR edit form */}
        {!selectedBarcode ? (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {pendingList.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="text-center py-8 space-y-2">
                <CheckCircle className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-500 mx-auto" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">All Barcodes Verified</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                  When a reporter scans an unrecorded barcode, it will appear here so you can add its name, supplier, Customer AE, and reference photo.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {/* Search & Sort Controls */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="relative flex-1">
                    <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={searchQuery}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
                        setCurrentPage(1);
                      }}
                      placeholder="Filter pending by barcode or SN..."
                      className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 shadow-xs"
                    />
                    {searchQuery && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSearchQuery('');
                          setCurrentPage(1);
                        }}
                        className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-0.5"
                      >
                        <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (sortField === 'id') {
                        setSortDirection(prev => prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
                      } else {
                        setSortField('id');
                        setSortDirection('desc');
                      }
                      setCurrentPage(1);
                    }}
                    className="px-2.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors shrink-0 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700"
                    title="Toggle SN sorting"
                  >
                    <span className="font-mono text-[11px]">SN</span>
                    {sortField === 'id' && (sortDirection === 'asc' ? <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" /> : <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />)}
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* List Items */}
                <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[45vh] overflow-y-auto">
                  {paginatedList.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="py-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 font-semibold">
                      No pending barcodes match "{searchQuery}"
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    paginatedList.map((item, idx) => (
                      <div 
                        key={item.id || item.barcode}
                        className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/70 hover:bg-blue-50/50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between gap-3 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
                          <Barcode className="w-6 h-6 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className="font-mono font-black text-[10px] text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300 bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                                #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                              </span>
                              <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs truncate">
                                {item.barcode}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
                              {item.name || 'Unidentified item scanned by staff'}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {canVerify ? (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleSelect(item)}
                              className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              <span>Enter Details</span>
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={deletingId === (item.id || item.barcode)}
                              onClick={() => handleDeletePending(item)}
                              title="Dismiss / Remove this pending barcode"
                              className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/50 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                              aria-label="Delete pending barcode"
                            >
                              {deletingId === (item.id || item.barcode) ? (
                                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-rose-500" />
                              ) : (
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              )}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl">
                            Read-Only
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ))
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Table Pagination */}
                <TablePagination
                  currentPage={currentPage}
                  totalItems={processedPendingList.length}
                  pageSize={pageSize}
                  onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
                  onPageSizeChange={setPageSize}
                  pageSizeOptions={[5, 10, 25, 50]}
                  itemLabel="barcodes"
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Edit Form */
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
            <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 tracking-wider">
                  Target Barcode
                </span>
                <div className="font-mono font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-base">
                  {selectedBarcode.barcode}
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedBarcode(null)}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white underline cursor-pointer"
              >
                Back to List
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-3 font-semibold">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">Product Name *</label>
                <ProductAutoSuggest
                  mode="name"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g. Laptop Lenovo ThinkPad / Oreo Biscuit"
                  value={formData.name}
                  onChange={(val) => {
                    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, name: val }));
                    setNameError(null);
                  }}
                  onSelectProduct={handleAutoPopulate}
                  error={nameError}
                  className={`w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border ${
                    nameError ? 'border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-600' : 'border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 focus:border-blue-600'
                  } rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800 text-xs sm:text-sm`}
                />
              </div>

              {/* CUSTOMER AE SELECTOR */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-blue-950/40 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/60 rounded-2xl space-y-2 relative">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-black text-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300">
                    Customer Account Executive (AE) * <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold">(Required)</span>
                  </label>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold">
                    Receives CC on report emails
                  </span>
                </div>

                {selectedAe ? (
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between gap-2 shadow-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                      <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs truncate">
                          {selectedAe.name}
                        </div>
                        <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 truncate">
                          {selectedAe.email}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedAe(null);
                        setIsAeDropdownOpen(true);
                      }}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold shrink-0 transition-colors"
                    >
                      Change AE
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="relative">
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={aeSearch}
                        onFocus={() => setIsAeDropdownOpen(true)}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          setAeSearch(e.target.value);
                          setIsAeDropdownOpen(true);
                        }}
                        placeholder={loadingEmployees ? 'Loading staff directory...' : 'Search employee by name or company email...'}
                        className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 shadow-xs"
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setIsAeDropdownOpen(prev => !prev)}
                        className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200"
                      >
                        <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {isAeDropdownOpen && (
                      <div className="absolute z-20 left-0 right-0 mt-1 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl shadow-xl divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700">
                        {filteredEmployees.length === 0 ? (
                          <div className="p-3 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
                            No employees found matching "{aeSearch}".
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          filteredEmployees.map((emp, idx) => {
                            const empEmail = emp.email || emp.company_email || '';
                            return (
                              <button
                                key={emp.id || empEmail || idx}
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setSelectedAe({
                                    name: emp.name,
                                    email: empEmail,
                                    department: emp.department || 'Account Executive'
                                  });
                                  setIsAeDropdownOpen(false);
                                  setAeSearch('');
                                }}
                                className="w-full p-2.5 text-left hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/60 transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-2"
                              >
                                <div className="min-w-0">
                                  <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs truncate">
                                    {emp.name}
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
                                    {empEmail} {emp.department ? `• ${emp.department}` : ''}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 uppercase shrink-0">
                                  Select
                                </span>
                              </button>
                            );
                          })
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>



              {/* Optional Product Reference Photo */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl space-y-2">
                <span className="block text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold">
                  Reference Product Photo (Optional)
                </span>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  {formData.imageUrl ? (
                    <div className="relative w-16 h-16 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 shrink-0 group">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setLightboxPhoto({
                          url: formData.imageUrl,
                          title: formData.name || `Barcode ${selectedBarcode.barcode}`,
                          subtitle: `Reference Photo for ${selectedBarcode.barcode}`
                        })}
                        className="w-full h-full block cursor-zoom-in"
                        title="Click to zoom reference photo"
                      >
                        <img src={formData.imageUrl} alt="Reference" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setFormData({ ...formData, imageUrl: '' })}
                        className="absolute top-0.5 right-0.5 p-0.5 bg-black/70 text-white rounded-full hover:bg-rose-600 transition-colors"
                        title="Remove photo"
                      >
                        <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 shrink-0">
                      <ImageIcon className="w-5 h-5 mb-0.5 opacity-60" />
                      <span className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">No Image</span>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="flex-1 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <label className="flex-1 min-w-[120px] py-2 px-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-center cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs transition-colors">
                      {isUploadingImage ? <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />}
                      <span>{isUploadingImage ? 'Uploading...' : 'Upload Photo'}</span>
                      <input
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/*"
                        onChange={handleImageFile}
                        className="hidden"
                      />
                    </label>

                    <label className="flex-1 min-w-[120px] py-2 px-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700 rounded-xl text-center cursor-pointer text-xs font-bold text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs transition-colors">
                      {isUploadingImage ? <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />}
                      <span>Take Picture</span>
                      <input
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/*"
                        capture="environment"
                        onChange={handleImageFile}
                        className="hidden"
                      />
                    </label>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">SKU / Item Code</label>
                  <ProductAutoSuggest
                    mode="code"
                    placeholder="e.g. P124124141"
                    value={formData.code}
                    onChange={(val) => {
                      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, code: val }));
                      setSkuError(null);
                    }}
                    onSelectProduct={handleAutoPopulate}
                    error={skuError}
                    className={`w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border ${
                      skuError ? 'border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-600' : 'border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 focus:border-blue-600'
                    } rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono focus:outline-none focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800 text-xs sm:text-sm`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Supplier Name</label>
                  <SupplierInput
                    placeholder="e.g. Savemore, Walter Mart, Mondelez"
                    value={formData.supplierName}
                    onChange={(val) => setFormData({ ...formData, supplierName: val })}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800 text-xs sm:text-sm"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Base Price (₱)</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    step="0.01"
                    placeholder="0.00"
                    value={formData.price}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const p = e.target.value;
                      setFormData({ 
                        ...formData, 
                        price: p, 
                        priceWithVat: p ? (Number(p) * 1.12).toFixed(2) : '' 
                      });
                    }}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Price w/ VAT (₱)</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    step="0.01"
                    placeholder="0.00"
                    value={formData.priceWithVat}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, priceWithVat: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mb-1">Unit</label>
                  <select
                    value={formData.unitName || 'pc'}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, unitName: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value="pc">pc (piece)</option>
                  <option value="case">case</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-3 flex justify-end gap-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedBarcode(null)}
                className="px-4 py-2 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSaving}
                className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20 cursor-pointer"
              >
                {isSaving ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="w-4 h-4" />}
                <span>Save & Verify Barcode</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        )}

      </div>

      {/* Fullscreen Image Lightbox Modal */}
      <ImageLightboxModal
        isOpen={Boolean(lightboxPhoto)}
        imageUrl={lightboxPhoto?.url}
        images={lightboxPhoto?.images || (lightboxPhoto?.url ? [lightboxPhoto.url] : [])}
        initialIndex={lightboxPhoto?.initialIndex || 0}
        title={lightboxPhoto?.title}
        subtitle={lightboxPhoto?.subtitle}
        onClose={() => setLightboxPhoto(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/PendingBarcodesModal.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/PinRequestsQueueModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  KeyRound,
  Mail,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  Clock,
  Send,
  CheckCheck,
  Search,
  Filter,
  RefreshCw,
  Building,
  User,
  FileText,
  AlertTriangle,
  Sparkles,
  Trash2,
  ExternalLink,
  ChevronDown,
  X
} from 'lucide-react';
import { pinRequestService } from '../services/pinRequestService';
import { accessKeyService } from '../services/accessKeyService';

export default function PinRequestsQueueModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  currentUser,
  isTestMode = false,
  onQueueUpdated
}) {
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('pending'); // 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'all'
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState([]);
  const [processingId, setProcessingId] = useState(null);
  const [isBatchProcessing, setIsBatchProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState(null);
  const [rejectPromptId, setRejectPromptId] = useState(null);
  const [rejectionReason, setRejectionReason] = useState('');

  // Fetch requests & profiles
  const loadData = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const [reqs, profs] = await Promise.all([
        pinRequestService.getRequests(),
        accessKeyService.getProfiles()
      ]);
      setRequests(reqs || []);
      setProfiles(profs || []);
      if (onQueueUpdated) {
        onQueueUpdated(reqs || []);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error loading PIN requests:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadData();
      setSelectedIds([]);
      setStatusMessage(null);
      setRejectPromptId(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Listen for real-time changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleChanged = () => {
      if (isOpen) {
        loadData();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('rma-pin-requests-changed', handleChanged);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('rma-pin-requests-changed', handleChanged);
  }, [isOpen]);

  // Map slug to profile details
  const profileMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = {};
    profiles.forEach(p => {
      if (p.access_slug) {
        map[p.access_slug.toLowerCase()] = p;
      }
    });
    return map;
  }, [profiles]);

  // Filtered requests
  const filteredRequests = useMemo(() => {
    return requests.filter(req => {
      // Tab filter
      if (activeTab === 'pending' && req.status !== 'pending') return false;
      if (activeTab === 'approved' && req.status !== 'approved') return false;
      if (activeTab === 'rejected' && req.status !== 'rejected') return false;

      // Search query
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        const nameMatch = req.requester_name?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const emailMatch = req.requester_email?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const orgMatch = req.organization_name?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const slugMatch = req.access_slug?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const notesMatch = req.notes?.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        if (!nameMatch && !emailMatch && !orgMatch && !slugMatch && !notesMatch) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [requests, activeTab, searchQuery]);

  // Counts
  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    return {
      pending: requests.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length,
      approved: requests.filter(r => r.status === 'approved').length,
      rejected: requests.filter(r => r.status === 'rejected').length,
      all: requests.length
    };
  }, [requests]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Single Request Approval Handler
  const handleApprove = async (request) => {
    setProcessingId(request.id);
    setStatusMessage(null);

    const targetProfile = profileMap[request.access_slug?.toLowerCase()] || {
      name: `Station /${request.access_slug}`,
      pin_code: '123456',
      access_slug: request.access_slug
    };

    const adminName = currentUser?.name || currentUser?.full_name || 'Admin';

    try {
      const res = await pinRequestService.approveRequest({
        requestId: request.id,
        approvedBy: adminName,
        pinCode: targetProfile.pin_code,
        profileName: targetProfile.name,
        accessSlug: request.access_slug,
        isTestMode
      });

      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `PIN code (${targetProfile.pin_code}) successfully dispatched to ${request.requester_email}!`
      });

      await loadData();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Approve PIN request error:', err);
      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: `Failed to approve PIN request: ${err.message}`
      });
    } finally {
      setProcessingId(null);
    }
  };

  // Rejection Handler
  const handleConfirmReject = async (requestId) => {
    setProcessingId(requestId);
    setStatusMessage(null);
    const adminName = currentUser?.name || currentUser?.full_name || 'Admin';

    try {
      await pinRequestService.rejectRequest({
        requestId,
        rejectedBy: adminName,
        reason: rejectionReason
      });

      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'info',
        text: 'Request marked as rejected.'
      });

      setRejectPromptId(null);
      setRejectionReason('');
      await loadData();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Reject PIN request error:', err);
      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: `Failed to reject PIN request: ${err.message}`
      });
    } finally {
      setProcessingId(null);
    }
  };

  // Batch Approval Handler
  const handleBatchApprove = async () => {
    if (selectedIds.length === 0) return;
    setIsBatchProcessing(true);
    setStatusMessage(null);

    const adminName = currentUser?.name || currentUser?.full_name || 'Admin';

    try {
      await pinRequestService.approveBatch({
        requestIds: selectedIds,
        approvedBy: adminName,
        getProfilePinFn: async (id) => {
          const req = requests.find(r => r.id === id);
          const prof = profileMap[req?.access_slug?.toLowerCase()] || {
            name: `Station /${req?.access_slug}`,
            pin_code: '123456',
            access_slug: req?.access_slug || 'dock'
          };
          return {
            pinCode: prof.pin_code,
            profileName: prof.name,
            accessSlug: prof.access_slug
          };
        },
        isTestMode
      });

      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `Successfully approved & dispatched PINs for ${selectedIds.length} request(s)!`
      });

      setSelectedIds([]);
      await loadData();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Batch approve error:', err);
      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'error',
        text: `Batch approval error: ${err.message}`
      });
    } finally {
      setIsBatchProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // Delete Handler
  const handleDelete = async (requestId) => {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete this request from history?')) return;
    try {
      await pinRequestService.deleteRequest(requestId);
      await loadData();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Delete request error:', err);
    }
  };

  // Multi-select helpers
  const handleSelectAll = (e) => {
    if (e.target.checked) {
      const pendingIds = filteredRequests.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').map(r => r.id);
      setSelectedIds(pendingIds);
    } else {
      setSelectedIds([]);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleSelect = (id) => {
    if (selectedIds.includes(id)) {
      setSelectedIds(selectedIds.filter(item => item !== id));
    } else {
      setSelectedIds([...selectedIds, id]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div 
        className="relative w-full max-w-4xl my-auto max-h-[85vh] bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 sm:px-8 py-5 sm:py-6 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 shrink-0 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-800/50">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500 to-orange-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20">
              <KeyRound className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <h2 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Pending PIN Requests Queue
                </h2>
                {counts.pending > 0 ? (
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-black bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 animate-pulse">
                    {counts.pending} Pending
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400">
                    All Reviewed
                  </span>
                )}
                {isTestMode && (
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-200 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" />
                    Test Mode (Simulated SMTP)
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                Review and approve 6-digit gatekeeper authorization requests for external stores and warehouse intake.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={loadData}
              disabled={isLoading}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Refresh requests"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-2 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Close"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Global Feedback Banner */}
        {statusMessage && (
          <div className={`px-6 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-between border-b ${
            statusMessage.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800'
              : statusMessage.type === 'error'
              ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950/50 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800'
              : 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/50 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800'
          }`}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {statusMessage.type === 'success' ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
              ) : statusMessage.type === 'error' ? (
                <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600" />
              ) : (
                <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
              )}
              <span>{statusMessage.text}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusMessage(null)}
              className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Controls: Search, Filters & Batch Actions */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {/* Status Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 p-1 bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-2xl shrink-0 overflow-x-auto">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('pending')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeTab === 'pending'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-xs font-black'
                  : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <span>Pending</span>
              <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] ${
                counts.pending > 0 ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 font-black' : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600'
              }`}>
                {counts.pending}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('approved')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeTab === 'approved'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-xs font-black'
                  : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <span>Approved</span>
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600">
                {counts.approved}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('rejected')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeTab === 'rejected'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-xs font-black'
                  : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <span>Rejected</span>
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600">
                {counts.rejected}
              </span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('all')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                activeTab === 'all'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-xs font-black'
                  : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'
              }`}
            >
              <span>All</span>
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600">
                {counts.all}
              </span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Search Input & Batch Action */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 grow max-w-md">
            <div className="relative grow">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search by name, email, store, or slug..."
                className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600/10"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                  className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
                >
                  <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Batch Approve Selected Button */}
            {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleBatchApprove}
                disabled={isBatchProcessing}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold shadow-sm transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 cursor-pointer animate-in fade-in"
              >
                {isBatchProcessing ? (
                  <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <CheckCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                )}
                <span>Approve Selected ({selectedIds.length})</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* List of Requests */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto flex-1 p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-3">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="py-16 text-center space-y-3">
              <RefreshCw className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-blue-600 mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">Loading PIN authorization requests...</p>
            </div>
          ) : filteredRequests.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-16 text-center space-y-3">
              <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-3xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-7 h-7 text-emerald-500" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                {activeTab === 'pending'
                  ? 'All caught up! No pending PIN requests.'
                  : `No requests found under "${activeTab}".`}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                When warehouse personnel or customer supermarkets scan a QR code without a PIN, their authorization requests will appear here for one-click approval.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* Batch Select Bar for Pending */}
              {activeTab === 'pending' && filteredRequests.length > 0 && (
                <div className="px-2 pb-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold">
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={
                        filteredRequests.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length > 0 &&
                        selectedIds.length === filteredRequests.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length
                      }
                      onChange={handleSelectAll}
                      className="rounded border-slate-300 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500"
                    />
                    <span>Select All Pending ({filteredRequests.filter(r => r.status === 'pending').length})</span>
                  </label>

                  <span>Showing {filteredRequests.length} record(s)</span>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Request Cards */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {filteredRequests.map((req, idx) => {
                  const targetProfile = profileMap[req.access_slug?.toLowerCase()] || {
                    name: `Station /${req.access_slug}`,
                    pin_code: '123456',
                    session_duration_hours: 0
                  };
                  const isPending = req.status === 'pending';
                  const isApproved = req.status === 'approved';
                  const isRejected = req.status === 'rejected';
                  const isSelected = selectedIds.includes(req.id);
                  const isProcessing = processingId === req.id;
                  const isPromptingReject = rejectPromptId === req.id;

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={req.id}
                      className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                        isSelected
                          ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50/30 dark:bg-blue-950/20'
                          : isPending
                          ? 'border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/50 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-xs hover:border-amber-400'
                          : isApproved
                          ? 'border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-900/40 bg-emerald-50/20 dark:bg-emerald-950/10'
                          : 'border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-900/40'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start justify-between gap-3">
                        {/* Left column: Checkbox + User & Org Info */}
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                          {isPending && (
                            <input
                              type="checkbox"
                              checked={isSelected}
                              onChange={() => handleToggleSelect(req.id)}
                              className="mt-1 rounded border-slate-300 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 cursor-pointer"
                            />
                          )}

                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                              <span className="font-mono font-black text-[10px] text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300 bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                                #{idx + 1}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                                {req.requester_name}
                              </span>

                              {/* Status Badge */}
                              <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider ${
                                isPending
                                  ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800'
                                  : isApproved
                                  ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800'
                                  : 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800'
                              }`}>
                                {req.status}
                              </span>

                              {/* Target Station Badge */}
                              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                                Target: <strong>{targetProfile.name}</strong> (<code>/{req.access_slug}</code>)
                              </span>
                            </div>

                            {/* Organization & Email */}
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 flex-wrap">
                              {req.organization_name && (
                                <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                                  <Building className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                                  {req.organization_name}
                                </span>
                              )}
                              <a
                                href={`mailto:${req.requester_email}`}
                                className="flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline font-mono"
                              >
                                <Mail className="w-3 h-3" />
                                {req.requester_email}
                              </a>
                            </div>

                            {/* Reason / Notes */}
                            {req.notes && (
                              <div className="pt-1 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-start gap-1.5 italic">
                                <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                                <span>"{req.notes}"</span>
                              </div>
                            )}

                            {/* Audit Trail for Approved / Rejected */}
                            {(isApproved || isRejected) && (
                              <div className="pt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-2">
                                <span>Reviewed by: <strong>{req.approved_by || 'Admin'}</strong></span>
                                {req.reviewed_at && (
                                  <span>&bull; {new Date(req.reviewed_at).toLocaleString()}</span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            )}

                            <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                              Requested: {new Date(req.created_at).toLocaleString()}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* Right column: Action Buttons */}
                        <div className="flex sm:flex-col items-end justify-between sm:justify-start gap-2 shrink-0 pt-2 sm:pt-0">
                          {isPending ? (
                            <>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                disabled={isProcessing}
                                onClick={() => handleApprove(req)}
                                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer"
                                title={`Approve and email PIN ${targetProfile.pin_code} to ${req.requester_email}`}
                              >
                                {isProcessing ? (
                                  <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                                ) : (
                                  <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                )}
                                <span>Approve &amp; Dispatch PIN</span>
                              </button>

                              {!isPromptingReject ? (
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  disabled={isProcessing}
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    setRejectPromptId(req.id);
                                    setRejectionReason('');
                                  }}
                                  className="px-3 py-1 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950/40 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/50 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                                >
                                  Reject
                                </button>
                              ) : null}
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(req.id)}
                                className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Delete record"
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Rejection Note Prompt Inline */}
                      {isPromptingReject && (
                        <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 rounded-xl space-y-2 animate-in fade-in">
                          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200">
                            Rejection Reason / Note <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400">(Optional)</span>
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="text"
                            value={rejectionReason}
                            onChange={(e) => setRejectionReason(e.target.value)}
                            placeholder="e.g. Unrecognized vendor or missing store branch..."
                            className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-lg border border-rose-300 dark:border-rose-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none"
                          />
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setRejectPromptId(null)}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              Cancel
                            </button>
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleConfirmReject(req.id)}
                              className="px-3 py-1 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"
                            >
                              Confirm Rejection
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
          <div>
            Total: <strong>{requests.length}</strong> authorization requests recorded
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-900 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close Queue
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
