                  <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 leading-snug line-clamp-2">
                    {prod.name}
                  </h4>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-brand-700">SKU: {prod.sku}</span>
                    <span>{prod.case_pack || 'Carton Pack'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* QR and Barcode Graphic Container */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-2.5 my-1">
                  
                  {/* QR Code */}
                  <div className="shrink-0 bg-white p-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                    <QRCodeSVG
                      value={prod.barcode}
                      size={64}
                      level="M"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Visual Barcode Bars Representation */}
                  <div className="flex-1 ml-3 flex flex-col items-center">
                    <div className="h-10 w-full flex items-stretch justify-center space-x-[2px] overflow-hidden">
                      {prod.barcode.split('').map((char, i) => {
                        const digit = parseInt(char, 10) || 1;
                        const widthClass = digit % 3 === 0 ? 'w-1 bg-black' : digit % 2 === 0 ? 'w-0.5 bg-black' : 'w-1.5 bg-black';
                        return (
                          <React.Fragment key={i}>
                            <span className={widthClass}></span>
                            <span className="w-0.5 bg-transparent"></span>
                          </React.Fragment>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-black tracking-widest text-slate-800 mt-1">
                      {prod.barcode}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                </div>

                {/* Footer Tag */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                  <span>Standard Box Sticker</span>
                  <span>SRP: {formatPeso(prod.unit_price)}</span>
                </div>

              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/PrintBarcodesTab.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/ProductAutoSuggest.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { 
  Building2, 
  Sparkles, 
  RefreshCw, 
  ArrowRight
} from 'lucide-react';
import { purchaseOrdersApi } from '../services/purchaseOrdersApi';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';

/**
 * Product & SKU Real-Time Auto-Suggest Input
 * 
 * - Supports searching by Product Name OR SKU / Item Code
 * - Queries Enterprise Erply DB (5,793+ SKUs) & Supabase Saved Products
 * - Auto-populates all details on selection WITHOUT re-opening dropdown on other fields
 * - Strictly no fake/auto-generated images or data
 */
export default function ProductAutoSuggest({
  mode = 'name', // 'name' | 'code'
  value = '',
  onChange,
  onSelectProduct,
  placeholder,
  className = '',
  id,
  name,
  required = false,
  error = null,
  disabled = false
}) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [highlightedIndex, setHighlightedIndex] = useState(-1);
  const [localCatalog, setLocalCatalog] = useState([]);
  const [lastSelected, setLastSelected] = useState(null);

  const wrapperRef = useRef(null);
  const debounceTimerRef = useRef(null);
  const isFocusedRef = useRef(false);
  const userTypedRef = useRef(false);

  // Pre-fetch local catalog once for instant offline/zero-latency matching
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const loadCatalog = async () => {
      try {
        const fetchFn = catalogService.getSavedProducts || catalogService.getProducts;
        if (typeof fetchFn === 'function') {
          const products = await fetchFn.call(catalogService);
          if (isMounted && Array.isArray(products)) {
            setLocalCatalog(products);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[ProductAutoSuggest] Catalog prefetch notice:', err?.message || err);
      }
    };
    loadCatalog();
    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, []);

  // Close dropdown on click outside
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event) {
      if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
        userTypedRef.current = false;
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    document.addEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handleClickOutside);
    };
  }, []);

  // Perform search ONLY when value changes due to explicit user typing in THIS field
  useEffect(() => {
    // If change was not initiated by user typing in this specific input, never open or search
    if (!userTypedRef.current) {
      setIsOpen(false);
      setIsLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const query = String(value || '').trim();

    // If query is short or matches the exact item that was just selected, don't re-trigger popover
    if (query.length < 2) {
      setSuggestions([]);
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsOpen(false);
      return;
    }

    if (lastSelected && (
      (mode === 'name' && query.toLowerCase() === (lastSelected.name || '').toLowerCase()) ||
      (mode === 'code' && query.toLowerCase() === (lastSelected.code || lastSelected.sku || '').toLowerCase())
    )) {
      setIsOpen(false);
      return;
    }

    if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
    }

    debounceTimerRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const cleanLower = query.toLowerCase();

      try {
        // 1. Search local saved products
        const localMatches = localCatalog
          .filter(p => {
            const pName = String(p.name || '').toLowerCase();
            const pCode = String(p.code || p.sku || '').toLowerCase();
            const pBarcode = String(p.barcode || '').toLowerCase();
            return pName.includes(cleanLower) || pCode.includes(cleanLower) || pBarcode.includes(cleanLower);
          })
          .map(p => {
            const rawSku = (p.code && p.code !== p.barcode) ? p.code : ((p.sku && p.sku !== p.barcode) ? p.sku : '');
            return {
              id: p.id || p.code || p.sku,
              name: p.name || '',
              code: rawSku,
              sku: rawSku,
              barcode: p.barcode || '',
              supplierName: p.supplier_name || p.supplierName || '',
              price: Number(p.price || 0),
              priceWithVat: Number(p.price_with_vat || (p.price ? p.price * 1.12 : 0)).toFixed(2),
              unitName: p.unit_name || p.unitName || 'pc',
              imageUrl: p.image_url || p.imageUrl || '',
              brandName: p.brand_name || p.brand || '',
              source: 'Master Catalog',
              isCatalog: true
            };
          });

        // 2. Query live database API (via unified catalogService serverless proxy & purchaseOrdersApi)
        let apiMatches = [];
        try {
          const remoteResults = await catalogService.searchAllProducts(query, 30);
          if (Array.isArray(remoteResults) && remoteResults.length > 0) {
            apiMatches = remoteResults.map(item => {
              const rawSku = (item.code && item.code !== item.barcode) ? item.code : ((item.sku && item.sku !== item.barcode) ? item.sku : '');
              return {
                id: item.id || item.code || item.sku,
                name: item.name || '',
                code: rawSku,
                sku: rawSku,
                barcode: item.barcode || '',
                supplierName: item.supplierName || item.supplier_name || '',
                price: Number(item.price || 0),
                priceWithVat: Number(item.priceWithVat || item.price_with_vat || (item.price ? item.price * 1.12 : 0)).toFixed(2),
                unitName: item.unitName || item.unit_name || 'pc',
                imageUrl: item.imageUrl || item.image_url || '',
                brandName: item.brandName || item.brand_name || '',
                source: item.source || 'Catalog API',
                isCatalog: false
              };
            });
          } else {
            const fallbackResults = await purchaseOrdersApi.searchProducts(query, 30);
            if (Array.isArray(fallbackResults)) {
              apiMatches = fallbackResults.map(item => {
                const basePrice = item.unit_price ? Number(item.unit_price) : 0;
                const pVat = item.raw_data?.priceWithVat 
                  ? Number(item.raw_data.priceWithVat).toFixed(2)
                  : (basePrice ? (basePrice * 1.12).toFixed(2) : '0.00');
                const rawSku = (item.sku && item.sku !== item.barcode) ? item.sku : ((item.code && item.code !== item.barcode) ? item.code : '');

                return {
                  id: item.id || item.sku,
                  name: item.name || '',
                  code: rawSku,
                  sku: rawSku,
                  barcode: item.barcode || '',
                  supplierName: item.supplier || item.raw_data?.supplierName || '',
                  price: Number(basePrice.toFixed(2)),
                  priceWithVat: pVat,
                  unitName: item.raw_data?.unitName || 'pc',
                  imageUrl: item.image_url || item.imageUrl || '',
                  brandName: item.brand || item.raw_data?.brandName || '',
                  source: 'Erply Catalog',
                  isCatalog: false
                };
              });
            }
          }
        } catch (apiErr) {
          console.warn('[ProductAutoSuggest] API query notice:', apiErr.message);
        }

        // 3. Deduplicate by code / sku / name (local catalog takes priority)
        const combined = [...localMatches];
        const seenKeys = new Set(localMatches.map(m => `${(m.code || '').toLowerCase()}-${(m.name || '').toLowerCase()}`));

        for (const item of apiMatches) {
          const key = `${(item.code || '').toLowerCase()}-${(item.name || '').toLowerCase()}`;
          if (!seenKeys.has(key)) {
            seenKeys.add(key);
            combined.push(item);
          }
        }

        // Open dropdown if user typed in this field
        if (userTypedRef.current) {
          setSuggestions(combined.slice(0, 15));
          setIsOpen(combined.length > 0);
          setHighlightedIndex(-1);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[ProductAutoSuggest] Search error:', err);
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    }, 220);

    return () => {
      if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [value, mode, localCatalog, lastSelected]);

  const handleSelect = (product) => {
    userTypedRef.current = false;
    isFocusedRef.current = false;
    setLastSelected(product);
    setIsOpen(false);
    setSuggestions([]);
    setHighlightedIndex(-1);

    if (onSelectProduct) {
      onSelectProduct(product);
    } else if (onChange) {
      const cleanSku = (product.code && product.code !== product.barcode) 
        ? product.code 
        : ((product.sku && product.sku !== product.barcode) ? product.sku : '');
      onChange(mode === 'code' ? cleanSku : product.name);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (!isOpen || suggestions.length === 0) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' && suggestions.length > 0) {
        setIsOpen(true);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIndex(prev => (prev < suggestions.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIndex(prev => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : suggestions.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (highlightedIndex >= 0 && suggestions[highlightedIndex]) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSelect(suggestions[highlightedIndex]);
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      setIsOpen(false);
      userTypedRef.current = false;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full" ref={wrapperRef}>
      <div className="relative flex items-center">
        <input
          id={id}
          name={name}
          type="text"
          autoComplete="off"
          disabled={disabled}
          required={required}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => {
            userTypedRef.current = true;
            onChange(e.target.value);
            setLastSelected(null);
          }}
          onFocus={() => {
            isFocusedRef.current = true;
            if (suggestions.length > 0 && userTypedRef.current) {
              setIsOpen(true);
            }
          }}
          onBlur={() => {
            isFocusedRef.current = false;
            // Delay closing to allow taps or clicks on dropdown items
            setTimeout(() => {
              setIsOpen(false);
              userTypedRef.current = false;
            }, 350);
          }}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          placeholder={placeholder || (mode === 'code' ? 'e.g. P124124141' : 'e.g. Oishi Popcorn Chocolate 60g')}
          className={`${className} ${isLoading ? 'pr-8' : ''}`}
        />

        {isLoading && (
          <div className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 pointer-events-none">
            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 mt-1">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Floating Suggestions Dropdown */}
      {isOpen && suggestions.length > 0 && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full mt-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl z-50 overflow-hidden max-h-72 overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150 divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
          {/* Header pill strip */}
          <div className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 backdrop-blur-xs z-10 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
              <span>Select to Auto-Populate Product Details</span>
            </span>
            <span className="font-mono text-[9px] bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold">
              {suggestions.length} match{suggestions.length > 1 ? 'es' : ''}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* List items */}
          <div className="p-1 space-y-0.5">
            {suggestions.map((item, idx) => {
              const isHighlighted = idx === highlightedIndex;

              return (
                <button
                  key={`${item.code}-${idx}`}
                  type="button"
                  onMouseDown={(e) => {
                    // Prevent blur from closing dropdown before click registers
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleSelect(item);
                  }}
                  onTouchEnd={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleSelect(item);
                  }}
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(item)}
                  onMouseEnter={() => setHighlightedIndex(idx)}
                  className={`w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-start justify-between gap-3 ${
                    isHighlighted
                      ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/70 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 shadow-xs'
                      : 'hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/60 border border-transparent'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1">
                    {/* Item Name */}
                    <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs leading-snug line-clamp-2">
                      {item.name}
                    </div>

                    {/* Metadata tags: SKU, Supplier, Unit */}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px]">
                      {item.code && (
                        <span className="font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                          SKU: {item.code}
                        </span>
                      )}

                      {item.supplierName && (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">
                          <Building2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5 opacity-70" />
                          <span>{item.supplierName}</span>
                        </span>
                      )}

                      {item.unitName && (
                        <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono">
                          • {item.unitName}
                        </span>
                      )}

                      <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[9px] font-extrabold ${
                        item.isCatalog 
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800'
                          : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800'
                      }`}>
                        {item.source}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Price & Selection Pill */}
                  <div className="text-right shrink-0 space-y-0.5">
                    {item.priceWithVat && Number(item.priceWithVat) > 0 ? (
                      <>
                        <div className="font-mono font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs">
                          ₱{Number(item.priceWithVat || item.price || 0).toFixed(2)}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">
                          Base: ₱{Number(item.price || 0).toFixed(2)}
                        </div>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono italic">
                        No Price
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                      <span>Select</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/ProductAutoSuggest.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/ProductEditModal.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  X, 
  Save, 
  Trash2, 
  Upload, 
  Camera,
  AlertCircle, 
  RefreshCw, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Package, 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  ZoomIn, 
  Search, 
  UserCheck, 
  Building2,
  ChevronDown,
  Lock
} from 'lucide-react';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';
import { authService } from '../services/authService';
import { notificationService } from '../services/notificationService';
import ImageLightboxModal from './ImageLightboxModal';
import SupplierInput from './SupplierInput';
import ProductAutoSuggest from './ProductAutoSuggest';

export default function ProductEditModal({ isOpen, onClose, product, onSaved, onDeleted, currentUser }) {
  const isEditing = Boolean(product && product.id && (typeof product.id === 'number' || (/^\d+$/.test(String(product.id).trim()) && !String(product.id).startsWith('prod_'))));
  const isExistingBarcode = Boolean(product && product.barcode);

  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [barcode, setBarcode] = useState('');
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [supplierName, setSupplierName] = useState('');
  const [price, setPrice] = useState('');
  const [priceWithVat, setPriceWithVat] = useState('');
  const [unitName, setUnitName] = useState('pc');
  const [piecesPerCase, setPiecesPerCase] = useState('');
  const [imageUrl, setImageUrl] = useState('');
  const [photoFile, setPhotoFile] = useState(null);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState(null);
  const [lightboxPhoto, setLightboxPhoto] = useState(null);

  // Customer AE (Account Executive) State
  const [selectedAe, setSelectedAe] = useState(null); // { name, email, department }
  const [aeSearch, setAeSearch] = useState('');
  const [isAeDropdownOpen, setIsAeDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
  const [loadingEmployees, setLoadingEmployees] = useState(false);

  // Company Division: 'Pingcon / Bonita' vs 'A2Z2GO / Keysys'
  const [company, setCompany] = useState('Pingcon / Bonita');

  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorNotice, setErrorNotice] = useState(null);
  const [skuError, setSkuError] = useState(null);
  const [nameError, setNameError] = useState(null);


  // Fetch employees from authService directory on open
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setLoadingEmployees(true);
      authService.getEmployees()
        .then(list => {
          setEmployees(list || []);
        })
        .catch(err => {
          console.warn('Failed to load employees for AE selection:', err);
        })
        .finally(() => {
          setLoadingEmployees(false);
        });
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      if (product) {
        const barcodeStr = product.barcode ? String(product.barcode).trim() : '';
        const rawName = String(product.name || '').trim();
        const isBatchManifestTitle = rawName.toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest');
        setName(isBatchManifestTitle ? '' : rawName);
        setBarcode(barcodeStr);

        // SKU and Barcode are strictly different.
        // When assigning SKU or if code is equal to barcode or placeholder, default to BLANK.
        const rawCode = String(product.code || product.sku || '').trim();
        const isSameAsBarcode = Boolean(barcodeStr && rawCode === barcodeStr);
        const isPlaceholder = rawCode.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting') || rawCode.toLowerCase().includes('unidentified');
        const initialCode = (!isSameAsBarcode && !isPlaceholder) ? rawCode : '';
        setCode(initialCode);

        setSupplierName(product.supplier_name || product.supplierName || 'Savemore');
        setPrice(product.price !== undefined ? String(product.price) : '0');
        setPriceWithVat(product.price_with_vat !== undefined ? String(product.price_with_vat) : String(product.priceWithVat || '0'));
        setUnitName(product.unit_name || product.unitName || 'pc');
        setPiecesPerCase(
          product.pieces_per_case !== undefined && product.pieces_per_case !== null
            ? String(product.pieces_per_case)
            : (product.piecesPerCase !== undefined && product.piecesPerCase !== null ? String(product.piecesPerCase) : '')
        );

        // Only preload image if it is an existing verified catalog product with an official image.
        // For unassigned barcodes or new SKU assignments, strictly start with empty state placeholder.
        const isVerifiedCatalogItem = Boolean(product.id && product.is_verified !== false);
        const catalogImage = isVerifiedCatalogItem ? (product.image_url || product.imageUrl || '') : '';
        setImageUrl(catalogImage);
        setPhotoPreview(catalogImage || null);

        // Prepopulate AE if saved
        if (product.ae_name || product.ae_email) {
          setSelectedAe({
            name: product.ae_name || '',
            email: product.ae_email || '',
            department: product.ae_department || 'Account Executive'
          });
        } else {
          setSelectedAe(null);
        }

        // Default unified company
        setCompany('Wholesale Distribution');
      } else {
        // Reset for new product
        setName('');
        setBarcode('');
        setCode('');
        setSupplierName('');
        setPrice('');
        setPriceWithVat('');
        setUnitName('pc');
        setPiecesPerCase('');
        setImageUrl('');
        setPhotoPreview(null);
        setSelectedAe(null);
        setCompany('Wholesale Distribution');
      }
      setPhotoFile(null);
      setAeSearch('');
      setIsAeDropdownOpen(false);
      setErrorNotice(null);
      setSkuError(null);
      setNameError(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen, product]);

  const handleNameChange = (val) => {
    setName(val);
    setNameError(null);
  };

  const handleCodeChange = (val) => {
    setCode(val);
    setSkuError(null);
  };

  const handleAutoPopulate = (item) => {
    if (!item) return;
    if (item.name) setName(item.name);
    const candidateCode = String(item.code || item.sku || '').trim();
    const currentBarcode = String(barcode || item.barcode || '').trim();
    if (candidateCode && candidateCode !== currentBarcode && !candidateCode.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting') && !candidateCode.toLowerCase().includes('unidentified')) {
      setCode(candidateCode);
    } else {
      setCode('');
    }
    if (item.barcode && !barcode) setBarcode(item.barcode);

    // Auto populate existing data; if none leave blank, no fake data
    setSupplierName(item.supplierName || item.supplier_name || '');

    if (item.price !== undefined && item.price !== null && Number(item.price) > 0) {
      const p = Number(item.price);
      setPrice(p.toFixed(2));
      setPriceWithVat(item.priceWithVat && Number(item.priceWithVat) > 0 ? String(Number(item.priceWithVat).toFixed(2)) : (p * 1.12).toFixed(2));
    } else {
      setPrice('');
      setPriceWithVat('');
    }

    if (item.unitName || item.unit_name) {
      setUnitName(item.unitName || item.unit_name);
    } else {
      setUnitName('pc');
    }

    if (item.pieces_per_case || item.piecesPerCase) {
      setPiecesPerCase(String(item.pieces_per_case || item.piecesPerCase));
    } else {
      setPiecesPerCase('');
    }

    // Do NOT auto generate fake image. Only set if real image exists from catalog
    if (item.imageUrl) {
      setImageUrl(item.imageUrl);
      setPhotoPreview(item.imageUrl);
    } else if (!photoFile) {
      setImageUrl('');
      setPhotoPreview(null);
    }

    setNameError(null);
    setSkuError(null);
  };

  const handlePriceChange = (val) => {
    if (val === '' || /^\d*\.?\d{0,2}$/.test(val)) {
      setPrice(val);
      const num = parseFloat(val);
      if (!isNaN(num)) {
        setPriceWithVat((num * 1.12).toFixed(2));
      }
    }
  };

  const handlePriceBlur = () => {
    if (price !== '') {
      const p = Number((parseFloat(price) || 0).toFixed(2));
      setPrice(p.toFixed(2));
      setPriceWithVat((p * 1.12).toFixed(2));
    }
  };

  const handlePriceWithVatChange = (val) => {
    if (val === '' || /^\d*\.?\d{0,2}$/.test(val)) {
      setPriceWithVat(val);
    }
  };

  const handlePriceWithVatBlur = () => {
    if (priceWithVat !== '') {
      const p = Number((parseFloat(priceWithVat) || 0).toFixed(2));
      setPriceWithVat(p.toFixed(2));
    }
  };

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      setPhotoFile(file);
      setPhotoPreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    }
  };

  // Filter employees for AE Search
  const filteredEmployees = useMemo(() => {
    const q = aeSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!q) return employees.slice(0, 15);
    return employees.filter(emp => 
      (emp.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (emp.email || emp.company_email || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (emp.department || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [employees, aeSearch]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!barcode.trim() || !name.trim()) {
      setErrorNotice('Barcode and Product Name are required.');
      return;
    }

    // Customer AE is strictly REQUIRED
    if (!selectedAe || !selectedAe.email) {
      setErrorNotice('Customer Account Executive (AE) is required. Please search and select an AE from the company employee directory.');
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);
    setErrorNotice(null);

    try {
      let finalImageUrl = imageUrl;
      if (photoFile) {
        finalImageUrl = await catalogService.uploadPhoto(photoFile, null, 'product', {
          sku: code.trim() || barcode.trim(),
          name: name.trim()
        });
      }

      const isCaseUnit = (unitName || '').toLowerCase() === 'case';
      const cleanPiecesPerCase = isCaseUnit ? (parseInt(piecesPerCase, 10) || null) : null;

      const payload = {
        barcode: barcode.trim(),
        code: code.trim() || null,
        name: name.trim(),
        supplierName: supplierName.trim() || 'Savemore',
        price: Number((parseFloat(price) || 0).toFixed(2)),
        priceWithVat: Number((parseFloat(priceWithVat) || parseFloat(price) || 0).toFixed(2)),
        unitName: unitName.trim() || 'pc',
        pieces_per_case: cleanPiecesPerCase,
        piecesPerCase: cleanPiecesPerCase,
        imageUrl: finalImageUrl || null,
        aeName: selectedAe.name,
        aeEmail: selectedAe.email,
        company: company
      };

      let savedProductData;
      if (isEditing) {
        const res = await catalogService.updateProduct(product.id, payload);
        savedProductData = res?.product || { id: product.id, ...payload };
      } else {
        const res = await catalogService.createProduct(payload);
        savedProductData = res?.product || payload;
      }

      if (onSaved) onSaved({
        ...savedProductData,
        child_id: product?.child_id
      });
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorNotice(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-lg w-full flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] sm:max-h-[92vh] overflow-hidden my-0 sm:my-auto">
        {/* Mobile Drag Indicator */}
        <div className="bottom-sheet-handle sm:hidden" />
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 rounded-2xl shadow-inner">
              <Package className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                {isEditing ? 'Edit Product Details' : 'Add New Product to Catalog'}
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {isEditing 
                  ? 'Update product specs, price, Customer AE, and reference photo' 
                  : 'Register custom item into Supabase products database'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
          
          {errorNotice && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-300 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
              <span>{errorNotice}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          <form id="product-edit-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3.5 text-xs">
            
            {/* Reference Image Preview & Upload */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl space-y-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                Product Reference Photo
              </label>
              
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                {photoPreview ? (
                  <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-blue-400 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 shadow-sm shrink-0 relative group">
                    <img src={photoPreview} alt="Preview" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/45 text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setLightboxPhoto({
                          url: photoPreview,
                          title: name || 'Product Reference Photo',
                          subtitle: barcode ? `Barcode: ${barcode}` : ''
                        })}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-black/60 hover:bg-black/90 text-white cursor-zoom-in"
                        title="Click to zoom image"
                      >
                        <ZoomIn className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => { setPhotoPreview(null); setPhotoFile(null); setImageUrl(''); }}
                        className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-600/80 hover:bg-rose-600 text-white"
                        title="Remove photo"
                      >
                        <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 flex flex-col items-center justify-center shrink-0 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700">
                    <ImageIcon className="w-6 h-6 mb-0.5 opacity-60" />
                    <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">No Image</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs cursor-pointer shadow-xs transition-all">
                      <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                      <span>Upload Photo</span>
                      <input
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/*"
                        onChange={handlePhotoSelect}
                        className="hidden"
                      />
                    </label>

                    <label className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/50 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs cursor-pointer shadow-xs transition-all">
                      <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                      <span>Take Picture</span>
                      <input
                        type="file"
                        accept="image/*"
                        capture="environment"
                        onChange={handlePhotoSelect}
                        className="hidden"
                      />
                    </label>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                    Optional: Upload or take a picture of the product. Displayed when reporters scan this barcode.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Product Name */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Product Name *
              </label>
              <ProductAutoSuggest
                mode="name"
                required
                value={name}
                onChange={handleNameChange}
                onSelectProduct={handleAutoPopulate}
                placeholder="e.g. Oishi Popcorn Chocolate 60g"
                error={nameError}
                className={`w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border ${
                  nameError ? 'border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-600' : 'border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 focus:border-blue-600'
                } rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800`}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Barcode & SKU Code */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                    Barcode / QR Code *
                  </label>
                  {isExistingBarcode && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Lock className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                      Locked Scanned Barcode
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  readOnly={isExistingBarcode}
                  disabled={isExistingBarcode}
                  value={barcode}
                  onChange={(e) => !isExistingBarcode && setBarcode(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. 4800016551857"
                  className={`w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold border ${
                    isExistingBarcode
                      ? 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 cursor-not-allowed select-all'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-white border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                  title={isExistingBarcode ? "Scanned barcode is locked during SKU assignment to prevent data corruption." : "Enter product barcode"}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  SKU / Item Code
                </label>
                <ProductAutoSuggest
                  mode="code"
                  value={code}
                  onChange={handleCodeChange}
                  onSelectProduct={handleAutoPopulate}
                  placeholder="e.g. SS1742P"
                  error={skuError}
                  className={`w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border ${
                    skuError ? 'border-rose-500 focus:border-rose-600' : 'border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 focus:border-blue-600'
                  } rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800`}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* CUSTOMER ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE (AE) SELECTOR - STRICTLY REQUIRED */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-blue-950/40 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-900/60 rounded-2xl space-y-2 relative">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <label className="block text-xs font-black text-blue-950 dark:text-blue-300">
                  Customer Account Executive (AE) * <span className="text-rose-500 font-bold">(Required)</span>
                </label>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 font-semibold">
                  Receives CC on report emails
                </span>
              </div>

              {selectedAe ? (
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between gap-2 shadow-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                    <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs truncate">
                        {selectedAe.name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 truncate">
                        {selectedAe.email}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSelectedAe(null);
                      setIsAeDropdownOpen(true);
                    }}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold shrink-0 transition-colors"
                  >
                    Change AE
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="relative">
                  <div className="relative">
                    <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-2.5" />
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={aeSearch}
                      onFocus={() => setIsAeDropdownOpen(true)}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setAeSearch(e.target.value);
                        setIsAeDropdownOpen(true);
                      }}
                      placeholder={loadingEmployees ? 'Loading company staff directory...' : 'Search AE employee by name, company email, or department...'}
                      className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-blue-300 dark:border-blue-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 shadow-xs"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setIsAeDropdownOpen(prev => !prev)}
                      className="absolute right-2.5 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200"
                    >
                      <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Dropdown list of matching employees */}
                  {isAeDropdownOpen && (
                    <div className="absolute z-20 left-0 right-0 mt-1 max-h-52 overflow-y-auto bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl shadow-xl divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700">
                      {filteredEmployees.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="p-3 text-center text-slate-400 text-xs">
                          No employees found matching "{aeSearch}".
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        filteredEmployees.map((emp, idx) => {
                          const empEmail = emp.email || emp.company_email || '';
                          return (
                            <button
                              key={emp.id || empEmail || idx}
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setSelectedAe({
                                  name: emp.name,
                                  email: empEmail,
                                  department: emp.department || 'Account Executive'
                                });
                                setIsAeDropdownOpen(false);
                                setAeSearch('');
                              }}
                              className="w-full p-2.5 text-left hover:bg-blue-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/60 transition-colors flex items-center justify-between gap-2"
                            >
                              <div className="min-w-0">
                                <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs truncate">
                                  {emp.name}
                                </div>
                                <div className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
                                  {empEmail} {emp.department ? `• ${emp.department}` : ''}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 uppercase shrink-0">
                                Select
                              </span>
                            </button>
                          );
                        })
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>


            {/* Price & Price with VAT */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Net Price (₱)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  value={price}
                  onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                  onChange={(e) => handlePriceChange(e.target.value)}
                  onBlur={handlePriceBlur}
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Price w/ VAT (₱)
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  value={priceWithVat}
                  onFocus={(e) => e.target.select()}
                  onChange={(e) => handlePriceWithVatChange(e.target.value)}
                  onBlur={handlePriceWithVatBlur}
                  placeholder="0.00"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Unit
                </label>
                <select
                  value={unitName || 'pc'}
                  onChange={(e) => setUnitName(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="pc">pc (piece)</option>
                  <option value="case">case</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Pieces Per Case (Pack Size) - when Unit is 'case' */}
            {unitName === 'case' && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/80 rounded-2xl space-y-1 animate-in fade-in">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200">
                  Pieces per Case (Pack Size) *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  value={piecesPerCase}
                  onChange={(e) => setPiecesPerCase(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. 24"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-600 shadow-2xs"
                />
                <p className="text-[10px] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                  Specifies how many individual pieces are inside 1 case (e.g. 6 cases × 24 pcs/cs = 144 pcs total).
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Supplier */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                Supplier Name
              </label>
              <SupplierInput
                value={supplierName}
                onChange={(val) => setSupplierName(val)}
                placeholder="e.g. Savemore / Mondelez / Bonita"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800"
              />
            </div>

          </form>
        </div>

        {/* Pinned Footer with Actions */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 pb-safe bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-end gap-3 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="touch-target px-4 py-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white text-xs font-bold"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            
            <button
              type="submit"
              form="product-edit-form"
              disabled={isLoading}
              className="touch-target px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
            >
              {isLoading ? <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              <span>{isEditing ? 'Save Changes' : 'Save Product'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* Fullscreen Image Lightbox Modal */}
      <ImageLightboxModal
        isOpen={Boolean(lightboxPhoto)}
        imageUrl={lightboxPhoto?.url}
        images={lightboxPhoto?.images || (lightboxPhoto?.url ? [lightboxPhoto.url] : [])}
        initialIndex={0}
        title={lightboxPhoto?.title}
        subtitle={lightboxPhoto?.subtitle}
        onClose={() => setLightboxPhoto(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/ProductEditModal.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/ProductSearchTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  Search, 
  Package, 
  RefreshCw, 
  X, 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Plus, 
  ExternalLink, 
  ArrowRight, 
  List, 
  LayoutGrid,
  ArrowUpDown,
  ArrowUp,
  ArrowDown,
  RotateCcw
} from 'lucide-react';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';
import ImageLightboxModal from './ImageLightboxModal';
import TablePagination from './TablePagination';

export default function ProductSearchTab({ onInspectProduct, onImportToCatalog }) {
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = useState([]);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const [hasSearched, setHasSearched] = useState(false);
  const [selectedLightbox, setSelectedLightbox] = useState(null);
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState('name');
  const [sortDirection, setSortDirection] = useState('asc');
  const [supplierFilter, setSupplierFilter] = useState('all');
  const [sourceFilter, setSourceFilter] = useState('all');
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(10);

  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('rma_search_view_mode') || 'table';
  });

  const handleSetViewMode = (mode) => {
    setViewMode(mode);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('rma_search_view_mode', mode);
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  const handleSearch = async (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    const query = searchInput.trim();
    if (!query) return;

    setIsSearching(true);
    setHasSearched(true);
    setCurrentPage(1);

    try {
      const items = await catalogService.searchAllProducts(query, 50);
      setResults(items);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Multi-search notice:', err);
      setResults([]);
    } finally {
      setIsSearching(false);
    }
  };

  // Derive unique suppliers from search results
  const uniqueSuppliers = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set();
    results.forEach(r => {
      const s = r.supplierName || r.supplier;
      if (s && s.trim()) set.add(s.trim());
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [results]);

  // Derive unique sources from search results
  const uniqueSources = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set();
    results.forEach(r => {
      if (r.source && r.source.trim()) set.add(r.source.trim());
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [results]);

  // Handle column header sorting
  const handleSort = (field) => {
    setCurrentPage(1);
    if (sortField === field) {
      setSortDirection(prev => prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
      setSortField(field);
      setSortDirection('asc');
    }
  };

  // Filter and sort results
  const processedResults = useMemo(() => {
    let list = results.filter(item => {
      if (supplierFilter !== 'all') {
        const s = (item.supplierName || item.supplier || '').trim();
        if (s !== supplierFilter) return false;
      }
      if (sourceFilter !== 'all') {
        if ((item.source || '').trim() !== sourceFilter) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    list.sort((a, b) => {
      let valA, valB;
      switch (sortField) {
        case 'id':
          valA = Number(a.id) || 0;
          valB = Number(b.id) || 0;
          break;
        case 'barcode':
          valA = String(a.barcode || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.barcode || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'code':
          valA = String(a.code || a.sku || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.code || b.sku || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'name':
          valA = String(a.name || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.name || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'price':
          valA = Number(a.priceWithVat || a.price || 0);
          valB = Number(b.priceWithVat || b.price || 0);
          break;
        case 'supplier':
          valA = String(a.supplierName || a.supplier || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.supplierName || b.supplier || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'source':
          valA = String(a.source || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.source || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        default:
          valA = a.id;
          valB = b.id;
      }

      if (valA < valB) return sortDirection === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      if (valA > valB) return sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    });

    return list;
  }, [results, supplierFilter, sourceFilter, sortField, sortDirection]);

  // Paginated slice
  const paginatedResults = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return processedResults.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [processedResults, currentPage, pageSize]);

  const hasActiveFilters = supplierFilter !== 'all' || sourceFilter !== 'all';

  const resetFilters = () => {
    setSupplierFilter('all');
    setSourceFilter('all');
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  const renderSortIndicator = (field) => {
    if (sortField !== field) {
      return <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-400 shrink-0 ml-1" />;
    }
    return sortDirection === 'asc' ? (
      <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 shrink-0 ml-1" />
    ) : (
      <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 shrink-0 ml-1" />
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Search Header Bar */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-inner">
            <Search className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
              Universal Catalog Search
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              Instant multi-item search across your verified database & enterprise wholesale catalog.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Search Input Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSearch} className="flex gap-2">
          <div className="relative flex-1">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchInput}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search by product name (e.g. Chocolate, Biscuit, Coffee), barcode, or SKU code..."
              className="w-full pl-10 pr-9 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-800 transition-all"
            />
            {searchInput && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchInput('')}
                className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isSearching || !searchInput.trim()}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-extrabold text-xs rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition-all shrink-0"
          >
            {isSearching ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Search className="w-4 h-4" />}
            <span>Search Catalog</span>
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>

      {/* Results Header with View Mode Switcher and Filters */}
      {hasSearched && (
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-3.5 sm:p-4 shadow-sm space-y-3">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
            <div>
              Found <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{processedResults.length}</strong> products matching "{searchInput}"
              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 block sm:inline sm:ml-2">
                (Searched across database & product catalog)
              </span>
            </div>

            {results.length > 0 && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end sm:self-auto">
                {/* View switcher */}
                <div className="flex items-center bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-1 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSetViewMode('table')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                      viewMode === 'table'
                        ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 shadow-sm'
                        : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
                    }`}
                    title="Rows / Table View"
                  >
                    <List className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Rows List</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSetViewMode('grid')}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                      viewMode === 'grid'
                        ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 shadow-sm'
                        : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200'
                    }`}
                    title="Grid / Cards View"
                  >
                    <LayoutGrid className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Grid Cards</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Search Result Filtering Options */}
          {results.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Filter results:</span>

              {uniqueSuppliers.length > 1 && (
                <select
                  value={supplierFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setSupplierFilter(e.target.value);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                  }}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                >
                  <option value="all">All Suppliers ({uniqueSuppliers.length})</option>
                  {uniqueSuppliers.map(sup => (
                    <option key={sup} value={sup}>{sup}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              )}

              {uniqueSources.length > 1 && (
                <select
                  value={sourceFilter}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setSourceFilter(e.target.value);
                    setCurrentPage(1);
                  }}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                >
                  <option value="all">All Sources</option>
                  {uniqueSources.map(src => (
                    <option key={src} value={src}>{src}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              )}

              {hasActiveFilters && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={resetFilters}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Reset Filters</span>
                </button>
              )}

              <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 ml-auto">
                Click column headers to sort (<strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 capitalize">{sortField}</strong> {sortDirection === 'asc' ? '▲' : '▼'})
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Results List / Grid */}
      {isSearching ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 space-y-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6">
          <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 mx-auto animate-spin text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">Searching catalog...</p>
        </div>
      ) : hasSearched && processedResults.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-14 text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 space-y-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm">
          <Package className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600" />
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
            {hasActiveFilters ? 'No products match the selected filters' : `No products found matching "${searchInput}"`}
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
            {hasActiveFilters ? 'Try resetting your supplier or source filters.' : 'Try searching with a shorter keyword or checking the barcode spelling.'}
          </p>
          {hasActiveFilters && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={resetFilters}
              className="mt-2 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 font-bold text-xs hover:underline"
            >
              Reset Filters
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : processedResults.length > 0 && viewMode === 'table' ? (
        /* TABLE / ROWS VIEW WITH SORTABLE HEADERS */
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('id')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white w-16 cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Serial Number"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <span>SN</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('id')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-3 w-14 text-center select-none">Photo</th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('barcode')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Barcode"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <span>Barcode</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('barcode')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('code')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by SKU / Code"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <span>SKU / Code</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('code')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('name')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Product Name"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <span>Product Name</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('name')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('price')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Price"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end">
                      <span>Price (w/ VAT)</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('price')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('supplier')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Supplier"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <span>Supplier</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('supplier')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('source')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-3 text-center font-bold cursor-pointer select-none hover:text-blue-600 dark:hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Source"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-center">
                      <span>Source</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('source')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold w-24 select-none">Action</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800 font-medium">
                {paginatedResults.map((item, idx) => {
                  const isSupabase = item.source?.includes('Supabase');
                  const hasPhoto = Boolean(item.imageUrl);
                  const serialNum = item.id || ((currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1);

                  return (
                    <tr key={`${item.barcode || item.code}-${idx}`} className="hover:bg-blue-50/30 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50 transition-colors">
                      {/* 1. SN COLUMN AT FAR LEFT */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono">
                        <span className="font-black text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-300 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs">
                          #{serialNum}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* 2. Photo Thumbnail with Lightbox */}
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                        {hasPhoto ? (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setSelectedLightbox({
                              url: item.imageUrl,
                              title: item.name,
                              subtitle: `Barcode: ${item.barcode} • SN #${serialNum} • ${item.supplierName || 'Wholesale Supplier'}`
                            })}
                            className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 inline-block hover:opacity-85 hover:scale-105 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-zoom-in"
                            title="Click to zoom reference photo in fullscreen"
                          >
                            <img src={item.imageUrl} alt={item.name} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                            <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* 3. Barcode */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                        {item.barcode}
                      </td>

                      {/* 4. SKU / Code */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                        {item.code ? (
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold text-[11px] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                            {item.code}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 italic">—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* 5. Product Name */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white max-w-xs truncate" title={item.name}>
                        {item.name}
                      </td>

                      {/* 6. Price */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right font-mono font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 text-sm">
                        ₱{Number(item.priceWithVat || item.price || 0).toFixed(2)}
                      </td>

                      {/* 7. Supplier */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold truncate max-w-[140px]">
                        {item.supplierName || 'Savemore'}
                      </td>

                      {/* 8. Source */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider ${
                          isSupabase
                            ? 'bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/60 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800'
                            : 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800'
                        }`}>
                          {isSupabase ? 'Database' : 'Catalog'}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* 9. Action */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                        {onImportToCatalog && !isSupabase && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => onImportToCatalog(item)}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-lg text-xs transition-colors"
                            title="Add to Verified Saved Products"
                          >
                            + Save
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <TablePagination
            currentPage={currentPage}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            totalItems={processedResults.length}
            onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
            onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
              setPageSize(newSize);
              setCurrentPage(1);
            }}
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* GRID CARDS VIEW WITH LIGHTBOX */
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 2xl:grid-cols-5 gap-3.5">
            {paginatedResults.map((item, idx) => {
              const hasPhoto = Boolean(item.imageUrl);
              const serialNum = item.id || ((currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1);
              const isSupabase = item.source?.includes('Supabase');

              return (
                <div 
                  key={`${item.barcode || item.code}-${idx}`}
                  className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-blue-300 dark:hover:border-blue-700 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 group"
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                      <span className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-300 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg">
                        SN #{serialNum}
