                      </span>
                      <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider ${
                        isSupabase
                          ? 'bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/60 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800'
                          : 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800'
                      }`}>
                        {isSupabase ? 'Database' : 'Catalog'}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                      {hasPhoto ? (
                        <div 
                          onClick={() => setSelectedLightbox({
                            url: item.imageUrl,
                            title: item.name,
                            subtitle: `Barcode: ${item.barcode} • SN #${serialNum} • ${item.supplierName || 'Wholesale Supplier'}`
                          })}
                          className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 shrink-0 cursor-zoom-in hover:opacity-90 relative"
                          title="Click to zoom reference photo in fullscreen"
                        >
                          <img src={item.imageUrl} alt={item.name} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/40 text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-900/50">
                          <ImageIcon className="w-6 h-6" />
                        </div>
                      )}

                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        {item.code && (
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold truncate mb-0.5">
                            SKU: <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{item.code}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs sm:text-sm line-clamp-2 leading-tight">
                          {item.name}
                        </h4>
                        
                        <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 truncate">
                          Barcode: <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{item.barcode}</strong>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 block font-medium">Price (w/ VAT)</span>
                        <span className="font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono text-sm">
                          ₱{Number(item.priceWithVat || item.price || 0).toFixed(2)}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="text-right">
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 block font-medium">Supplier</span>
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 truncate max-w-[120px] block">
                          {item.supplierName || 'Savemore'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {onImportToCatalog && !isSupabase && (
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex justify-end">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onImportToCatalog(item)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Save to DB</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <TablePagination
            currentPage={currentPage}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            totalItems={processedResults.length}
            onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
            onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
              setPageSize(newSize);
              setCurrentPage(1);
            }}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Fullscreen Image Lightbox Modal */}
      <ImageLightboxModal
        isOpen={Boolean(selectedLightbox)}
        imageUrl={selectedLightbox?.url}
        title={selectedLightbox?.title}
        subtitle={selectedLightbox?.subtitle}
        onClose={() => setSelectedLightbox(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/PurchasingBufferTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Truck, 
  Clock, 
  AlertCircle, 
  FilePlus, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Building2, 
  Package, 
  Layers, 
  ArrowRight,
  ShieldAlert,
  Printer,
  Phone,
  Mail,
  UserCheck,
  Search,
  ExternalLink
} from 'lucide-react';
import { formatPeso } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import { rmaApi } from '../supabaseClient';

export default function PurchasingBufferTab({ tickets = [], onUpdateTicket }) {
  const [createdPoNotice, setCreatedPoNotice] = useState(null);
  const [liveSuppliers, setLiveSuppliers] = useState([]);
  const [supplierSearchQuery, setSupplierSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [isSupplierModalOpen, setIsSupplierModalOpen] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadSuppliers() {
      try {
        const suppliers = await rmaApi.getLiveSuppliers(200);
        setLiveSuppliers(suppliers);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Failed to load suppliers:', e);
      }
    }
    loadSuppliers();
  }, []);

  // Group tickets by supplier
  const supplierGroups = tickets.reduce((acc, ticket) => {
    const supp = ticket.supplier || 'Unassigned Supplier';
    if (!acc[supp]) {
      acc[supp] = {
        supplierName: supp,
        tickets: [],
        totalUnits: 0,
        totalAmount: 0,
        pendingBufferDaysMin: 7
      };
    }
    acc[supp].tickets.push(ticket);
    acc[supp].totalUnits += Number(ticket.quantity) || 0;
    acc[supp].totalAmount += Number(ticket.total_amount) || 0;
    if (ticket.buffer_days_left !== undefined && ticket.buffer_days_left < acc[supp].pendingBufferDaysMin) {
      acc[supp].pendingBufferDaysMin = ticket.buffer_days_left;
    }
    return acc;
  }, {});

  const supplierList = Object.values(supplierGroups);

  // Action: Generate Vendor Return PO
  const handleGenerateSupplierPO = async (suppName, ticketIds) => {
    const year = new Date().getFullYear();
    const poNumber = `PO-RET-${year}-${String(Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900))}`;

    for (const id of ticketIds) {
      await onUpdateTicket(id, {
        supplier_po_no: poNumber,
        status: 'In Transit'
      });
    }

    setCreatedPoNotice(`Consolidated Vendor Purchase Order #${poNumber} issued for ${suppName} (${ticketIds.length} RMA items consolidated)`);
    setTimeout(() => setCreatedPoNotice(null), 5000);
  };

  // Action: Buffer Dispatch
  const handleBufferDispatch = async (ticket) => {
    await onUpdateTicket(ticket.id, {
      status: 'Buffer Replacement',
      notes: `Buffer units dispatched from Warehouse Inventory Buffer stock on ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}.`
    });
    setCreatedPoNotice(`Inventory buffer stock allocated for Ticket ${ticket.id} (${ticket.quantity} units)!`);
    setTimeout(() => setCreatedPoNotice(null), 5000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      
      {/* Toast Notice */}
      {createdPoNotice && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-500/40 text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200 rounded-2xl flex items-center space-x-3 text-xs sm:text-sm animate-in slide-in-from-top-2 shadow-sm">
          <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 shrink-0" />
          <span className="font-semibold">{createdPoNotice}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-500/40">
              Purchasing & Inventory Buffer Control
            </span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Truck className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
            Supplier Consolidated Claims & SLA Countdown
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Group defective merchandise by factory supplier to issue batch POs and monitor Inventory buffer replacement turnaround.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsSupplierModalOpen(true)}
            className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-purple-50 hover:bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950/80 dark:hover:bg-purple-900 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors shadow-sm"
          >
            <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
            <span>Supplier Directory ({liveSuppliers.length > 0 ? liveSuppliers.length : 610})</span>
          </button>

          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 p-2.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-mono">
            <div className="text-center px-3">
              <span className="text-slate-400 block text-[10px]">SUPPLIERS</span>
              <span className="text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-bold text-base">{supplierList.length}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-px h-7 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800"></div>
            <div className="text-center px-3">
              <span className="text-slate-400 block text-[10px]">TOTAL DEFECTS</span>
              <span className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold text-base">
                {supplierList.reduce((acc, s) => acc + s.totalUnits, 0)} Units
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Supplier Cards Grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
        {supplierList.map((group) => {
          const matchedSupplier = liveSuppliers.find(s => 
            s.sheet_supplier_name?.toLowerCase() === group.supplierName.toLowerCase() ||
            s.full_company_name?.toLowerCase().includes(group.supplierName.toLowerCase()) ||
            group.supplierName.toLowerCase().includes(s.sheet_supplier_name?.toLowerCase() || '___')
          );

          return (
            <div 
              key={group.supplierName}
              className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4"
            >
              {/* Header */}
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                    <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 mr-1.5" />
                    {group.supplierName}
                  </span>

                  {/* Buffer Countdown Badge */}
                  <div className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center space-x-1.5 border ${
                    group.pendingBufferDaysMin <= 0
                      ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-950 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/50 animate-pulse'
                      : group.pendingBufferDaysMin <= 3
                      ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-950 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/40'
                      : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/40'
                  }`}>
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>
                      {group.pendingBufferDaysMin <= 0 
                        ? 'SLA OVERDUE (0d)' 
                        : `${group.pendingBufferDaysMin} Days Buffer Left`}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Live Vendor Contact Details from auto_po_supplier_contacts */}
                {matchedSupplier && (
                  <div className="mt-3 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-purple-50/70 dark:bg-purple-950/40 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800/40 text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200">
                      <span>{matchedSupplier.full_company_name || matchedSupplier.sheet_supplier_name}</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] bg-purple-200/60 dark:bg-purple-800/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                        {matchedSupplier.terms || 'Standard Terms'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 pt-0.5">
                      {matchedSupplier.contact_person && <span>👤 {matchedSupplier.contact_person}</span>}
                      {matchedSupplier.phone && <span>📞 {matchedSupplier.phone}</span>}
                      {matchedSupplier.email && <span>✉️ {matchedSupplier.email}</span>}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mt-4 text-xs font-mono">
                  <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Consolidated Units</span>
                    <span className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{group.totalUnits} Units</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] block">{group.tickets.length} Returns</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Total Claim Value</span>
                    <span className="text-lg font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{formatPeso(group.totalAmount)}</span>
                    <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] block">To Debit / Replace</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Items in Supplier Pool */}
              <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80 pt-3">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                  Consolidated Defective Lots:
                </span>
                <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                  {group.tickets.map((t) => (
                    <div 
                      key={t.id} 
                      className="p-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/80 flex items-center justify-between text-xs"
                    >
                      <div className="truncate mr-2">
                        <span className="font-mono text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-300 font-bold mr-1.5">{t.id}</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{t.sku} - {t.product_name}</span>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                          {t.quantity} pcs • {t.customer_name} • PO: {t.supplier_po_no || 'PO Unassigned'}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {t.status !== 'Buffer Replacement' && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleBufferDispatch(t)}
                          className="shrink-0 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-semibold bg-purple-100 hover:bg-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-600/20 dark:hover:bg-purple-600 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-200 dark:hover:text-white rounded-lg border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-500/40 transition-colors"
                          title="Allocate replacement from Inventory buffer"
                        >
                          Dispatch Buffer
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Action: Generate PO */}
              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                  PO: {group.tickets[0]?.supplier_po_no || 'None'}
                </span>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleGenerateSupplierPO(group.supplierName, group.tickets.map(t => t.id))}
                  className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl flex items-center space-x-1.5 shadow-md shadow-purple-600/20 transition-all"
                >
                  <FilePlus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Issue Supplier Return PO</span>
                </button>
              </div>

            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Live Supplier Directory Modal (610 Suppliers) */}
      {isSupplierModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 animate-in fade-in">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t sm:border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl w-full max-w-3xl max-h-[92dvh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 pb-safe">
            {/* Mobile bottom-sheet drag handle */}
            <div className="sm:hidden pt-2.5 pb-1 flex justify-center shrink-0">
              <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Building2 className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
                  Live Supplier Directory ({liveSuppliers.length > 0 ? liveSuppliers.length : 610} Vendors)
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Connected to <code className="font-mono text-purple-600">auto_po_supplier_contacts</code> • Search primary and secondary suppliers
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsSupplierModalOpen(false)}
                className="min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 font-bold transition-colors"
                aria-label="Close"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Search Bar */}
            <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/50">
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3" />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={supplierSearchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSupplierSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search vendor name, contact person, or payment terms (e.g. Banela, Munoz, Suy Sing, PDC)..."
                  className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500"
                  autoFocus
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Modal Supplier List */}
            <div className="p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 flex-1">
              {liveSuppliers
                .filter(s => {
                  if (!supplierSearchQuery.trim()) return true;
                  const q = supplierSearchQuery.toLowerCase();
                  return (
                    s.sheet_supplier_name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    s.full_company_name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    s.contact_person?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    s.terms?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                    s.phone?.includes(q)
                  );
                })
                .slice(0, 50)
                .map((sup) => (
                  <div
                    key={sup.id}
                    className="p-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 hover:border-purple-300 dark:hover:border-purple-800 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                          {sup.full_company_name || sup.sheet_supplier_name}
                        </span>
                        {sup.sheet_supplier_name && sup.sheet_supplier_name !== sup.full_company_name && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-purple-600 font-mono bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                            {sup.sheet_supplier_name}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {sup.terms && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-mono bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800">
                            {sup.terms}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-0.5">
                        {sup.contact_person && <span>👤 Contact: <b className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{sup.contact_person}</b></span>}
                        {sup.phone && <span>📞 Phone: <span className="font-mono">{sup.phone}</span></span>}
                        {sup.email && <span>✉️ Email: <span className="font-mono">{sup.email}</span></span>}
                      </div>
                      {sup.address && (
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                          📍 {sup.address}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        handleGenerateSupplierPO(sup.sheet_supplier_name || sup.full_company_name, []);
                        setIsSupplierModalOpen(false);
                      }}
                      className="shrink-0 px-3 py-1.5 bg-purple-50 hover:bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-950 dark:hover:bg-purple-900 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 font-bold text-[11px] rounded-xl border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 transition-colors"
                    >
                      Draft Return PO
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}
            </div>

            {/* Modal Footer */}
            <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-500">
              <span>Showing up to 50 matching suppliers</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsSupplierModalOpen(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold rounded-xl"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

const QUICK_AUTH_STORAGE_KEY = 'rma_quick_auth_admin';

const CUSTOMER_DISPOSITION_OPTIONS = [
  '1- Pending Triage',
  '2- Restock to Inventory',
  '3- Return to Vendor (RTV)',
  '4- Quarantine',
  '5- Scrap / Dispose',
  '6- Buffer Stock Exchange'
];

const SUPPLIER_DISPOSITION_OPTIONS = [
  '1 - Pending Vendor Pickup',
  '2 - In Transit to Vendor',
  '3 - Vendor Credit / AP Deduction Settled',
  '4 - Vendor Replacement Stock Received',
  '5 - Claim Rejected by Vendor'
];

const DISPOSITION_OPTIONS = [
  ...CUSTOMER_DISPOSITION_OPTIONS,
  ...SUPPLIER_DISPOSITION_OPTIONS
];

function normalizeDispositionOption(disp) {
  if (!disp) return '1- Pending Triage';
  const found = DISPOSITION_OPTIONS.find(opt => 
    opt.toLowerCase() === disp.toLowerCase() || 
    opt.replace(/^\d+-\s*/, '').toLowerCase() === disp.replace(/^\d+-\s*/, '').toLowerCase()
  );
  return found || disp;
}

/**
 * Enterprise Automatic Lifecycle Status Calculator
 * Lifecycle status is 100% computed automatically from triage disposition and financial records.
 */
export function computeAutomaticLifecycleStatus(disposition, hasCreditMemo = false, currentStatus = null) {
  if (hasCreditMemo) return 'credit_memo_issued';
  const disp = String(disposition || '').toLowerCase().trim();

  if (
    disp.includes('restock') || 
    disp.includes('accepted replacement') || 
    disp.includes('replacement stock received')
  ) {
    return 'restocked';
  }
  if (
    disp.includes('scrap') || 
    disp.includes('dispose') || 
    disp.includes('local destruction')
  ) {
    return 'scrapped';
  }
  if (disp.includes('buffer stock') || disp.includes('buffer replacement')) {
    return 'buffer_replacement_dispatched';
  }
  if (disp.includes('rejected') || disp.includes('invalid claim')) {
    return 'rejected';
  }
  if (disp.includes('deduction') || disp.includes('ap deduction') || disp.includes('vendor credit') || disp.includes('credit memo')) {
    return 'credit_memo_issued';
  }
  return 'under_inspection';
}

  const [adminSiNumber, setAdminSiNumber] = useState('');

  // Reclassify RMA Type between customer_inbound and supplier_outbound
  const handleToggleRmaType = async (newType) => {
    if (!report || isUpdatingType) return;
    const currentType = report.rma_type || 'customer_inbound';
    if (currentType === newType) return;

    setIsUpdatingType(true);

    try {

      const isPendingTriage = !currentDisp ||

          .then(({ data, error }) => {
            if (!error && Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 1) {
              setManifestItems(data.map((it, idx) => {

                const itSku = String(it.sku || it.code || '').trim();

      }
    } else {

    }
  }, [report]);

  const handleSaveTriage = async () => {
    if (!report) return;

    } finally {
      setIsSavingTriage(false);
    }
  };

  };

  const handleSaveManifestTriage = async () => {
    if (!report || !manifestItems.length) return;
    setIsSavingManifestTriage(true);
    try {
      const inspectorName = verifiedAdmin?.name || currentUser?.name || 'Warehouse Staff';
      const existingAudit = Array.isArray(report.audit_trail) ? [...report.audit_trail] : [];
      existingAudit.push({
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        stage: 'MANIFEST_TRIAGE',
        actor: inspectorName,
        note: `Manifest line-item triage completed for ${manifestItems.length} items by ${inspectorName}`
      });

      // 1. Update items in parent report
      const updatedReportRow = {
        ...report,
        items: manifestItems,
        inspected_by: inspectorName,
        inspected_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        audit_trail: existingAudit
      };

      const { error: repErr } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .update({
          items: manifestItems,
          inspected_by: inspectorName,

          audit_trail: existingAudit
        })
        .eq('id', report.id);

      if (repErr) {
        console.warn('Notice updating rma_reports with manifest triage:', repErr.message);
      }

      // 2. Update child rma_items records in Supabase if schema permits
      try {
        for (const item of manifestItems) {
          const itemUpdates = {};
          if (item.sku) itemUpdates.sku = item.sku;
          if (item.name) itemUpdates.name = item.name;
          if (Object.keys(itemUpdates).length > 0) {
            await supabase
              .from('rma_items')
              .update(itemUpdates)
              .eq('rma_report_id', report.id)
              .eq('barcode', item.barcode);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Notice updating rma_items table:', e?.message);
      }

      // 3. Update child rma_reports records if they exist
      try {
        for (const item of manifestItems) {
          await supabase
            .from('rma_reports')
            .update({
              condition_grade: item.condition_grade,
              warehouse_location: (item.warehouse_location || '').trim().toUpperCase(),
              disposition: item.disposition,
              status: computeAutomaticLifecycleStatus(item.disposition, false, null),
              inspected_by: inspectorName,
              inspected_at: new Date().toISOString()
            })
            .eq('parent_rma_id', report.id)
            .eq('barcode', item.barcode);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Notice updating child rma_reports:', e?.message);
      }

      setReport(updatedReportRow);
      setManifestTriageSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => setManifestTriageSuccess(false), 4000);

      if (onRefresh) onRefresh(updatedReportRow);
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-data-changed', {
        detail: { type: 'manifest-triage-updated', report: updatedReportRow }
      }));
    } catch (err) {
      alert(`Error saving manifest triage: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsSavingManifestTriage(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkStoreHandoverComplete = async () => {
    if (!report || isClosingHandover) return;
    setIsClosingHandover(true);
    try {
      const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
      const inspector = verifiedAdmin?.name || currentUser?.name || 'Warehouse Staff';
      const updates = {
        status: 'closed',
        notes: `${report.notes ? report.notes + ' | ' : ''}Store handover completed. Signed Buffer Replacement Slip received. Ticket closed.`,
        audit_trail: [
          ...(Array.isArray(report.audit_trail) ? report.audit_trail : []),
          {
            timestamp,
            stage: 'BUFFER_HANDOVER_COMPLETE',
            actor: inspector,
            note: 'Store handover confirmed: signed exchange slip received and ticket closed.'
          }
        ]
      };
      const { data: updated, error } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .update(updates)
        .eq('id', report.id)
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) throw error;
      const finalRep = updated || { ...report, ...updates };
      setReport(finalRep);
      setRmaStatus('closed');
      if (onRefresh) onRefresh(finalRep);
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-data-changed', {
        detail: { type: 'buffer-closed', rma: report.rma_number }
      }));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to close handover:', e);
      alert(`Failed to close handover: ${e.message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsClosingHandover(false);
    }
  };

  const totalSplitQty = Number(report?.quantity) || 0;
  const maxSplitVal = Math.max(1, totalSplitQty - 1);
  const derivedPart2Qty = Math.max(1, totalSplitQty - (parseInt(splitPart1Qty, 10) || 1));

  const handleSplitPart1Change = (val) => {
    if (val === '') {
      setSplitPart1Qty('');
      return;
    }
    const parsed = parseInt(val, 10);
    if (!isNaN(parsed)) {
      if (parsed > maxSplitVal) {
        setSplitPart1Qty(maxSplitVal);
      } else if (parsed < 1) {
        setSplitPart1Qty(1);
      } else {
        setSplitPart1Qty(parsed);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSplitPart2Change = (val) => {
    if (val === '') {
      setSplitPart1Qty(maxSplitVal);
      return;
    }
    const parsed = parseInt(val, 10);
    if (!isNaN(parsed)) {
      const clampedP2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(maxSplitVal, parsed));
      setSplitPart1Qty(totalSplitQty - clampedP2);
    }
  };

  const handleSplitPart1Blur = () => {
    const parsed = parseInt(splitPart1Qty, 10);
    if (isNaN(parsed) || parsed < 1) {
      setSplitPart1Qty(1);
    } else if (parsed > maxSplitVal) {
      setSplitPart1Qty(maxSplitVal);
    } else {
      setSplitPart1Qty(parsed);
    }
  };

  const stepSplitPart1 = (delta) => {
    const current = parseInt(splitPart1Qty, 10) || 1;
    const next = Math.max(1, Math.min(maxSplitVal, current + delta));
    setSplitPart1Qty(next);
  };

  const stepSplitPart2 = (delta) => {
    stepSplitPart1(-delta);
  };

  const handleSwapSplit = () => {
    const p1 = parseInt(splitPart1Qty, 10) || 1;
    const p2 = totalSplitQty - p1;
    if (p2 >= 1 && p2 <= maxSplitVal) {
      setSplitPart1Qty(p2);
    }
  };

  const handleExecuteSplit = async () => {
    if (!report || isExecutingSplit) return;
    const totalQty = Number(report.quantity) || 0;
    const p1Qty = parseInt(splitPart1Qty, 10);
    const p2Qty = totalQty - p1Qty;

    if (isNaN(p1Qty) || p1Qty < 1 || p2Qty < 1 || p1Qty + p2Qty !== totalQty) {
      alert(`Invalid split quantities. Part 1 must be between 1 and ${Math.max(1, totalQty - 1)}.`);
      return;
    }

    setIsExecutingSplit(true);
    try {
      const inspectorName = verifiedAdmin?.name || currentUser?.name || 'Warehouse Staff';

      // 1. Generate unique child RMA Number (e.g. RMA-2026-0005-96LJ-B)
      let childRmaNumber = `${report.rma_number}-B`;
      const { data: existingChild } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .select('rma_number')
        .eq('rma_number', childRmaNumber)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (existingChild) {
        childRmaNumber = `${report.rma_number}-C`;
        const { data: existingChildC } = await supabase
          .from('rma_reports')
          .select('rma_number')
          .eq('rma_number', childRmaNumber)
          .maybeSingle();
        if (existingChildC) {
          childRmaNumber = `${report.rma_number}-D`;
        }
      }

      const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();

      // 2. Insert new child ticket (Part 2)
      const childPayload = {
        rma_number: childRmaNumber,
        barcode: report.barcode,
        code: report.code,
        name: report.name,
        supplier_name: report.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment',
        price: report.price || 0,
        price_with_vat: report.price_with_vat || 0,
        unit_name: report.unit_name || 'pc',
        quantity: p2Qty,
        total_quantity: p2Qty,
        condition_grade: splitPart2Grade,
        disposition: splitPart2Disposition,
        warehouse_location: splitPart2Location ? splitPart2Location.trim().toUpperCase() : 'SCRAP-BIN',
        status: computeAutomaticLifecycleStatus(splitPart2Disposition, false, null),
        reason: splitPart2Reason || report.reason || 'Damaged packaging / Defective units',
        explanation: `Split from ${report.rma_number} (${p2Qty} of ${totalQty} units). Disposition: ${splitPart2Disposition}`,
        parent_rma_id: report.id,
        items: Array.isArray(report.items) && report.items.length > 0
          ? [{ ...report.items[0], quantity: p2Qty, reason: splitPart2Reason || report.reason }]
          : [],
        photos: report.photos || [],
        paperwork_photos: report.paperwork_photos || [],
        store_branch: report.store_branch,
        si_number: report.si_number,
        dr_number: report.dr_number,
        po_number: report.po_number,
        invoice_dr_number: report.invoice_dr_number,
        reporter_name: report.reporter_name,
        reporter_contact: report.reporter_contact,
        reported_by: report.reported_by,
        ae_name: report.ae_name,
        ae_email: report.ae_email,
        company: report.company,
        rma_type: report.rma_type || 'customer_inbound',
        inspected_by: inspectorName,
        inspected_at: timestamp,
        notes: `Split from parent ticket ${report.rma_number}. Triage: ${splitPart2Disposition}`,
        audit_trail: [
          {
            timestamp,
            stage: 'SPLIT_CREATED',
            actor: inspectorName,
            condition_grade: splitPart2Grade,
            disposition: splitPart2Disposition,
            note: `Created via partial split from ${report.rma_number} (${p2Qty} ${report.unit_name || 'pcs'})`
          }
        ]
      };

      const { data: newChild, error: childError } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .insert([childPayload])
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (childError) throw childError;

      // 3. Update Parent Ticket (Part 1)
      const existingAudit = Array.isArray(report.audit_trail) ? [...report.audit_trail] : [];
      const parentUpdates = {
        quantity: p1Qty,
        total_quantity: p1Qty,
        status: computeAutomaticLifecycleStatus(splitPart1Disposition, false, report.notes),
        condition_grade: splitPart1Grade,
        disposition: splitPart1Disposition,
        warehouse_location: splitPart1Location ? splitPart1Location.trim().toUpperCase() : report.warehouse_location || null,
        inspected_by: inspectorName,
        inspected_at: timestamp,
        items: Array.isArray(report.items) && report.items.length > 0
          ? report.items.map((it, idx) => idx === 0 ? { ...it, quantity: p1Qty } : it)
          : report.items,
        notes: `${report.notes ? report.notes + ' | ' : ''}Split: Kept ${p1Qty} units (${splitPart1Disposition}), split ${p2Qty} units to ${childRmaNumber} (${splitPart2Disposition})`,
        audit_trail: [
          ...existingAudit,
          {
            timestamp,
            stage: 'SPLIT_EXECUTED',
            actor: inspectorName,
            condition_grade: splitPart1Grade,
            disposition: splitPart1Disposition,
            note: `Split ticket: Kept ${p1Qty} units on ${report.rma_number}, created ${childRmaNumber} with ${p2Qty} units`
          }
        ]
      };

      const { data: updatedParent, error: parentError } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .update(parentUpdates)
        .eq('id', report.id)
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (parentError) throw parentError;

      // 4. Update local state
      const finalParent = updatedParent || { ...report, ...parentUpdates };
      setReport(finalParent);
      setConditionGrade(splitPart1Grade);
      setDisposition(normalizeDispositionOption(splitPart1Disposition));
      setWarehouseLocation(splitPart1Location || '');
      setIsSplitting(false);
      setSplitSuccessMessage(`Successfully split: Kept ${p1Qty} ${report.unit_name || 'pcs'} on this ticket (${splitPart1Disposition}), and created new ticket ${childRmaNumber} with ${p2Qty} ${report.unit_name || 'pcs'} (${splitPart2Disposition})!`);
      setTimeout(() => setSplitSuccessMessage(''), 10000);

      // 5. Notify parent to refresh lists and dispatch event (pass newChild so it immediately appears in UI)
      if (onRefresh) {
        onRefresh(finalParent, newChild);
      }
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-data-changed', { detail: { type: 'item-split', parentId: report.id, childId: newChild?.id } }));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to execute split:', err);
      alert(`Split failed: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsExecutingSplit(false);
    }
  };

  // Authentication & Verification State
  const [verifiedAdmin, setVerifiedAdmin] = useState(null);
  const [authStep, setAuthStep] = useState('email'); // 'email' | 'otp'
  const [emailInput, setEmailInput] = useState('');
  const [otpInput, setOtpInput] = useState('');
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState(0);
  const [isVerifying, setIsVerifying] = useState(false);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState(null);
  const [authSuccessMsg, setAuthSuccessMsg] = useState(null);

  // Sandbox Test Mode State: Strictly restricted to Super Admin
  const [isTestMode, setIsTestMode] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const user = authService.getCurrentUser();
      if (user?.role !== 'super_admin') return false;
      return typeof window !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true';
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleStorage = () => {
      try {
        const user = authService.getCurrentUser();
        if (user?.role === 'super_admin') {
          setIsTestMode(localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true');
        } else {
          setIsTestMode(false);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    };
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    window.addEventListener('rma-data-changed', handleStorage);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
      window.removeEventListener('rma-data-changed', handleStorage);
    };
  }, []);

  // Check if current logged-in user is already admin or super admin
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;

    if (currentUser && (currentUser.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser.role === 'admin')) {
      setVerifiedAdmin(currentUser);
      return;
    }

    // Check session storage cache for verified admin in THIS tab only (never localStorage)
    try {
      const cached = sessionStorage.getItem(QUICK_AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
      if (cached) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
        if (parsed && (parsed.role === 'super_admin' || parsed.role === 'admin')) {
          setVerifiedAdmin(parsed);
          return;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    setVerifiedAdmin(null);
    setAuthStep('email');
    setOtpInput('');
  }, [isOpen, currentUser]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (countdown <= 0) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setCountdown(prev => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : 0));
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [countdown]);

  // 1. Primary fetch when modal opens, rmaNumber changes, or manual retry requested
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !rmaNumber) {
      setReport(null);
      setReportError(null);
      setIsLoadingReport(false);
      setSyncAttempt(1);
      return;
    }

    let isMounted = true;
    const cleanRma = String(rmaNumber).trim();

    const findInReports = (list) => {
      if (!Array.isArray(list) || !cleanRma) return null;
      const target = cleanRma.toUpperCase();
      return list.find(r => (String(r.rma_number || '').toUpperCase() === target && !r.parent_rma_id) || String(r.id) === cleanRma)
          || list.find(r => String(r.rma_number || '').toUpperCase() === target);
    };

    // Try local list first for instant responsiveness
    const immediateMatch = findInReports(recentReportsList);
    if (immediateMatch) {
      setReport(immediateMatch);
      setIsLoadingReport(false);
      setReportError(null);
      return;
    }

    // Begin asynchronous polling loop (retry every 800ms up to 5 attempts)
    setIsLoadingReport(true);
    setReportError(null);
    setSyncAttempt(1);

    (async () => {
      const maxAttempts = 12;
      let foundRecord = null;

      for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        setSyncAttempt(attempt);

        // Check recentReportsList on each retry tick
        const tickMatch = findInReports(recentReportsList);
        if (tickMatch) {
          foundRecord = tickMatch;
          break;
        }

        // Query Supabase
        try {
          let query = supabase.from('rma_reports').select('*');
          if (/^\d+$/.test(cleanRma)) {
            query = query.or(`rma_number.ilike.${cleanRma},id.eq.${cleanRma}`);
          } else {
            query = query.ilike('rma_number', cleanRma);
          }

          const { data, error } = await query;
          if (!error && Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) {
            foundRecord = data.find(d => !d.parent_rma_id) || data[0];
            break;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn(`RMA sync attempt ${attempt} notice:`, e?.message);
        }

        // Delay 1000ms before next attempt if record not yet available
        if (attempt < maxAttempts) {
          await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
        }
      }

      if (!isMounted) return;

      if (foundRecord) {
        setReport(foundRecord);
        setIsLoadingReport(false);
        setReportError(null);
      } else {
        setIsLoadingReport(false);
        setReportError(`No return report found matching "${cleanRma}". The record may still be syncing to the cloud or the QR code may be invalid.`);
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [isOpen, rmaNumber, retryTrigger]);

  // 2. Silent background sync when recentReportsList updates (WITHOUT triggering loading spinners or unmounting UI)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !rmaNumber || !recentReportsList.length) return;
    const cleanRma = String(rmaNumber).trim().toUpperCase();
    const match = recentReportsList.find(
      r => (String(r.rma_number || '').toUpperCase() === cleanRma && !r.parent_rma_id) ||
           String(r.id) === cleanRma
    ) || recentReportsList.find(
      r => String(r.rma_number || '').toUpperCase() === cleanRma
    );
    if (match) {
      setReport(prev => {
        if (!prev) return match;
        // Do not downgrade an existing parent record to a child record
        if (!prev.parent_rma_id && match.parent_rma_id) return prev;
        if (
          prev.status !== match.status ||
          prev.disposition !== match.disposition ||
          prev.condition_grade !== match.condition_grade ||
          prev.warehouse_location !== match.warehouse_location ||
          prev.code !== match.code ||
          prev.name !== match.name ||
          prev.notes !== match.notes
        ) {
          return match;
        }
        return prev;
      });
    }
  }, [isOpen, rmaNumber, recentReportsList]);

  // Extract unique known suppliers for suggestion autocomplete
  const knownSuppliers = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set();
    (savedProductsList || []).forEach(p => {
      const s = (p.supplier_name || p.supplierName || '').trim();
      if (s && s !== 'Pending Assignment' && s !== 'Unassigned' && s !== 'Warehouse') {
        set.add(s);
      }
    });
    (recentReportsList || []).forEach(r => {
      const s = (r.supplier_name || '').trim();
      if (s && s !== 'Pending Assignment' && s !== 'Unassigned' && s !== 'Warehouse') {
        set.add(s);
      }
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [savedProductsList, recentReportsList]);

  // Synchronize AI-extracted or existing paperwork document details whenever report changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (report) {
      const meta = report.ai_document_metadata || {};
      setAdminSiNumber(report.si_number || meta.si_number || '');
      setAdminDrNumber(report.dr_number || report.invoice_dr_number || meta.dr_number || meta.invoice_dr_number || '');
      setAdminPoNumber(report.po_number || meta.po_number || '');
      setAdminSupplierName(report.supplier_name && report.supplier_name !== 'Pending Assignment' ? report.supplier_name : (meta.vendor_name || ''));
      setAdminStoreBranch(report.store_branch || meta.store_branch || '');
      setAdminExpiryDate(report.expiry_date || '');
      setAdminBatchLot(report.batch_lot_number || '');
      setIsEditingAiDetails(false);
    }
  }, [report?.id, report?.si_number, report?.dr_number, report?.po_number, report?.invoice_dr_number, report?.supplier_name, report?.store_branch, report?.expiry_date, report?.batch_lot_number]);

  // Step 1: Request OTP for authorized company admin
  const handleRequestOtp = async (e) => {
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    const cleanEmail = emailInput.trim().toLowerCase();
    setAuthError(null);
    setAuthSuccessMsg(null);

    if (!cleanEmail) {
      setAuthError('Please enter your company email address.');
      return;
    }

    if (countdown > 0) return;

    setIsVerifying(true);

    try {
      // 1. Verify that email belongs to an active employee
      const employees = await authService.getEmployees();
      const emp = employees.find(e => e.email?.toLowerCase() === cleanEmail);

      if (!emp) {
        throw new Error(`Access Denied: "${cleanEmail}" is not recognized as an authorized company account. Public customers and unverified users cannot access Quick Actions.`);
      }

      if (emp.is_active === false) {
        throw new Error(`Access Denied: The employee account (${cleanEmail}) is marked as Resigned or Inactive.`);
      }

      if (emp.role !== 'super_admin' && emp.role !== 'admin') {
        throw new Error(`Permission Restricted: Account "${cleanEmail}" has role "${emp.role}". Only Admin and Super Admin roles can operate Return Quick Actions.`);
      }

      // 2. Request OTP via authService
      const res = await authService.requestOtp(cleanEmail);
      setAuthStep('otp');
      setCountdown(60);
      setAuthSuccessMsg(`Verification code sent to ${cleanEmail}. Please enter the 6-digit OTP code below.`);
      if (res?.rateLimited) {
        setAuthError(res.message);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setAuthError(err.message || 'Failed to dispatch OTP code. Please check your email.');
    } finally {
      setIsVerifying(false);
    }
  };

  // Step 2: Verify 6-digit OTP Code
  const handleVerifyOtp = async (e) => {
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    const cleanEmail = emailInput.trim().toLowerCase();
    const cleanOtp = otpInput.trim();
    setAuthError(null);

    if (!cleanOtp) {
      setAuthError('Please enter the 6-digit OTP code.');
      return;
    }

    setIsVerifying(true);

    try {
      const res = await authService.verifyOtp(cleanEmail, cleanOtp);
      if (res?.success && res.user) {
        if (res.user.role !== 'admin' && res.user.role !== 'super_admin') {
          throw new Error('Access Denied: Only Admin and Super Admin roles can access Quick Actions.');
        }

        const verified = {
          id: res.user.id,
          name: res.user.name,
          email: res.user.email,
          role: res.user.role,
          department: res.user.department || 'Finance'
        };

        setVerifiedAdmin(verified);
        sessionStorage.setItem(QUICK_AUTH_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(verified));
        setAuthSuccessMsg(`Welcome, ${verified.name}! Admin Quick Actions unlocked.`);
        if (onAdminVerified) {
          onAdminVerified(verified);
        }
      } else {
        throw new Error('Verification failed. Please check the code.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setAuthError(err.message || 'Invalid or expired OTP code.');
    } finally {
      setIsVerifying(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSwitchAccount = () => {
    setVerifiedAdmin(null);
    sessionStorage.removeItem(QUICK_AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
    setAuthStep('email');
    setOtpInput('');
    setAuthError(null);
    setAuthSuccessMsg(null);
  };

  const handleSaveAiDetails = async () => {
    if (!report?.id) return;
    setIsSavingAiDetails(true);
    try {
      const cleanSi = adminSiNumber.trim();
      const cleanDr = adminDrNumber.trim();
      const cleanPo = adminPoNumber.trim();
      const primaryDoc = cleanDr || cleanSi || cleanPo || null;
      const cleanBranch = adminStoreBranch.trim();
      const cleanSupplier = adminSupplierName.trim();
      const cleanLot = adminBatchLot.trim();
      const cleanExpiry = adminExpiryDate || null;

      // 1. Prepare updates for main rma_reports row
      const updates = {
        si_number: cleanSi || null,
        dr_number: cleanDr || null,
        po_number: cleanPo || null,
        invoice_dr_number: primaryDoc,
        store_branch: cleanBranch || null,
        expiry_date: cleanExpiry,
        batch_lot_number: cleanLot || null
      };

      if (cleanSupplier) {
        updates.supplier_name = cleanSupplier;
      }

      // If multi-item batch manifest, also update child items inside the manifest JSON
      let updatedItems = report.items;
      if (Array.isArray(report.items) && report.items.length > 0) {
        updatedItems = report.items.map(it => ({
          ...it,
          ...(cleanSupplier ? { supplier_name: cleanSupplier } : {}),
          ...(cleanExpiry ? { expiry_date: cleanExpiry } : {})
        }));
        updates.items = updatedItems;
      }

      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('rma_reports')
        .update(updates)
        .eq('id', report.id);

      if (error) {
        console.warn('Initial update failed, falling back to core columns:', error.message);
        const fallback = { ...updates };
        if (error.message.includes('si_number')) delete fallback.si_number;
        if (error.message.includes('dr_number')) delete fallback.dr_number;
        if (error.message.includes('po_number')) delete fallback.po_number;
        const { error: fbErr } = await supabase.from('rma_reports').update(fallback).eq('id', report.id);
        if (fbErr) throw fbErr;
      }

      // 2. Also update child records in rma_reports table for this parent
      if (report.id && cleanSupplier) {
        try {
          await supabase
            .from('rma_reports')
            .update({ supplier_name: cleanSupplier })
            .eq('parent_rma_id', report.id);
        } catch { }
      }

      // 3. Optimistically update local report state
      const updatedReport = {
        ...report,
        si_number: cleanSi || null,
        dr_number: cleanDr || null,
        po_number: cleanPo || null,
        invoice_dr_number: primaryDoc,
        store_branch: cleanBranch || null,
        store: cleanBranch || null,
        supplier_name: cleanSupplier || report.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment',
        supplier: cleanSupplier || report.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment',
        expiry_date: cleanExpiry,
        batch_lot_number: cleanLot || null,
        ...(updatedItems ? { items: updatedItems } : {})
      };

      setReport(updatedReport);
      setIsEditingAiDetails(false);

      // 4. Trigger instant parent refresh across Customer Hub & Supplier Hub
      if (typeof onRefresh === 'function') {
        onRefresh(updatedReport);
      }
      if (typeof onReportUpdated === 'function') {
        onReportUpdated(updatedReport);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to update commercial document and AI details:', e);
      alert('Failed to save updated commercial documents: ' + (e?.message || e));
    } finally {
      setIsSavingAiDetails(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Derive catalog & memo status for this report
  const cleanBarcode = String(report?.barcode || '').trim();
  const matchedProduct = cleanBarcode 
    ? savedProductsList.find(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode).trim() === cleanBarcode) 
    : null;
  const isSavedInProducts = Boolean(matchedProduct && matchedProduct.is_verified !== false);

  const existingMemo = report
    ? creditMemosList.find(m => m.rma_number === report?.rma_number || String(m.report_id) === String(report?.id))
    : null;

  const hasLinkedCreditMemo = Boolean(
    existingMemo ||
    (report?.rma_number && creditMemosList.some(m => m.rma_number === report?.rma_number))
  );

  const isMultiItemManifest = Boolean(
    report?.is_parent ||
    manifestItems.length > 1 ||
    (Array.isArray(report?.items) && report.items.length > 1) ||
    (typeof report?.name === 'string' && report.name.toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest'))
  );

  const isSkuAssigned = isMultiItemManifest ? true : hasAssignedSku(report, savedProductsList);

  // Enterprise Multi-Tier Financial Threshold Rule:
  // If total claim exceeds ₱10,000, Super Admin authorization is required to activate Credit Memo button
  const itemQty = Number(report?.quantity) || 1;
  const itemUnitPrice = Number(report?.price_with_vat) || Number(report?.price) || Number(matchedProduct?.price_with_vat) || Number(matchedProduct?.price) || 0;
  const totalClaimValue = itemQty * itemUnitPrice;
  const isHighValueClaim = totalClaimValue > 10000;
  const isSuperAdmin = (verifiedAdmin?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'super_admin');
  const canIssueCreditMemo = !isHighValueClaim || isSuperAdmin;

  // Photos
  const photoList = report?.photo_urls 
    ? (Array.isArray(report.photo_urls) ? report.photo_urls : [report.photo_urls])
    : (report?.photo_url ? [report.photo_url] : []);

  const reporterName = report?.reporter_name || report?.reported_by || report?.customer_name || 'Staff / Customer';
  const reporterContact = report?.reporter_contact || report?.reporter_phone || report?.phone || '';

  // Paperwork & AI Verification Details
  const paperworkList = report?.paperwork_photos
    ? (Array.isArray(report.paperwork_photos) ? report.paperwork_photos : [report.paperwork_photos])
    : [];
  const aiMetadata = report?.ai_document_metadata || null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-950/75 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden my-0 sm:my-auto max-h-[92dvh] sm:max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col">
        {/* Mobile Drag Indicator */}
        <div className="bottom-sheet-handle sm:hidden" />
        
        {/* Header Bar */}
        <div className="relative shrink-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-700 via-indigo-700 to-slate-900 px-4 sm:px-6 py-3.5 sm:py-4 text-white">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="p-2 bg-white/10 rounded-xl backdrop-blur-xs border border-white/20 shrink-0">
                <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-300" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-lg font-black tracking-tight truncate">
                    RMA Quick Processing
                  </h3>
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline-flex text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white/20 text-white font-bold shrink-0">
                    Box QR Action
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs text-blue-100 font-medium truncate">
                  Instant intake, SKU assignment & Credit Memo
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 text-white/80 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0"
              title="Close Quick Actions"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>



        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain">

          {/* 1. Loading State with Asynchronous Sync Counter */}
          {isLoadingReport && !report && (
            <div className="py-8 text-center space-y-3">
              <RefreshCw className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-600 animate-spin mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                Finalizing return submission sync... Attempt {syncAttempt} of 12
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Polling local buffer and Supabase database for return authorization <span className="font-mono font-bold text-blue-600">{rmaNumber}</span>...
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 2. Error Loading Report with Manual Retry Option */}
          {reportError && !report && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/50 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 rounded-2xl flex items-start gap-3 text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs flex-1">
                <div className="font-bold">Return Record Not Found</div>
                <p className="leading-relaxed">{reportError}</p>
                <div className="pt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setReportError(null);
                      setRetryTrigger(prev => prev + 1);
                    }}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl font-bold transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Retry Sync</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onClose}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 rounded-xl font-bold hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Close Window
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 3. Report Loaded: Display Summary Card */}
          {report && (
            <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-3">
              {/* TOP SEGMENTED SWITCHER: Customer Inbound vs Supplier Outbound */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    Logistics Stream Classification:
                  </span>
                  <span className={`text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                    report.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound'
                      ? 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/70 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800'
                      : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800'
                  }`}>
                    {report.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' ? 'Outbound Vendor RTV' : 'Inbound Customer RMA'}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-slate-900 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-300/80 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between gap-1 shadow-2xs">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={isUpdatingType}
                    onClick={() => handleToggleRmaType('customer_inbound')}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      (report.rma_type === 'customer_inbound' || !report.rma_type)
                        ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                        : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                    <span>📥 Customer Return (Inbound)</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={isUpdatingType}
                    onClick={() => handleToggleRmaType('supplier_outbound')}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 px-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      report.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound'
                        ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-xs'
                        : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                    <span>📤 Supplier Claim (Outbound / RTV)</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {typeFeedback && (
                <div className="p-2 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 flex items-center gap-1.5 animate-in fade-in">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                  <span>{typeFeedback}</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 block">
                    Scanned Return Authorization
                  </span>
                  <div className="text-lg font-black font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>{report.rma_number || rmaNumber}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {onViewReportQR && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onViewReportQR(report)}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    title="Print Box QR Sticker"
                  >
                    <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                    <span>Print QR Sticker</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Product Info Grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Item Barcode</span>
                  <div className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">
                    {report.barcode || 'N/A'}
                  </div>
                  {matchedProduct?.code && (
                    <div className="font-mono text-[11px] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
                      SKU: {matchedProduct.code}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Product Name</span>
                  <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate" title={report.name || report.product_name}>
                    {matchedProduct?.name || report.name || report.product_name || `Barcode ${report.barcode}`}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Defect / Reason</span>
                  <span className="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 text-[10px] font-bold">
                    {report.reason || 'Damaged'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-400 block">Reported By</span>
                  <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                    {reporterName}
                  </div>
                  {reporterContact && (
                    <div className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                      {reporterContact}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* CONTEXTUAL STREAM HIGHLIGHT: Customer Inbound vs Supplier Outbound */}
              {report.rma_type === 'supplier_outbound' ? (
                <div className="p-3 bg-purple-50/70 dark:bg-purple-950/30 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 rounded-xl space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200 font-black">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide">
                      <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
                      <span>Supplier Outbound Return (RTV Recovery)</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/60 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
                      Vendor Chargeback
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-[11px] pt-1">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Master Supplier</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate block">{report.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Warehouse Bin</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">{report.warehouse_location || 'DOCK'}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Batch / Lot #</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">{report.batch_lot_number || 'N/A'}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Total Debit Value</span>
                      <strong className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono font-black">₱{totalClaimValue.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/70 dark:bg-blue-950/30 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-xl space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 font-black">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide">
                      <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                      <span>Customer Inbound Return (Credit Processing)</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
                      Customer Credit
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-[11px] pt-1">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Store / Branch</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate block">{report.store_branch || 'Store/Branch Unassigned'}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Invoice / DR #</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">{report.invoice_dr_number || report.dr_number || report.si_number || 'None'}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Customer AE</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate block">{report.ae_name || 'Unassigned'}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block uppercase font-bold">Credit Memo</span>
                      <strong className={existingMemo ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono' : 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold'}>
                        {existingMemo ? `✓ ${existingMemo.credit_memo_number || 'Issued'}` : 'Pending Issuance'}
                      </strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Manifest Items List if Batch Manifest */}
              {Boolean(report?.is_parent || (Array.isArray(report.items) && report.items.length > 1)) && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl space-y-2 text-xs">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 uppercase tracking-wide text-[10px]">
                      <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                      <span>Multi-Item Return Manifest ({report.items.length} Line Items)</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-black text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                      Total: {report.total_quantity || report.items.reduce((s, it) => s + (Number(it.quantity) || 1), 0)} Units
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto">
                    {report.items.map((it, idx) => (
                      <div key={idx} className="p-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <div className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">
                            {it.name || it.productName}
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                            <span>BC: {it.barcode}</span>
                            <span>•</span>
                            {(() => {
                              const itBarcode = String(it.barcode || '').trim();
                              const rawSku = String(it.code || it.sku || '').trim();
                              const isSkuValid = rawSku && rawSku !== itBarcode && !rawSku.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting');
                              return isSkuValid ? (
                                <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">SKU: {rawSku}</span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold">SKU: Awaiting SKU</span>
                              );
                            })()}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono font-black text-[11px]">
                            {it.quantity} {it.unit_name || it.unit || 'pc'}
                          </span>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-bold truncate max-w-[120px]">
                            {it.reason}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Proof Photos Thumbnail */}
              {photoList.length > 0 && (
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-slate-400">Proof Photo:</span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onOpenLightbox && onOpenLightbox({
                      images: photoList,
                      initialIndex: 0,
                      url: photoList[0],
                      title: report.name || `Return ${report.rma_number}`,
                      subtitle: `RMA #${report.rma_number} • Reported by ${reporterName}`
                    })}
                    className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 hover:scale-105 shadow-xs transition-transform cursor-zoom-in inline-block"
                    title="Click to zoom proof photo"
                  >
                    <img src={photoList[0]} alt="Proof" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Direct Google Drive Folder Link */}
