                        <h5 className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                          Supplier Debit Claim / AP Deduction
                        </h5>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          Total Vendor Claim: ₱{totalClaimValue.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} ({itemQty} unit{itemQty > 1 ? 's' : ''})
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0 bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/70 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800">
                      Outbound RTV Claim
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="p-3 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 rounded-xl border border-purple-100 dark:border-purple-900/40 text-xs space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                      <span>Vendor / Master Supplier:</span>
                      <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono">{report?.supplier || report?.vendor || 'Master Supplier'}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                      <span>RTV Outbound Reference:</span>
                      <strong className="text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-mono">{report?.rma_number}</strong>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                      <span>Triage Disposition:</span>
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{disposition || 'Pending Vendor Pickup'}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-0.5">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (onPrintThermalLabel) onPrintThermalLabel(report);
                        else setIsThermalLabelOpen(true);
                      }}
                      className="py-2.5 px-3 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 active:bg-purple-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
                    >
                      <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Print RTV Label</span>
                    </button>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => {
                        const win = window.open('', '_blank');
                        if (win) {
                          win.document.write(`
                            <html>
                              <head>
                                <title>Supplier Debit Claim - ${report?.rma_number}</title>
                                <style>
                                  body { font-family: monospace; padding: 24px; color: #111; }
                                  h2 { margin: 0 0 8px 0; }
                                  table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 16px; }
                                  th, td { border: 1px solid #ccc; padding: 8px; text-align: left; }
                                  .header { border-bottom: 2px solid #333; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
                                </style>
                              </head>
                              <body>
                                <div class="header">
                                  <h2>PINGCON MARKETING - SUPPLIER DEBIT MEMORANDUM</h2>
                                  <div>RTV Reference: <strong>${report?.rma_number}</strong></div>
                                  <div>Supplier: <strong>${report?.supplier || 'Master Vendor'}</strong></div>
                                  <div>Date: <strong>${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}</strong></div>
                                </div>
                                <p>This document authorizes Accounts Payable deduction / supplier debit for return to vendor claim.</p>
                                <table>
                                  <tr><th>Item</th><th>Barcode / SKU</th><th>Qty</th><th>Unit Price</th><th>Total Deduction</th></tr>
                                  <tr>
                                    <td>${report?.name || 'Product'}</td>
                                    <td>${report?.code || report?.sku || report?.barcode || 'N/A'}</td>
                                    <td>${itemQty}</td>
                                    <td>₱${Number(report?.price || 0).toFixed(2)}</td>
                                    <td><strong>₱${totalClaimValue.toFixed(2)}</strong></td>
                                  </tr>
                                </table>
                                <div style="margin-top: 30px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between;">
                                  <div>Authorized by: _______________________</div>
                                  <div>Vendor Received by: _______________________</div>
                                </div>
                                <script>window.print();</script>
                              </body>
                            </html>
                          `);
                          win.document.close();
                        }
                      }}
                      className="py-2.5 px-3 bg-purple-100 hover:bg-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-950/70 dark:hover:bg-purple-900/70 text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Receipt className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300" />
                      <span>Print Debit Voucher</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/80 rounded-2xl shadow-xs space-y-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className={`p-2 rounded-xl ${existingMemo ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:text-emerald-400'}`}>
                        <Receipt className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <h5 className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                          {existingMemo ? `Credit Memo: ${existingMemo.credit_memo_number}` : 'Finance Credit Memorandum'}
                        </h5>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                          {existingMemo
                            ? `₱${Number(existingMemo.credit_amount || existingMemo.amount || 0).toFixed(2)} credited by ${existingMemo.credit_issued_by || 'Finance'}`
                            : `Total Claim: ₱${totalClaimValue.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })} (${itemQty} unit${itemQty > 1 ? 's' : ''})`}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0 ${
                      existingMemo
                        ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300'
                        : isHighValueClaim
                          ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300'
                          : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300'
                    }`}>
                      {existingMemo ? 'Issued' : isHighValueClaim ? 'High-Value Claim' : 'Standard Claim'}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Financial Safety Rule Notice (> ₱10,000) */}
                  {isHighValueClaim && !existingMemo && (
                    <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl border text-xs flex items-start gap-2.5 ${
                      isSuperAdmin 
                        ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200'
                        : 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/50 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200'
                    }`}>
                      {isSuperAdmin ? (
                        <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      ) : (
                        <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                      )}
                      <div className="space-y-0.5">
                        <div className="font-black">
                          {isSuperAdmin 
                            ? `👑 Super Admin Approved (> ₱10,000 Claim)`
                            : `🔒 Financial Safety Lock (Claim > ₱10,000)`}
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] opacity-90">
                          {isSuperAdmin
                            ? `Authorized by ${verifiedAdmin?.name || currentUser?.name} (Super Admin). Credit Memo issuance enabled.`
                            : `Total claim is ₱${totalClaimValue.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}, exceeding the ₱10,000 threshold. Only a Super Admin can issue this credit memo.`}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {isMultiItemManifest ? (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 shadow-2xs">
                      <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="font-semibold text-[11px]">
                        ℹ️ Multi-Item Manifest: Finance Credit Memos are issued individually per line item in the Customer RMA Hub drawer table.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ) : !existingMemo ? (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={!canIssueCreditMemo}
                      onClick={() => {
                        if (canIssueCreditMemo && onOpenCreditMemo && report) {
                          onOpenCreditMemo(report);
                        }
                      }}
                      className={`w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs font-extrabold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm transition-all ${
                        canIssueCreditMemo
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 active:bg-emerald-800 text-white cursor-pointer'
                          : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed opacity-70'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {canIssueCreditMemo ? (
                        <>
                          <Receipt className="w-4 h-4" />
                          <span>+ Issue Credit Memo</span>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
                          <span>Locked: Super Admin Approval Required</span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onViewCreditMemoVoucher && onViewCreditMemoVoucher(existingMemo)}
                        className="py-2 px-3 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Print CM Voucher</span>
                      </button>

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => onOpenCreditMemo && onOpenCreditMemo(report, existingMemo)}
                        className="py-2 px-3 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Edit CM</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* ENTERPRISE AUDIT TRAIL & LIFECYCLE TIMELINE */}
              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                <RMATimelineAudit report={report} creditMemosList={creditMemosList} />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="shrink-0 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 px-4 sm:px-6 py-3 pb-safe border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
          <span className="text-slate-500 font-mono text-[11px] truncate pr-2">
            {report?.rma_number || rmaNumber || 'RMA Portal'}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="touch-target px-5 py-2 bg-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-xl font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            Done / Close
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* 4x6" Thermal Box Label Modal */}
      {isThermalLabelOpen && report && (
        <ThermalBoxLabelModal
          isOpen={isThermalLabelOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsThermalLabelOpen(false)}
          report={report}
          currentUser={verifiedAdmin || currentUser}
        />
      )}

      {/* Buffer Stock Replacement Dispatch Slip Modal */}
      {isBufferSlipOpen && report && (
        <BufferExchangeSlipModal
          isOpen={isBufferSlipOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsBufferSlipOpen(false)}
          report={report}
          hasCreditMemo={hasLinkedCreditMemo}
          onDispatched={(updatedReport) => {
            setReport(updatedReport);
            setRmaStatus('buffer_replacement_dispatched');
            setDisposition('6- Buffer Stock Exchange');
            if (onRefresh) {
              onRefresh(updatedReport);
            }
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { QRCodeSVG } from 'qrcode.react';
import { 
  X, 
  Printer, 
  Download, 
  FileDown, 
  Check, 
  QrCode, 
  Building2, 
  Sparkles,
  RefreshCw
} from 'lucide-react';
import { downloadQrCodePng, downloadBoxStickerPng, printBoxSticker } from '../utils/qrDownload';

export default function ReturnQRModal({ isOpen, onClose, report, onOpenQuickAction }) {
  const [downloadingType, setDownloadingType] = useState(null); // 'qr' | 'label' | null
  const [downloadNotice, setDownloadNotice] = useState(null);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen || !report) return null;

  const rmaNumber = report.rma_number || report.rmaNumber || report.id || 'N/A';
  const barcode = report.barcode || 'N/A';
  const sku = report.code || report.sku || '';
  const itemName = report.name || report.product_name || report.productName || `Barcode ${barcode}`;
  const quantity = report.quantity || 1;
  const unit = report.unit_name || report.unit || 'pc';
  const supplier = report.supplier_name || report.supplier || 'Warehouse';
  const reason = report.reason || report.defect_category || 'Damaged / Return';
  const reporter = report.reporter_name || report.reported_by || 'Staff';
  const reporterContact = report.reporter_contact || report.reporter_phone || report.phone || (report.reported_by && report.reported_by.includes('(') ? report.reported_by.replace(/.*\((.*)\).*/, '$1') : '') || 'N/A';
  const storeBranch = report.store_branch || report.store || '';
  const manifestItems = Array.isArray(report.items) ? report.items : [];
  const isManifest = manifestItems.length > 1 || (report.total_items && report.total_items > 1);
  const totalItems = report.total_items || (manifestItems.length > 0 ? manifestItems.length : 1);
  const totalQuantity = report.total_quantity || (manifestItems.length > 0 ? manifestItems.reduce((acc, it) => acc + (Number(it.quantity) || 1), 0) : quantity);
  const createdDateObj = new Date(report.created_at || Date.now());
  const dateFormatted = createdDateObj.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric'
  });
  const timeFormatted = createdDateObj.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit'
  });
  const dateTimeFormatted = `${dateFormatted} • ${timeFormatted}`;

  // Clean RMA URL payload: when scanned by smartphone camera or barcode gun, opens RMA Quick Action
  const qrPayload = typeof window !== 'undefined'
    ? `${window.location.origin}/?rma=${encodeURIComponent(rmaNumber)}&rep=${encodeURIComponent(reporter)}&contact=${encodeURIComponent(reporterContact)}&dt=${encodeURIComponent(dateTimeFormatted)}`
    : rmaNumber;

  const handlePrint = async () => {
    setIsPrinting(true);
    try {
      await printBoxSticker({
        svgElementOrId: 'rma-sticker-qr-svg',
        rmaNumber,
        supplier,
        itemName,
        barcode,
        sku,
        quantity,
        unit,
        reason,
        reporter,
        reporterContact,
        dateFormatted: dateTimeFormatted,
        storeBranch,
        totalItems,
        totalQuantity,
        items: manifestItems,
        documentTitle: `RMA-Verification-Label-${rmaNumber}`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to print sticker directly:', err);
      window.print();
    } finally {
      setIsPrinting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadQrOnly = async () => {
    try {
      setDownloadingType('qr');
      setDownloadNotice(null);
      await downloadQrCodePng({
        svgElementOrId: 'rma-sticker-qr-svg',
        rmaNumber,
        productName: itemName,
        barcode,
        reporter,
        reporterContact,
        dateFormatted: dateTimeFormatted
      });
      setDownloadNotice('QR Code downloaded successfully!');
      setTimeout(() => setDownloadNotice(null), 3500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to download QR code:', err);
      alert('Unable to download QR code. Please try again or use Print Sticker.');
    } finally {
      setDownloadingType(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadFullLabel = async () => {
    try {
      setDownloadingType('label');
      setDownloadNotice(null);
      await downloadBoxStickerPng({
        svgElementOrId: 'rma-sticker-qr-svg',
        rmaNumber,
        supplier,
        itemName,
        barcode,
        sku,
        quantity,
        unit,
        reason,
        reporter,
        reporterContact,
        dateFormatted: dateTimeFormatted,
        storeBranch,
        totalItems,
        totalQuantity,
        items: manifestItems
      });
      setDownloadNotice('Box Sticker image downloaded!');
      setTimeout(() => setDownloadNotice(null), 3500);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Failed to download label:', err);
      alert('Unable to download label image. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setDownloadingType(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-6 md:p-8 bg-slate-950/75 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div 
        id="rma-qr-box-sticker-wrapper"
        className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] sm:max-h-[85vh] my-0 sm:my-auto"
      >
        {/* Mobile Drag Indicator */}
        <div className="bottom-sheet-handle sm:hidden" />

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 sm:px-8 py-5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shrink-0 no-print">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5 min-w-0 pr-2">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 shrink-0">
              <QrCode className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm sm:text-base truncate">

              </h3>

            className="p-2 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 touch-target"
            aria-label="Close"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Feedback Alert if just downloaded */}
        {downloadNotice && (
          <div className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 border-b border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in shrink-0">

          {/* Action Buttons Grid */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">

              onClick={handleDownloadFullLabel}

              type="button"
              className="touch-target px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
              title="Download entire verification box sticker as PNG"
            >
              {downloadingType === 'label' ? (
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
              ) : (
                <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
              )}
              <span className="truncate">Save Sticker</span>
            </button>

            {/* 3. Print Sticker Button */}
            <button
              onClick={handlePrint}
              disabled={isPrinting}
              type="button"
              className="touch-target px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-black transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-blue-600/25 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-75"
              title="Print high-resolution official sticker label"
            >
              {isPrinting ? <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />}
              <span className="truncate">{isPrinting ? 'Preparing Label...' : 'Print Label'}</span>
            </button>

            {/* 4. Quick Actions / Close */}
            {onOpenQuickAction ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  onClose();
                  onOpenQuickAction(rmaNumber);
                }}
                className="touch-target px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/70 hover:bg-amber-100 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                title="Open Quick Processing Actions for this RMA"
              >
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
                <span className="truncate">Quick Actions</span>
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                type="button"
                className="touch-target px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            )}

          </div>

          <p className="text-[10px] text-center text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hidden sm:block">
            Standard label sizing for warehouse intake stickers, mobile downloads, and thermal printers.
          </p>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  X,
