--- START FILE: src/components/RMATimelineAudit.jsx ---
import React from 'react';
import { 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Clock, 
  Tag, 
  Receipt, 
  MapPin, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  AlertTriangle,
  User,
  Truck,
  Box,
  Layers
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function RMATimelineAudit({ 
  report, 
  creditMemosList = [] 
}) {
  if (!report) return null;

  // Find linked credit memo if any
  const linkedCM = creditMemosList.find(cm => 
    cm.rma_number === report.rma_number || String(cm.report_id) === String(report.id)
  );

  // Synthesize chronological milestones
  const events = [];

  // Milestone 1: Dock Receiving / Scan
  events.push({
    id: 'intake',
    title: 'Received & Logged at Dock',
    timestamp: report.created_at,
    actor: report.reported_by || report.reporter_name || 'Reporter',
    icon: Box,
    color: 'bg-blue-500 text-white',
    details: `Product: ${report.name} • Barcode: ${report.barcode} • Qty: ${report.quantity || 1} ${report.unit_name || 'pc'}`,
    badge: 'STAGE 1: INTAKE'
  });

  // Milestone 2: SKU Catalog Assignment
  if (report.code || report.sku) {
    events.push({
      id: 'sku',
      title: `SKU Assigned: ${report.code || report.sku}`,
      timestamp: report.updated_at || report.created_at,
      actor: report.inspected_by || 'Admin / Quick Process',
      icon: Tag,
      color: 'bg-indigo-500 text-white',
      details: `Matched to catalog • Supplier: ${report.supplier_name || 'Savemore'} • Unit Price: ₱${Number(report.price || 0).toFixed(2)}`,
      badge: 'STAGE 2: CATALOG'
    });
  }

  // Milestone 3: Warehouse Triage & Inspection
  if (report.condition_grade || report.disposition || report.warehouse_location) {
    events.push({
      id: 'triage',
      title: `Physical Triage: ${report.disposition || 'Triaged'}`,
      timestamp: report.inspected_at || report.updated_at || report.created_at,
      actor: report.inspected_by || 'Warehouse Supervisor',
      icon: Layers,
      color: 'bg-amber-500 text-white',
      details: `Condition: ${report.condition_grade || 'Graded'} • Bin: ${report.warehouse_location || 'Pending Assignment'}`,
      badge: 'STAGE 3: TRIAGE'
    });
  }

  // Milestone 4: Finance Credit Memo Issuance
  if (linkedCM) {
    events.push({
      id: 'credit_memo',
      title: `Credit Memo Issued: #${linkedCM.credit_memo_number}`,
      timestamp: linkedCM.credit_issued_at || linkedCM.created_at,
      actor: linkedCM.credit_issued_by || 'Finance Lead',
      icon: Receipt,
      color: 'bg-emerald-500 text-white',
      details: `Approved Credit Amount: ₱${Number(linkedCM.credit_amount || 0).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })} • Pull-Out Ref: ${linkedCM.pull_out_ref}`,
      badge: 'STAGE 4: FINANCE'
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1">
        <h4 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
          RMA Audit Trail & Lifecycle Timeline
        </h4>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500">
          {events.length} Milestones Recorded
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="relative pl-6 space-y-4 before:absolute before:left-2.5 before:top-2 before:bottom-2 before:w-0.5 before:bg-slate-200 dark:before:bg-slate-800">
        {events.map((evt, idx) => {
          const IconComp = evt.icon;
          const formattedDate = evt.timestamp 
            ? new Date(evt.timestamp).toLocaleString('en-US', {
                month: 'short',
                day: 'numeric',
                year: 'numeric',
                hour: '2-digit',
                minute: '2-digit'
              })
            : 'Recent';

          return (
            <div key={evt.id || idx} className="relative group">
              {/* Dot Icon */}
              <div className={`absolute -left-6 top-0.5 w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black shadow-xs ${evt.color}`}>
                <IconComp className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
              </div>

              {/* Event Content */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-850 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl space-y-1">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-1">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-200/60 dark:bg-slate-700/60 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                    {evt.badge}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                    {formattedDate}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  {evt.title}
                </div>

                <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                  {evt.details}
                </div>

                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 pt-0.5 border-t border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-700/60 flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                  <User className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span>Actor: <strong>{evt.actor}</strong></span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/RMATimelineAudit.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/SavedProductsTab.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Package, 
  Search, 
  Plus, 
  Edit3, 
  Trash2, 
  CheckCircle, 
  Image as ImageIcon, 
  ExternalLink, 
  X, 
  RefreshCw, 
  List, 
  LayoutGrid, 
  Copy, 
  Check,
  ArrowUpDown,
  ArrowUp,
  ArrowDown,
  Filter,
  RotateCcw
} from 'lucide-react';
import ImageLightboxModal from './ImageLightboxModal';
import TablePagination from './TablePagination';

export default function SavedProductsTab({ 
  products = [], 
  isLoading = false,
  onAddProduct, 
  onEditProduct, 
  onDeleteProduct,
  onBulkDeleteProduct,
  currentUser 
}) {
  const [filterQuery, setFilterQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterSupplier, setFilterSupplier] = useState('all');
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState('all');
  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState('id');
  const [sortDirection, setSortDirection] = useState('desc');
  const [selectedLightbox, setSelectedLightbox] = useState(null);
  const [copiedBarcode, setCopiedBarcode] = useState(null);
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
  const [pageSize, setPageSize] = useState(10);
  const [selectedProductIds, setSelectedProductIds] = useState(new Set());
  
  // Automatically prune orphan product selection IDs whenever products list updates
  useEffect(() => {
    setSelectedProductIds(prev => {
      if (prev.size === 0) return prev;
      const valid = new Set(products.flatMap(p => [p.id, p.barcode].filter(Boolean)));
      const next = new Set([...prev].filter(id => valid.has(id)));
      return next.size === prev.size ? prev : next;
    });
  }, [products]);
  
  // File Explorer view type toggle: default to 'table' (rows list) as requested
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState(() => {
    return localStorage.getItem('rma_saved_products_view_mode') || 'table';
  });

  const canEdit = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';
  const canDelete = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin' || currentUser?.role === 'admin';

  const handleSetViewMode = (mode) => {
    setViewMode(mode);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('rma_saved_products_view_mode', mode);
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  const copyToClipboard = (barcode) => {
    if (!barcode) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(barcode);
    setCopiedBarcode(barcode);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedBarcode(null), 2000);
  };

  // Derive unique suppliers for the filter dropdown
  const uniqueSuppliers = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set();
    products.forEach(p => {
      const s = p.supplier_name || p.supplierName;
      if (s && s.trim()) set.add(s.trim());
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [products]);

  // Handle column header sorting
  const handleSort = (field) => {
    if (sortField === field) {
      setSortDirection(prev => prev === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
    } else {
      setSortField(field);
      setSortDirection('asc');
    }
    setCurrentPage(1);
  };

  // Filter and sort products
  const processedProducts = useMemo(() => {
    const q = filterQuery.toLowerCase().trim();

    let list = products.filter(p => {
      // Text search
      if (q) {
        const matches = (
          (p.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (p.barcode || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (p.code || '').toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          String(p.id || '').includes(q) ||
          (p.supplier_name || p.supplierName || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
        if (!matches) return false;
      }

      // Supplier filter
      if (filterSupplier !== 'all') {
        const s = (p.supplier_name || p.supplierName || '').trim();
        if (s !== filterSupplier) return false;
      }

      // Status filter
      if (filterStatus === 'verified' && p.is_verified === false) return false;
      if (filterStatus === 'pending' && p.is_verified !== false) return false;

      return true;
    });

    // Sorting
    list.sort((a, b) => {
      let valA, valB;
      switch (sortField) {
        case 'id':
          valA = Number(a.id) || 0;
          valB = Number(b.id) || 0;
          break;
        case 'barcode':
          valA = String(a.barcode || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.barcode || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'code':
          valA = String(a.code || a.sku || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.code || b.sku || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'name':
          valA = String(a.name || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.name || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'price':
          valA = Number(a.price_with_vat || a.price || 0);
          valB = Number(b.price_with_vat || b.price || 0);
          break;
        case 'supplier':
          valA = String(a.supplier_name || a.supplierName || '').toLowerCase();
          valB = String(b.supplier_name || b.supplierName || '').toLowerCase();
          break;
        case 'status':
          valA = a.is_verified !== false ? 1 : 0;
          valB = b.is_verified !== false ? 1 : 0;
          break;
        default:
          valA = a.id;
          valB = b.id;
      }

      if (valA < valB) return sortDirection === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
      if (valA > valB) return sortDirection === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
      return 0;
    });

    return list;
  }, [products, filterQuery, filterSupplier, filterStatus, sortField, sortDirection]);

  // Paginated slice
  const paginatedProducts = useMemo(() => {
    const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
    return processedProducts.slice(start, start + pageSize);
  }, [processedProducts, currentPage, pageSize]);

  const hasActiveFilters = filterQuery || filterSupplier !== 'all' || filterStatus !== 'all';

  const resetFilters = () => {
    setFilterQuery('');
    setFilterSupplier('all');
    setFilterStatus('all');
    setCurrentPage(1);
    setSelectedProductIds(new Set());
  };

  // Bulk Selection Helpers
  const isAllPageSelected = useMemo(() => {
    if (paginatedProducts.length === 0) return false;
    return paginatedProducts.every(p => selectedProductIds.has(p.id || p.barcode));
  }, [paginatedProducts, selectedProductIds]);

  const toggleSelectProduct = (id) => {
    setSelectedProductIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const toggleSelectAllPage = () => {
    setSelectedProductIds(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (isAllPageSelected) {
        paginatedProducts.forEach(p => next.delete(p.id || p.barcode));
      } else {
        paginatedProducts.forEach(p => next.add(p.id || p.barcode));
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const selectAllFiltered = () => {
    const next = new Set();
    processedProducts.forEach(p => next.add(p.id || p.barcode));
    setSelectedProductIds(next);
  };

  const clearSelection = () => {
    setSelectedProductIds(new Set());
  };

  const selectedProductsList = useMemo(() => {
    return products.filter(p => selectedProductIds.has(p.id || p.barcode));
  }, [products, selectedProductIds]);

  const renderSortIndicator = (field) => {
    if (sortField !== field) {
      return <ArrowUpDown className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-300 group-hover:text-slate-400 shrink-0 ml-1" />;
    }
    return sortDirection === 'asc' ? (
      <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0 ml-1" />
    ) : (
      <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 shrink-0 ml-1" />
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 w-full min-w-0 box-border">
      {/* Top Controls Bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-sm w-full min-w-0 box-border">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-inner">
            <Package className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                Verified Products Catalog
              </h3>
              <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-black bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-300 shrink-0">
                {products.length} Items in DB
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate">
              Custom catalog items saved with verified barcodes & reference photos.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between sm:justify-end gap-2.5 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0 flex-wrap">
          {/* File Explorer Style View Type Switcher */}
          <div className="flex items-center bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900/80 p-1 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleSetViewMode('table')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                viewMode === 'table'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
              title="Rows / Table View (with SN column)"
            >
              <List className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Rows List</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleSetViewMode('grid')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all ${
                viewMode === 'grid'
                  ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-white'
              }`}
              title="Grid Cards View"
            >
              <LayoutGrid className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Grid Cards</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {canEdit && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onAddProduct}
              className="px-3.5 sm:px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-md shadow-blue-600/20 transition-all shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Add Product</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter / Search & Sort Controls Toolbar */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-3.5 sm:p-4 shadow-sm space-y-3 w-full min-w-0 box-border">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center gap-2.5 w-full min-w-0">
          {/* Search Box */}
          <div className="relative w-full md:flex-1 min-w-0">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-3 shrink-0" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={filterQuery}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setFilterQuery(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              placeholder="Search by SN (#), product name, barcode, SKU, or supplier..."
              className="w-full min-w-0 pl-10 pr-9 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-900 transition-all box-border"
            />
            {filterQuery && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setFilterQuery('');
                  setCurrentPage(1);
                }}
                className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 p-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Supplier & Status Dropdown Filters in responsive layout */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:flex md:items-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto min-w-0">
            <select
              value={filterSupplier}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setFilterSupplier(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="w-full md:w-auto min-w-0 px-3 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-900 transition-all cursor-pointer truncate box-border"
            >
              <option value="all">All Suppliers ({uniqueSuppliers.length})</option>
              {uniqueSuppliers.map(sup => (
                <option key={sup} value={sup}>{sup}</option>
              ))}
            </select>

            {/* Status Dropdown Filter */}
            <select
              value={filterStatus}
              onChange={(e) => {
                setFilterStatus(e.target.value);
                setCurrentPage(1);
              }}
              className="w-full md:w-auto min-w-0 px-3 py-2.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:bg-white dark:focus:bg-slate-900 transition-all cursor-pointer truncate box-border"
            >
              <option value="all">All Status</option>
              <option value="verified">Verified Only</option>
              <option value="pending">Pending Verification</option>
            </select>

            {/* Reset Filters Button */}
            {hasActiveFilters && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={resetFilters}
                className="w-full md:w-auto px-3 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-600 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-200 rounded-2xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-colors shrink-0 cursor-pointer box-border"
                title="Reset all filters"
              >
                <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                <span>Reset</span>
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Filter Summary & Active Sort Notice */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 px-1 pt-0.5 font-medium">
          <div>
            Showing <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{processedProducts.length}</strong> of {products.length} products
            {hasActiveFilters && <span className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold ml-1.5">• Filter active</span>}
          </div>
          <div className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
            Click column headers to sort (<strong className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 capitalize">{sortField}</strong> {sortDirection === 'asc' ? '▲' : '▼'})
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Products Content: Loading / Empty / Table / Grid */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="py-16 text-center text-slate-400 space-y-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6">
          <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 mx-auto animate-spin text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">Loading custom catalog from Supabase...</p>
        </div>
      ) : processedProducts.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-14 text-center text-slate-400 space-y-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm">
          <Package className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600" />
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
            {hasActiveFilters ? 'No products match the selected filters' : 'No saved products in custom database yet'}
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 max-w-sm mx-auto">
            {hasActiveFilters ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={resetFilters}
                className="text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold hover:underline"
              >
                Click here to clear all filters
              </button>
            ) : (
              'When you verify pending barcodes or add items, they will appear here with instant edit and delete controls.'
            )}
          </p>
          {canEdit && !hasActiveFilters && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onAddProduct}
              className="mt-3 px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900/60 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 font-bold rounded-xl text-xs inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
            >
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Add Your First Product</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : viewMode === 'table' ? (
        /* ============================================================ */
        /* VIEW 1: PRODUCTION-LEVEL ROW LIST / TABLE VIEW WITH SORTABLE HEADERS */
        /* ============================================================ */
        <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-slate-50/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 select-none">
                  {/* Select All Checkbox Header */}
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-3 w-10 text-center">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={isAllPageSelected}
                      onChange={toggleSelectAllPage}
                      className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
                      title={isAllPageSelected ? "Deselect all on this page" : "Select all on this page"}
                    />
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('id')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white w-16 cursor-pointer hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Serial Number"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <span>SN</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('id')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-3 w-16 text-center">Photo</th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('barcode')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Barcode"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <span>Barcode</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('barcode')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('code')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by SKU / Code"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <span>SKU / Code</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('code')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('name')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Product Name"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <span>Product Name</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('name')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('price')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold cursor-pointer hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Price"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end">
                      <span>Price (w/ VAT)</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('price')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('supplier')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold cursor-pointer hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Supplier"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <span>Supplier</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('supplier')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                    Customer AE
                  </th>
                  <th 
                    onClick={() => handleSort('status')}
                    className="py-3.5 px-3 text-center font-bold cursor-pointer hover:text-indigo-600 dark:hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors group"
                    title="Click to sort by Status"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-center">
                      <span>Status</span>
                      {renderSortIndicator('status')}
                    </div>
                  </th>
                  <th className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-bold w-24">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/60 font-medium">
                {paginatedProducts.map((product, idx) => {
                  const hasPhoto = Boolean(product.image_url || product.imageUrl);
                  const photoSrc = product.image_url || product.imageUrl;
                  const isCopied = copiedBarcode === product.barcode;
                  const isSelected = selectedProductIds.has(product.id || product.barcode);

                  return (
                    <tr 
                      key={product.id || product.barcode} 
                      className={`transition-colors group ${
                        isSelected 
                          ? 'bg-indigo-50/80 dark:bg-indigo-950/50' 
                          : 'hover:bg-indigo-50/30 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/40'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* Individual Row Checkbox */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={isSelected}
                          onChange={() => toggleSelectProduct(product.id || product.barcode)}
                          className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
                        />
                      </td>

                      {/* 1. SN (SERIAL NUMBER / DATABASE ID) COLUMN - AT FAR LEFT */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono">
                        <span className="font-black text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 border border-indigo-200/90 dark:border-indigo-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-xs tracking-tight shadow-xs">
                          #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* 2. Photo thumbnail with Clickable Zoom Lightbox */}
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">
                        {hasPhoto ? (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setSelectedLightbox({
                              url: photoSrc,
                              title: product.name,
                              subtitle: `Barcode: ${product.barcode} • SN #${product.id} • ${product.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}`

                            title="Click to zoom reference photo in fullscreen"
                          >
                            <img 
                              src={photoSrc} 
                              alt={product.name} 
                              className="w-full h-full object-cover" 
                            />
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-700">
                            <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* 3. Barcode with copy button */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                          <span>{product.barcode}</span>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => copyToClipboard(product.barcode)}
                            className="p-1 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 rounded-md transition-colors"
                            title="Copy barcode"

                            {isCopied ? (
                              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />

                      </td>

                      {/* 4. SKU / Code */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">

                        {product.name}

                            : 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800'

                          )}

                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* Floating Bulk Action Bar for Table */}
          {selectedProductIds.size > 0 && (
            <div className="p-3 sm:px-4 bg-slate-900/95 dark:bg-slate-950/95 text-white border-t border-slate-700 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black">
                  {selectedProductIds.size}
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
                  {selectedProductIds.size} product{selectedProductIds.size > 1 ? 's' : ''} selected
                </span>
                {selectedProductIds.size < processedProducts.length && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={selectAllFiltered}
                    className="text-xs text-indigo-300 hover:text-white underline font-semibold ml-1 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Select all {processedProducts.length} filtered
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={clearSelection}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Deselect
                </button>
                {canDelete && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => onBulkDeleteProduct && onBulkDeleteProduct(selectedProductsList)}
                    className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>Delete Selected ({selectedProductIds.size})</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <TablePagination
            currentPage={currentPage}
            totalItems={processedProducts.length}
            pageSize={pageSize}
            onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
            onPageSizeChange={setPageSize}
            pageSizeOptions={[10, 25, 50, 100]}
            itemLabel="verified products"
          />
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* ============================================================ */
        /* VIEW 2: FILE EXPLORER STYLE GRID CARDS VIEW                  */
        /* ============================================================ */
        <div className="space-y-3.5">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 2xl:grid-cols-5 gap-3.5">
            {paginatedProducts.map((product, idx) => {
            const hasPhoto = Boolean(product.image_url || product.imageUrl);
            const photoSrc = product.image_url || product.imageUrl;
            const isSelected = selectedProductIds.has(product.id || product.barcode);

            return (
              <div 
                key={product.id || product.barcode}
                className={`border rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 group ${

                    ? 'bg-indigo-50/90 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 border-indigo-500'
                    : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/80 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 hover:border-indigo-300 dark:hover:border-indigo-500'
                }`}
              >
                <div>
                  {/* Top: Checkbox + SN Badge + Verified Badge */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={isSelected}
                        onChange={() => toggleSelectProduct(product.id || product.barcode)}
                        className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-600 cursor-pointer"
                      />
                      <span className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/80 border border-indigo-200/80 dark:border-indigo-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg">
                        SN #{(currentPage - 1) * pageSize + idx + 1}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800">
                      VERIFIED
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Photo & Details */}
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    {hasPhoto ? (
                      <div 
                        onClick={() => setSelectedLightbox({
                          url: photoSrc,
                          title: product.name,
                          subtitle: `Barcode: ${product.barcode} • SN #${product.id} • ${product.supplier_name || 'Savemore'}`
                        })}
                        className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 shrink-0 cursor-zoom-in hover:opacity-90 relative"
                        title="Click to zoom reference photo in fullscreen"
                      >
                        <img src={photoSrc} alt={product.name} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900">
                        <ImageIcon className="w-6 h-6" />
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      {product.code && (
                        <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold truncate mb-0.5">
                          SKU: <span className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{product.code}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs sm:text-sm line-clamp-2 leading-tight">
                        {product.name}
                      </h4>
                      
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 truncate">
                        Barcode: <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">{product.barcode}</strong>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Metadata: Price & Supplier & AE */}
                  <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 block font-medium">Price (w/ VAT)</span>
                      <span className="font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono text-sm">
                        ₱{Number(product.price_with_vat || product.priceWithVat || product.price || 0).toFixed(2)}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-right">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 block font-medium">Supplier</span>
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 truncate max-w-[120px] block">
                        {product.supplier_name || product.supplierName || 'Savemore'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* AE Info row */}
                  <div className="mt-2 pt-1.5 border-t border-slate-100/80 dark:border-slate-700/40 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">Customer AE:</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 truncate max-w-[180px]">
                      {product.ae_name ? `${product.ae_name}` : <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">Unassigned</span>}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Actions: Edit & Delete */}
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700/60 flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                  {canEdit && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onEditProduct(product)}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-700/60 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                      title="Edit product details & photo"
                    >
                      <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                      <span>Edit</span>
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {canDelete && (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => onDeleteProduct(product)}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-900/60 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors"
                      title="Delete product permanently"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Delete</span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Floating Bulk Action Bar for Grid Cards */}
        {selectedProductIds.size > 0 && (
          <div className="p-3 sm:px-4 bg-slate-900/95 dark:bg-slate-950/95 text-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-700 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-in fade-in">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black">
                {selectedProductIds.size}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
                {selectedProductIds.size} product{selectedProductIds.size > 1 ? 's' : ''} selected
              </span>
              {selectedProductIds.size < processedProducts.length && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={selectAllFiltered}
                  className="text-xs text-indigo-300 hover:text-white underline font-semibold ml-1 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Select all {processedProducts.length} filtered
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={clearSelection}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              >
                Deselect
              </button>
              {canDelete && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => onBulkDeleteProduct && onBulkDeleteProduct(selectedProductsList)}
                  className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Delete Selected ({selectedProductIds.size})</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Grid View Pagination */}
        <TablePagination
          currentPage={currentPage}
          totalItems={processedProducts.length}
          pageSize={pageSize}
          onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
          onPageSizeChange={setPageSize}
          pageSizeOptions={[10, 25, 50, 100]}
          itemLabel="verified products"
        />
      </div>
      )}

      {/* Fullscreen Image Lightbox Modal */}
      <ImageLightboxModal
        isOpen={Boolean(selectedLightbox)}
        imageUrl={selectedLightbox?.url}
        images={selectedLightbox?.images || (selectedLightbox?.url ? [selectedLightbox.url] : [])}
        initialIndex={0}
        title={selectedLightbox?.title}
        subtitle={selectedLightbox?.subtitle}
        onClose={() => setSelectedLightbox(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/ScannerModal.jsx ---
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Html5Qrcode } from 'html5-qrcode';
import { Camera, X, RefreshCw, Zap, AlertCircle, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { playBeep } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

export default function ScannerModal({ isOpen, onClose, onScanSuccess, catalog = [] }) {
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState(null);
  const [isScanning, setIsScanning] = useState(false);
  const [cameras, setCameras] = useState([]);
  const [activeCameraId, setActiveCameraId] = useState(null);
  const html5QrCodeRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      stopScanner();
      return;
    }

    // Discover cameras
    Html5Qrcode.getCameras()
      .then(devices => {
        if (devices && devices.length > 0) {
          setCameras(devices);
          // Prefer back/environment camera
          const backCam = devices.find(d => 
            d.label.toLowerCase().includes('back') || 
            d.label.toLowerCase().includes('rear') ||
            d.label.toLowerCase().includes('environment')
          );
          const chosen = backCam ? backCam.id : devices[0].id;
          setActiveCameraId(chosen);
          startScanner(chosen);
        } else {
          setErrorMsg('No camera hardware detected on this device. You can search by SKU or enter barcode manually.');
        }
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.warn('Camera discovery error:', err);
        setErrorMsg('Camera access was not granted or is blocked by browser permissions. You can use manual SKU search.');
      });

    return () => {
      stopScanner();
    };
  }, [isOpen]);

  const startScanner = async (cameraId) => {
    try {
      setErrorMsg(null);
      if (html5QrCodeRef.current) {
        await stopScanner();
      }

      const html5QrCode = new Html5Qrcode('camera-reader-viewport');
      html5QrCodeRef.current = html5QrCode;

      const config = {
        fps: 15,
        qrbox: { width: 260, height: 260 },
        aspectRatio: 1.0,
      };

      await html5QrCode.start(
        cameraId,
        config,
        (decodedText) => {
          playBeep('success');
          onScanSuccess(decodedText);
          onClose();
        },
        () => {
          // Frame error, ignore
        }
      );

      setIsScanning(true);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Start scanner error:', err);
      setErrorMsg('Unable to start camera stream. Ensure camera permissions are allowed in your browser.');
      setIsScanning(false);
    }
  };

  const stopScanner = async () => {
    if (html5QrCodeRef.current) {
      try {
        if (html5QrCodeRef.current.isScanning) {
          await html5QrCodeRef.current.stop();
        }
        await html5QrCodeRef.current.clear();
      } catch (e) {
        console.debug('Scanner stop error:', e);
      }
      html5QrCodeRef.current = null;
    }
    setIsScanning(false);
  };

  const switchCamera = () => {
    if (cameras.length <= 1) return;
    const currentIndex = cameras.findIndex(c => c.id === activeCameraId);
    const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % cameras.length;
    const nextCamera = cameras[nextIndex];
    setActiveCameraId(nextCamera.id);
    startScanner(nextCamera.id);
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 bg-slate-950/75 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t sm:border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] pb-safe">
        
        {/* Mobile bottom-sheet drag handle */}
        <div className="sm:hidden pt-2.5 pb-1 flex justify-center shrink-0">
          <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
        </div>

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-brand-50 dark:bg-brand-500/10 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400 border border-brand-200 dark:border-brand-500/20">
              <Camera className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-base">Camera Barcode Scanner</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Align retail box barcode or QR code</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            {cameras.length > 1 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={switchCamera}
                className="min-h-[44px] px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs flex items-center space-x-1.5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 transition-colors"
                title="Switch Camera"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">Flip</span>
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="min-w-[44px] min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
              aria-label="Close scanner"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Viewfinder Area */}
        <div className="p-4 flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-950 relative overflow-hidden">
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-xs aspect-square rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-brand-500/40 bg-black flex items-center justify-center shadow-inner">
            <div id="camera-reader-viewport" className="w-full h-full object-cover"></div>
            
            {/* Visual targeting overlay */}
            <div className="absolute inset-4 pointer-events-none border border-brand-400/30 rounded-xl flex flex-col justify-between p-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="w-4 h-4 border-t-2 border-l-2 border-brand-400"></span>
                <span className="w-4 h-4 border-t-2 border-r-2 border-brand-400"></span>
              </div>
              <div className="relative w-full">
                <div className="w-full h-0.5 bg-brand-400 shadow-[0_0_12px_#38bdf8] scanner-laser"></div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between">
                <span className="w-4 h-4 border-b-2 border-l-2 border-brand-400"></span>
                <span className="w-4 h-4 border-b-2 border-r-2 border-brand-400"></span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Error or waiting state */}
            {errorMsg && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/95 p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
                <AlertCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-400 mb-2" />
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-200 leading-relaxed">{errorMsg}</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-3 flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs text-slate-400">
            <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-400" />
            <span>Align barcode within the target box</span>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Settings,

  ExternalLink
} from 'lucide-react';
import { rmaApi, supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { applyEmailTestMode } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';
import { notificationService } from '../services/notificationService';
import { purchaseOrdersApi } from '../services/purchaseOrdersApi';
import ApiKeysManagementSection from './ApiKeysManagementSection';

export default function SettingsTab({ 
  isTestMode, 
  onToggleTestMode,
  onOpenPortalQr,
  currentUser
}) {
  const [connectionStatus, setConnectionStatus] = useState({
    loading: false,
    checked: false,
    connected: false,
    message: ''
  });

  const [smtpStatus, setSmtpStatus] = useState({
    loading: false,
    checked: false,
    success: false,
    message: '',
    diagnostic: '',
    passLength: null,
    hadSpaces: false
  });

  // Super Admin Configurable RMA Email Recipients State
  const [mainRecipient, setMainRecipient] = useState('azgodev@gmail.com');
  const [ccRecipients, setCcRecipients] = useState([
    'mgan@pingconmarketing.com',
    'marketing@pingconmarketing.com',
    'azgan@pingconmarketing.com',
    'jaezelle.benito@pingconmarketing.com'
  ]);
  const [newCcInput, setNewCcInput] = useState('');
  const [isSavingRecipients, setIsSavingRecipients] = useState(false);
  const [recipientFeedback, setRecipientFeedback] = useState(null);

  // Live Product Catalog API State
  const [poApiKey, setPoApiKey] = useState(() => purchaseOrdersApi.getApiKey() || '');
  const [poApiStatus, setPoApiStatus] = useState({
    loading: false,
    checked: false,
    connected: false,
    message: ''
  });
  const [isSavingPoKey, setIsSavingPoKey] = useState(false);
  const [poKeyFeedback, setPoKeyFeedback] = useState(null);

  const supabaseUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL || 'https://lschluviltzsknptwgrz.supabase.co';
  const supabaseKey = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || 'sb_publishable_Jrv9ZNgGXJ4PZoNWCJSHxQ_7hZtQqd3';

  useEffect(() => {
    handleCheckConnection();
    handleCheckPoApi();

    // Auto-sync Catalog API key from/to Supabase cloud for seamless mobile/desktop sharing
    purchaseOrdersApi.loadApiKeyFromCloud().then(cloudKey => {
      if (cloudKey) {
        setPoApiKey(cloudKey);
        handleCheckPoApi();
      } else {
        const localKey = purchaseOrdersApi.getApiKey();
        if (localKey && localKey !== 'pk_live_po_cloud_db_2026_dev_key') {
          purchaseOrdersApi.setApiKey(localKey);
        }
      }
    });

    // 1. Load active email recipient settings
    const active = notificationService.getEmailSettings();
    if (active?.toEmail) setMainRecipient(active.toEmail);
    if (Array.isArray(active?.baseCcList)) setCcRecipients(active.baseCcList);

    // 2. Load from Supabase rma_settings if available
    notificationService.loadEmailSettingsFromDb().then(dbSettings => {
      if (dbSettings?.toEmail) setMainRecipient(dbSettings.toEmail);
      if (Array.isArray(dbSettings?.baseCcList)) setCcRecipients(dbSettings.baseCcList);
    });

    const handleSyncRecipients = () => {
      const updated = notificationService.getEmailSettings();
      if (updated?.toEmail) setMainRecipient(updated.toEmail);
      if (Array.isArray(updated?.baseCcList)) setCcRecipients(updated.baseCcList);
    };

    window.addEventListener('rma-settings-changed', handleSyncRecipients);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleSyncRecipients);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('rma-settings-changed', handleSyncRecipients);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleSyncRecipients);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleCheckConnection = async () => {
    setConnectionStatus({ loading: true, checked: false, connected: false, message: 'Pinging Supabase...' });
    const result = await rmaApi.testConnection();
    setConnectionStatus({
      loading: false,
      checked: true,
      connected: result.connected,
      message: result.message
    });
  };

  const handleCheckPoApi = async () => {
    setPoApiStatus({ loading: true, checked: false, connected: false, message: 'Testing Product Catalog API...' });
    const result = await purchaseOrdersApi.testConnection(true);
    setPoApiStatus({
      loading: false,
      checked: true,
      connected: result.connected,
      message: result.connected 
        ? `Connected! Access verified to 5,793+ live SKUs in erply_products.` 
        : (result.error || 'Connection failed.')
    });
  };

  const handleSavePoKey = async () => {
    setIsSavingPoKey(true);
    setPoKeyFeedback(null);
    try {
      await purchaseOrdersApi.setApiKey(poApiKey);

    } catch (err) {
      setPoKeyFeedback({ type: 'error', message: err.message });
    } finally {
      setIsSavingPoKey(false);

      passLength: res.passLength || null,
      hadSpaces: Boolean(res.hadSpaces)
    });

  // Add CC email to list

      setRecipientFeedback({ type: 'error', message: 'Please enter a valid email address.' });
      return;
    }

    if (ccRecipients.map(c => c.toLowerCase()).includes(clean)) {
      setRecipientFeedback({ type: 'error', message: 'This email is already in the CC list.' });
      return;
    }

    setCcRecipients(prev => [...prev, clean]);
    setNewCcInput('');
    setRecipientFeedback(null);
  };

  // Remove CC email from list
  const handleRemoveCcEmail = (emailToRemove) => {
    setCcRecipients(prev => prev.filter(email => email.toLowerCase() !== emailToRemove.toLowerCase()));
    setRecipientFeedback(null);
  };

  // Restore Default Corporate Recipients
  const handleResetDefaults = () => {
    const defaults = {
      toEmail: 'azgodev@gmail.com',
      baseCcList: [
        'mgan@pingconmarketing.com',
        'marketing@pingconmarketing.com',
        'azgan@pingconmarketing.com',
        'jaezelle.benito@pingconmarketing.com'
      ]
    };
    setMainRecipient(defaults.toEmail);
    setCcRecipients(defaults.baseCcList);
    setRecipientFeedback({ type: 'success', message: 'Corporate defaults restored! Click "Save Changes" to apply.' });
  };

  // Save Recipient Settings
  const handleSaveRecipients = async () => {
    const cleanTo = mainRecipient.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!cleanTo || !cleanTo.includes('@') || !cleanTo.includes('.')) {
      setRecipientFeedback({ type: 'error', message: 'Please enter a valid Primary TO recipient email address.' });

    setIsSavingRecipients(true);

    } finally {
      setIsSavingRecipients(false);
    }
  };

  const isSuperAdmin = currentUser?.role === 'super_admin';

              />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
              The primary destination mailbox for automated RMA alerts. In Live Mode, emails are dispatched directly to this address.

          {/* CC Distribution List */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <label className="block text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">

              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">

            </div>

            {/* CC Chips / Badges Container */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl min-h-[58px] flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center">
              {ccRecipients.length === 0 ? (
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 italic">No CC recipients configured. Add one below.</span>
              ) : (
                ccRecipients.map((email) => (
                  <span
                    key={email}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono shadow-2xs group max-w-full"
                  >
                    <span className="truncate max-w-[200px] sm:max-w-xs">{email}</span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleRemoveCcEmail(email)}
                      className="text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 dark:hover:text-rose-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer p-0.5 rounded-md shrink-0"
                      title={`Remove ${email}`}
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </span>
                ))
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Add new CC form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleAddCcEmail} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 w-full min-w-0">
              <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-0">
                <Mail className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none" />
                <input
                  type="email"
                  value={newCcInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewCcInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Enter email to add to CC (e.g. manager@pingconmarketing.com)"
                  className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 box-border"
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full sm:w-auto px-3.5 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 box-border"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Add CC</span>
              </button>
            </form>

            <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/60 dark:bg-blue-950/30 border border-blue-200/80 dark:border-blue-900/40 rounded-xl text-[11px] text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-200 leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-2">
              <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>
                <strong>Smart Dynamic AE Addition:</strong> The Customer Account Executive (AE) assigned to the product (e.g. <code>alleli.almaida@ph.keysys.com</code>) is <strong>automatically appended</strong> to this CC list upon report dispatch.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* CARD 2: TEST MODE SWITCH CARD */}
      <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Simulation / Test Mode Toggle</h2>
              <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 dark:bg-purple-950/60 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800">
                👑 Super Admin Exclusive
              </span>
              {isTestMode ? (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/40">
                  ACTIVE
                </span>
              ) : (
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                  OFF
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-xl">

        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-500/20">

                <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-300 font-mono font-bold">
                  EXTERNAL_API_KEY_DANILO

--- START FILE: src/components/SubmitRMATab.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Camera, 
  Barcode, 
  MapPin, 
  Upload, 
  Sparkles, 
  Plus, 
  Minus, 
  Building2, 
  FileText, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  RefreshCw,
  Send,
  Zap,
  Info,
  Check,
  Search,
  Package,
  Layers,
  DollarSign,
  Hash,
  X,
  Loader2
} from 'lucide-react';
import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';
import ScannerModal from './ScannerModal';
import { AE_ROSTERS } from '../data/mockData';
import { rmaApi } from '../supabaseClient';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';
import { generateTicketId, playBeep, formatPeso, generateAiDiagnosis } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

export default function SubmitRMATab({ 
  catalog = [], 
  onTicketCreated, 
  isTestMode = false, 
  onOpenTicketModal 
}) {
  const [isScannerOpen, setIsScannerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedProduct, setSelectedProduct] = useState(null);
  const [manualSkuInput, setManualSkuInput] = useState('');
  const [isSearchingManually, setIsSearchingManually] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [liveSearchResults, setLiveSearchResults] = useState([]);
  const [isSearchingLive, setIsSearchingLive] = useState(false);

  // Form State (Simplified for Repackers & Store Customers)
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    // Store Info
    customerName: 'Puregold Price Club',
    storeBranch: 'Branch 042 - San Fernando Pampanga',
    invoiceNo: '',
    
    // Quantity
    quantity: 1,
    
    // Serial Numbers (Optional)
    serialNumbers: '',
    
    // Defect & Photos
    defectCategory: 'Damaged in Transit / Crushed Carton',
    technicalDiagnosis: '',
    gpsCoordinates: '',
    photos: []
  });

  // UI state
  const [isAiLoading, setIsAiLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [isGpsLoading, setIsGpsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isUploadingPhoto, setIsUploadingPhoto] = useState(false);
  const [statusNotification, setStatusNotification] = useState(null);

  // Auto assign Group & AE based on matched product behind the scenes
  const getProductRouting = (product) => {
    const isGroup1 = product?.group?.includes('KEYSYS') || product?.brand === 'Keysys' || product?.brand === 'A2Z2Go';
    const groupKey = isGroup1 ? 'Group 1 (KEYSYS & A2Z2GO)' : 'Group 2 (PINGCON & BONITA TISSUE)';
    const roster = AE_ROSTERS[groupKey];
    const defaultAe = roster.aes[0];
    return {
      group: groupKey,
      aeName: defaultAe.name,
      aeEmail: defaultAe.email,
      supervisorEmail: defaultAe.supervisorEmail
    };
  };

  // Toast notification
  const showBannerNotification = (msg, type = 'info') => {
    setStatusNotification({ msg, type });
    setTimeout(() => {
      setStatusNotification(null);
    }, 4500);
  };

  // Live Search Debounce Effect (queries 5,793 live ERPLY products)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) {
      setLiveSearchResults([]);
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      setIsSearchingLive(true);
      try {
        const results = await rmaApi.searchLiveProducts(searchQuery, 12);
        setLiveSearchResults(results);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Live search error:', e);
      } finally {
        setIsSearchingLive(false);
      }
    }, 280);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchQuery]);

  // Handle scanned or selected product
  const handleProductIdentified = async (productOrCode) => {
    let matched = null;

    if (typeof productOrCode === 'object' && productOrCode !== null) {
      matched = productOrCode;
    } else {
      const cleanCode = String(productOrCode).trim();
      if (!cleanCode) return;

      // If same product is scanned again, increment quantity +1!
      if (selectedProduct && (
        String(selectedProduct.sku).toLowerCase() === cleanCode.toLowerCase() || 
        String(selectedProduct.barcode).toLowerCase() === cleanCode.toLowerCase()
      )) {
        playBeep('increment');
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, quantity: (Number(prev.quantity) || 0) + 1 }));
        showBannerNotification(`Re-scanned ${selectedProduct.sku}: Quantity incremented to ${(Number(formData.quantity) || 1) + 1}!`, 'success');
        return;
      }

      // 1. Live ERPLY API & Multi-Tier Catalog Lookup
      try {
        matched = await catalogService.findProduct(cleanCode);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Live barcode lookup failed:', err);
      }

      // 2. Fallback to local catalog
      if (!matched) {
        const query = cleanCode.toLowerCase();
        matched = catalog.find(p => 
          p.barcode?.toLowerCase() === query || 
          p.sku?.toLowerCase() === query ||
          p.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
        );
      }
    }

    if (matched) {
      playBeep('success');
      setSelectedProduct(matched);
      setManualSkuInput('');
      setSearchQuery('');
      setIsSearchingManually(false);
      showBannerNotification(`Product Matched: "${matched.name}" (${matched.sku}) • Supplier: ${matched.supplier}`, 'success');
    } else {
      playBeep('error');
      // Boss rule: If product does not appear, still accept barcode scanner
      const unlisted = {
        id: `unreg-${Date.now()}`,
        sku: `SKU-${String(productOrCode).slice(-8).toUpperCase()}`,
        barcode: String(productOrCode),
        name: `Uncatalogued Product (${productOrCode})`,
        brand: '',
        supplier: '',
        unit_price: 0,
        case_pack: 'pc',
        image_url: null,
        group: 'Standard Items',
        requires_serial: false
      };
      setSelectedProduct(unlisted);
      showBannerNotification(`Uncatalogued Barcode "${productOrCode}". Accepted with default profile.`, 'warning');
    }
  };

  // Quantity controls
  const handleQuantityIncrement = () => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, quantity: (Number(prev.quantity) || 0) + 1 }));
    playBeep('increment');
  };

  const handleQuantityDecrement = () => {
    setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, quantity: Math.max(1, (Number(prev.quantity) || 1) - 1) }));
  };

  const handleQuantityChange = (e) => {
    const val = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
    if (isNaN(val)) {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, quantity: '' }));
    } else {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, quantity: Math.max(1, val) }));
    }
  };

  // GPS Grabber
  const handleGrabGps = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      alert('Geolocation is not supported by your browser.');
      return;
    }
    setIsGpsLoading(true);
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        const { latitude, longitude, accuracy } = pos.coords;
        const coordString = `${latitude.toFixed(5)}° N, ${longitude.toFixed(5)}° E (±${Math.round(accuracy)}m)`;
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, gpsCoordinates: coordString }));
        setIsGpsLoading(false);
        showBannerNotification(`GPS Logged: ${coordString}`, 'success');
      },
      () => {
        setIsGpsLoading(false);
        const fallback = '14.5995° N, 120.9842° E (Receiving Dock)';
        setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, gpsCoordinates: fallback }));
        showBannerNotification('GPS recorded (Receiving Dock)', 'info');
      },
      { timeout: 8000, enableHighAccuracy: true }
    );
  };

  // Defect Photo Upload
  const handlePhotoUpload = async (e) => {
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    if (files.length === 0) return;

    setIsUploadingPhoto(true);
    try {
      const uploadPromises = files.map(file => rmaApi.uploadPhoto(file));
      const urls = await Promise.all(uploadPromises);

      setFormData(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        photos: [...prev.photos, ...urls]
      }));
      showBannerNotification(`${files.length} defect photo(s) added!`, 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Photo upload error:', err);
      showBannerNotification('Photo upload failed. Using local preview.', 'warning');
    } finally {
      setIsUploadingPhoto(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRemovePhoto = (index) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      photos: prev.photos.filter((_, i) => i !== index)
    }));
  };

  // Simulated AI Defect Detection
  const handleAiDefectDetection = () => {
    setIsAiLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const diagnosis = generateAiDiagnosis(
        selectedProduct?.name || 'Wholesale Merchandise', 
        formData.defectCategory, 
        formData.photos.length
      );
      setFormData(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        technicalDiagnosis: diagnosis
      }));
      setIsAiLoading(false);
      playBeep('success');
      showBannerNotification('AI Defect Inspection findings generated!', 'success');
    }, 900);
  };

  // Submit RMA Ticket
  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!selectedProduct) {
      alert('Please scan or select a product first in Step 1.');
      return;
    }

    if (!formData.customerName.trim()) {
      alert('Please enter the Customer / Store Name.');
      return;
    }

    const qty = Number(formData.quantity) || 1;
    const unitPrice = Number(selectedProduct.unit_price) || 0;
    const totalAmount = qty * unitPrice;
    const routing = getProductRouting(selectedProduct);

    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const existingTickets = await rmaApi.getTickets();
      const ticketId = generateTicketId(existingTickets.length);

      const newTicket = {
        id: ticketId,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        customer_name: formData.customerName,
        store_branch: formData.storeBranch || 'Main Store',
        invoice_no: formData.invoiceNo || 'N/A',
        group: routing.group,
        ae_name: routing.aeName,
        ae_email: routing.aeEmail,
        supervisor_email: routing.supervisorEmail,
        product_name: selectedProduct.name,
        sku: selectedProduct.sku,
        barcode: selectedProduct.barcode || 'N/A',
        brand: selectedProduct.brand || 'Wholesale',
        supplier: selectedProduct.supplier || 'Primary Supplier',
        quantity: qty,
        unit_price: unitPrice,
        total_amount: totalAmount,
        serial_numbers: formData.serialNumbers || '',
        defect_category: formData.defectCategory,
        technical_diagnosis: formData.technicalDiagnosis || 'Physical inspection required by warehouse team.',
        gps_coordinates: formData.gpsCoordinates || 'Intake Terminal',
        photos: formData.photos.length > 0 ? formData.photos : (selectedProduct.image_url ? [selectedProduct.image_url] : []),
        status: 'Pending Inspection',
        pull_out_confirmed: false,
        credit_memo_no: '',
        credit_amount: 0,
        credit_issued_by: '',
        credit_issued_date: null,
        supplier_po_no: `PO-RET-${new Date().getFullYear()}-${String(existingTickets.length + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`,
        buffer_days_left: 7,
        notes: `Submitted by Repacker/Customer at ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}`
      };

      await rmaApi.createTicket(newTicket);

      // Trigger Confetti
      try {
        confetti({
          particleCount: 80,
          spread: 70,
          origin: { y: 0.6 }
        });
      } catch (e) {
        // optional
      }

      playBeep('success');
      onTicketCreated(newTicket);
      onOpenTicketModal(newTicket);

      // Reset
      setSelectedProduct(null);
      setFormData(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        quantity: 1,
        serialNumbers: '',
        technicalDiagnosis: '',
        photos: []
      }));
      showBannerNotification(`Ticket ${newTicket.id} created successfully!`, 'success');
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error creating RMA ticket:', err);
      alert('Error saving ticket: ' + (err.message || 'Unknown error'));
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      
      {/* Toast Banner Notification */}
      {statusNotification && (
        <div className={`p-4 rounded-2xl border flex items-center space-x-3 text-sm shadow-md transition-all animate-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-200 ${
          statusNotification.type === 'success' 
            ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/80 border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200' 
            : statusNotification.type === 'warning'
            ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/80 border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/40 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200'
            : 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-brand-950/80 border-blue-300 dark:border-brand-500/40 text-blue-900 dark:text-brand-200'
