                          <div className="font-mono font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white hover:text-amber-600 hover:underline">
                            {r.rma_number}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                            <span>{r.created_at ? new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString() : ''}</span>
                            {r.gps_latitude && r.gps_longitude && (
                              <a
                                href={`https://www.google.com/maps?q=${r.gps_latitude},${r.gps_longitude}`}
                                target="_blank"
                                rel="noreferrer"
                                onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                className="text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 font-bold"
                                title="View GPS Location on Google Maps"
                              >
                                <MapPin className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-rose-500" />
                                <span>Map</span>
                              </a>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          {(r.si_number || r.dr_number || r.po_number || r.invoice_dr_number) && (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap mt-1 text-[9px] font-mono leading-tight">
                              {r.si_number && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 font-bold">
                                  SI: {r.si_number}
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {r.dr_number && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-950/70 text-violet-700 dark:text-violet-300 border border-violet-200 dark:border-violet-800 font-bold">
                                  DR: {r.dr_number}
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {r.po_number && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/70 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 font-bold">
                                  PO: {r.po_number}
                                </span>
                              )}
                              {!r.si_number && !r.dr_number && !r.po_number && r.invoice_dr_number && (
                                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 font-bold">
                                  Doc: {r.invoice_dr_number}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          )}
                          {isManifest && (
                            <div className="mt-1">
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  toggleManifestExpand(manifestKey);
                                }}
                                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[9.5px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider inline-flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer ${
                                  isManifestExpanded
                                    ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white border border-purple-700'
                                    : 'bg-purple-100 hover:bg-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-950/70 text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 border border-purple-300 dark:border-purple-800'
                                }`}
                                title={isManifestExpanded ? "Collapse Manifest Items" : "Expand Manifest Items"}
                              >
                                <span>📦 Manifest ({manifestChildren.length})</span>
                                <ChevronDown className={`w-3 h-3 transform transition-transform ${isManifestExpanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
                              </button>
                            </div>
                          )}
                          {existingClaim && (
                            <div className="mt-1">
                              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 shadow-2xs" title={`Official RTV Voucher Active: ${existingClaim.claimNumber || existingClaim.claim_number}`}>
                                <CheckCircle2 className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                                <span>RTV Voucher Active</span>
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Vendor / Supplier & Warehouse Bin */}
                        <td className="p-3">
                          <div className={`font-bold ${res.supplier === 'Pending Assignment' ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' : 'text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200'}`}>
                            {res.supplier}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono mt-0.5">
                            Bin: <strong className="text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">{r.warehouse_location || 'DOCK'}</strong>
                            {r.batch_lot_number && (
                              <span className="text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 font-bold ml-1.5">• Lot: {r.batch_lot_number}</span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Product Description & SKU */}
                        <td className="p-3">
                          <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-xs" title={res.name}>
                            {res.name}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">
                            {isManifest ? (
                              <span>Total: <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold">{res.qty} units</strong> • Batch Manifest</span>
                            ) : (
                              <span>Qty: <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold">{formatQuantityWithPackSize(res.qty, r.unit_name, r.pieces_per_case || res.matchedProduct?.pieces_per_case)}</strong> • SKU: <strong className={res.code ? 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300' : 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400'}>{res.code || 'Unassigned'}</strong> • BC: {r.barcode}</span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>

                        {/* Triage Disposition */}
                        <td className="p-3">
                          <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-extrabold border inline-block whitespace-nowrap shadow-2xs ${
                            r.disposition === 'Return to Vendor (RTV)' || (r.disposition && r.disposition.includes('Vendor'))
                              ? 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-950/70 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-800'
                              : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700'
                          }`}>
                            {r.disposition || '1 - Pending Vendor Pickup'}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Qty & Unit */}
                        <td className="p-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap font-mono">
                          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-800 font-black text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 text-xs inline-flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs">
                            <span>{formatQuantityWithPackSize(res.qty, r.unit_name, r.pieces_per_case || res.matchedProduct?.pieces_per_case)}</span>
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Unit Price */}
                        <td className="p-3 text-right font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                          {isManifest ? (
                            <span className="text-slate-400 italic text-[11px]">—</span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className={res.price <= 0 ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold' : ''}>
                              ₱{res.price.toFixed(2)}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>

                        {/* Total Claim */}
                        <td className="p-3 text-right font-mono font-black text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                          <span className={res.total <= 0 ? 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' : ''}>
                            ₱{res.total.toFixed(2)}
                          </span>
                        </td>

                        {/* Actions Column: Thermal Label, Inspect/Triage, Assign SKU, Debit Claim & Delete */}
                        <td className="p-2.5 text-center" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                            
                            {/* 1. Print 4x6 Thermal Box Label */}
                            {onPrintLabel && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onPrintLabel(r)}
                                className="p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title="Print 4x6 inch Thermal Box Label"
                              >
                                <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300" />
                              </button>
                            )}

                            {/* 2. Inspect / Triage Physical Return (Safeguarded by Assign SKU) */}
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => {
                                if (!isManifest && !hasAssignedSku(r, savedProductsList)) {
                                  setFinancialWarningTarget({
                                    item: r,
                                    title: "Assign SKU Required First",
                                    message: "This item does not have an official catalog SKU assigned yet. Please assign an SKU first before conducting warehouse inspection and physical triage."
                                  });
                                  return;
                                }
                                if (onOpenQuickAction) {
                                  onOpenQuickAction(r.rma_number);
                                }
                              }}
                              className="px-2 py-1 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/70 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                              title={`Inspect, triage condition grade, and assign rack/bin location for ${r.rma_number}`}
                            >
                              <ClipboardCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                              <span>Inspect / Triage</span>
                            </button>

                            {/* 3. Assign SKU (for single items if unassigned) */}
                            {!isManifest && res.isUnassigned && (onAssignSku || onEditProductFromReport) && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  if (onAssignSku) onAssignSku(r);
                                  else if (onEditProductFromReport) onEditProductFromReport(r);
                                }}
                                className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:hover:bg-blue-900/70 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                title={`Assign official SKU, pricing, and master vendor for "${res.name || r.barcode}"`}
                              >
                                <Package className="w-3 h-3 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                                <span>Assign SKU</span>
                              </button>
                            )}

                            {/* 4. Official Debit Claim Generation or Viewing */}
                            {existingClaim ? (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => setActiveClaimBatch(existingClaim)}
                                className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-950/70 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/70 text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                title={`View Official RTV Debit Claim Voucher: ${existingClaim.claimNumber || existingClaim.claim_number}`}
                              >
                                <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                                <span>RTV Voucher Active</span>
                              </button>
                            ) : !isClaimable ? (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => {
                                  setFinancialWarningTarget({
                                    item: r,
                                    title: "Assign SKU & Price Required",
                                    message: "Cannot issue RTV Debit Claim for ₱0.00 or unassigned SKU/vendor. Please click 'Assign SKU' first to set the official item price and master supplier."
                                  });
                                }}
                                className="px-2 py-1 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 border border-dashed border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-medium flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs hover:border-amber-400 hover:text-amber-600"
                                title="Cannot issue RTV Debit Claim for ₱0.00 or unassigned vendor. Click 'Assign SKU' first."
                              >
                                <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-500" />
                                <span>+ Debit Claim (₱0.00 / Unassigned)</span>
                              </button>
                            ) : (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleGenerateSingleClaim(r)}
                                disabled={isSavingClaim}
                                className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/70 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
                                title={`Generate RTV Debit Claim Voucher for ${r.rma_number}`}
                              >
                                <Receipt className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                                <span>+ Debit Claim</span>
                              </button>
                            )}

                            {/* 5. Delete Report */}
                            {canDeleteReports && onRequestDeleteReport && (
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => onRequestDeleteReport(r.id, r.rma_number, r)}
                                className="p-1.5 text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-50 dark:hover:bg-rose-950/50 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                title={`Delete RMA #${r.rma_number} and remove stored proof photos`}
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>

                      {/* Expandable Multi-Item Manifest Sub-Table Drawer */}
                      {isManifest && isManifestExpanded && (
                        <tr className="bg-amber-50/40 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-y-2 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/60">
                          <td colSpan={11} className="p-3 sm:p-4">
                            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/90 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/60 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
                              {/* Manifest Header */}
                              <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border-b border-amber-200/80 dark:border-amber-900/50 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <span className="p-1 rounded-md bg-amber-600 text-white">
                                    <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  </span>
                                  <span className="font-extrabold text-xs text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    Supplier RTV Manifest Items ({manifestChildren.length})
                                  </span>
                                  <span className="text-[11px] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 font-mono">
                                    RMA: {r.rma_number}
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                                    Total manifest quantity: <strong className="text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-bold">{res.qty} units</strong>
                                  </span>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => toggleManifestExpand(manifestKey)}
                                    className="text-xs text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 hover:text-amber-900 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-amber-100 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                  >
                                    Collapse ▲
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                              </div>

                              {/* Child Items Table */}
                              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                                  <thead>
                                    <tr className="bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-800/50 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
                                      <th className="py-2 px-2 text-center w-12">#</th>
                                      <th className="py-2 px-3">Product Description / Name</th>
                                      <th className="py-2 px-3 font-mono">Barcode</th>
                                      <th className="py-2 px-3 font-mono">Assigned SKU</th>
                                      <th className="py-2 px-3 text-right">Qty &amp; Unit</th>
                                      <th className="py-2 px-3 text-right">Unit Price</th>
                                      <th className="py-2 px-3 text-right">Total Claim</th>
                                      <th className="py-2 px-3">Triage &amp; Reason</th>
                                      <th className="py-2 px-2 text-center">Actions</th>
                                    </tr>
                                  </thead>
                                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-700/60">
                                    {manifestChildren.map((child, cIdx) => {
                                      const childBarcode = String(child.barcode || '').trim();
                                      const matchedChild = childBarcode ? savedProductsList.find(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode).trim() === childBarcode) : null;
                                      const childName = (child.name || child.productName || matchedChild?.name || `Item #${cIdx + 1}`).trim();
                                      const childRawSku = String(child.code || child.sku || matchedChild?.code || matchedChild?.sku || '').trim();
                                      const isChildSkuValid = Boolean(childRawSku && childRawSku !== childBarcode && !childRawSku.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting'));
                                      const childQty = Number(child.quantity || child.qty) || 1;
                                      const childUnit = child.unit_name || child.unit || r.unit_name || 'pc';
                                      const childPrice = Number(child.price_with_vat || child.price || matchedChild?.price_with_vat || matchedChild?.price || 0);
                                      const childTotal = childQty * childPrice;
                                      const childDisp = child.disposition || r.disposition || '1 - Pending Vendor Pickup';

                                      const childReportItem = {
                                        ...child,
                                        id: child.id || `${r.id || r.rma_number}_item_${childBarcode || cIdx}`,
                                        rma_number: r.rma_number,
                                        barcode: childBarcode,
                                        code: isChildSkuValid ? childRawSku : null,
                                        sku: isChildSkuValid ? childRawSku : null,
                                        name: childName,
                                        quantity: childQty,
                                        unit_name: childUnit,
                                        price: childPrice,
                                        price_with_vat: childPrice,
                                        supplier_name: child.supplier_name || r.supplier_name || 'Savemore',
                                        parent_rma_id: r.id
                                      };

                                      return (
                                        <tr key={childReportItem.id || cIdx} className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors">
                                          <td className="py-2 px-2 text-center font-mono font-bold text-slate-400">
                                            #{cIdx + 1}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-xs" title={childName}>
                                            {childName}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 font-mono text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold">
                                            {childBarcode || '—'}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 font-mono">
                                            {isChildSkuValid ? (
                                              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-[11px]">
                                                {childRawSku}
                                              </span>
                                            ) : (
                                              <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-semibold text-[10px]">
                                                Awaiting SKU
                                              </span>
                                            )}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                                            {formatQuantityWithPackSize(childQty, childUnit, child.pieces_per_case || matchedChild?.pieces_per_case)}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                                            ₱{childPrice.toFixed(2)}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3 text-right font-mono font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">
                                            ₱{childTotal.toFixed(2)}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-3">
                                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800">
                                              {childDisp}
                                            </span>
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-2 px-2 text-center">
                                            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                                              {!isChildSkuValid && onAssignSku && (
                                                <button
                                                  type="button"
                                                  onClick={() => onAssignSku(childReportItem)}
                                                  className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-950/70 dark:text-blue-300 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 cursor-pointer"
                                                  title="Assign SKU"
                                                >
                                                  Assign SKU
                                                </button>
                                              )}
                                              <button
                                                type="button"
                                                onClick={() => handleGenerateSingleClaim(childReportItem)}
                                                disabled={!isChildSkuValid || childPrice <= 0 || isSavingClaim}
                                                className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-950/70 dark:text-amber-300 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-40"
                                                title="Generate individual debit claim"
                                              >
                                                + Claim
                                              </button>
                                            </div>
                                          </td>
                                        </tr>
                                      );
                                    })}
                                  </tbody>
                                </table>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      )}
                    </React.Fragment>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Table Pagination Component */}
        <TablePagination
          currentPage={currentPage}
          totalItems={rtvCandidates.length}
          pageSize={pageSize}
          onPageChange={setCurrentPage}
          onPageSizeChange={(newSize) => {
            setPageSize(newSize);
            setCurrentPage(1);
          }}
          pageSizeOptions={[10, 25, 50, 100]}
          itemLabel="claim items"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Lightbox Modal (Fallback if onViewPhoto is not supplied) */}
      {localLightboxPhoto && (
        <ImageLightboxModal
          isOpen={Boolean(localLightboxPhoto)}
          imageUrl={localLightboxPhoto?.url}
          images={localLightboxPhoto?.images || [localLightboxPhoto.url]}
          initialIndex={localLightboxPhoto?.initialIndex || 0}
          title={localLightboxPhoto?.title}
          subtitle={localLightboxPhoto?.subtitle}
          onClose={() => setLocalLightboxPhoto(null)}
        />
      )}

      {/* FORMAL RTV DEBIT CLAIM VOUCHER MODAL */}
      {activeClaimBatch && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-xs flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 max-w-3xl w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[95vh] animate-in zoom-in-95">
            
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="p-4 sm:px-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-850 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Receipt className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                  Supplier Debit Claim Voucher (RTV)
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  Synced to Database
                </span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveClaimBatch(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white text-xs font-bold"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Printable Voucher Mount */}
            <div id="rtv-voucher-mount" className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-6 text-xs bg-white text-black font-sans">
              
              {/* Header Grid */}
              <div className="border-b-2 border-black pb-4 flex items-start justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-600">

                    {activeClaimBatch.claimNumber || activeClaimBatch.claim_number}

                  {financialWarningTarget.message || "Cannot issue RTV Debit Claim for ₱0.00 or unassigned vendor. Please click 'Assign SKU' first to set the official item price and master supplier."}

              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setFinancialWarningTarget(null)}
                className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer"

                Dismiss
              </button>

                  <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Assign SKU Now</span>
                </button>
              )}

      )}

  );

--- START FILE: src/components/SupplierInput.jsx ---
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Building2, Check, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { catalogService } from '../services/catalogService';

/**
 * Modern Autocomplete Input for Supplier Names
 * - Automatically loads existing suppliers from catalog and RMA returns
 * - Shows instantaneous match suggestions (e.g. typing "Save" suggests "Savemore")
 * - Prevents discrepancies like Savemore vs Save More vs savemore
 */
export default function SupplierInput({
  value = '',
  onChange,
  placeholder = 'e.g. Savemore, Walter Mart, Mondelez',
  className = '',
  id = 'supplier-name-input',
  name = 'supplierName',
  required = false
}) {
  const [knownSuppliers, setKnownSuppliers] = useState([
    'Savemore',
    'Walter Mart',
    'SM Supermarket',
    'Puregold',
    'Robinsons Supermarket',
    'Mondelez',
    'Universal Robina Corporation (URC)',
    'Bonita',
    'Keysys',
    'A2Z2GO',
    'Pingcon Marketing'
  ]);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [highlightedIndex, setHighlightedIndex] = useState(-1);
  const wrapperRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    catalogService.getUniqueSuppliers().then(list => {
      if (mounted && Array.isArray(list) && list.length > 0) {
        setKnownSuppliers(list);
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { mounted = false; };
  }, []);

  // Close on outside click
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(event) {
      if (wrapperRef.current && !wrapperRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
        setIsOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const cleanValue = String(value || '').trim();
  const cleanLower = cleanValue.toLowerCase();

  // Find matches that contain the query
  const matchingSuppliers = knownSuppliers.filter(s => {
    if (!cleanLower) return true;
    return s.toLowerCase().includes(cleanLower);
  });

  // Check if there is a primary suggestion that doesn't exactly match what was typed
  const topSuggestion = matchingSuppliers.find(
    s => s.toLowerCase() !== cleanLower && s.toLowerCase().startsWith(cleanLower)
  ) || matchingSuppliers.find(s => s.toLowerCase() !== cleanLower);

  const handleSelect = (supplier) => {
    onChange(supplier);
    setIsOpen(false);
    setHighlightedIndex(-1);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
    if (!isOpen || matchingSuppliers.length === 0) {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
        setIsOpen(true);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIndex(prev => (prev < matchingSuppliers.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : 0));
    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlightedIndex(prev => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : matchingSuppliers.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      if (highlightedIndex >= 0 && matchingSuppliers[highlightedIndex]) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSelect(matchingSuppliers[highlightedIndex]);
      } else if (topSuggestion) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSelect(topSuggestion);
      }
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full" ref={wrapperRef}>
      <div className="relative">
        <input
          id={id}
          name={name}
          type="text"
          autoComplete="off"
          list="known-suppliers-datalist"
          value={value}
          required={required}
          onChange={(e) => {
            onChange(e.target.value);
            setIsOpen(true);
            setHighlightedIndex(-1);
          }}
          onFocus={() => setIsOpen(true)}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          className={className}
        />

        <datalist id="known-suppliers-datalist">
          {knownSuppliers.map((s) => (
            <option key={s} value={s} />
          ))}
        </datalist>
      </div>

      {/* Quick Suggestion Pill when typing (e.g. typing "Save" suggests "Savemore") */}
      {cleanValue && topSuggestion && cleanLower !== topSuggestion.toLowerCase() && (
        <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] animate-in fade-in">
          <span className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium">Suggestion:</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleSelect(topSuggestion)}
            className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950/70 dark:hover:bg-indigo-900 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 rounded-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-2xs"
            title={`Auto-fill "${topSuggestion}" to prevent discrepancy`}
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-indigo-500" />
            <span>Use "{topSuggestion}"</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Floating Dropdown of Matching Suppliers */}
      {isOpen && matchingSuppliers.length > 0 && cleanValue && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-full mt-1.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl shadow-xl z-50 overflow-hidden max-h-56 overflow-y-auto animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
          <div className="p-1.5">
            <div className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span>Recorded Suppliers</span>
              <span>{matchingSuppliers.length} match{matchingSuppliers.length > 1 ? 'es' : ''}</span>
            </div>
            {matchingSuppliers.slice(0, 8).map((supplier, idx) => {
              const isSelected = supplier.toLowerCase() === cleanLower;
              const isHighlighted = idx === highlightedIndex;

              return (
                <button
                  key={supplier}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSelect(supplier)}
                  className={`w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                    isHighlighted || isSelected
                      ? 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950/60 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 font-bold'
                      : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Building2 className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isSelected ? 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400' : 'text-slate-400'}`} />
                    <span>{supplier}</span>
                  </div>
                  {isSelected && (
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

--- END FILE: src/components/SupplierInput.jsx ---

--- START FILE: src/components/TablePagination.jsx ---
import React from 'react';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';

export default function TablePagination({
  currentPage = 1,
  totalItems = 0,
  pageSize = 10,
  onPageChange,
  onPageSizeChange,
  pageSizeOptions = [10, 25, 50, 100],
  itemLabel = 'items'
}) {
  if (totalItems === 0) return null;

  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalItems / pageSize));
  const startIndex = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize + 1;
  const endIndex = Math.min(totalItems, currentPage * pageSize);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold select-none rounded-b-2xl">
      {/* Left: Rows Per Page & Item Range */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Rows per page:</span>
          <select
            value={pageSize}
            onChange={(e) => {
              if (onPageSizeChange) onPageSizeChange(Number(e.target.value));
              if (onPageChange) onPageChange(1);
            }}
            className="px-2 py-1 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-600 cursor-pointer shadow-xs"
          >
            {pageSizeOptions.map(opt => (
              <option key={opt} value={opt}>{opt}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-700">|</span>

        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          Showing <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{startIndex} - {endIndex}</strong> of <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{totalItems}</strong> {itemLabel}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Right: Page Navigation */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 self-end sm:self-auto">
        <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mr-1.5">
          Page <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{currentPage}</strong> of <strong className="text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{totalPages}</strong>
        </span>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange && onPageChange(Math.max(1, currentPage - 1))}
          disabled={currentPage <= 1}
          className="min-h-[44px] px-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-white dark:disabled:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          title="Previous Page"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>Prev</span>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onPageChange && onPageChange(Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + 1))}
          disabled={currentPage >= totalPages}
          className="min-h-[44px] px-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:hover:bg-white dark:disabled:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all shadow-xs cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          title="Next Page"
        >
          <span>Next</span>
          <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

--- START FILE: src/components/ThermalBoxLabelModal.jsx ---
import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Printer,
  X,
  Download,
  CheckCircle2,
  Package,
  MapPin,
  Calendar,
  Building2,
  Tag,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertTriangle
} from 'lucide-react';
import { QRCodeSVG } from 'qrcode.react';
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { printIsolatedElement } from '../utils/printIsolatedElement';

/**
 * Generates pseudo-Code128 SVG Barcode pattern based on string input
 */
function SimpleBarcodeSVG({ value, height = 36 }) {
  const cleanVal = String(value || '000000000000').trim();
  // Generate deterministic bar widths from character codes
  const bars = [];
  let currentX = 0;

  // Guard quiet zone
  bars.push({ x: 0, width: 4 });
  currentX += 8;

  for (let i = 0; i < cleanVal.length; i++) {
    const code = cleanVal.charCodeAt(i);
    const w1 = ((code % 3) + 1) * 2;
    const w2 = (((code >> 1) % 2) + 1) * 2;
    const w3 = (((code >> 2) % 3) + 1) * 2;

    bars.push({ x: currentX, width: w1 });
    currentX += w1 + 3;
    bars.push({ x: currentX, width: w2 });
    currentX += w2 + 2;
    bars.push({ x: currentX, width: w3 });
    currentX += w3 + 3;
  }

  // End quiet zone
  bars.push({ x: currentX, width: 4 });
  currentX += 8;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
      <svg
        width="100%"
        height={height}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${currentX} ${height}`}
        className="w-full max-h-9 overflow-visible"
        preserveAspectRatio="none"
      >
        {bars.map((bar, idx) => (
          <rect key={idx} x={bar.x} y={0} width={bar.width} height={height} fill="#000000" />
        ))}
      </svg>
      <div className="font-mono text-[10px] tracking-widest font-black text-black mt-0.5">
        *{cleanVal}*
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ThermalBoxLabelModal({
  isOpen,

  const printAreaRef = useRef(null);
  // Dynamic Print Sizing: '4x6' | '3x3' | '2x2' | 'a4'
  const [labelSize, setLabelSize] = useState('4x6');

  if (!isOpen || !report) return null;

  const rmaNumber = report?.rma_number || report?.rmaNumber || 'RMA-PENDING';
  const barcode = report?.barcode || 'N/A';
  const sku = report?.code || report?.sku || 'UNASSIGNED';
  const name = report?.name || report?.productName || 'Returned Merchandise';
  const quantity = report?.quantity || 1;
  const unit = report?.unit_name || report?.unit || 'pc';

  const location = report?.warehouse_location || 'DOCK-INTAKE';
  const grade = report?.condition_grade || 'B - Damaged Packaging Only';

  const inspectedBy = report?.inspected_by || report?.reported_by || 'Warehouse Dock';

  const reporterContact = report?.reporter_contact || report?.reporter_phone || report?.phone || (report?.reported_by && report.reported_by.includes('(') ? report.reported_by.replace(/.*\((.*)\).*/, '$1') : '') || 'N/A';
  const storeBranch = report?.store_branch || report?.store || '';
  const manifestItems = Array.isArray(report?.items) ? report.items : [];
  const isManifest = manifestItems.length > 1 || (report?.total_items && report.total_items > 1);

          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"

              Close
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handlePrint}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-black text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900 dark:hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-xl text-xs font-black flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer"

            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { 
  Search, 
  Filter, 
  Download, 
  QrCode, 
  Building2, 
  Package, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  ExternalLink,
  MapPin,
  ChevronDown,
  Hash
} from 'lucide-react';
import { formatPeso, getEmailRoutingPayload } from '../utils/rmaHelpers';

export default function TicketsVaultTab({ 
  tickets = [], 
  onUpdateTicketStatus, 
  onOpenTicketModal, 
  isTestMode = false 
}) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('ALL');
  const [selectedGroup, setSelectedGroup] = useState('ALL');
  const [expandedTicketId, setExpandedTicketId] = useState(null);

  // Status badge styling helper
  const getStatusBadge = (status) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'Credit Memo Issued':
        return 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-500/30';
      case 'Buffer Replacement':
        return 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300 border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-500/30';
      case 'Approved':
        return 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-500/30';
      case 'In Transit':
        return 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-500/30';
      case 'Rejected':
        return 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/30';
      default:
        return 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700';
    }
  };

  // Filtered tickets
  const filteredTickets = useMemo(() => {
    return tickets.filter(ticket => {
      const matchesSearch = 
        ticket.id?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        ticket.customer_name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        ticket.product_name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        ticket.sku?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
        ticket.ae_name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());

      const matchesStatus = statusFilter === 'ALL' || ticket.status === statusFilter;
      const matchesGroup = selectedGroup === 'ALL' || ticket.group?.includes(selectedGroup);

      return matchesSearch && matchesStatus && matchesGroup;
    });
  }, [tickets, searchTerm, statusFilter, selectedGroup]);

  // Export to CSV
  const handleExportCSV = () => {
    const headers = [
      'Ticket ID',
      'Date',
      'Customer',
      'Branch',
      'Product',
      'SKU',
      'Brand',
      'Serial Numbers',
      'Qty',
      'Unit Price',
      'Total Value (PHP)',
      'Status',
      'Defect Category',
      'AE Name',
      'Credit Memo #',
      'Supplier'
    ];

    const rows = filteredTickets.map(t => [
      t.id,
      new Date(t.created_at).toLocaleDateString(),
      `"${(t.customer_name || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      `"${(t.store_branch || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      `"${(t.product_name || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      t.sku,
      t.brand || '',
      `"${(t.serial_numbers || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      t.quantity,
      t.unit_price,
      t.total_amount,
      t.status,
      `"${(t.defect_category || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`,
      t.ae_name,
      t.credit_memo_no || '',
      t.supplier
    ]);

    const csvContent = 'data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,' + [headers.join(','), ...rows.map(e => e.join(','))].join('\n');
    const encodedUri = encodeURI(csvContent);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.setAttribute('href', encodedUri);
    link.setAttribute('download', `RMA_Vault_Export_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      
      {/* Header & Stats Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>RMA Tickets Vault</span>
            <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-300 font-mono font-bold">
              {filteredTickets.length} of {tickets.length} Records
            </span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
            Complete archive of wholesale returns, return authorization QR codes, and resolution audit trail.
          </p>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={handleExportCSV}
          className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center space-x-2 transition-colors shadow-sm"
        >
          <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
          <span>Export Vault to CSV</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Filter and Search Bar */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm">
        {/* Search Input */}
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-3" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search Ticket ID, SKU, Customer..."
            className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-medium"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Status Filter */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <Filter className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
          <select
            value={statusFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-medium"
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Statuses</option>
            <option value="Pending Inspection">Pending Inspection</option>
            <option value="Approved">Approved</option>
            <option value="In Transit">In Transit</option>
            <option value="Buffer Replacement">Buffer Replacement</option>
            <option value="Credit Memo Issued">Credit Memo Issued</option>
            <option value="Rejected">Rejected</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        {/* Business Group Filter */}
        <div>
          <select
            value={selectedGroup}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedGroup(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-medium"
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Business Groups</option>
            <option value="Group 2">Group 2 (PINGCON & BONITA)</option>
            <option value="Group 1">Group 1 (KEYSYS & A2Z2GO)</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tickets List */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {filteredTickets.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-12 text-center text-slate-500">
            <Package className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mx-auto mb-3" />
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-sm">No RMA tickets found</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Try modifying your search or filter criteria.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          filteredTickets.map((ticket) => {
            const isExpanded = expandedTicketId === ticket.id;

            return (
              <div 
                key={ticket.id}
                className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-sm transition-all space-y-4"
              >
                {/* Primary Row */}
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-mono text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-wide">
                        {ticket.id}
                      </span>
                      <span className={`px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold uppercase border ${getStatusBadge(ticket.status)}`}>
                        {ticket.status}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">
                        {new Date(ticket.created_at).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100">{ticket.customer_name}</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600">•</span>
                      <span className="text-slate-500">{ticket.store_branch}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Actions & QR Code Launch */}
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 self-end sm:self-auto">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => onOpenTicketModal(ticket)}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-brand-50 dark:bg-brand-600/15 hover:bg-brand-100 text-brand-700 dark:text-brand-300 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition-colors border border-brand-200 dark:border-brand-500/30"
                      title="View Printable Return QR Code"
                    >
                      <QrCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-600 dark:text-brand-400" />
                      <span>Return QR</span>
                    </button>

                    {/* Inline Status Changer */}
                    <select
                      value={ticket.status}
                      onChange={(e) => onUpdateTicketStatus(ticket.id, e.target.value)}
                      className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-brand-500 font-medium"
                    >
                      <option value="Pending Inspection">Pending Inspection</option>
                      <option value="Approved">Approved</option>
                      <option value="In Transit">In Transit</option>
                      <option value="Buffer Replacement">Buffer Replacement</option>
                      <option value="Credit Memo Issued">Credit Memo Issued</option>
                      <option value="Rejected">Rejected</option>
                    </select>

                    {/* Expand Toggle */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setExpandedTicketId(isExpanded ? null : ticket.id)}
                      className="p-1.5 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors"
                      title="Expand details"
                    >
                      <ChevronDown className={`w-4 h-4 transition-transform ${isExpanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Second Line: Product Summary Chips */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-xs pt-1 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/80">
                  <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Product & SKU</span>
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block">
                      {ticket.product_name}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">{ticket.sku}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Return Quantity</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono text-sm">{ticket.quantity} Units</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block font-mono">@{formatPeso(ticket.unit_price)}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Total Claim Value</span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono text-sm">{formatPeso(ticket.total_amount)}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 block">{ticket.supplier}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] block">Responsible AE</span>
                    <span className="font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 truncate block">{ticket.ae_name}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 truncate block">{ticket.credit_memo_no ? `CM: ${ticket.credit_memo_no}` : 'CM Pending'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Expanded Details Drawer */}
                {isExpanded && (
                  <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-3 text-xs bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 p-4 rounded-2xl">
                    {ticket.serial_numbers && (
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                        <Hash className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-brand-600" />
                        <span className="font-bold">Serial Numbers:</span>
                        <span className="font-mono">{ticket.serial_numbers}</span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Defect Statement */}
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 block mb-1">
                        Reason: {ticket.defect_category}
                      </span>
                      <p className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                        {ticket.technical_diagnosis}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    {/* Metadata & GPS */}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4 text-slate-500 text-[11px]">
                      {ticket.gps_coordinates && (
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                          <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                          <span>GPS: {ticket.gps_coordinates}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div>
                        <span>Invoice: </span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{ticket.invoice_no || 'N/A'}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span>Group: </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">{ticket.group}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Photos Preview */}
                    {ticket.photos && ticket.photos.length > 0 && (
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px] font-medium block mb-1.5">Defect Documentation Photos:</span>
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                          {ticket.photos.map((p, idx) => (
                            <a key={idx} href={p} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="relative w-16 h-16 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 group shrink-0">
                              <img src={p} alt="Defect" className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
                              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 flex items-center justify-center transition-opacity">
                                <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white" />
                              </div>
                            </a>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

              </div>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
