--- START FILE: src/services/accessKeyService.js ---
import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { getDeviceFingerprint } from '../utils/deviceFingerprint';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'rma_portal_access_keys_v2';
const SETTINGS_KEY = 'portal_access_keys_store';
const SESSION_KEY = 'rma_portal_gate_session';
const ATTEMPTS_KEY = 'rma_gate_pin_attempts_';
const DELETED_KEY = 'rma_deleted_access_slugs';

function getDeletedSlugs() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(DELETED_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function addDeletedSlug(slug) {
  if (!slug) return;
  try {
    const list = getDeletedSlugs();
    const clean = String(slug).trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!list.includes(clean)) {
      list.push(clean);
      localStorage.setItem(DELETED_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    }
  } catch {}
}

export const DEFAULT_ACCESS_PROFILES = [
  {
    id: 'wh-dock-main-default',
    name: 'Main Warehouse Floor',
    type: 'internal_warehouse',
    access_slug: 'dock',
    pin_code: '123456',
    session_duration_hours: 0, // 0 = No Expiry (Permanent)
    cooldown_duration_hours: 0, // 0 = Cooldown Disabled
    is_active: true,
    created_by: 'System Default',
    created_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    updated_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
  },
  {
    id: 'cust-delivery-box-default',
    name: 'Customer Delivery Boxes',
    type: 'external_customer',
    access_slug: 'returns',
    pin_code: '654321',
    session_duration_hours: 2, // 2 Hours per device
    cooldown_duration_hours: 6, // 6 Hours Cooldown Lockout
    is_active: true,
    created_by: 'System Default',
    created_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',
    updated_at: '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
  }
];

export const accessKeyService = {
  /**
   * GET ALL QR ACCESS PROFILES
   * 1. Query public.portal_access_keys table (if exists)
   * 2. Fallback to Supabase rma_settings table (key: 'portal_access_keys_store')
   * 3. Fallback to localStorage / DEFAULT_ACCESS_PROFILES
   */
  async getProfiles() {
    let remoteProfiles = null;

    // 1. Try dedicated table in Supabase
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('portal_access_keys')
        .select('*')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

      if (!error && Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) {
        remoteProfiles = data;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Table may not exist yet in database
    }

    // 2. Fallback to rma_settings store
    if (!remoteProfiles) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('rma_settings')
          .select('value')
          .eq('key', SETTINGS_KEY)
          .single();

        if (!error && data?.value && Array.isArray(data.value) && data.value.length > 0) {
          remoteProfiles = data.value;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // Settings table notice
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback to localStorage
    let localProfiles = [];
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        localProfiles = JSON.parse(raw);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // Merge: Defaults -> LocalStorage -> Remote Supabase
    const profileMap = new Map();
    const deletedSlugs = getDeletedSlugs();

    DEFAULT_ACCESS_PROFILES.forEach(p => {
      if (!deletedSlugs.includes(p.access_slug.toLowerCase())) {
        profileMap.set(p.access_slug.toLowerCase(), p);
      }
    });
    localProfiles.forEach(p => {
      if (p.access_slug && !deletedSlugs.includes(p.access_slug.toLowerCase())) {
        profileMap.set(p.access_slug.toLowerCase(), p);
      }
    });
    (remoteProfiles || []).forEach(p => {
      if (p.access_slug && !deletedSlugs.includes(p.access_slug.toLowerCase())) {
        profileMap.set(p.access_slug.toLowerCase(), p);
      }
    });

    const merged = Array.from(profileMap.values()).sort((a, b) => {
      const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
      const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
      return dateB - dateA;
    });

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));
    } catch (e) {}

    return merged;
  },

  /**
   * GET PROFILE BY SLUG
   */
  async getProfileBySlug(slug) {
    if (!slug) return null;
    const cleanSlug = String(slug).trim().toLowerCase();
    const all = await this.getProfiles();
    return all.find(p => p.access_slug.toLowerCase() === cleanSlug) || null;
  },

  /**
   * CREATE / SAVE NEW QR ACCESS PROFILE
   */
  async createProfile({
    name,
    type = 'internal_warehouse',
    accessSlug,
    pinCode,
    sessionDurationHours = 0,
    cooldownDurationHours = 6,
    createdBy = 'Admin'
  }) {
    if (!name || !name.trim()) throw new Error('Profile name is required');
    if (!pinCode || !/^\d{6}$/.test(String(pinCode).trim())) {
      throw new Error('PIN must be exactly 6 numeric digits (0-9)');
    }

    const cleanName = name.trim();
    let cleanSlug = (accessSlug || cleanName)
      .toLowerCase()
      .trim()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');

    if (!cleanSlug) cleanSlug = `gate-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;

    // Ensure unique slug
    const existing = await this.getProfiles();
    if (existing.some(p => p.access_slug === cleanSlug)) {
      cleanSlug = `${cleanSlug}-${Math.floor(100 + Math.random() * 900)}`;
    }

    const newProfile = {
      id: `key_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`,
      name: cleanName,
      type: type === 'external_customer' ? 'external_customer' : 'internal_warehouse',
      access_slug: cleanSlug,
      pin_code: String(pinCode).trim(),
      session_duration_hours: Math.max(0, parseFloat(sessionDurationHours) || 0),
      cooldown_duration_hours: type === 'internal_warehouse' ? 0 : Math.max(0, parseFloat(cooldownDurationHours) || 0),
      is_active: true,
      created_by: createdBy || 'Admin',
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    // 1. Try Supabase table
    try {
      await supabase.from('portal_access_keys').insert([newProfile]);
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Persist to rma_settings
    const updatedList = [newProfile, ...existing];
    try {
      await supabase.from('rma_settings').upsert({
        key: SETTINGS_KEY,
        value: updatedList,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {}

    return newProfile;
  },

  /**
   * UPDATE PROFILE (PIN, Duration, Name, Cooldown, Status)
   */
  async updateProfile(idOrSlug, updates) {
    const existing = await this.getProfiles();
    const targetIdx = existing.findIndex(p => p.id === idOrSlug || p.access_slug === idOrSlug);
    if (targetIdx === -1) throw new Error('Access profile not found');

    const updatedProfile = {
      ...existing[targetIdx],
      ...updates,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    if (updates.pin_code && !/^\d{6}$/.test(String(updates.pin_code).trim())) {
      throw new Error('PIN must be exactly 6 numeric digits');
    }

    existing[targetIdx] = updatedProfile;

    // 1. Try Supabase table
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('portal_access_keys')
        .update(updatedProfile)
        .eq('access_slug', updatedProfile.access_slug);
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Persist to rma_settings
    try {
      await supabase.from('rma_settings').upsert({
        key: SETTINGS_KEY,
        value: existing,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(existing));
    } catch (e) {}

    return updatedProfile;
  },

  /**
   * DELETE PROFILE (Permanently removes QR access profile and records tombstone)
   */
  async deleteProfile(idOrSlug) {
    if (!idOrSlug) return false;
    const existing = await this.getProfiles();
    const target = existing.find(p => p.id === idOrSlug || p.access_slug?.toLowerCase() === String(idOrSlug).toLowerCase());
    if (!target) return false;

    // Record tombstone to prevent resurrection from default profiles
    addDeletedSlug(target.access_slug);

    const filtered = existing.filter(p => p.id !== target.id && p.access_slug?.toLowerCase() !== target.access_slug.toLowerCase());

    // 1. Delete from Supabase dedicated table
    try {
      await supabase.from('portal_access_keys').delete().eq('access_slug', target.access_slug);
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Update rma_settings
    try {
      await supabase.from('rma_settings').upsert({
        key: SETTINGS_KEY,
        value: filtered,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    // 3. Update localStorage
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(filtered));
    } catch (e) {}

    // 4. If current device session was for this slug, clear it
    const active = this.getActiveSession();
    if (active && active.slug?.toLowerCase() === target.access_slug.toLowerCase()) {
      this.clearSession();
    }

    return true;
  },

  /**
   * VERIFY PIN WITH SERVER-SIDE ANTI-FRAUD COOLDOWN ENGINE & BRUTE-FORCE PROTECTION
   */
  async verifyPin(slug, inputPin) {
    const profile = await this.getProfileBySlug(slug);
    if (!profile) {
      return { success: false, error: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'QR Access Profile not found.' };
    }

    if (!profile.is_active) {
      return { success: false, error: 'INACTIVE', message: 'This QR Access Code is currently inactive.' };
    }

    // Check rate limit on device
    const attemptKey = `${ATTEMPTS_KEY}${slug}`;
    let attemptsData = { count: 0, lockedUntil: 0 };
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(attemptKey);
      if (raw) attemptsData = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (e) {}

    const now = Date.now();
    if (attemptsData.lockedUntil && attemptsData.lockedUntil > now) {
      const secondsLeft = Math.ceil((attemptsData.lockedUntil - now) / 1000);
      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'LOCKED',
        secondsLeft,
        message: `Too many incorrect attempts. Please wait ${secondsLeft}s before retrying.`
      };
    }

    const cleanInput = String(inputPin || '').trim();
    const deviceFingerprint = await getDeviceFingerprint();

    // 1. PRIMARY: Call unbypassable server-side verification endpoint
    try {
      const resp = await fetch('/api/v1/auth/verify-pin', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          slug: profile.access_slug,
          pin: cleanInput,
          deviceFingerprint
        })
      });

      const data = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));

      // HTTP 429: Active Cooldown Lockout
      if (resp.status === 429 || data.error === 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE') {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE',
          message: data.message || 'Return Window Currently Locked',
          cooldownRemainingMinutes: data.cooldownRemainingMinutes || 60,
          unlocksAt: data.unlocksAt,
          sessionExpiresAt: data.sessionExpiresAt,
          profileName: data.profileName || profile.name,
          cooldownDurationHours: data.cooldownDurationHours || profile.cooldown_duration_hours || 6
        };
      }

      // HTTP 200: Successful authentication
      if (resp.ok && data.success && data.session) {
        try { localStorage.removeItem(attemptKey); } catch (e) {}
        try { 
          localStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(data.session)); 
          if (data.session.cooldownUntil) {
            localStorage.setItem(`rma_last_session_${data.session.slug?.toLowerCase()}`, JSON.stringify(data.session));
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        return { success: true, profile: data.profile || profile, session: data.session };
      }

      // HTTP 401: Invalid PIN
      if (resp.status === 401 || data.error === 'INVALID_PIN') {
        const newCount = (attemptsData.count || 0) + 1;
        let lockedUntil = 0;
        if (newCount >= 5) lockedUntil = now + 30000;
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(attemptKey, JSON.stringify({ count: newCount >= 5 ? 0 : newCount, lockedUntil }));
        } catch (e) {}

        return {
          success: false,
          error: 'INVALID_PIN',
          remainingAttempts: Math.max(0, 5 - newCount),
          isLocked: lockedUntil > 0,
          message: lockedUntil > 0 
            ? 'Too many incorrect attempts. Locked for 30 seconds.'
            : 'Incorrect 6-digit PIN. Please retry.'
        };
      }

      if (data.message && !resp.ok) {
        return { success: false, error: data.error || 'ERROR', message: data.message };
      }
    } catch (netErr) {
      console.warn('API endpoint unreachable; using direct Supabase anti-fraud fallback:', netErr);
    }

    // 2. FALLBACK: Direct Supabase Cooldown Check & PIN verification
    // Checks public.device_intake_sessions directly so cooldowns are NEVER bypassed
    try {
      if (profile.type === 'external_customer' && Number(profile.session_duration_hours) > 0) {
        const { data: dbSessions } = await supabase
          .from('device_intake_sessions')
          .select('*')
          .eq('device_fingerprint', deviceFingerprint)
          .eq('access_slug', profile.access_slug)
          .order('cooldown_until', { ascending: false })
          .limit(1);

        if (dbSessions && dbSessions.length > 0) {
          const s = dbSessions[0];
          const cooldownDate = new Date(s.cooldown_until);
          const expiresDate = new Date(s.session_expires_at);
          const nowDate = new Date();

          if (nowDate >= expiresDate && nowDate < cooldownDate) {
            const diffMs = cooldownDate.getTime() - nowDate.getTime();
            const cooldownRemainingMinutes = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(diffMs / (60 * 1000)));
            return {
              success: false,
              error: 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE',
              message: 'Return Window Currently Locked: Your previous RMA session has concluded.',
              cooldownRemainingMinutes,
              unlocksAt: s.cooldown_until,
              sessionExpiresAt: s.session_expires_at,
              profileName: profile.name,
              cooldownDurationHours: profile.cooldown_duration_hours || 6
            };
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // Verify PIN locally
    const cleanExpected = String(profile.pin_code || '').trim();
    if (cleanInput === cleanExpected) {
      try { localStorage.removeItem(attemptKey); } catch (e) {}
      const session = this.createSession(profile);

      // Async record session in Supabase
      if (profile.type === 'external_customer') {
        const durationHours = Number(profile.session_duration_hours || 2);
        const cooldownHours = Number(profile.cooldown_duration_hours !== undefined ? profile.cooldown_duration_hours : 6);
        const nowIso = new Date().toISOString();
        const sessionExpiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + (durationHours * 3600 * 1000)).toISOString();
        const cooldownUntil = new Date(new Date(sessionExpiresAt).getTime() + (cooldownHours * 3600 * 1000)).toISOString();

        supabase.from('device_intake_sessions').insert([{
          access_slug: profile.access_slug,
          device_fingerprint: deviceFingerprint,
          ip_address: 'client-direct',
          session_started_at: nowIso,
          session_expires_at: sessionExpiresAt,
          cooldown_until: cooldownUntil,
          status: 'active'
        }]).then(() => {}).catch(() => {});
      }

      return { success: true, profile, session };
    } else {
      const newCount = (attemptsData.count || 0) + 1;
      let lockedUntil = 0;
      if (newCount >= 5) lockedUntil = now + 30000;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(attemptKey, JSON.stringify({ count: newCount >= 5 ? 0 : newCount, lockedUntil }));
      } catch (e) {}

      return {
        success: false,
        error: 'INVALID_PIN',
        remainingAttempts: Math.max(0, 5 - newCount),
        isLocked: lockedUntil > 0,
        message: lockedUntil > 0 
          ? 'Too many incorrect attempts. Locked for 30 seconds.'
          : 'Incorrect 6-digit PIN. Please retry.'
      };
    }
  },

  /**
   * CHECK DEVICE COOLDOWN STATUS
   * Authoritatively checks if current device is in active cooldown for a given slug.
   * Auto-unlocks if an admin has cleared cooldowns or deleted the session.
   */
  async checkDeviceCooldown(slug, passedProfile = null) {
    if (!slug) return null;
    const cleanSlug = String(slug).trim().toLowerCase();

    // 0. Resolve profile to check cooldown_reset_at watermark
    let profile = passedProfile;
    if (!profile) {
      try {
        profile = await this.getProfileBySlug(cleanSlug);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    const resetTimestamp = profile?.cooldown_reset_at ? new Date(profile.cooldown_reset_at).getTime() : 0;

    // 1. Invalidate local cache if created before an admin emergency reset
    try {
      const cached = localStorage.getItem(`rma_last_session_${cleanSlug}`);
      if (cached) {
        const s = JSON.parse(cached);
        const sessionCreated = new Date(s.unlockedAt || s.created_at || s.expiresAt || 0).getTime();

        if (resetTimestamp > 0 && sessionCreated > 0 && sessionCreated <= resetTimestamp) {
          localStorage.removeItem(`rma_last_session_${cleanSlug}`);
        } else if (s.cooldownUntil) {
          const cdTime = new Date(s.cooldownUntil).getTime();
          if (Date.now() >= cdTime) {
            localStorage.removeItem(`rma_last_session_${cleanSlug}`);
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Hardware fingerprint & Supabase remote check (AUTHORITATIVE SOURCE OF TRUTH)
    try {
      const deviceFingerprint = await getDeviceFingerprint();

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('device_intake_sessions')
        .select('*')
        .eq('access_slug', cleanSlug)
        .eq('device_fingerprint', deviceFingerprint)
        .order('cooldown_until', { ascending: false })
        .limit(1);

      // If NO session in database (admin cleared cooldowns or session expired), WIPE local cache and unlock!
      if (!error && (!data || data.length === 0)) {
        try {
          localStorage.removeItem(`rma_last_session_${cleanSlug}`);
        } catch (e) {}
        return null; // FULLY UNLOCKED FOR ALL DEVICES!
      }

      if (!error && Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) {
        const s = data[0];
        const sessionCreated = new Date(s.session_started_at || s.created_at || 0).getTime();

        // If session was created prior to admin emergency reset watermark, wipe local cache & unlock
        if (resetTimestamp > 0 && sessionCreated > 0 && sessionCreated <= resetTimestamp) {
          try {
            localStorage.removeItem(`rma_last_session_${cleanSlug}`);
          } catch (e) {}
          return null;
        }

        const now = new Date();
        const cooldownDate = new Date(s.cooldown_until);
        const expiresDate = new Date(s.session_expires_at);

        if (now >= expiresDate && now < cooldownDate) {
          const diffMs = cooldownDate.getTime() - now.getTime();
          return {
            isCooldownActive: true,
            cooldownRemainingMinutes: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(diffMs / (60 * 1000))),
            unlocksAt: s.cooldown_until,
            sessionExpiresAt: s.session_expires_at,
            profileName: profile?.name || cleanSlug,
            cooldownDurationHours: profile?.cooldown_duration_hours || 6
          };
        } else {
          // Cooldown naturally over
          try {
            localStorage.removeItem(`rma_last_session_${cleanSlug}`);
          } catch (e) {}
          return null;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Remote cooldown check notice:', e.message);
    }

    return null;
  },

  /**
   * ADMIN EMERGENCY RESET / CLEAR COOLDOWNS
   * Instantly unlocks all physical devices for a given QR profile.
   */
  async emergencyResetCooldowns(slug, profileId = null) {
    const cleanSlug = String(slug || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const resetTimestamp = new Date().toISOString();

    // 1. Clear local session cache on admin machine
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(`rma_last_session_${cleanSlug}`);
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Direct Supabase delete from device_intake_sessions (removes all device locks)
    try {
      if (cleanSlug) {
        await supabase.from('device_intake_sessions').delete().eq('access_slug', cleanSlug);
      }
      if (profileId) {
        await supabase.from('device_intake_sessions').delete().eq('profile_id', profileId);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Device intake sessions delete notice:', e.message);
    }

    // 3. Update cooldown_reset_at watermark in portal_access_keys & rma_settings
    try {
      if (cleanSlug) {
        await supabase
          .from('portal_access_keys')
          .update({ cooldown_reset_at: resetTimestamp, updated_at: resetTimestamp })
          .eq('access_slug', cleanSlug);
      }

      // Update rma_settings store
      const allProfiles = await this.getProfiles();
      const updatedList = allProfiles.map(p => {
        if (p.access_slug.toLowerCase() === cleanSlug || (profileId && p.id === profileId)) {
          return { ...p, cooldown_reset_at: resetTimestamp, updated_at: resetTimestamp };
        }
        return p;
      });

      await supabase.from('rma_settings').upsert({
        key: SETTINGS_KEY,
        value: updatedList,
        updated_at: resetTimestamp
      });

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Profile cooldown_reset_at watermark notice:', e.message);
    }

    // 4. Real-time broadcast to instantly unlock all live phones and browser tabs
    try {
      const channel = supabase.channel('gatekeeper_cooldown_bus');
      channel.send({
        type: 'broadcast',
        event: 'cooldown_cleared',
        payload: { slug: cleanSlug, profileId, resetAt: resetTimestamp }
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.BroadcastChannel) {
        const bc = new BroadcastChannel('rma_portal_sync_bus');
        bc.postMessage({ type: 'cooldown_cleared', slug: cleanSlug, resetAt: resetTimestamp });
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    return true;
  },

  /**
   * CREATE ENCRYPTED SESSION TOKEN ON DEVICE
   */
  createSession(profile) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const durationHours = Number(profile.session_duration_hours || 0);
    const cooldownHours = Number(profile.cooldown_duration_hours !== undefined ? profile.cooldown_duration_hours : 6);
    const expiresAt = durationHours > 0 
      ? new Date(now + (durationHours * 3600 * 1000)).toISOString() 
      : null; // null = No Expiry (Permanent)

    const cooldownUntil = (durationHours > 0 && cooldownHours > 0 && expiresAt)
      ? new Date(new Date(expiresAt).getTime() + (cooldownHours * 3600 * 1000)).toISOString()
      : null;

    const token = `gate_${profile.access_slug}_${now.toString(36)}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}`;

    const sessionPayload = {
      token,
      slug: profile.access_slug,
      profileId: profile.id,
      profileName: profile.name,
      type: profile.type,
      durationHours,
      cooldownDurationHours: cooldownHours,
      unlockedAt: new Date(now).toISOString(),
      expiresAt,
      cooldownUntil
    };

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(sessionPayload));
      if (cooldownUntil) {
        localStorage.setItem(`rma_last_session_${profile.access_slug.toLowerCase()}`, JSON.stringify(sessionPayload));
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    return sessionPayload;
  },

  /**
   * CHECK IF ACTIVE VALID SESSION EXISTS ON DEVICE
   */
  getActiveSession(targetSlug = null) {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY);
      if (!raw) return null;

      const session = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (!session || !session.token) return null;

      // If specific targetSlug is provided, check matching slug
      if (targetSlug && session.slug?.toLowerCase() !== targetSlug.toLowerCase()) {
        return null;
      }

      // Check expiration for temporary customer sessions
      if (session.expiresAt) {
        const expTime = new Date(session.expiresAt).getTime();
        if (Date.now() >= expTime) {
          // If session expired and cooldown applies, ensure last session cache is preserved
          if (session.cooldownUntil) {
            try {
              localStorage.setItem(`rma_last_session_${session.slug?.toLowerCase()}`, JSON.stringify(session));
            } catch (e) {}
          }
          // Expired -> Clean up active session
          localStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
          return null;
        }
      }

      return session;
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  },

  /**
   * CLEAR SESSION (LOGOUT DEVICE FROM GATEKEEPER)
   */
  clearSession(slug = null) {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const session = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (session && session.slug && session.cooldownUntil) {
          localStorage.setItem(`rma_last_session_${session.slug.toLowerCase()}`, JSON.stringify(session));
        }
      }
      localStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
    } catch (e) {}
  },

  /**
   * TEST MODE ACTIVE CHECK
   */
  isTestModeActive() {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true';
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }
};

// Cross-tab broadcast channel for instantaneous authentication synchronization
const authChannel = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.BroadcastChannel 
  ? new BroadcastChannel('rma_auth_bus') 
  : null;

export const authService = {
  getHrApiKey() {
    return localStorage.getItem(HR_API_KEY_STORAGE) || import.meta.env.VITE_HR_API_KEY || '';
  },

  setHrApiKey(key) {
    if (key) localStorage.setItem(HR_API_KEY_STORAGE, key.trim());
    else localStorage.removeItem(HR_API_KEY_STORAGE);
  },

  getCurrentUser() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
      return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Complete, secure logout across all local caches and broadcast to all open tabs
   */
  async logout() {
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
      localStorage.removeItem('rma_portal_admin_session');
      localStorage.removeItem('rma_admin_session_v2');
      localStorage.removeItem('rma_quick_auth_admin');
      
      sessionStorage.removeItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY);
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_portal_admin_session');
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_admin_session_v2');
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_quick_auth_admin');
      sessionStorage.removeItem('rma_login_pending_email');
      
      // Clear any cached OTPs
      try {
        Object.keys(sessionStorage).forEach(k => {
          if (k.startsWith('otp_')) sessionStorage.removeItem(k);
        });
      } catch (e) {}

      // Broadcast logout across all tabs immediately
      try {
        authChannel?.postMessage({ type: 'LOGOUT', timestamp: Date.now() });
        localStorage.setItem('rma_logout_sync', String(Date.now()));
      } catch (e) {}

      await supabase.auth.signOut({ scope: 'local' }).catch(() => {});
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Supabase auth signOut notice:', e);
    }
  },

  /**
   * Listen for logout or session changes across tabs
   */
  onAuthChange(callback) {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};
    
    const handleBroadcast = (e) => {
      if (e.data?.type === 'LOGOUT') callback({ type: 'LOGOUT' });
    };

    const handleStorage = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'rma_logout_sync' || (e.key === AUTH_STORAGE_KEY && !e.newValue)) {
        callback({ type: 'LOGOUT' });
      }
    };

    authChannel?.addEventListener('message', handleBroadcast);
    window.addEventListener('storage', handleStorage);

    return () => {
      authChannel?.removeEventListener('message', handleBroadcast);
      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorage);
    };
  },

  /**
   * Fetch employee directory from Supabase admin_users table
   */
  async getEmployees() {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('admin_users')
        .select('*')
        .order('role', { ascending: true })
        .order('name', { ascending: true });

      if (error || !data || data.length === 0) {
        return DEFAULT_EMPLOYEES;
      }
      return data;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Error fetching employees from Supabase:', e);
      return DEFAULT_EMPLOYEES;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Sync active employees from Pingcon HR Center API
   * Strictly extracts COMPANY EMAILS from the HR system/sheet, ignoring personal accounts.
   * Endpoint: https://hr-center-pingcon.laravel.cloud/api/v1/employees
   */
  async syncFromHRCenter(apiKey) {
    const key = apiKey || this.getHrApiKey();
    if (!key) {
      throw new Error('HR Center API Key is required. Please obtain your key from the developer tools.');
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch('https://hr-center-pingcon.laravel.cloud/api/v1/employees?per_page=150', {
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${key.trim()}`,
          'Accept': 'application/json'
        }
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HR Center API returned status ${res.status}: ${res.statusText}`);
      }

      const json = await res.json();
      const hrList = Array.isArray(json) ? json : (json.data || []);

      if (!hrList.length) {
        return { count: 0, message: 'No employees found in HR Center response.' };
      }

      // Upsert into Supabase admin_users with COMPANY EMAIL PRIORITY
      const rows = [];
      for (const emp of hrList) {
        // Look for company email field
        const companyEmail = (
          emp.company_email ||
          emp.companyEmail ||
          emp.company_email_address ||
          emp.work_email ||
          emp.official_email ||
          emp.corporate_email ||
          ''
        ).toLowerCase().trim();

        let chosenEmail = companyEmail;

        // Fallback only if no designated company email, and ensure it is NOT a personal email
        if (!chosenEmail || chosenEmail === 'n/a') {
          const rawEmail = (emp.email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
          if (rawEmail && !rawEmail.includes('@gmail.com') && !rawEmail.includes('@yahoo.com') && !rawEmail.includes('@hotmail.com')) {
            chosenEmail = rawEmail;
          }
        }

        // If this is Danilo Alvaro, enforce finance2@keysysincorporated.com as Super Admin
        const empName = emp.full_name || emp.name || `${emp.first_name || ''} ${emp.last_name || ''}`.trim() || 'Employee';
        const isDanilo = empName.toLowerCase().includes('danilo') && empName.toLowerCase().includes('alvaro');

        if (isDanilo) {
          chosenEmail = 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com';
        }

        if (!chosenEmail || chosenEmail === 'n/a') {
          continue; // Skip employees without a valid company email
        }

        rows.push({
          name: isDanilo ? 'Danilo Alvaro Jr. (Super Admin)' : empName,
          email: chosenEmail,
          role: isDanilo ? 'super_admin' : (emp.role || 'inventory_staff'),
          is_active: emp.status !== 'resigned' && emp.status !== 'inactive' && emp.is_active !== false,
          department: emp.department || emp.department_name || (isDanilo ? 'Finance Systems / IT' : 'General')
        });
      }

      // Upsert rows into Supabase admin_users
      for (const row of rows) {
        await supabase
          .from('admin_users')
          .upsert([row], { onConflict: 'email' });
      }

      this.setHrApiKey(key);
      return { 
        count: rows.length, 
        message: `Successfully synchronized ${rows.length} company employee accounts with official company emails!` 
      };
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to sync from HR Center API: ${err.message}`);
    }
  },

  /**
   * Super Admin action: Toggle active vs resigned status

  async setEmployeeStatus(id, email, isActive) {
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('admin_users')

  async setEmployeeRole(email, role) {

  },

  /**
   * Super Admin action: Add new employee with company email
   */
  async addEmployee({ name, email, role = 'inventory_staff', department = 'General' }) {
    const cleanEmail = email.toLowerCase().trim();
    const row = {
      name: name.trim(),
      email: cleanEmail,
      role,
      is_active: true,
      department: department.trim()
    };

    const { error } = await supabase

      .upsert([row], { onConflict: 'email' });

    return { success: true };
  },

  /**
   * OTP DISPATCH:
   * 1. Checks if email belongs to authorized company employee directory
   * 2. Checks if employee is ACTIVE (blocks resigned accounts)
   * 3. Generates OTP token in database for verification redundancy
   * 4. Dispatches genuine email via Supabase Auth signInWithOtp (using custom SMTP from finance2@keysysincorporated.com)
   */
  async requestOtp(email) {
    const cleanEmail = (email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!cleanEmail) throw new Error('Please enter your company email address.');

    // 1. Check employee directory in Supabase
    let employee = null;
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('admin_users')
        .select('*')
        .eq('email', cleanEmail)
        .limit(1);

      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
        employee = data[0];
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Supabase employee lookup notice:', e);
    }

    // Fallback to initial company employees
    if (!employee) {
      employee = DEFAULT_EMPLOYEES.find(e => e.email.toLowerCase() === cleanEmail);
    }

    if (!employee) {
      throw new Error(`Access Blocked: "${cleanEmail}" is not recognized as an authorized company employee email. Please use your official company email address.`);
    }

    // 2. Check if employee is resigned
    if (employee.is_active === false) {
      throw new Error(`Access Blocked: This employee account (${cleanEmail}) is marked as RESIGNED or INACTIVE. Access denied.`);
    }

    // 3. Generate 6-digit OTP code for local/database fallback
    const otpCode = String(Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000));
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(); // 10 minutes

    // Save to otp_tokens table
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('otp_tokens')
        .insert([{
          email: cleanEmail,
          otp_code: otpCode,
          expires_at: expiresAt,
          is_used: false
        }]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('OTP token insert notice:', e);
    }

    // Store in session cache
    sessionStorage.setItem(`otp_${cleanEmail}`, JSON.stringify({
      code: otpCode,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000
    }));

    // 4. Trigger Real Supabase Auth Email Dispatch via Custom SMTP
    let emailDispatched = false;
    let rateLimited = false;
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({
        email: cleanEmail,
        options: {
          shouldCreateUser: true,
          emailRedirectTo: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? `${window.location.origin}/admin` : undefined
        }
      });
      if (!error) {
        emailDispatched = true;
        console.log(`[Supabase Auth] Real email OTP dispatched to ${cleanEmail}`);
      } else {
        console.warn('[Supabase Auth] signInWithOtp notice:', error.message);
        if (error.message && (error.message.includes('security purposes') || error.message.includes('429') || error.status === 429)) {
          rateLimited = true;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[Supabase Auth] Dispatch error:', e);
    }

    // 5. Dual dispatch guarantee: If Supabase was rate-limited or failed, dispatch via our verified Google SMTP endpoint
    if (!emailDispatched) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/send-email', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            from: 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com',
            fromName: 'Keysys RMA Portal (Authentication)',
            to: cleanEmail,
            subject: `Your RMA Portal Verification Code: ${otpCode}`,
            html: `
              <div style="font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; max-width: 500px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 16px; background: #ffffff;">
                <div style="background: #1e3a8a; padding: 20px; border-radius: 12px; color: #ffffff; text-align: center;">
                  <h2 style="margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800;">Wholesale RMA Portal</h2>
                  <div style="font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.85; margin-top: 4px;">Staff Verification Code</div>
                </div>
                <div style="padding: 24px 16px; text-align: center;">
                  <p style="font-size: 13px; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 8px;">Hello <strong>${employee.name}</strong>,</p>
                  <p style="font-size: 13px; color: #64748b;">Your one-time login verification code for the RMA Operations Portal is:</p>
                  <div style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 6px; color: #1e3a8a; margin: 20px 0; padding: 16px; background: #f8fafc; border: 2px dashed #cbd5e1; border-radius: 12px;">
                    ${otpCode}
                  </div>
                  <p style="font-size: 11px; color: #94a3b8;">This code is valid for 10 minutes. If you did not request this code, you may safely ignore this email.</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            `,
            text: `Your RMA Portal verification code is: ${otpCode}. Valid for 10 minutes.`
          })
        });
        emailDispatched = true;
        console.log(`[Direct SMTP] Fallback OTP email successfully dispatched to ${cleanEmail}`);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Fallback direct OTP email dispatch notice:', err);
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      email: cleanEmail,
      sender: 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com',
      employeeName: employee.name,
      role: employee.role,
      emailDispatched,
      rateLimited,
      message: rateLimited 
        ? `A verification code was already dispatched to ${cleanEmail}. Please check your inbox or spam.` 
        : `OTP sent to ${cleanEmail}. Valid for 10 minutes.`
    };
  },

  /**
   * VERIFY OTP & CREATE SESSION
   * Verifies against Supabase Auth, or database otp_tokens table
   */
  async verifyOtp(email, enteredCode) {
    const cleanEmail = (email || '').toLowerCase().trim();
    const cleanCode = (enteredCode || '').trim();

    if (!cleanCode) throw new Error('Please enter the OTP verification code.');

    let isValid = false;

    // 1a. Attempt verification with Supabase Auth OTP (type: 'email')
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({
        email: cleanEmail,
        token: cleanCode,
        type: 'email'
      });
      if (!error && (data?.session || data?.user)) {
        isValid = true;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Supabase Auth verify notice:', e);
    }

    // 1b. Attempt verification with Supabase Auth OTP (type: 'signup' for newly registered company accounts)
    if (!isValid) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({
          email: cleanEmail,
          token: cleanCode,
          type: 'signup'
        });
        if (!error && (data?.session || data?.user)) {
          isValid = true;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 1c. Attempt verification with token_hash (if user pastes token from email link)
    if (!isValid && cleanCode.length > 20) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({
          token_hash: cleanCode,
          type: 'signup'
        });
        if (!error && (data?.session || data?.user)) {
          isValid = true;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 2. Fallback: Check Supabase otp_tokens table
    if (!isValid) {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('otp_tokens')
          .select('*')
          .eq('email', cleanEmail)
          .eq('otp_code', cleanCode)
          .eq('is_used', false)
          .gt('expires_at', new Date().toISOString())
          .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
          .limit(1);

        if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
          isValid = true;
          // Mark as used
          await supabase
            .from('otp_tokens')
            .update({ is_used: true })
            .eq('id', data[0].id);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Supabase OTP verify error:', e);
      }
    }

    // 3. Fallback: Check session cache
    if (!isValid) {
      try {
        const cached = sessionStorage.getItem(`otp_${cleanEmail}`);
        if (cached) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
          if (parsed.code === cleanCode && Date.now() < parsed.expiresAt) {
            isValid = true;
            sessionStorage.removeItem(`otp_${cleanEmail}`);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Session OTP check notice:', e);
      }
    }

    if (!isValid) {
      throw new Error('Invalid or expired OTP code. Please check your inbox or request a new code.');
    }

    // 4. Fetch employee details from admin_users
    let employee = null;
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from('admin_users')
        .select('*')
        .eq('email', cleanEmail)
        .limit(1);

      if (data && data.length > 0) employee = data[0];
    } catch {}

    if (!employee) {
      employee = DEFAULT_EMPLOYEES.find(e => e.email.toLowerCase() === cleanEmail) || {
        name: cleanEmail.split('@')[0],
        email: cleanEmail,
        role: 'inventory_staff',
        is_active: true
      };
    }

    const sessionUser = {
      id: employee.id || 1,
      name: employee.name,
      email: employee.email,
      role: employee.role || 'inventory_staff',
      department: employee.department || 'General',
      loggedInAt: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    localStorage.setItem(AUTH_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(sessionUser));
    return { success: true, user: sessionUser };
  }
};

import { supabase } from '../supabaseClient';
import { INITIAL_PRODUCTS } from '../data/mockData';
import { notificationService } from './notificationService';
import { purchaseOrdersApi } from './purchaseOrdersApi';

/**
 * Safe test mode resolution:
 * Strictly restricted to Super Admin.
 * Anonymous reporters, store workers, and non-super-admins are ALWAYS Live.
 */
function isSuperAdminTestModeActive() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  try {
    const user = authService.getCurrentUser();
    if (user?.role !== 'super_admin') {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('rma_portal_test_mode', 'false');
      } catch (e) {}
      return false;
    }
    return localStorage.getItem('rma_portal_test_mode') === 'true';
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}

// Cross-tab broadcast channel for instant multi-device / multi-tab reactivity
const syncChannel = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.BroadcastChannel 
  ? new BroadcastChannel('rma_portal_sync_bus') 
  : null;

/**
 * UNIFIED CATALOG & RMA REPORTING SERVICE
 */
export const catalogService = {
  /**
   * Broadcast real-time change to all listeners and open tabs
   */
  notifyChange(type = 'data-updated', payload = {}) {
    if (this._productLookupCache) {
      if (payload?.barcode) {
        this._productLookupCache.delete(String(payload.barcode).trim());
      } else {
        this._productLookupCache.clear();
      }
    }
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('rma-data-changed', { detail: { type, payload } }));
      try {
        syncChannel?.postMessage({ type, payload, timestamp: Date.now() });
      } catch (e) {
        // BroadcastChannel notice
      }
    }
  },

  /**
   * Subscribe to real-time events across windows / tabs
   */
  onDataChange(callback) {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};

    const handleCustom = (e) => callback(e.detail);
    const handleBroadcast = (e) => callback(e.data);

    window.addEventListener('rma-data-changed', handleCustom);
    syncChannel?.addEventListener('message', handleBroadcast);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('rma-data-changed', handleCustom);
      syncChannel?.removeEventListener('message', handleBroadcast);
    };
  },

  /**
   * Test connection to Supabase database
   */
  async testSupabase() {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('id, barcode, name')
        .limit(5);

      if (error) {
        return { connected: false, error: error.message };
      }
      return { connected: true, rowsFound: data ? data.length : 0 };
    } catch (err) {
      return { connected: false, error: err.message };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Client-side image compression (Aggressive Free-Tier Optimization):
   * Resizes large photos (like 48MP phone captures) to max 1280px and converts to WebP at quality 0.7.
   * Shrinks 4MB-10MB mobile uploads down to ~80KB-180KB (>95% reduction),
   * preventing Vercel 10s serverless timeouts and conserving storage.
   */
  async compressImage(file, maxDimension = 1280, quality = 0.7) {
    if (!file || !file.type?.startsWith('image/')) return file;
    if (file.type === 'image/svg+xml') return file;

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      try {
        const img = new Image();
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        img.onload = () => {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          let { width, height } = img;
          if (width > maxDimension || height > maxDimension) {
            if (width > height) {
              height = Math.round((height * maxDimension) / width);
              width = maxDimension;
            } else {
              width = Math.round((width * maxDimension) / height);
              height = maxDimension;
            }
          }
          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = width;
          canvas.height = height;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);

          // Attempt WebP encoding first (supported on all modern browsers)
          const exportMime = 'image/webp';
          canvas.toBlob(
            (blob) => {
              if (blob) {
                const cleanBaseName = file.name ? file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') : 'rma_photo';
                const compressedFile = new File([blob], `${cleanBaseName}.webp`, {
                  type: 'image/webp',
                  lastModified: Date.now()
                });
                resolve(compressedFile);
              } else {
                // Fallback to JPEG if browser canvas fails WebP export
                canvas.toBlob(
                  (fallbackBlob) => {
                    if (fallbackBlob) {
                      const cleanBaseName = file.name ? file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') : 'rma_photo';
                      resolve(new File([fallbackBlob], `${cleanBaseName}.jpg`, {
                        type: 'image/jpeg',
                        lastModified: Date.now()
                      }));
                    } else {
                      resolve(file);
                    }
                  },
                  'image/jpeg',
                  quality
                );
              }
            },
            exportMime,
            quality
          );
        };
        img.onerror = () => {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          resolve(file);
        };
        img.src = url;
      } catch (err) {
        resolve(file);
      }
    });
  },

  /**
   * Smart Hybrid Photo Upload:
   * 1. Aggressively compresses photo to WebP (max 1280px, quality 0.7, ~80-180KB).
   * 2. Primary: Uploads to Company Google Workspace Drive (/api/upload-photo) in dedicated folder.
   * 3. Fallback: If Google Drive credentials are not yet set or offline, uploads to Supabase Storage ('rma-photos').
   * 4. Tertiary Fallback: Offline Base64 Data URL so user never loses their submission.
   */
  async uploadPhoto(file, rmaNumber = 'GENERAL', category = 'damaged_items', extraMeta = {}) {
    const details = await this.uploadPhotoWithDetails(file, rmaNumber, category, extraMeta);
    return details?.url || details;
  },

  /**
   * Upload photo and return full details including Google Drive folder URLs
   */
  async uploadPhotoWithDetails(file, rmaNumber = 'GENERAL', category = 'damaged_items', extraMeta = {}) {
    if (!file) return null;
    try {
      // 1. Client-Side Aggressive WebP Compression
      const compressed = await this.compressImage(file, 1280, 0.7);
      const base64Data = await this.fileToBase64(compressed);

      // 2. Primary: Attempt Google Workspace Drive upload via serverless integration
      try {
        const gdriveRes = await fetch('/api/upload-photo', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            fileData: base64Data,
            fileName: compressed.name || `RMA_${rmaNumber}_${category}_${Date.now()}.webp`,
            mimeType: compressed.type || 'image/webp',
            rmaNumber,
            category,
            targetFolderId: extraMeta.targetFolderId || null,
            sku: extraMeta.sku || extraMeta.code || null,
            productName: extraMeta.name || extraMeta.productName || null,
            rmaType: extraMeta.rmaType || extraMeta.rma_type || 'customer_inbound',
            customerName: extraMeta.customerName || extraMeta.storeBranch || extraMeta.store_branch || null,
            storeBranch: extraMeta.storeBranch || extraMeta.store_branch || null,
            supplierName: extraMeta.supplierName || extraMeta.supplier_name || null
          })
        });

        if (gdriveRes.ok) {
          const gdriveJson = await gdriveRes.json();
          if (gdriveJson.success && (gdriveJson.url || gdriveJson.previewUrl)) {
            return {
              url: gdriveJson.url || gdriveJson.previewUrl,
              previewUrl: gdriveJson.previewUrl || gdriveJson.url,
              rmaFolderUrl: gdriveJson.rmaFolderUrl || null,
              rmaFolderId: gdriveJson.rmaFolderId || null,
              fileId: gdriveJson.fileId || null,
              provider: 'google_drive'
            };
          }
        }
      } catch (gdriveErr) {
        console.warn('Google Drive photo upload notice (falling back to Supabase):', gdriveErr.message);
      }

      // 3. Secondary Fallback: Supabase Storage ('rma-photos' bucket)
      const cleanName = compressed.name ? compressed.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g, '_') : 'photo.webp';
      const folderPrefix = category === 'official_paperwork' ? 'paperwork' : 'reports';
      const filePath = `${folderPrefix}/${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}_${cleanName}`;
      
      const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
        .from('rma-photos')
        .upload(filePath, compressed, {
          cacheControl: '3600',
          upsert: true,
          contentType: compressed.type || 'image/webp'
        });

      if (!error) {
        const { data: publicUrlData } = supabase.storage
          .from('rma-photos')
          .getPublicUrl(filePath);

        if (publicUrlData?.publicUrl) {
          return {
            url: publicUrlData.publicUrl,
            previewUrl: publicUrlData.publicUrl,
            provider: 'supabase'
          };
        }
      }

      // 4. Tertiary Fallback: Base64 Data URL
      return {
        url: base64Data,
        previewUrl: base64Data,
        provider: 'local_base64'
      };
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Photo upload exception (falling back to data URL):', err.message);
      const b64 = await this.fileToBase64(file);
      return {
        url: b64,
        previewUrl: b64,
        provider: 'local_base64'
      };
    }
  },

  /**
   * Inspect paperwork photo using Google Gemini Flash OCR service
   * Returns verification flag, document type, DR number, store branch, etc.
   */
  async inspectPaperwork(fileOrBase64, signal) {
    let base64Data = '';
    let mimeType = 'image/jpeg';

    if (typeof fileOrBase64 === 'string') {
      base64Data = fileOrBase64;
      if (fileOrBase64.startsWith('data:image/')) {
        mimeType = fileOrBase64.substring(5, fileOrBase64.indexOf(';'));
      }
    } else if (fileOrBase64 instanceof File || fileOrBase64 instanceof Blob) {
      mimeType = fileOrBase64.type || 'image/jpeg';
      base64Data = await this.fileToBase64(fileOrBase64);
    } else {
      throw new Error('Invalid file or image provided for paperwork inspection.');
    }

    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/ai/inspect-paperwork', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        fileData: base64Data,
        mimeType
      }),
      signal
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const errText = await res.text();
      try {
        return JSON.parse(errText);
      } catch (e) {
        throw new Error(`Paperwork inspection error (${res.status}): ${errText}`);
      }
    }

    return await res.json();
  },

  fileToBase64(file) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
      reader.onerror = error => reject(error);
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  },

  /**
   * Permanently deletes a stored proof image from Google Workspace Drive or Supabase Storage
   */
  async deleteStoredImage(imageUrl) {
    if (!imageUrl || typeof imageUrl !== 'string') return;
    try {
      // 1. Google Drive deletion (via serverless API endpoint)
      const isGdrive = imageUrl.includes('drive.google.com') || 
                       imageUrl.includes('googleusercontent.com') ||
                       imageUrl.startsWith('RMA_') ||
                       imageUrl.endsWith('.webp');

      if (isGdrive) {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/upload-photo?fileUrl=${encodeURIComponent(imageUrl)}`, {
          method: 'DELETE',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ fileUrl: imageUrl })
        }).catch(e => {
          console.warn('[Google Drive Delete Network Notice]:', e.message);
          return null;
        });

        if (res && res.ok) {
          console.log('[Google Drive] Image deletion confirmed for:', imageUrl);
        }
        return;
      }

      // 2. Supabase Storage deletion ('rma-photos' bucket)
      if (imageUrl.includes('/rma-photos/')) {
        const parts = imageUrl.split('/rma-photos/');
        if (parts[1]) {
          const storagePath = decodeURIComponent(parts[1].split('?')[0]);
          await supabase.storage.from('rma-photos').remove([storagePath]);
          console.log('[Supabase Storage] Image deleted:', storagePath);
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Delete stored image exception:', err.message);
    }
  },

  /**
   * Delete multiple stored image URLs and Google Drive folders in batch
   * Supports cleaning up specific file URLs, folder IDs, RMA folders, and Product SKU folders
   */
  async deleteStoredImages(imageUrls, folderIds = [], folderUrls = [], extra = {}) {
    const cleanList = Array.isArray(imageUrls)
      ? imageUrls.map(u => (typeof u === 'object' && u) ? (u.url || u.previewUrl || u.fileUrl || u.id) : u).filter(u => u && typeof u === 'string')
      : [];
    const cleanFolders = Array.isArray(folderIds) ? folderIds.filter(f => f && typeof f === 'string') : (folderIds ? [folderIds] : []);
    const cleanFolderUrls = Array.isArray(folderUrls) ? folderUrls.filter(u => u && typeof u === 'string') : (folderUrls ? [folderUrls] : []);
    const rmaNumbers = Array.isArray(extra?.rmaNumbers) ? extra.rmaNumbers.filter(Boolean) : (extra?.rmaNumber ? [extra.rmaNumber] : []);
    const skus = Array.isArray(extra?.skus) ? extra.skus.filter(Boolean) : (extra?.sku ? [extra.sku] : []);

    if (cleanList.length === 0 && cleanFolders.length === 0 && cleanFolderUrls.length === 0 && rmaNumbers.length === 0 && skus.length === 0) return;

    // Separate Google Drive vs Supabase Storage
    const gdriveUrls = [];
    const supabasePaths = [];

    cleanList.forEach(url => {
      if (url.includes('/rma-photos/')) {
        const parts = url.split('/rma-photos/');
        if (parts[1]) {
          supabasePaths.push(decodeURIComponent(parts[1].split('?')[0]));
        }
      } else {
        gdriveUrls.push(url);
      }
    });

    const tasks = [];

    // Batch delete Supabase images in 1 call
    if (supabasePaths.length > 0) {
      tasks.push(
        supabase.storage.from('rma-photos').remove(supabasePaths).catch(e => {
          console.warn('[Supabase Batch Delete Notice]:', e.message);
        })
      );
    }

    // Batch delete Google Drive photos & folders via /api/upload-photo (support POST & DELETE)
    if (gdriveUrls.length > 0 || cleanFolders.length > 0 || cleanFolderUrls.length > 0 || rmaNumbers.length > 0 || skus.length > 0) {
      tasks.push(
        fetch('/api/upload-photo?action=delete', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            action: 'delete',
            fileUrls: gdriveUrls,
            folderIds: cleanFolders,
            folderUrls: cleanFolderUrls,
            rmaNumbers,
            skus
          })
        }).then(async res => {
          if (res.ok) {
            const data = await res.json().catch(() => null);
            console.log('[Google Drive Asset Delete Result]:', data);
            if (data?.failed && data.failed.length > 0) {
              console.warn('[Google Drive Delete Incomplete Notice]:', data.failed);
            }
          } else {
            const errText = await res.text().catch(() => '');
            console.warn('[Google Drive Batch Delete Server Error]:', res.status, errText);
          }
        }).catch(e => {
          console.warn('[Google Drive Batch Delete Notice]:', e.message);
        })
      );
    }

    await Promise.allSettled(tasks);
  },

  /**
   * Fast Barcode / SKU Lookup:
   * PRIORITY 1: Secure Serverless Proxy (/api/v1/products/lookup)
   *             Works across ANY mobile phone, dock scanner, or incognito browser without requiring client credentials.
   * PRIORITY 2: Direct Supabase Database Fallback (if serverless API is offline or unreachable)
   * PRIORITY 3: Wholesale Verified Catalog Fallback (Group 1 & 2 Products)
   * Returns null if uncatalogued, prompting the user with the unregistered barcode workflow.
   */
  _productLookupCache: new Map(),

  async findProduct(barcodeOrQuery) {
    const clean = String(barcodeOrQuery || '').trim();
    if (!clean) return null;

    // Fast-path: return cached lookup instantly if available
    if (this._productLookupCache && this._productLookupCache.has(clean)) {
      return this._productLookupCache.get(clean);
    }

    // 1. SECURE SERVERLESS PROXY LOOKUP (PRIORITY #1: /api/v1/products/lookup)
    // Server securely holds the Laravel Cloud API credentials and queries Supabase + erply_products
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/products/lookup?barcode=${encodeURIComponent(clean)}`, {
        headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
      });
      if (res && res.ok) {
        const json = await res.json();
        if (json.success && json.found && json.product) {
          const p = json.product;
          const matchedProd = {
            id: p.id,
            barcode: p.barcode || clean,
            code: (p.code && p.code !== (p.barcode || clean)) ? p.code : (p.sku && p.sku !== (p.barcode || clean) ? p.sku : null),
            name: p.name,
            price: Number(p.price || 0),
            priceWithVat: Number(p.priceWithVat || p.price_with_vat || p.price || 0),
            supplierName: p.supplierName || p.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment',
            brandName: p.brandName || p.brand_name || null,
            unitName: p.unitName || p.unit_name || 'pc',
            hasSerialNumbers: Boolean(p.hasSerialNumbers || p.has_serial_numbers),
            imageUrl: p.imageUrl || p.image_url || null,
            ae_name: p.ae_name || null,
            ae_email: p.ae_email || null,
            company: p.company || null,
            isVerified: p.isVerified !== false && p.is_verified !== false,
            source: json.source === 'database' ? 'Supabase Database (Yours)' : (json.source === 'erply_api' ? 'ERPLY POS/ERP Catalog (Live API)' : 'Wholesale Master Catalog')
          };
          if (this._productLookupCache) {
            this._productLookupCache.set(clean, matchedProd);
            if (matchedProd.barcode) this._productLookupCache.set(String(matchedProd.barcode).trim(), matchedProd);
          }
          return matchedProd;
        }
      }
    } catch (apiErr) {
      console.warn('Server lookup proxy unavailable (falling back to client DB):', apiErr.message);
    }

    // 2. Direct Coworker Live Catalog Fallback via purchaseOrdersApi (erply_products)
    try {
      const liveProduct = await purchaseOrdersApi.findProductByBarcode(clean);
      if (liveProduct) {
        // Cache into Supabase products table asynchronously so subsequent searches are instant
        try {
          const liveSku = (liveProduct.code && liveProduct.code !== clean) ? liveProduct.code : (liveProduct.sku && liveProduct.sku !== clean ? liveProduct.sku : null);
          supabase.from('products').upsert([{
            barcode: liveProduct.barcode || clean,
            code: liveSku,
            name: liveProduct.name,
            supplier_name: liveProduct.supplier || liveProduct.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment',
            price: Number(liveProduct.price || liveProduct.unit_price || 0),
            price_with_vat: Number(liveProduct.price_with_vat || liveProduct.priceWithVat || 0),
            brand_name: liveProduct.brand || liveProduct.brand_name || null,
            unit_name: liveProduct.unit_name || 'pc',
            is_verified: true,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }], { onConflict: 'barcode' }).then(() => {}).catch(() => {});
        } catch (cErr) {}

        return {
          id: liveProduct.id,
          barcode: liveProduct.barcode || clean,
          code: (liveProduct.code && liveProduct.code !== clean) ? liveProduct.code : (liveProduct.sku && liveProduct.sku !== clean ? liveProduct.sku : null),
          name: liveProduct.name,
          price: Number(liveProduct.price || liveProduct.unit_price || 0),
          priceWithVat: Number(liveProduct.price_with_vat || liveProduct.priceWithVat || 0),
          supplierName: liveProduct.supplier || liveProduct.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment',
          brandName: liveProduct.brand || liveProduct.brand_name || null,
          unitName: liveProduct.unit_name || 'pc',
          hasSerialNumbers: Boolean(liveProduct.requires_serial || liveProduct.has_serial_numbers),
          imageUrl: liveProduct.image_url || null,
          ae_name: liveProduct.ae_name || null,
          ae_email: liveProduct.ae_email || null,
          company: liveProduct.company || null,
          isVerified: true,
          source: 'ERPLY POS/ERP Catalog (Live API)'
        };
      }
    } catch (poErr) {
      console.warn('purchaseOrdersApi lookup fallback notice:', poErr?.message || poErr);
    }

    // 2. Direct Supabase Fallback (if serverless API endpoint was offline or in local client dev)
    try {
      let supaItem = null;
      const { data: byBarcode, error: errBarcode } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('*')
        .eq('barcode', clean)
        .limit(1);

      if (!errBarcode && byBarcode && byBarcode.length > 0) {
        if (!byBarcode[0].name?.startsWith('[DELETED]')) {
          supaItem = byBarcode[0];
        }
      }

      if (!supaItem) {
        const { data: byCode, error: errCode } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .select('*')
          .ilike('code', clean)
          .limit(1);

        if (!errCode && byCode && byCode.length > 0) {
          if (!byCode[0].name?.startsWith('[DELETED]')) {
            supaItem = byCode[0];
          }
        }
      }

      if (supaItem) {
        return {
          id: supaItem.id,
          barcode: supaItem.barcode,
          code: (supaItem.code && supaItem.code !== supaItem.barcode) ? supaItem.code : (supaItem.sku && supaItem.sku !== supaItem.barcode ? supaItem.sku : null),
          name: supaItem.name,
          price: Number(supaItem.price || 0),
          priceWithVat: Number(supaItem.price_with_vat || supaItem.price || 0),
          supplierName: supaItem.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment',
          brandName: supaItem.brand_name || null,
          unitName: supaItem.unit_name || 'pc',
          hasSerialNumbers: supaItem.has_serial_numbers || false,
          imageUrl: supaItem.image_url || null,
          ae_name: supaItem.ae_name || null,
          ae_email: supaItem.ae_email || null,
          company: supaItem.company || null,
          isVerified: supaItem.is_verified !== false,
          source: 'Supabase Database (Yours)'
        };
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Supabase lookup exception:', e.message);
    }

    // 3. Wholesale Verified Catalog Fallback (Group 1 & 2 Products)
    const mockItem = INITIAL_PRODUCTS.find(p => 
      p.barcode === clean || 
      (p.sku && p.sku.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase())
    );
    if (mockItem) {
      const isBonitaOrPingcon = (
        (mockItem.brand && mockItem.brand.toLowerCase().includes('bonita')) ||
        (mockItem.group && mockItem.group.toLowerCase().includes('pingcon'))
      );
      return {
        id: mockItem.id,
        barcode: mockItem.barcode,
        code: (mockItem.sku && mockItem.sku !== mockItem.barcode) ? mockItem.sku : null,
        sku: (mockItem.sku && mockItem.sku !== mockItem.barcode) ? mockItem.sku : null,
        name: mockItem.name,
        price: Number(mockItem.unit_price || 0),
        priceWithVat: Number(mockItem.unit_price || 0) * 1.12,
        supplierName: mockItem.supplier || 'Savemore',
        brandName: mockItem.brand || null,
        unitName: 'pc',
        hasSerialNumbers: mockItem.requires_serial || false,
        imageUrl: mockItem.image_url || null,
        ae_name: null,
        ae_email: null,
        company: isBonitaOrPingcon ? 'Pingcon / Bonita' : 'A2Z2GO / Keysys',
        isVerified: true,
        source: 'Wholesale Verified Catalog'
      };
    }

    return null;
  },

  /**
   * COMPREHENSIVE MULTI-PRODUCT SEARCH:
   * Searches BOTH:
   * 1. Secure Serverless Proxy Search (/api/v1/products/lookup?search=...)
   * 2. Supabase 'products' table (Priority 2 Fallback)
   * 3. Enterprise Wholesale Catalog (Priority 3 Fallback)
   * Returns ALL matching products up to limit.
   */
  async searchAllProducts(query, limit = 50) {
    const clean = String(query || '').trim();
    if (!clean) return [];

    const results = [];
    const seenKeys = new Set();
    const cleanLower = clean.toLowerCase();

    // 1. Secure Serverless Multi-Catalog Search (/api/v1/products/lookup?search=...)
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/v1/products/lookup?search=${encodeURIComponent(clean)}&limit=${limit}`);
      if (res && res.ok) {
        const json = await res.json();
        if (json.success && Array.isArray(json.products)) {
          for (const item of json.products) {
            const key = String(item.barcode || item.code || item.id).trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!seenKeys.has(key)) {
              seenKeys.add(key);
              results.push({
                id: item.id,
                barcode: item.barcode,
                code: (item.code && item.code !== item.barcode) ? item.code : (item.sku && item.sku !== item.barcode ? item.sku : null),
                name: item.name,
                price: Number(item.price || 0),
                priceWithVat: Number(item.priceWithVat || item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0),
                supplierName: item.supplierName || item.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment',
                brandName: item.brandName || item.brand_name || null,
                unitName: item.unitName || item.unit_name || 'pc',
                hasSerialNumbers: Boolean(item.hasSerialNumbers || item.has_serial_numbers),
                imageUrl: item.imageUrl || item.image_url || null,
                isVerified: item.isVerified !== false && item.is_verified !== false,
                source: item.source || 'Server Catalog API'
              });
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (apiErr) {
      console.warn('Server search proxy notice:', apiErr.message);
    }

    // 2. Client-side Supabase products table fallback
    try {
      const { data: supaItems, error } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('*')
        .or(`name.ilike.%${clean}%,barcode.ilike.%${clean}%,code.ilike.%${clean}%`)
        .order('is_verified', { ascending: false })
        .limit(limit);

      if (!error && supaItems && Array.isArray(supaItems)) {
        for (const item of supaItems) {
          if (item.name?.startsWith('[DELETED]') || item.barcode?.startsWith('__CONFIG_')) continue;
          const key = String(item.barcode || item.code || item.id).trim().toLowerCase();
          if (!seenKeys.has(key)) {
            seenKeys.add(key);
            results.push({
              id: item.id,
              barcode: item.barcode,
              code: (item.code && item.code !== item.barcode) ? item.code : (item.sku && item.sku !== item.barcode ? item.sku : null),
              name: item.name,
              price: Number(item.price || 0),
              priceWithVat: Number(item.price_with_vat || item.price || 0),
              supplierName: item.supplier_name || 'Pending Assignment',
              brandName: item.brand_name || null,
              unitName: item.unit_name || 'pc',
              hasSerialNumbers: item.has_serial_numbers || false,
              imageUrl: item.image_url || null,
              isVerified: item.is_verified !== false,
              source: 'Supabase Database (Custom)'
            });
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Supabase product search warning:', e);
    }

    // 3. Wholesale Verified Catalog Fallback (INITIAL_PRODUCTS)
    for (const mock of INITIAL_PRODUCTS) {
      const matchText = `${mock.name} ${mock.brand || ''} ${mock.category || ''} ${mock.sku || ''} ${mock.barcode || ''}`.toLowerCase();
      if (matchText.includes(cleanLower)) {
        const key = String(mock.barcode || mock.sku || mock.id).trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!seenKeys.has(key)) {
          seenKeys.add(key);
          results.push({
            id: mock.id,
            barcode: mock.barcode,
            code: (mock.sku && mock.sku !== mock.barcode) ? mock.sku : null,
            sku: (mock.sku && mock.sku !== mock.barcode) ? mock.sku : null,
            name: mock.name,
            price: Number(mock.unit_price || 0),
            priceWithVat: Number(mock.unit_price || 0) * 1.12,
            supplierName: mock.supplier || 'Savemore',
            brandName: mock.brand || null,
            unitName: 'pc',
            hasSerialNumbers: mock.requires_serial || false,
            imageUrl: mock.image_url || null,
            isVerified: true,
            source: 'Wholesale Verified Catalog'
          });
        }
      }
    }

    return results;
  },

  /**
   * FETCH ALL VERIFIED SAVED PRODUCTS FROM SUPABASE DATABASE
   */
  async getSavedProducts() {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('*')
        .eq('is_verified', true)
        .not('name', 'like', '[DELETED]%')
        .order('updated_at', { ascending: false });

      if (error) {
        console.warn('Error fetching saved products from Supabase:', error.message);
        return [];
      }
      return (data || []).map(p => {
        const brand = p.brand_name || '';
        const pcsMatch = brand.match(/\[Pcs\/Cs:(\d+)\]/i);
        const pieces = pcsMatch ? parseInt(pcsMatch[1], 10) : (p.pieces_per_case || null);
        const cleanBrand = brand.replace(/\[Pcs\/Cs:\d+\]/gi, '').trim() || null;
        return {
          ...p,
          pieces_per_case: pieces,
          piecesPerCase: pieces,
          brand_name: cleanBrand
        };
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Saved products fetch exception:', e);
      return [];
    }
  },

  async getProducts() {
    return this.getSavedProducts();
  },
