/**
 * Enterprise Accounting & Logistics CSV Exporter
 * Formats financial records with clean headers and UTF-8 BOM for Microsoft Excel & Google Sheets.
 */

const MONTH_NAMES = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec'];

/**
 * Format timestamp strictly for filenames:
 * YYYY-MMMon-DD HHMM (e.g. 2026-11Nov-09 1430)
 */
export function formatFilenameDateTime(date = new Date()) {
  const d = (date instanceof Date && !isNaN(date.getTime())) ? date : new Date(date || Date.now());
  const safeDate = isNaN(d.getTime()) ? new Date() : d;
  const yyyy = safeDate.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(safeDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const mon = MONTH_NAMES[safeDate.getMonth()] || 'Jan';
  const dd = String(safeDate.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const hh = String(safeDate.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const min = String(safeDate.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}${mon}-${dd} ${hh}${min}`;
}

export function resolveFilenameWithTimestamp(defaultPrefix, customFilename) {
  const ts = formatFilenameDateTime();
  if (!customFilename) return `${defaultPrefix} ${ts}.csv`;
  const cleanName = customFilename.replace(/\.csv$/i, '');
  return `${cleanName} ${ts}.csv`;
}

/**
 * Format any date or timestamp strictly to 24-hour military time without colons:
 * YYYY-MM-DD HHMM (e.g. 2026-11-06 0845)
 */
export function formatMilitaryDateTime(val) {
  if (!val) return '';
  const d = new Date(val);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(val);
  const yyyy = d.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const dd = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const hh = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
  const min = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd} ${hh}${min}`;
}

function escapeCsvCell(val) {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '""';
  const str = String(val).replace(/"/g, '""');
  return `"${str}"`;
}

function extractPhotoLink(r) {
  if (!r) return 'N/A';
  if (r.google_drive_folder_url && r.google_drive_folder_url.startsWith('http')) {
    return r.google_drive_folder_url;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(r.photos) && r.photos.length > 0 && typeof r.photos[0] === 'string') {
    return r.photos[0];
  }
  if (typeof r.photos === 'string' && r.photos.startsWith('http')) {
    return r.photos;
  }
  if (r.photo_url && typeof r.photo_url === 'string' && r.photo_url.startsWith('http')) {
    return r.photo_url;
  }
  return 'N/A';
}

function downloadCsvBlob(csvContent, filename) {
  // \uFEFF is UTF-8 Byte Order Mark (BOM) so Excel reads formatting and currencies properly
  const blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 200);
}

 */
export function exportRMAReportsToCSV(reports, filename = null) {
  if (!reports || reports.length === 0) {
    alert('No reports available to export.');
    return;
  }

  const headers = [
    'SN',
    'RMA Number',
    'Date Logged (YYYY-MM-DD HHMM)',
    'Store / Branch',
    'Invoice / DR #',
    'Batch / Lot #',
    'Expiry Date',
    'Status',
    'Disposition',
    'Condition Grade',
    'Warehouse Location',
    'Supplier / Vendor',
    'Barcode',

    'Packaging Unit',

    'Price w/ VAT (PHP)',
    'Total Claim Value (PHP)',
    'Reporter Name',
    'Reported By',
    'Inspected By',
    'Defect Reason',
    'Google Drive Photo Link',
    'Google Drive Folder',
    'Notes'
  ];

  const rows = reports.map((r, index) => {

    return [

      escapeCsvCell(r.rma_number),

      escapeCsvCell(r.store_branch || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.invoice_dr_number || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.batch_lot_number || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.expiry_date || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.status || 'pending'),
      escapeCsvCell(r.disposition || 'Pending Triage'),
      escapeCsvCell(r.condition_grade || 'Unassessed'),
      escapeCsvCell(r.warehouse_location || 'DOCK'),
      escapeCsvCell(r.supplier_name || 'Savemore'),
      escapeCsvCell(r.barcode),
      escapeCsvCell(r.code || r.sku || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.name),
      escapeCsvCell(qty),
      escapeCsvCell(r.unit_name || 'pc'),
      escapeCsvCell(Number(r.price || 0).toFixed(2)),
      escapeCsvCell(Number(r.price_with_vat || 0).toFixed(2)),
      escapeCsvCell(totalVal),
      escapeCsvCell(r.reporter_name || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.reported_by || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.inspected_by || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.reason || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(photoLink),
      escapeCsvCell(r.google_drive_folder_url || ''),
      escapeCsvCell(r.notes || '')
    ].join(',');
  });

  const csv = [headers.join(','), ...rows].join('\r\n');
  const actualFilename = resolveFilenameWithTimestamp('Pingcon_RMA_Reports', filename);
  downloadCsvBlob(csv, actualFilename);
}

/**
 * Bulletproof Isolated Print Engine
 * Renders target HTML element into a dedicated, clean, invisible iframe.
 * Eliminates background page leakage, prevents multi-page overflow (guarantees exactly 1 page),
 * and ensures 100% visual fidelity between the on-screen preview and printed paper / PDF export.
 */

export function printIsolatedElement({
  elementId,
  documentTitle = 'Print Document',
  pageSize = 'portrait', // 'portrait' | '4in 6in' | '3in 3in' | '2in 2in' | 'A4 portrait'
  pageMargin = '0.2in',
  scale = 1.0,
  customStyles = ''
}) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;

  const sourceEl = typeof elementId === 'string' ? document.getElementById(elementId) : elementId;
  if (!sourceEl) {
    console.error('printIsolatedElement: Target element not found:', elementId);
    return;
  }

  // Clone target element
  const clone = sourceEl.cloneNode(true);

  // Synchronize dynamic form controls (inputs, textareas, selects) from live DOM into cloned DOM
  try {
    const sourceInputs = sourceEl.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select');
    const cloneInputs = clone.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select');
    sourceInputs.forEach((srcInput, idx) => {
      const clnInput = cloneInputs[idx];
      if (clnInput) {
        if (srcInput.type === 'checkbox' || srcInput.type === 'radio') {
          clnInput.checked = srcInput.checked;
          if (srcInput.checked) clnInput.setAttribute('checked', 'checked');
          else clnInput.removeAttribute('checked');
        } else {
          clnInput.value = srcInput.value;
          clnInput.setAttribute('value', srcInput.value);
        }
      }
    });
  } catch (syncErr) {
    console.warn('Form controls clone sync notice:', syncErr);
  }

  // Remove existing print iframe if any
  const existingIframe = document.getElementById('app-isolated-print-iframe');
  if (existingIframe) {
    existingIframe.remove();
  }

  // Create clean isolated iframe
  const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.id = 'app-isolated-print-iframe';
  iframe.style.position = 'fixed';
  iframe.style.top = '-9999px';
  iframe.style.left = '-9999px';
  iframe.style.width = '0px';
  iframe.style.height = '0px';
  iframe.style.border = '0';
  iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);

  // Collect existing stylesheets & fonts from main window and sanitize @page rules
  const stylesheets = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"], style'))
    .map(el => {
      let html = el.outerHTML;
      // Strip any conflicting global @page rules from parent styles
      return html.replace(/@page\s*\{[^}]*\}/gi, '');
    })
    .join('\n');

  const iframeDoc = iframe.contentWindow.document;
  iframeDoc.open();
  iframeDoc.write(`
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8" />
        <title>${documentTitle}</title>
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
        ${stylesheets}
        <style>
          @page {
            size: ${pageSize} !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
          }
          *, *::before, *::after {
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
            print-color-adjust: exact !important;
          }
          html, body {
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            width: 100% !important;
            height: auto !important;
            background: #ffffff !important;
            color: #000000 !important;
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif !important;
            overflow: visible !important;
          }
          body {
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: flex-start !important;
            page-break-before: avoid !important;
            page-break-after: avoid !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
          .isolated-print-sheet {
            width: 100% !important;
            height: auto !important;
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: flex-start !important;
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            padding: ${pageMargin} !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            text-align: center !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
            page-break-after: avoid !important;
            break-after: avoid !important;
          }
          .isolated-print-card {
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: flex-start !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
            page-break-after: avoid !important;
            break-after: avoid !important;
            max-width: 100% !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            transform-origin: top center !important;
            ${scale !== 1.0 ? `zoom: ${scale};` : ''}
          }
          @media print {
            body, .isolated-print-sheet, .isolated-print-card, #thermal-label-mount, #rtv-voucher-mount {
              page-break-after: avoid !important;
              break-after: avoid !important;
              page-break-inside: avoid !important;
              break-inside: avoid !important;
            }
          }
          ${customStyles}
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <div class="isolated-print-sheet">
          <div class="isolated-print-card">
            ${clone.outerHTML}
          </div>
        </div>
      </body>
    </html>
  `);
  iframeDoc.close();

  // Trigger print after styles & SVG elements have painted
  const executePrint = () => {
    try {
      iframe.contentWindow.focus();
      iframe.contentWindow.print();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Isolated print warning:', err);
    } finally {
      // Clean up iframe after print dialog completes
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (iframe && iframe.parentNode) {
          iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
        }
      }, 3000);
    }
  };

  // Wait 150ms for layout & SVG render
  setTimeout(executePrint, 150);
}

/**
 * QR Code & Box Sticker Download Utility
 * Client-side high-resolution PNG & SVG generation for mobile and desktop devices.
 */

/**
 * Convert an SVG element to an HTMLImageElement
 */
function svgToImage(svgElement) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      const xml = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svgElement);
      const svgBlob = new Blob([xml], { type: 'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8' });
      const URL = window.URL || window.webkitURL || window;
      const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        resolve({ img, blobUrl });
      };
      img.onerror = (err) => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
        reject(err);
      };
      img.src = blobUrl;
    } catch (e) {
      reject(e);
    }
  });
}

/**
 * Trigger file download via a transient anchor element
 */
function triggerDownload(dataUrlOrBlob, filename) {
  const isBlob = dataUrlOrBlob instanceof Blob;
  const url = isBlob ? URL.createObjectURL(dataUrlOrBlob) : dataUrlOrBlob;
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.style.display = 'none';
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    if (isBlob) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, 200);
}

/**
 * Helper: Draw multi-line wrapped text with strict boundary management (left aligned)
 * Returns the Y coordinate after the last line of text drawn.
 */
function drawWrappedText(ctx, text, x, y, maxWidth, lineHeight, maxLines = 2) {
  if (!text) return y;
  const words = String(text).trim().split(/\s+/);
  let line = '';
  let currentY = y;
  let linesDrawn = 0;

  for (let n = 0; n < words.length; n++) {
    const testLine = line ? `${line} ${words[n]}` : words[n];
    const metrics = ctx.measureText(testLine);
    if (metrics.width > maxWidth && n > 0) {
      linesDrawn++;
      if (linesDrawn >= maxLines) {
        // Last line limit hit: append ellipsis only if more words remain
        let truncatedLine = line;
        while (ctx.measureText(truncatedLine + '...').width > maxWidth && truncatedLine.length > 0) {
          truncatedLine = truncatedLine.slice(0, -1);
        }
        ctx.fillText(truncatedLine + '...', x, currentY);
        return currentY + lineHeight;
      }
      ctx.fillText(line, x, currentY);
      line = words[n];
      currentY += lineHeight;
    } else {
      line = testLine;
    }
  }

  if (line) {
    ctx.fillText(line, x, currentY);
    currentY += lineHeight;
  }

  return currentY;
}

/**
 * Helper: Draw multi-line wrapped text with center alignment
 */
function drawWrappedTextCentered(ctx, text, centerX, y, maxWidth, lineHeight, maxLines = 2) {
  if (!text) return y;
  const words = String(text).trim().split(/\s+/);
  let line = '';
  let currentY = y;
  let linesDrawn = 0;

  for (let n = 0; n < words.length; n++) {
    const testLine = line ? `${line} ${words[n]}` : words[n];
    const metrics = ctx.measureText(testLine);
    if (metrics.width > maxWidth && n > 0) {
      linesDrawn++;
      if (linesDrawn >= maxLines) {
        let truncatedLine = line;
        while (ctx.measureText(truncatedLine + '...').width > maxWidth && truncatedLine.length > 0) {
          truncatedLine = truncatedLine.slice(0, -1);
        }
        ctx.fillText(truncatedLine + '...', centerX, currentY);
        return currentY + lineHeight;
      }
      ctx.fillText(line, centerX, currentY);
      line = words[n];
      currentY += lineHeight;
    } else {
      line = testLine;
    }
  }

  if (line) {
    ctx.fillText(line, centerX, currentY);
    currentY += lineHeight;
  }

  return currentY;
}

/**
 * Download High-Resolution QR Code (PNG)
 * Generates an ultra-crisp card with the QR code and RMA Ticket info.
 */
export async function downloadQrCodePng({
  svgElementOrId,
  rmaNumber = 'RMA-TICKET',
  productName = '',
  barcode = '',
  reporter = '',
  reporterContact = '',
  dateFormatted = '',
  filename
}) {
  const svgEl = typeof svgElementOrId === 'string'
    ? document.getElementById(svgElementOrId)
    : svgElementOrId;

  if (!svgEl) {
    throw new Error('QR SVG element not found in DOM.');
  }

  const { img, blobUrl } = await svgToImage(svgEl);

  try {
    // Canvas dimensions (high-res 1200 x 1420)
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const width = 1200;
    const height = 1420;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) throw new Error('Could not initialize 2D canvas context.');

    // 1. Clean White Background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // 2. Subtle outer border with rounded corners
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 12;
    ctx.strokeRect(30, 30, width - 60, height - 60);

    // 3. Header badge
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.fillRect(30, 30, width - 60, 90);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 32px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('WHOLESALE RMA RETURN AUTHORIZATION', width / 2, 90);

    // 4. Draw QR Code centered (high contrast)
    const qrSize = 780;
    const qrX = (width - qrSize) / 2;
    const qrY = 160;

    // White backing box for QR with subtle border
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(qrX - 20, qrY - 20, qrSize + 40, qrSize + 40);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeRect(qrX - 20, qrY - 20, qrSize + 40, qrSize + 40);

    ctx.drawImage(img, qrX, qrY, qrSize, qrSize);

    // 5. Instruction below QR
    ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('▲ SCAN QR CODE FOR INSTANT WAREHOUSE INTAKE ▲', width / 2, 1000);

    // 6. RMA Ticket Number (Big Monospace)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    let rmaFontSize = 64;
    ctx.font = `900 ${rmaFontSize}px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace`;
    while (ctx.measureText(rmaNumber).width > 1050 && rmaFontSize > 34) {
      rmaFontSize -= 2;
      ctx.font = `900 ${rmaFontSize}px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace`;
    }
    ctx.fillText(rmaNumber, width / 2, 1085);

    // 7. Product & Barcode Subtitle (Wrapped cleanly across up to 2 lines)
    let nextY = 1150;
    if (productName || barcode) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#1e293b';
      ctx.font = 'bold 36px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
      nextY = drawWrappedTextCentered(ctx, productName || 'Returned Merchandise', width / 2, nextY, 1040, 44, 2);

      if (barcode) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
        ctx.font = 'bold 28px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
        ctx.fillText(`Barcode: ${barcode}`, width / 2, nextY + 10);
        nextY += 45;
      }
      if (reporter || reporterContact || dateFormatted) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
        ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
        const repInfo = reporter ? (reporterContact && reporterContact !== 'N/A' ? `${reporter} (${reporterContact})` : reporter) : '';
        const metaLine = [repInfo, dateFormatted].filter(Boolean).join('  •  ');
        if (metaLine) {
          ctx.fillText(metaLine, width / 2, nextY + 10);
          nextY += 40;
        }
      }

      // Reporter Signature Line
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(width / 2 - 240, nextY + 30);
      ctx.lineTo(width / 2 + 240, nextY + 30);
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(`Reporter Signature: ${reporter || 'Staff'}`, width / 2, nextY + 60);
    }

    // 8. Footer timestamp / system notice
    ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.font = '500 22px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
    const dateStr = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
    ctx.fillText(`RMA Portal Verification • Generated ${dateStr}`, width / 2, 1365);

    // Convert to PNG and download
    const finalFilename = filename || `${rmaNumber}-QR.png`;
    canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
      if (blob) {
        triggerDownload(blob, finalFilename);
      } else {
        triggerDownload(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'), finalFilename);
      }
    }, 'image/png');

    return true;
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
  }
}

/**
 * Generate Complete Official RMA Box Verification Label Canvas
 * High-res 1200 x 1680 px graphic formatted specifically for box adhesion & thermal prints.
 * Completely eliminates overlap and truncation of RMA number, full product names, and return reasons.
 */
export async function generateBoxStickerCanvas({
  svgElementOrId,
  rmaNumber = 'RMA-TICKET',
  supplier = '',
  itemName = 'Returned Merchandise',
  barcode = '',
  sku = '',
  quantity = 1,
  unit = 'pc',
  reason = 'Defective / Return',
  reporter = 'Warehouse Staff',
  reporterContact = '',
  dateFormatted = '',
  storeBranch = '',
  store = '',
  totalItems = 1,
  totalQuantity = 1,
  items = []
}) {
  const svgEl = typeof svgElementOrId === 'string'
    ? document.getElementById(svgElementOrId)
    : svgElementOrId;

  if (!svgEl) {
    throw new Error('QR SVG element not found in DOM.');
  }

  const resolvedStore = storeBranch || store || '';
  const isManifest = (Array.isArray(items) && items.length > 1) || (Number(totalItems) > 1);
  const effectiveTotalItems = Math.max(1, Number(totalItems) || (Array.isArray(items) ? items.length : 1));
  const effectiveTotalQuantity = Math.max(1, Number(totalQuantity) || (Array.isArray(items) ? items.reduce((acc, it) => acc + (Number(it.quantity) || 1), 0) : Number(quantity) || 1));

  const { img, blobUrl } = await svgToImage(svgEl);

  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const width = 1200;
    const height = 1680;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) throw new Error('Could not initialize canvas context.');

    // 1. Crisp White Background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // 2. Outer Heavyweight Border
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 14;
    ctx.strokeRect(40, 40, width - 80, height - 80);

    // 3. Top Header: Wholesale Operations & Dock Intake badge
    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('WHOLESALE RMA OPERATIONS', 80, 110);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.font = '900 38px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('RETURN VERIFICATION LABEL', 80, 160);

    // Dock intake pill on top right
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.fillRect(width - 320, 95, 240, 65);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('DOCK INTAKE', width - 200, 140);

    // Header divider line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(80, 195);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 80, 195);
    ctx.stroke();

    // 4. Middle Right: High-contrast QR Code with framed border
    // Sized at 380px (qrX = 740), leaving a generous 630px left column for RMA number & supplier
    const qrSize = 380;
    const qrX = width - 80 - qrSize; // 740
    const qrY = 225;

    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.strokeRect(qrX, qrY, qrSize, qrSize);
    ctx.drawImage(img, qrX + 15, qrY + 15, qrSize - 30, qrSize - 30);

    // Strip below QR: "SCAN FOR RMA DETAILS"
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.fillRect(qrX, qrY + qrSize, qrSize, 42);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('SCAN FOR RMA DETAILS', qrX + qrSize / 2, qrY + qrSize + 29);

    // 5. Middle Left Column: RMA Number, Supplier, and Status
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('RETURN AUTHORIZATION #', 80, 260);

    // Dynamic Font Sizing for RMA Number to strictly prevent overlapping the QR code!
    // Maximum left column width before reaching QR frame is 620px (from x=80 to x=700)
    let rmaFontSize = 54;
    ctx.font = `900 ${rmaFontSize}px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace`;
    while (ctx.measureText(rmaNumber).width > 610 && rmaFontSize > 26) {
      rmaFontSize -= 2;
      ctx.font = `900 ${rmaFontSize}px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace`;
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.fillText(rmaNumber, 80, 335);

    // 6. Section 2: Returned Item Details Container Box (Taller & beautifully spaced)
    const boxY = 670;
    const boxH = 760;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
    ctx.fillRect(80, boxY, width - 160, boxH);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#cbd5e1';
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeRect(80, boxY, width - 160, boxH);

    let div2Y = boxY + 410;

    if (isManifest) {
      // Header for Batch Manifest
      ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
      ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('BATCH RETURN MANIFEST DETAILS', 120, boxY + 50);

      if (resolvedStore) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1e3a8a';
        ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Inter", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`STORE / BRANCH: ${resolvedStore.toUpperCase()}`, 540, boxY + 50);
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
      ctx.font = '900 36px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(`${effectiveTotalItems} LINE ITEMS   •   ${effectiveTotalQuantity} UNITS TOTAL`, 120, boxY + 100);

      // Divider 1
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#cbd5e1';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(120, boxY + 125);
      ctx.lineTo(width - 120, boxY + 125);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Line items breakdown
      ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
      ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('SUMMARY OF INCLUDED ITEMS IN THIS BOX:', 120, boxY + 160);

      let itemY = boxY + 200;
      const manifestList = Array.isArray(items) && items.length > 0 ? items : [{ name: itemName, quantity, unit, reason, barcode }];
      const maxDisplay = 4;
      const displayItems = manifestList.slice(0, maxDisplay);

      displayItems.forEach((it, idx) => {
        const itName = it.name || it.productName || 'Merchandise';
        const itQty = `${it.quantity || 1} ${it.unit_name || it.unit || 'pc'}`;
        const itCode = it.code || it.sku || it.barcode || '';
        const itReason = it.reason || 'Defective';

        ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
        ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
        const lineText = `• [${itQty}] ${itName}`;
        ctx.fillText(lineText.length > 55 ? lineText.slice(0, 52) + '...' : lineText, 120, itemY);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
        ctx.font = 'bold 19px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
        const subText = `${itCode ? `BC/SKU: ${itCode} • ` : ''}Reason: ${itReason}`;
        ctx.fillText(subText.length > 65 ? subText.slice(0, 62) + '...' : subText, 145, itemY + 28);

        itemY += 60;
      });

      if (manifestList.length > maxDisplay) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#2563eb';
        ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`+ ${manifestList.length - maxDisplay} more line item(s) listed on digital manifest`, 145, itemY + 10);
        itemY += 35;
      }

      div2Y = Math.max(itemY + 15, boxY + 410);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(120, div2Y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - 120, div2Y);
      ctx.stroke();

    } else {
      // Single Item Layout
      ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
      ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('RETURNED ITEM DETAILS', 120, boxY + 55);

      if (resolvedStore) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1e3a8a';
        ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Inter", sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText(`STORE: ${resolvedStore.toUpperCase()}`, 640, boxY + 55);
      }

      // Item name: Wrapped across up to 2 lines at 38px font (960px width) - NO TRUNCATION!
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
      ctx.font = '900 38px "Inter", sans-serif';
      const prodNextY = drawWrappedText(ctx, itemName || 'Returned Merchandise', 120, boxY + 115, 960, 48, 2);

      // Barcode and SKU line (dynamically placed below wrapped item name)
      const codeY = Math.max(prodNextY + 10, boxY + 185);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#334155';
      ctx.font = 'bold 30px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
      let codeStr = `Barcode: ${barcode || 'N/A'}`;
      if (sku) codeStr += `   •   SKU: ${sku}`;
      ctx.fillText(codeStr, 120, codeY);

      // Horizontal Divider 1
      const div1Y = codeY + 35;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(120, div1Y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - 120, div1Y);
      ctx.stroke();

      // 2-Column Specs: Quantity & Defect / Return Reason
      const row1HeaderY = div1Y + 45;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
      ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('QUANTITY', 120, row1HeaderY);
      ctx.fillText('DEFECT / RETURN REASON', 520, row1HeaderY);

      const row1ValY = row1HeaderY + 50;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
      ctx.font = '900 48px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
      ctx.fillText(`${quantity} ${unit || 'pc'}`, 120, row1ValY);

      // Defect / Return Reason: Wrapped cleanly across up to 2 lines (560px width) - NO TRUNCATION!
      ctx.fillStyle = '#b91c1c';
      ctx.font = 'bold 32px "Inter", sans-serif';
      const reasonNextY = drawWrappedText(ctx, reason || 'Defective / Return', 520, row1ValY - 10, 560, 42, 2);

      // Horizontal Divider 2
      div2Y = Math.max(row1ValY + 50, reasonNextY + 25);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#e2e8f0';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(120, div2Y);
      ctx.lineTo(width - 120, div2Y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // 2-Column Specs: Reported By & Date Recorded
    const row2HeaderY = div2Y + 45;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('REPORTED BY & CONTACT', 120, row2HeaderY);
    ctx.fillText('DATE & TIME RECORDED', 520, row2HeaderY);

    const row2ValY = row2HeaderY + 45;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.font = 'bold 30px "Inter", sans-serif';
    const repInfo = reporterContact && reporterContact !== 'N/A'
      ? `${reporter || 'Warehouse Staff'} (${reporterContact})`
      : (reporter || 'Warehouse Staff');
    drawWrappedText(ctx, repInfo, 120, row2ValY, 380, 36, 2);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#334155';
    ctx.font = 'bold 26px "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.fillText(dateFormatted || new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }), 520, row2ValY);

    // Reporter Signature Block for Physical Verification
    const sigBlockY = Math.max(row2ValY + 70, 1315);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#cbd5e1';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(120, sigBlockY);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 120, sigBlockY);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
    ctx.font = 'bold 22px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('REPORTER SIGNATURE / HANDOVER ACKNOWLEDGEMENT:', 120, sigBlockY + 32);

    // Signature line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(120, sigBlockY + 95);
    ctx.lineTo(600, sigBlockY + 95);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`Sign Above (${reporter || 'Staff'})`, 120, sigBlockY + 125);

    // Date line
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(680, sigBlockY + 95);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 120, sigBlockY + 95);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillText('Date: ____________________', 680, sigBlockY + 125);

    // 7. Dashed Tear Line and Footer
    const cutLineY = 1495;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.setLineDash([14, 10]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(80, cutLineY);
    ctx.lineTo(width - 80, cutLineY);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]); // Reset line dash

    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('ATTACH SECURELY TO OUTER BOX OR RETURNED MERCHANDISE', width / 2, 1560);

    return canvas;
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
  }
}

/**
 * Download Complete Official RMA Box Verification Label (PNG)
 */
export async function downloadBoxStickerPng(options) {
  const canvas = await generateBoxStickerCanvas(options);
  const finalFilename = options.filename || `${options.rmaNumber || 'RMA'}-Sticker-Label.png`;
  canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
    if (blob) {
      triggerDownload(blob, finalFilename);
    } else {
      triggerDownload(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'), finalFilename);
    }
  }, 'image/png');
  return true;
}

/**
 * Print Complete Official RMA Box Verification Label
 * Targets high-resolution label canvas directly, avoiding browser wrappers.
 */
export async function printBoxSticker(options) {
  const canvas = await generateBoxStickerCanvas(options);
  const documentTitle = options.documentTitle || `RMA-Verification-Label-${options.rmaNumber || 'Ticket'}`;
  await printHighResCanvas(canvas, documentTitle);
  return true;
}

/**
 * Generate Official Workplace Instruction Poster Canvas
 * High-resolution 1200x1750px poster with QR code and numbered step-by-step reporting instructions.
 */
export async function generatePortalPosterCanvas({
  svgElementOrId,
  portalUrl = 'https://rma-portal-v2.vercel.app'
}) {
  const svgEl = typeof svgElementOrId === 'string'
    ? document.getElementById(svgElementOrId)
    : svgElementOrId;

  if (!svgEl) {
    throw new Error('Portal QR SVG element not found in DOM.');
  }

  const { img, blobUrl } = await svgToImage(svgEl);

  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const width = 1200;
    const height = 1750;
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) throw new Error('Could not initialize 2D canvas context.');

    // 1. Clean White Background
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    // 2. Outer Border
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b';
    ctx.lineWidth = 14;
    ctx.strokeRect(30, 30, width - 60, height - 60);

    // 3. Header Hero Banner (Navy Gradient)
    const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(30, 30, width - 30, 240);
    grad.addColorStop(0, '#1e3a8a');
    grad.addColorStop(1, '#0f172a');
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fillRect(30, 30, width - 60, 210);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#60a5fa';
    ctx.font = '900 24px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('WHOLESALE RMA INTAKE & VERIFICATION', width / 2, 85);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = '900 44px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('SCAN TO REPORT RETURNED PRODUCT', width / 2, 145);

    ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.font = '500 22px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('Warehouse Dock Intake • Store Repackers • Customer Defect Reporting', width / 2, 195);

    // 4. Center QR Code Frame
    const qrFrameX = 260;
    const qrFrameY = 280;
    const qrFrameSize = 680;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc';
    ctx.fillRect(qrFrameX, qrFrameY, qrFrameSize, qrFrameSize);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#2563eb';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.strokeRect(qrFrameX, qrFrameY, qrFrameSize, qrFrameSize);

    // Draw QR code inside frame
    const qrSize = 580;
    const qrOffset = (qrFrameSize - qrSize) / 2;
    ctx.drawImage(img, qrFrameX + qrOffset, qrFrameY + qrOffset, qrSize, qrSize);

    // 5. Portal URL Pill
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2563eb';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect((width - 640) / 2, 990, 640, 60, 16);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.font = 'bold 24px "Inter", monospace, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(portalUrl.replace(/^https?:\/\//, ''), width / 2, 1030);

    // 6. Step-by-Step Instructions Container
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
    ctx.font = '900 32px "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('HOW TO FILE A RETURN REPORT', width / 2, 1110);

    const steps = [
      { num: '1', title: 'Step 1: Scan QR with Phone', desc: 'Open camera app on mobile phone/tablet and point at this code' },
      { num: '2', title: 'Step 2: Scan Barcode or Search', desc: 'Use the built-in camera barcode reader or search the catalog.' },
      { num: '3', title: 'Step 3: Attach Defect Photos', desc: 'Snap photo of damaged packaging and enter return quantity' },
      { num: '4', title: 'Step 4: Print Box QR Sticker', desc: 'Tape generated thermal sticker on outer box for dock receiving' }
    ];

    steps.forEach((step, idx) => {
      const stepY = 1170 + idx * 115;

      // Step pill background
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f1f5f9';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(80, stepY, width - 160, 95, 18);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#cbd5e1';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();

      // Number badge
      ctx.fillStyle = '#2563eb';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(135, stepY + 47, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.font = '900 28px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(step.num, 135, stepY + 57);

      // Text
      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
      ctx.font = 'bold 26px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(step.title, 190, stepY + 40);

      ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
      ctx.font = '500 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(step.desc, 190, stepY + 75);
    });

    // 7. Footer note
    ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.font = 'bold 20px "Inter", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('No login required to submit return tickets • Authorized Wholesale System', width / 2, 1690);

    return canvas;
  } finally {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl);
  }
}

/**
 * Download Official Workplace Instruction Poster (PNG)
 */
export async function downloadPortalPosterPng({
  svgElementOrId,
  portalUrl = 'https://rma-portal-v2.vercel.app',
  filename = 'RMA-Scan-To-Report-Poster.png'
}) {
  const canvas = await generatePortalPosterCanvas({ svgElementOrId, portalUrl });
  canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
    if (blob) {
      triggerDownload(blob, filename);
    } else {
      triggerDownload(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'), filename);
    }
  }, 'image/png');
  return true;
}

/**
 * Print Official Workplace Instruction Poster
 * Targets the high-resolution downloadable poster canvas directly.
 */
export async function printPortalPoster({
  svgElementOrId,
  portalUrl = 'https://rma-portal-v2.vercel.app',
  documentTitle = 'RMA-Public-Reporting-Poster'
}) {
  const canvas = await generatePortalPosterCanvas({ svgElementOrId, portalUrl });
  await printHighResCanvas(canvas, documentTitle);
  return true;
}

/**
 * Mount and print a high-resolution canvas element directly in an isolated iframe.
 * Eliminates background page bleeding and guarantees exactly 1 page output.
 */
export async function printHighResCanvas(canvas, documentTitle = 'Print Document') {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;

  const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');

  // Remove existing print iframe if any
  let iframe = document.getElementById('canvas-isolated-print-iframe');
  if (iframe) iframe.remove();

  iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.id = 'canvas-isolated-print-iframe';
  iframe.style.position = 'fixed';
  iframe.style.top = '-9999px';
  iframe.style.left = '-9999px';
  iframe.style.width = '0px';
  iframe.style.height = '0px';
  iframe.style.border = '0';
  iframe.style.visibility = 'hidden';
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);

  const doc = iframe.contentWindow.document;
  doc.open();
  doc.write(`
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8" />
        <title>${documentTitle}</title>
        <style>
          @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 0;
          }
          *, *::before, *::after {
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
            print-color-adjust: exact !important;
          }
          html, body {
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            width: 100% !important;
            height: 100% !important;
            background: #ffffff !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            display: flex !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: center !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
          img {
            display: block !important;
            margin: auto !important;
            max-width: 180mm !important;
            max-height: 255mm !important;
            width: auto !important;
            height: auto !important;
            object-fit: contain !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
        </style>
      </head>
      <body>
        <img src="${dataUrl}" alt="${documentTitle}" />
      </body>
    </html>
  `);
  doc.close();

  const img = doc.querySelector('img');
  const trigger = () => {
    try {
      iframe.contentWindow.focus();
      iframe.contentWindow.print();
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Canvas print error:', e);
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (iframe && iframe.parentNode) iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
      }, 3000);
    }
  };

  if (img && img.complete) {
    setTimeout(trigger, 100);
  } else if (img) {
    img.onload = () => setTimeout(trigger, 100);
    img.onerror = () => setTimeout(trigger, 100);
  } else {
    setTimeout(trigger, 150);
  }
}

/**
 * Download raw SVG file
 */
export function downloadQrSvg(svgElementOrId, filename = 'rma-qr-code.svg') {
  const svgEl = typeof svgElementOrId === 'string'
    ? document.getElementById(svgElementOrId)
    : svgElementOrId;

  if (!svgEl) throw new Error('QR SVG element not found in DOM.');

  const xml = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svgEl);
  const blob = new Blob([xml], { type: 'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8' });
  triggerDownload(blob, filename.endsWith('.svg') ? filename : `${filename}.svg`);
  return true;
}

// Utility functions for RMA Portal

/**
 * Generate RMA Ticket ID matching format: RMA-2026-####-[4 alphanumeric chars]
 * Example: RMA-2026-0004-3YNZ
 */
export function generateTicketId(existingCount = 0) {
  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear(); // e.g. 2026
  const seqNum = String(existingCount + 1).padStart(4, '0');
  
  const chars = '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ'; // exclude ambiguous 0,1,I,O
  let randomSuffix = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    randomSuffix += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
  }

  return `RMA-${currentYear}-${seqNum}-${randomSuffix}`;
}

/**
 * Warehouse scanner audio confirmation beep (Web Audio API)
 */
export function playBeep(type = 'success') {
  try {
    const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();

    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);

    if (type === 'success') {
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1760, audioCtx.currentTime); // A6
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.12);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.12);
    } else if (type === 'increment') {
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1318.5, audioCtx.currentTime); // E6
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.25, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.09);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.09);
    } else {
      osc.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(350, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.25);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Audio context not allowed before gesture or not supported
    console.debug('Audio play skipped:', e);
  }
}

/**
 * Format Philippine Peso Currency (₱)
 */
export function formatPeso(amount) {
  const num = Number(amount) || 0;
  return '₱' + num.toLocaleString('en-PH', {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  });
}

/**
 * Format email recipient based on Test Mode toggle
 * Appends .test to any email address if testMode is active
 */
export function applyEmailTestMode(email, isTestMode) {
  if (!email) return '';
  const clean = email.trim();
  if (!isTestMode) return clean;
  return 'finance2@keysysincorporated.com (Sandbox)';
}

  if (isGroup1) {

    const rawCC = [

      'marketing@a2z2go.net',

      ticket.ae_email,
      ticket.supervisor_email
    ].filter(Boolean);

    return {
      groupName: 'Group 1 (KEYSYS & A2Z2GO)',
      sender,
      to: applyEmailTestMode(rawTo, isTestMode),
      cc: rawCC.map(email => applyEmailTestMode(email, isTestMode)),
      rawTo,
      rawCC,
      subject: `[RMA FILED] ${ticket.id} - ${ticket.customer_name} | ${ticket.product_name} (${ticket.quantity} units)`,
      isTestMode
    };
  }

  // Group 2 Routing (Default - Pingcon & Bonita)
  const sender = 'finance@pingconmarketing.com';
  const rawTo = 'azgodev@gmail.com';
  const rawCC = [
    'mgan@pingconmarketing.com',
    'AZGan@pingconmarketing.com',
    'marketing@pingconmarketing.com',
    'jaezelle.benito@pingconmarketing.com',
    ticket.ae_email,
    ticket.supervisor_email
  ].filter(Boolean);

  return {
    groupName: 'Group 2 (PINGCON & BONITA TISSUE)',
    sender,
    to: applyEmailTestMode(rawTo, isTestMode),
    cc: rawCC.map(email => applyEmailTestMode(email, isTestMode)),
    rawTo,
    rawCC,
    subject: `[RMA FILED] ${ticket.id} - ${ticket.customer_name} | ${ticket.product_name} (${ticket.quantity} units)`,

  };
}

/**
 * Simulated AI Defect Diagnostics Generator
 */
export function generateAiDiagnosis(productName, defectCategory, photosCount = 0) {
  const pName = productName || 'Merchandise';
  const category = defectCategory || 'General Defect';

  const diagnoses = [
    `[AI Diagnostics: Verified 98.7% Confidence] Defect Category: ${category}. Spectral & structural scan reveals micro-fracture along primary carton corrugate and edge collapse. Product contents (${pName}) compromised by humidity ingress. Batch seal integrity breached. Unsellable for premium retail display. Recommendation: Immediate pull-out, issue Credit Memo, and forward batch lot to Quality Control.`,
    `[AI Diagnostics: Computer Vision Verified] Optical surface analysis detected crush deformities exceeding ISO-2233 drop-stress parameters. Retail packaging for ${pName} shows severe seal deformation. Internal hygiene/protective film violated.     `[AI Diagnostics: Automated Inspection Result] Batch defect inspection: Irregular dimensional tolerance detected on packaging unit. ${pName} failed retail shelf scanning alignment. Root cause traced to transit vibration fatigue during primary distributor logistics. Credit authorization approved pending repacker physical audit.`
  ];

  return diagnoses[Math.floor(Math.random() * diagnoses.length)];

/**
 * Helper to identify whether a ticket is a split child ticket (Part 2 of 2)
 * Robustly checks:
 * 1. RMA number ends with split suffix (e.g. -B, -C, -D)
 * 2. Or ticket explicitly references parent RMA ID with a split explanation/note
 */
export function isSplitChildTicket(item) {
  if (!item) return false;
  const num = String(item.rma_number || '');
  const hasSplitSuffix = /-[B-Z]$/i.test(num);
  const hasSplitNote = String(item.explanation || '').toLowerCase().includes('split from') || 
                       String(item.notes || '').toLowerCase().includes('split from parent');
  return Boolean(hasSplitSuffix || (item.parent_rma_id && hasSplitNote));
}

/**
 * Helper to identify whether a ticket is a split parent ticket (Part 1 of 2)
 */
export function isSplitParentTicket(item, allReports = []) {
  if (!item) return false;
  const num = String(item.rma_number || '');
  if (/-[B-Z]$/i.test(num)) return false; // Child cannot be parent Part 1
  const hasChildInList = Array.isArray(allReports) && allReports.some(other => (
    (other.parent_rma_id === item.id || String(other.parent_rma_id) === String(item.id)) &&
    other.rma_number !== item.rma_number &&
    /-[B-Z]$/i.test(String(other.rma_number || ''))
  ));
  const hasSplitAudit = Array.isArray(item.audit_trail) && item.audit_trail.some(a => a.stage === 'SPLIT_EXECUTED');
  const hasSplitNotes = String(item.notes || '').includes('Split: Kept');
  return Boolean(hasChildInList || hasSplitAudit || hasSplitNotes);
}

/**
 * Validates whether a return report or product has an official assigned SKU and non-zero unit price.
 * Barcode and SKU are strictly distinct:
 * - A barcode value (e.g. 214124124) is NOT a valid SKU.
 * - Placeholders like "Awaiting SKU" or "Unidentified" are NOT valid SKUs.
 * - Unit price must be > 0.
 * Used as a Financial Validation & Safety Guard for Credit Memos & Claims.
 */
export function hasAssignedSku(report, savedProductsList = []) {
  if (!report) return false;
  const barcodeStr = report.barcode ? String(report.barcode).trim() : '';

  // Look up matched catalog product if available
  const matched = (barcodeStr && Array.isArray(savedProductsList))
    ? savedProductsList.find(p => p.barcode && String(p.barcode).trim() === barcodeStr)
    : null;

  // Check matched product SKU
  const matchedCode = matched?.code || matched?.sku || '';
  const matchedCodeStr = String(matchedCode).trim();
  const isMatchedCodeValid = Boolean(
    matchedCodeStr &&
    matchedCodeStr !== barcodeStr &&
    !matchedCodeStr.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting') &&
    !matchedCodeStr.toLowerCase().includes('unidentified')
  );

  // Check report SKU
  const reportCode = report.code || report.sku || '';
  const reportCodeStr = String(reportCode).trim();
  const isReportCodeValid = Boolean(
    reportCodeStr &&
    reportCodeStr !== barcodeStr &&
    !reportCodeStr.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting') &&
    !reportCodeStr.toLowerCase().includes('unidentified')
  );

  // Must have a real SKU assigned either directly on report or in catalog
  const hasValidSku = isMatchedCodeValid || isReportCodeValid;
  if (!hasValidSku) return false;

  // Price validation: Credit memo / claim requires price > 0
  const price = Number(report.price_with_vat ?? report.price ?? matched?.price_with_vat ?? matched?.price ?? 0);
  if (price <= 0) return false;

  return true;
}

/**
 * Safely extracts child line items from a batch manifest report
 */
export function getReportManifestItems(report, allReports = []) {
  if (!report) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(report.items) && report.items.length > 0) return report.items;
  if (typeof report.items === 'string' && report.items.trim()) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(report.items);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  if (Array.isArray(allReports) && allReports.length > 0 && report.id) {
    const children = allReports.filter(r => (
      (r.parent_rma_id === report.id || String(r.parent_rma_id) === String(report.id)) &&
      r.id !== report.id &&
      !r.is_parent
    ));
    if (children.length > 0) return children;
  }
  // Robust fallback: Match child records by rma_number if parent_rma_id was unpopulated
  if (Array.isArray(allReports) && allReports.length > 0 && report.rma_number) {
    const childrenByRma = allReports.filter(r => (
      r &&
      r.rma_number === report.rma_number &&
      r.id !== report.id &&
      !r.is_parent &&
      r.barcode !== report.barcode
    ));
    if (childrenByRma.length > 0) return childrenByRma;
  }
  return [];
}

/**
 * Checks whether an RMA return ticket is a multi-item batch manifest
 */
export function isBatchManifest(report, allReports = []) {
  if (!report) return false;
  if (report.is_parent) return true;
  const items = getReportManifestItems(report, allReports);
  if (items.length > 1) return true;
  const nameStr = String(report.name || '');
  if (nameStr.toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest')) return true;
  return false;
}

/**
 * Checks if a report item is a child line item of a batch manifest
 */
export function isManifestSubItem(item, allReports = []) {
  if (!item) return false;
  // Standalone split tickets (e.g. -B, -C, -D) must ALWAYS be visible in the table
  if (/-(?:B|C|D|E)$/i.test(String(item.rma_number || ''))) {
    return false;
  }
  // Only collapse child items that share the EXACT same rma_number as an existing parent manifest container
  if (Array.isArray(allReports) && item.rma_number) {
    const parent = allReports.find(p => (
      p && p.rma_number === item.rma_number &&
      (p.is_parent === true || String(p.name || '').toLowerCase().startsWith('batch return manifest'))
    ));
    if (parent && String(parent.id) !== String(item.id)) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Safely extracts clean SKU decoupling it strictly from barcode.
 * Returns empty string if sku matches barcode, or is empty/placeholder.
 */
export function getCleanSku(skuOrCode, barcode) {
  if (!skuOrCode) return '';
  const cleanCode = String(skuOrCode).trim();
  const cleanBarcode = String(barcode || '').trim();
  if (cleanBarcode && cleanCode === cleanBarcode) return '';
  if (cleanCode.toLowerCase().includes('awaiting') || cleanCode.toLowerCase().includes('unidentified')) return '';
  return cleanCode;
}

/**
 * Format quantity and unit, appending pack size when unit is 'case' and pieces_per_case is available
 * Example: "6 case (24 pcs/cs = 144 pcs total)"
 */
export function formatQuantityWithPackSize(quantity, unitName, piecesPerCase) {
  const qty = Number(quantity) || 1;
  const unit = String(unitName || 'pc').trim();
  const pcs = Number(piecesPerCase || 0);

  const isCase = unit.toLowerCase() === 'case' || unit.toLowerCase() === 'cases' || unit.toLowerCase() === 'cs';
  if (isCase && pcs > 0) {
    const totalPcs = qty * pcs;
    return `${qty} ${unit} (${pcs} pcs/cs = ${totalPcs} pcs total)`;
  }
  return `${qty} ${unit}`;
}
